你是物理教育互动课件的前端开发者。根据给定的 gameSpec、inquiryScript、事理图谱摘要与 telemetrySpec，生成**单文件 HTML**（内联 CSS/JS，无外部依赖）。 要求： - 控件 id 必须与 gameSpec.controls[].id / traceMapExpected 完全一致 - 调节变量用 range 或明确 UI；混淆变量按 confoundingUi.uiStrategy（teach_only 仅教案区说明，勿做成主滑条） - 物理公式与过关判定对齐 gameSpec.constraints 与 winCondition - 含 Observe 反馈：测试/发射后可看到结果提示，支持 retry 式再调 - 预留注释 供后期埋点（含 emit/snapshot/win 模板，与 heat-conduction 样本一致） - 过关 UI 出现时必须调用 emit('snapshot', { controls, winOk: true, hintKey }) 与 emit('win', { winOk: true }) - 页面顶部显示操作提示：「调节参数后点击发射/测试」 - 布局：canvas 主仿真区（id=simCanvas 或 gameSpec.layout.canvasId）+ 控件侧栏/下方（controlsPanel）；range 滑条与数值显示双向同步 - gameSpec.needsContinuousSim 为 true 时：须 requestAnimationFrame 驱动连续动画，update(dt)/draw() 分离，dt=Math.min(50, now-last)；实时显示 gameSpec.dataReadouts 中的物理量；禁止调参即过关（须可见轨迹/读数变化） - 力学/抛体/碰撞/振子/圆周/动量类：须用 requestAnimationFrame 驱动连续动画，禁止仅静态 canvas 重绘 - 须提供发射/测试按钮与复位按钮 - 不要编造 gameSpec 未列出的控件 id - 中文界面 ## 结构范例（拾光离线参照摘要） # 拾光物理仿真模式（离线参照摘要） > 历史来源：`resources/shiguangtongxue/`（离线镜像已移除）· 仅供 Agent HTML 生成 prompt 引用，**不挂载网站**。 ## 布局：canvas 主区 + 控件侧栏 - 左侧/上方：深色仿真区 `#simCanvasArea` + `#simCanvas` - 右侧/下方：浅色控件区 `#controlsPanel` - 移动端纵向堆叠（flex-direction: column） ```html
``` ## DPR 感知画布 ```javascript function resizeCanvas() { const area = document.getElementById('simCanvasArea'); const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1; const w = area.clientWidth, h = area.clientHeight; canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(w * dpr)); canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(h * dpr)); canvas.style.width = w + 'px'; canvas.style.height = h + 'px'; const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); if (ctx) ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0); } ``` ## RAF 主循环（update / draw 分离） ```javascript let last = performance.now(); function loop(now) { const dt = Math.min(50, now - last); last = now; update(dt); draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); } requestAnimationFrame(loop); ``` ## 控件模式 - 每个 range 滑条：label + `input[type=range]` + 数值显示（双向同步） - 主操作：发射/测试按钮（type=button，id 对齐 traceMap） - 辅助：复位、暂停/继续 - 混淆变量：仅 teach 区文案或弱化样式，勿与主滑条同级强调 ## 实时反馈 - 仿真区旁或下方：≥2 个物理量实时读数（速度、位移、能量等） - Observe 区：测试/发射后显示判定结果，支持再调 retry - 过关态：明确文案 + `emit('snapshot', …)` + `emit('win', …)` ## Agent 生成约束（相对拾光的差异） - **单文件 HTML**：内联 CSS/JS，禁止外部 CDN（拾光用 tailwind CDN，Agent 不可用） - **trace 埋点**：保留 `` - **运动类**：必须 RAF + dt 限幅，禁止调参即过关（须可见轨迹/读数变化） ## 参考实验路径 | 类型 | 路径 | |------|------| | 标准 engine 壳 | `senior/mechanics/atwood/index.html` | | 抛体 | `senior/mechanics/projectile/index.html` | | 碰撞 | `senior/mechanics/momentum/index.html` |

<!DOCTYPE html>
<!-- BATCH1-FIXED-CHALLENGE-20260724 -->
<html lang="zh">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>斜面台 · 摩擦探究</title>
  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    body { font-family:var(--font-sans); background: #f5f7fa; padding: 20px; display: flex; justify-content: center; }
    .app { max-width: 720px; width: 100%; background: white; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px 20px 32px; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); }
    h1 { font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 4px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; }
    .sub { color: #4a5568; font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 20px; border-left: 3px solid #3182ce; padding-left: 12px; }
    .canvas-wrap { background: #eef2f6; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    canvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; background: #dce3ed; border-radius: 8px; }
    .control-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 18px 24px; margin: 18px 0 12px; }
    .slider-group { flex: 1 1 180px; min-width: 140px; }
    .slider-group label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; color: #1a202c; margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .slider-group input { width: 100%; accent-color: #2b6cb0; }
    .value-badge { background: #edf2f7; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.8rem; }
    .action-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; margin: 12px 0 16px; }
    .btn { background: #2b6cb0; color: white; border: none; padding: 8px 22px; border-radius: 40px; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.15s; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(43,108,176,0.2); }
    .btn:active { transform: scale(0.96); }
    .btn-outline { background: transparent; border: 1px solid #a0aec0; color: #2d3748; box-shadow: none; }
    .btn-outline:hover { background: #f0f4f8; }
    .observe-box { background: #f0f5fa; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; margin: 12px 0 8px; border-left: 4px solid #3182ce; }
    .observe-box .label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #2c5282; letter-spacing: 0.3px; }
    .observe-box .state { font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 2px; }
    .hint { color: #2d3748; background: #fff9e6; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 0.9rem; margin: 6px 0 10px; border: 1px solid #f6e3b0; }
    .confound-note { background: #f7fafc; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #4a5568; border: 1px dashed #cbd5e0; margin: 8px 0 12px; }
    .win-banner { background: #38a169; color: white; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 40px; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; margin: 8px 0 0; }
    .irrelevant-area { margin-top: 12px; display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; }
    .flex { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .mt-1 { margin-top: 6px; }
  
/* === essence-sidebar-shell (auto) === */
html, body { width:100%; height:100%; margin:0; padding:0 !important; overflow:hidden; }
body { display:block !important; align-items:stretch !important; justify-content:stretch !important; min-height:0 !important; }
#essence-app {
  display:flex; flex-direction:row; width:100%; height:100%; min-height:0;
  background:inherit;
}
#essence-stage {
  position:relative; flex:1; min-width:0; min-height:0;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:#0f172a;
}
#essence-stage canvas {
  display:block; width:100% !important; height:100% !important; max-width:none !important;
  margin:0 !important; border-radius:0 !important; flex:1; min-height:0;
}
#essence-hud {
  position:absolute; top:10px; left:10px; right:10px; z-index:5; pointer-events:none;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; max-width:min(420px, calc(100% - 20px));
}
#essence-hud .essence-title {
  pointer-events:none; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(15,23,42,0.88); color:#e2e8f0; font-size:14px; font-weight:600;
  border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.35);
}
#essence-hud .essence-sub {
  pointer-events:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:10px;
  background:rgba(15,23,42,0.75); color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px;
  border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.25);
}
#essence-bench {
  width:clamp(280px, 28vw, 340px); flex-shrink:0; min-height:0;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  background:#fff; border-left:1px solid #e2e8f0;
  color:#1a202c;
}
#essence-bench .essence-scroll {
  flex:1; overflow-y:auto; padding:14px 16px 8px; min-height:0;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
}
#essence-bench .essence-ft {
  padding:10px 16px 14px; border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0; flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;
}
#essence-bench .slider-group input[type=range],
#essence-bench input[type=range] {
  width:100%; height:28px; margin:0;
}
@media (max-width:720px) {
  #essence-app { flex-direction:column; }
  #essence-stage { flex:1 1 0; min-height:48vh; }
  #essence-bench { width:100%; max-height:min(42vh,360px); border-left:none; border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0; }
}

#essence-stage .canvas-wrap,
#essence-stage .canvas-area,
#essence-stage > div:not(#essence-hud):not(#dual-mode-hud) {
  flex:1; min-height:0; width:100%; height:100%;
  margin:0 !important; padding:0 !important; border-radius:0 !important;
  background:transparent !important; display:flex; align-items:stretch;
}
/* dual-mode HUD 不得吃到舞台 flex 拉伸规则，否则会变成整条白幕遮挡 canvas */
#essence-stage > #dual-mode-hud {
  position:absolute !important; top:10px !important; left:10px !important; right:10px !important;
  width:auto !important; height:auto !important; max-width:none !important;
  flex:none !important; margin:0 !important; padding:0 !important;
  background:transparent !important; align-items:flex-start !important;
  justify-content:flex-start !important; z-index:9; pointer-events:none !important;
}
#essence-stage > #dual-mode-hud .dual-chip,
#essence-stage > #dual-mode-hud #challengeStats {
  height:auto !important; align-self:flex-start !important; flex:none !important;
  pointer-events:auto !important;
}
#essence-bench .essence-scroll > .app,
#essence-bench .essence-scroll > .card,
#essence-bench .essence-scroll > .container,
#essence-bench .essence-scroll > .game {
  display:contents;
}

/* hide original card chrome when wrapped */
.essence-legacy-hide-outer > .app,
.essence-legacy-hide-outer > .card,
.essence-legacy-hide-outer > .container,
.essence-legacy-hide-outer > .game,
.essence-legacy-hide-outer > #app { display:contents; }


/* === dual-mode-shell (auto) === */
#dual-mode-hud {
  position:absolute; top:10px; left:10px; right:10px; z-index:8;
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start;
  gap:8px; pointer-events:none;
}
#dual-mode-hud .dual-chip {
  pointer-events:auto; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  padding:8px 14px; border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.92); border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.45);
  box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(15,23,42,0.12); color:#1e293b; font-size:13px;
}
#dual-mode-hud #modeLabel { font-weight:700; color:#2563eb; }
#dual-mode-hud #timerDisplay { font-family:var(--font-mono); font-weight:600; color:#334155; }
#challengeStats {
  pointer-events:auto; display:none; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  padding:8px 14px; border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.92); border:1px solid rgba(248,113,113,0.45);
  box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(15,23,42,0.12); color:#1e293b; font-size:13px;
}
#challengeStats.is-visible { display:inline-flex; }
#attemptsDisplay { font-weight:700; color:#dc2626; font-size:16px; }
#essence-bench-hd, .dual-bench-hd {
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  padding:12px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0; background:#fff; flex-shrink:0;
}
#essence-bench-hd h1, .dual-bench-hd h1 {
  margin:0; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; color:#1e293b; line-height:1.3;
}
#modeSelect {
  border:1px solid #93c5fd; border-radius:999px; padding:4px 10px;
  font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:#1d4ed8; background:#eff6ff; cursor:pointer;
}
#essence-bench.dual-mode-ready { display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
button.dual-disabled, .dual-disabled { opacity:0.45; pointer-events:none; cursor:not-allowed; }


/* === craft-gold-shell === */
:root{--font-sans:"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",system-ui,sans-serif;--font-mono:ui-monospace,"Cascadia Code",Consolas,monospace;--font-display:var(--font-sans);--font-formula:"Cambria Math","Times New Roman",serif;--craft-accent:#d08850;--craft-bg:#14100c;--craft-panel:#241c14;--craft-text:#f0e6d8;--craft-muted:#a09078;}
html,body{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;overflow:hidden!important;
  font-family:var(--font-sans)!important;background:var(--craft-bg)!important;color:var(--craft-text)!important;}
#essence-app,#app{background:var(--craft-bg)!important;}
#essence-stage,#stage{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%,rgba(255,255,255,.04),transparent 55%),var(--craft-bg)!important;}
#essence-bench,.control-panel,#controls-area,#bench{background:linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-panel) 92%,#fff),var(--craft-panel))!important;border-left:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 35%,transparent)!important;color:var(--craft-text)!important;}
#essence-bench-hd,.dual-bench-hd,.bench-hd,.ctrl-hd{background:rgba(0,0,0,.25)!important;border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 30%,transparent)!important;}
#essence-bench-hd h1,.bench-hd-title,.ctrl-hd{color:var(--craft-accent)!important;}
#essence-bench .essence-scroll,#essence-bench .essence-ft,.bench-scroll,.ctrl-scroll,.ctrl-ft{background:transparent!important;color:var(--craft-text)!important;}
#essence-bench label,.slider-group label,.slabel{color:var(--craft-text)!important;}
#essence-bench .essence-sub,#essence-hud .essence-sub{color:var(--craft-muted)!important;}
#essence-bench .btn,button.btn,.pixel-btn,#btnLaunch{background:var(--craft-accent)!important;border:none!important;color:#0b1020!important;font-weight:700!important;border-radius:12px!important;}
#craft-intro,#craft-win{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
}
#craft-intro[hidden],#craft-win[hidden]{display:none!important;}
.craft-card{
  width:min(440px,92vw);background:var(--craft-panel);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 45%,transparent);
  border-radius:18px;padding:22px 22px 18px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
}
.craft-card h2{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--craft-accent);letter-spacing:1px;}
.craft-card p{margin:0 0 12px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--craft-text);font-size:.95rem;}
.craft-card .formula{font-family:var(--font-formula);font-size:1.05rem;color:#fff;background:rgba(0,0,0,.28);
  border-left:3px solid var(--craft-accent);padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;margin:10px 0 16px;}
.craft-card button{width:100%;padding:12px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--craft-accent);color:#0b1020;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem;}
#craft-gauge{
  margin-top:6px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 30%,transparent);font-size:12px;color:var(--craft-muted);
}
#craft-gauge strong{color:var(--craft-accent);font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:16px;display:block;margin-top:2px;}
.app,.card,.container{background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;color:inherit!important;}
.sub,.hint{color:var(--craft-text)!important;border-left-color:var(--craft-accent)!important;}
/* 清掉原白底蓝条卡片残留，适配 craft 侧栏 */
#essence-bench .observe-box{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.35)!important;border-left:4px solid var(--craft-accent)!important;color:var(--craft-text)!important;
}
#essence-bench .observe-box .label{color:var(--craft-accent)!important;font-weight:700;}
#essence-bench .observe-box .state{color:#fff!important;font-size:1.25rem;}
#essence-bench .value-badge{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.45)!important;color:#ffe0c2!important;
}
#essence-bench .btn-outline{
  background:transparent!important;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 55%,transparent)!important;
  color:var(--craft-text)!important;
}
#essence-bench .hint{
  background:rgba(232,160,106,.16)!important;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 50%,transparent)!important;
  color:var(--craft-text)!important;
}
#craft-gauge{display:none!important;}
#winBanner{display:none!important;}

/* 倒计时高对比：深色芯片 + 亮色字 */
#dual-mode-hud .dual-chip,
#challengeStats,
#essence-stage > #dual-mode-hud .dual-chip,
#essence-stage > #dual-mode-hud #challengeStats{
  background:#0f172a!important;
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 55%,transparent)!important;
  color:#f8fafc!important;
  box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.4)!important;
}
#dual-mode-hud #modeLabel,
#essence-stage > #dual-mode-hud #modeLabel{color:var(--craft-accent)!important;font-weight:700!important;}
#dual-mode-hud #timerDisplay,
#essence-stage > #dual-mode-hud #timerDisplay{
  font-family:var(--font-mono)!important;
  font-weight:700!important;color:#ffe0c2!important;letter-spacing:.5px;
}
#dual-timer-chip span[style*="background"]{background:rgba(255,224,194,.45)!important;}
#attemptsDisplay{color:#fda4af!important;font-weight:800!important;}

/* 侧栏层次（对齐斜抛观感） */
#essence-bench-hd,#essence-bench .dual-bench-hd{
  padding:14px 16px!important;
}
#essence-bench .essence-scroll{padding:16px 16px 10px!important;}
#essence-bench .control-grid{
  display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;gap:14px!important;
  margin:0 0 16px!important;padding:12px!important;border-radius:14px!important;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.22)!important;
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 22%,transparent)!important;
}
#essence-bench .slider-group{flex:none!important;min-width:0!important;width:100%!important;}
#essence-bench .slider-group label{
  font-size:.88rem!important;margin-bottom:6px!important;
}
#essence-bench .observe-box{
  margin:0 0 8px!important;padding:16px!important;border-radius:14px!important;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.32)!important;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04);
}
#essence-bench .essence-ft{
  padding:12px 16px 16px!important;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.18)!important;
  border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 28%,transparent)!important;
}
#essence-bench .essence-ft .btn{
  width:100%!important;padding:12px 16px!important;font-size:1rem!important;
  box-shadow:0 6px 18px color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 35%,transparent)!important;
}
#essence-bench .essence-ft .btn-outline{
  box-shadow:none!important;width:100%!important;padding:10px 14px!important;
}
#essence-bench .action-row{flex-direction:column!important;gap:8px!important;margin:0!important;width:100%;}
#essence-hud{
  top:10px!important;left:auto!important;right:12px!important;
  max-width:min(220px,40%)!important;z-index:6;
  align-items:flex-end!important;
}
#essence-hud .essence-title{
  background:rgba(15,23,42,.9)!important;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 40%,transparent)!important;
  font-size:13px!important;padding:6px 10px!important;
}
#essence-hud .essence-sub{display:none!important;}
#modeSelect{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.35)!important;
  border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 45%,transparent)!important;

}


/* === craft-sidebar-contrast === */
.sub,.hint{color:var(--craft-text)!important;border-left-color:var(--craft-accent)!important;}
#essence-bench .hint,
#essence-bench .hint-msg,
#essence-bench .hint-area,

#essence-bench #hintMsg,

  background:rgba(0,0,0,.28)!important;

  color:var(--craft-text)!important;

    (function() {
      function emit(type, payload) {
        try {
          if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
            window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
            return;
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        try {
          if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
            window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      function snapControls() {
        var o = {};
        document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el) {
          var id = el.id || el.name; if (id) o[id] = el.value;
        });
        return o;
      }

      // 同步挂载，供后续 craft-gold-runtime 包装 __emit → showWin
      window.__traceEmit = emit;
      window.__emit = emit;
      window.__snapControls = snapControls;

      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        emit('puzzle_open', {});

        // tuning 绑定 (滑条)
        document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]').forEach(function(el) {
          el.addEventListener('change', function() {
            if (window.__platformTraceControlsBound) return;
            emit('tuning', { control: el.id || 'slider', value: el.value });
          });
        });

      });
    })();
  </script>

      const btnReset = document.getElementById('btn-reset');

      // t=0 坡底，t=1 坡顶；待机靠坡顶，下滑 t 减小
      const T_TOP = 0.82;
      const T_BOTTOM = 0.12;
      let animating = false;
      let blockT = T_TOP;
      let testCount = 0;
      let sawSlide = false;
      let sawRest = false;
      let lastMu = null;
      let lastTheta = null;
      let won = false;
      let playMode = 'explore';
      let challengeLockedMu = null;
      let layout = { W: 680, H: 280, groundY: 225, BASE_X: 80, BASE_Y: 220, LENGTH: 260 };
      let outcomeFlash = 0; // 成功接货短暂光效
      let outcomeFlashKind = ''; // land | overshoot | stuck
      // 探究/竞赛分流：竞赛接货区更短，同参未必两边同结论；本局 Fixed 不换区
      const ZONE_MODE = {
        explore: { landLimit: -0.36, label: '接货区' },
        challenge: { landLimit: -0.16, label: '急单接货' }
      };
      function zoneCfg() {
        return ZONE_MODE[playMode] || ZONE_MODE.explore;
      }

        const mission = document.getElementById('goalMission');
        const side = document.getElementById('sideGoal');
        if (playMode === 'challenge' && challengeLockedMu != null) {
          if (mission) mission.textContent = '当前急单：μ=' + challengeLockedMu.toFixed(2) + ' 已锁定 · 调 θ 停到接货区 · 本局固定';
          if (side) side.textContent = '竞赛急单：μ 锁定为 ' + challengeLockedMu.toFixed(2) + '。限次只调倾角把货箱停在接货区（卡住或冲过都不换 μ）。';
        } else {
          if (mission) mission.textContent = '试卸：对比卡住、停接货区与冲过';
          if (side) side.textContent = '调 μ 与倾角，对比卡住、停接货区与冲过。';
        }
      }

      function setFrictionLocked(locked, muVal) {
        if (!frictionSlider) return;
        const grp = document.getElementById('group-friction');
        if (locked) {
          frictionSlider.value = String(muVal);
          frictionSlider.disabled = true;
          frictionSlider.style.opacity = '0.55';
          if (grp) grp.title = '竞赛急单：摩擦系数已锁定';

          frictionSlider.disabled = false;

          if (grp) grp.title = '';
        }
        updateLabels();
      }

      /** FixedChallenge：仅进入竞赛时锁定一次 μ；失败禁止重抽 */
      function lockChallengeOrder(reasonHint) {
        const nextMu = Math.round((0.35 + Math.random() * 0.40) * 100) / 100;
        challengeLockedMu = nextMu;
        const safeTheta = Math.max(5, Math.floor(Math.atan(challengeLockedMu) * 180 / Math.PI) - 8);
        setFrictionLocked(true, challengeLockedMu);
        angleSlider.value = String(safeTheta);
        blockT = T_TOP;
        stateDisplay.textContent = '—';
        hintMsg.textContent = (reasonHint || '急单已下发') + '：μ=' + challengeLockedMu.toFixed(2) + ' 已锁定（本局不变），调坡度再测';
        refreshGoalUI();
        idleDraw();
      }

      window.__frictionApplyMode = function(mode) {
        playMode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
        won = false;
        window.__legacyWinEmitted = false;
        testCount = 0; sawSlide = false; sawRest = false;
        lastMu = null; lastTheta = null;
        animating = false; btnTest.disabled = false;
        if (playMode === 'challenge') {
          challengeLockedMu = null;
          lockChallengeOrder('新急单');
        } else {
          challengeLockedMu = null;
          setFrictionLocked(false);
          frictionSlider.value = '0.70';
          angleSlider.value = '30';
          if (massSlider) massSlider.value = '1.0';
          hintMsg.textContent = '货箱状态待测 · 调参后点测试卸货';
          stateDisplay.textContent = '—';
          blockT = T_TOP;
          refreshGoalUI();
          idleDraw();
        }
      };

      function syncCanvasSize() {
        var stage = document.getElementById('essence-stage') || canvas.parentElement;
        var cssW = Math.max(2, (stage && stage.clientWidth) || canvas.clientWidth || 680);
        var cssH = Math.max(2, (stage && stage.clientHeight) || canvas.clientHeight || 280);
        var dpr = Math.min(2.5, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
        canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
        canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
        var bw = Math.round(cssW * dpr);
        var bh = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
        if (canvas.width !== bw || canvas.height !== bh) {
          canvas.width = bw;
          canvas.height = bh;
        }
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
        layout.W = cssW;
        layout.H = cssH;
        layout.groundY = Math.round(cssH * 0.84);
        // 左侧留给接货区，斜面加长以填满舞台中心
        var palletReserve = 120;
        layout.LENGTH = Math.round(Math.min(cssW * 0.58, 0.88 * (layout.groundY - 48)));
        layout.BASE_X = Math.round(Math.max(palletReserve + 16, Math.min(cssW * 0.28, cssW - layout.LENGTH - 80)));
        layout.BASE_Y = layout.groundY - 5;
      }

      function params() {
        const mu = parseFloat(frictionSlider.value);
        const thetaDeg = parseFloat(angleSlider.value);
        const mass = massSlider ? parseFloat(massSlider.value) : 1;
        const thetaRad = thetaDeg * Math.PI / 180;
        const tanTheta = Math.tan(thetaRad);
        const excess = tanTheta - mu;
        const willSlide = excess > 0;
        // 连续停距：超额越大，冲出坡脚越远；中间带落在接货区
        // stopT：≥0 在斜面上；<0 沿地面向左（接货区方向）
        let stopT = T_TOP;
        let outcome = 'stuck';
        if (willSlide) {
          // excess≈0.05 刚进区；越大越冲过；landLimit 按模式分流
          stopT = -(0.04 + excess * 0.95);
          if (stopT < -0.72) stopT = -0.72;
          if (stopT > zoneCfg().landLimit) outcome = 'land';
          else outcome = 'overshoot';
        }
        return { mu, thetaDeg, thetaRad, mass, tanTheta, excess, willSlide, stopT, outcome };
      }

      function updateLabels() {
        const p = params();
        muDisplay.textContent = p.mu.toFixed(2);
        angleDisplay.textContent = p.thetaDeg + '°';
        if (massDisplay) massDisplay.textContent = p.mass.toFixed(1);
      }

      function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
        const rr = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x + rr, y);
        ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, rr);
        ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, rr);
        ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, rr);
        ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, rr);
        ctx.closePath();
      }

      function drawScene(thetaRad, mass, t, sliding) {
        syncCanvasSize();
        const W = layout.W, H = layout.H;
        const groundY = layout.groundY;
        const BASE_X = layout.BASE_X, BASE_Y = layout.BASE_Y, LENGTH = layout.LENGTH;
        const m = (typeof mass === 'number' && isFinite(mass)) ? mass : 1;
        const cosA = Math.cos(thetaRad);
        const sinA = Math.sin(thetaRad);
        const dx = LENGTH * cosA;
        const dy = LENGTH * sinA;
        const topX = BASE_X + dx;
        const topY = BASE_Y - dy;

        const SC = { ink: '#14100c', mid: '#2e2418', hi: '#e8b888', glow: '#e07830', metal: '#7a7060', accent: '#d08850', ok: '#6fae8f' };
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

        // —— 斜面摩擦台：暖色木工坊 ——
        const wall = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
        wall.addColorStop(0, '#1e1810');
        wall.addColorStop(0.35, SC.ink);
        wall.addColorStop(0.72, '#181410');
        wall.addColorStop(1, '#100c08');
        ctx.fillStyle = wall;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

        const tNow = performance.now();
        const lampPulse = 0.92 + 0.08 * Math.sin(tNow * 0.002);
        const flood = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.42, H * 0.06, 8, W * 0.48, groundY * 0.55, Math.max(W, H) * 0.65);
        flood.addColorStop(0, `rgba(224,120,48,${0.20 * lampPulse})`);
        flood.addColorStop(0.4, `rgba(208,136,80,${0.08 * lampPulse})`);
        flood.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(20,16,12,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = flood;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

        // 悬挂工作灯（微摆 + 琥珀光晕）
        const lampX = Math.min(W - 90, topX + 50);
        const lampSwing = Math.sin(tNow * 0.0018) * 5;
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.metal;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(lampX, 6);
        ctx.lineTo(lampX + lampSwing, 52);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.accent;
        roundRect(lampX + lampSwing - 11, 52, 22, 14, 4);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(224,120,48,0.45)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.stroke();
        const lampGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(lampX + lampSwing, 72, 2, lampX + lampSwing, 85, 48);
        lampGlow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(224,120,48,${0.32 * lampPulse})`);
        lampGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(224,120,48,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = lampGlow;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(lampX + lampSwing, 85, 48, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // 加厚工具挂板 + 侧柜
        const pegX = W - 100;
        if (pegX > topX + 40) {
          ctx.fillStyle = SC.mid;
          roundRect(pegX, 118, 78, Math.max(50, groundY - 140), 4);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(122,112,96,0.6)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
          ctx.font = 'bold 10px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
          ctx.fillText('工具板', pegX + 16, 136);
          for (let pi = 0; pi < 5; pi++) {
            ctx.fillStyle = pi % 2 ? SC.metal : SC.accent;
            ctx.fillRect(pegX + 12, 148 + pi * 34, 24, 6);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(232,184,136,0.4)';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(pegX + 52, 158 + pi * 34, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
          }
        }

        // 木屑微尘
        for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
          const px = (i * 83 + tNow * 0.015) % W;
          const py = 36 + (i * 41) % Math.max(40, groundY - 80) + Math.sin(tNow * 0.0012 + i) * 4;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(232,184,136,${0.10 + (i % 3) * 0.04})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, 1 + (i % 2) * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }

        // 木工地坪
        const floor = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, H);
        floor.addColorStop(0, '#3a3228');
        floor.addColorStop(0.5, SC.mid);
        floor.addColorStop(1, SC.ink);
        ctx.fillStyle = floor;
        ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, H - groundY);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.metal;
        ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, 3);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(122,112,96,0.25)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(24 + i * 95, groundY + 6);
          ctx.lineTo(24 + i * 95, H - 6);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(208,136,80,0.15)';
        for (let g = 0; g < 9; g++) ctx.fillRect(20 + g * 78, groundY + 14, 32, 2);

        // 接货托盘：长度随模式 landLimit，目视可辨探究宽区 vs 竞赛短区
        const zc = zoneCfg();
        const palletW = Math.min(BASE_X - 16, Math.max(40, Math.abs(zc.landLimit) * LENGTH * 0.95));
        const palletX = Math.max(8, BASE_X - palletW - 8);
        const palletY = groundY - 6;
        ctx.fillStyle = playMode === 'challenge' ? '#a06030' : SC.accent;
        roundRect(palletX, palletY, palletW, 12, 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = playMode === 'challenge' ? '#7a5028' : '#6a4020';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        const slatN = Math.max(2, Math.floor(palletW / 24));
        for (let i = 0; i < slatN; i++) {
          ctx.fillRect(palletX + 6 + i * (palletW / slatN), palletY - 5, Math.max(10, palletW / slatN - 8), 6);
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15,23,42,0.35)';
        ctx.fillRect(palletX + 8, groundY + 2, palletW - 16, 3);
        // 成功接货短暂光晕 / 冲过警示描边
        if (outcomeFlash > 0) {
          const fa = Math.min(1, outcomeFlash);
          if (outcomeFlashKind === 'land') {
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(74,222,128,${0.85 * fa})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
            ctx.strokeRect(palletX - 3, palletY - 8, palletW + 6, 22);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(74,222,128,${0.18 * fa})`;
            ctx.fillRect(palletX - 3, palletY - 8, palletW + 6, 22);
          } else if (outcomeFlashKind === 'overshoot') {
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(248,113,113,${0.75 * fa})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
            ctx.setLineDash([4, 3]);
            ctx.strokeRect(palletX - 4, palletY - 10, palletW + 8, 26);
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
          }
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = 'bold 11px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(zc.label, palletX + Math.max(4, palletW / 2 - 22), palletY + 28);

        // —— 木质滑道楔体（加厚） ——
        const rampTh = 32;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(BASE_X, BASE_Y);
        ctx.lineTo(topX, topY);
        ctx.lineTo(topX + rampTh, topY);
        ctx.lineTo(topX + rampTh, BASE_Y);
        ctx.closePath();
        const rampFill = ctx.createLinearGradient(BASE_X, topY, topX, BASE_Y);
        rampFill.addColorStop(0, SC.hi);
        rampFill.addColorStop(0.5, SC.accent);
        rampFill.addColorStop(1, '#6a4020');
        ctx.fillStyle = rampFill;
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a2818';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        ctx.stroke();

        // 木板条纹理
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(BASE_X, BASE_Y);
        ctx.lineTo(topX, topY);
        ctx.lineTo(topX + rampTh, topY);
        ctx.lineTo(topX + rampTh, BASE_Y);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.clip();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(58,40,24,0.45)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
        for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
          const u = i / 11;
          const x0 = BASE_X + dx * u;
          const y0 = BASE_Y - dy * u;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x0, y0);
          ctx.lineTo(x0 + rampTh * cosA + 2, y0 + rampTh * sinA);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.restore();

        // 坡面高光边
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(BASE_X, BASE_Y);
        ctx.lineTo(topX, topY);
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.lineWidth = 5;
        ctx.stroke();

        // 坡顶装车台
        const deckW = 68, deckH = 16;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#7a5028';
        roundRect(topX - 6, topY - deckH - 2, deckW, deckH, 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a2818';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3820';
        ctx.fillRect(topX + deckW - 16, topY - deckH - 16, 6, 16);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = 'bold 11px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('装车台', topX, topY - deckH - 20);

        // 量角器弧 + 刻度
        const arcR = 36;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(BASE_X, BASE_Y, arcR, -thetaRad, 0);
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(208,136,80,0.75)`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(BASE_X, BASE_Y, arcR - 6, -thetaRad, 0);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(232,184,136,0.35)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.stroke();
        for (let tick = 0; tick <= 6; tick++) {
          const ta = -thetaRad * (tick / 6);
          const r0 = arcR - 2, r1 = arcR + (tick % 3 === 0 ? 5 : 3);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(BASE_X + Math.cos(ta) * r0, BASE_Y + Math.sin(ta) * r0);
          ctx.lineTo(BASE_X + Math.cos(ta) * r1, BASE_Y + Math.sin(ta) * r1);
          ctx.strokeStyle = tick % 3 === 0 ? SC.hi : 'rgba(122,112,96,0.6)';
          ctx.lineWidth = tick % 3 === 0 ? 1.5 : 1;
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(BASE_X, BASE_Y);
        ctx.lineTo(BASE_X + arcR + 8, BASE_Y);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(232,184,136,0.5)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.stroke();
        const midA = -thetaRad / 2;
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = 'bold 13px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('θ', BASE_X + Math.cos(midA) * (arcR + 14), BASE_Y + Math.sin(midA) * (arcR + 14) + 4);

        // 读数贴坡脚
        const badgeW = 118, badgeH = 48;
        const badgeX = BASE_X + 44;
        const badgeY = Math.max(56, BASE_Y - 78);
        roundRect(badgeX, badgeY, badgeW, badgeH, 10);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,16,12,0.88)';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(208,136,80,0.55)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = '13px ui-monospace,Consolas,"Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('μ = ' + parseFloat(frictionSlider.value).toFixed(2), badgeX + 12, badgeY + 20);
        ctx.fillText('θ = ' + (thetaRad * 180 / Math.PI).toFixed(0) + '°', badgeX + 12, badgeY + 38);

        // —— 木箱货件（硬描边、少 blur）；t<0 表示已离坡沿地面向左滑行 ——
        let objX, objY, onRamp = true;
        if (t >= 0) {
          objX = BASE_X + dx * t;
          objY = BASE_Y - dy * t;
        } else {
          onRamp = false;
          objX = BASE_X + t * LENGTH;
          objY = groundY - 10;
        }
        const size = 16 + Math.min(14, m * 2.4);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(objX, objY);
        ctx.rotate(onRamp ? -thetaRad : 0);
        ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
        ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;
        const crate = ctx.createLinearGradient(-size / 2, -size / 2, size / 2, size / 2);
        if (sliding) {
          crate.addColorStop(0, SC.glow);
          crate.addColorStop(1, SC.accent);
        } else {
          crate.addColorStop(0, SC.hi);
          crate.addColorStop(1, '#8a5830');
        }
        roundRect(-size / 2, -size / 2, size, size, 3);
        ctx.fillStyle = crate;
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a2818';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(58,40,24,0.55)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-size / 2 + 4, -size / 6);
        ctx.lineTo(size / 2 - 4, -size / 6);
        ctx.moveTo(-size / 2 + 4, size / 6);
        ctx.lineTo(size / 2 - 4, size / 6);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = sliding ? '#c04030' : '#6a4020';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, -size / 2 + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(0, size / 2 - 2);
        ctx.moveTo(-size / 2 + 2, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(size / 2 - 2, 0);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();

        // 下滑微尘：落在运动轨迹后方（坡顶一侧，相对向下滑动）
        if (sliding && onRamp && t < 0.75) {
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(232,184,136,0.55)';
          for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            const along = 10 + i * 6;
            const px = objX + Math.cos(thetaRad) * along + (i % 2) * 2;
            const py = objY - Math.sin(thetaRad) * along + 3;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(px, py, 1.4 + (i % 3) * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
          }
        }
        // 冲过接货区时的地面扬尘
        if (sliding && !onRamp) {
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(232,184,136,0.4)';
          for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(objX + 8 + i * 5, groundY - 2, 1.2 + (i % 2) * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
          }
        }
      }

      function idleDraw() {
        if (animating) return;
        const p = params();
        updateLabels();
        blockT = T_TOP;
        drawScene(p.thetaRad, p.mass, blockT, false);
        if (stateDisplay.textContent === '—' || stateDisplay.textContent === '') {
          /* keep */
        }
      }

      function maybeWin(lastOutcome) {
        if (won) return;
        const emit = window.__emit || window.__traceEmit || function(){};
        const controls = window.__snapControls ? window.__snapControls() : {};
        if (playMode === 'challenge') {
          if (lastOutcome !== 'land') {
            // FixedChallenge：失败只提示，μ 保持
            blockT = T_TOP;
            stateDisplay.textContent = lastOutcome === 'overshoot' ? '冲过接货区' : '卡住';
            hintMsg.textContent = lastOutcome === 'overshoot'
              ? ('冲过了：μ=' + (challengeLockedMu != null ? challengeLockedMu.toFixed(2) : '?') + ' 仍锁定。略减小倾角再试（本局不换单）。')
              : ('未卸下：μ=' + (challengeLockedMu != null ? challengeLockedMu.toFixed(2) : '?') + ' 仍锁定。加大倾角再试（本局不换单）。');
            refreshGoalUI();
            idleDraw();
            return;
          }
          won = true;
          emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: 'rush_unload' });
          emit('win', { winOk: true });
          if (typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
            window.__craftShowWin('急单完成：在摩擦系数锁定时，你把货箱停在了接货区——既未卡住，也未冲过。');
          }
          return;
        }
        if (testCount < 3 || !sawSlide || !sawRest) return;
        // 探究：最好见过冲过，但不强制（避免拖太久）；有卡住+卸下即可
        won = true;
        emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: 'critical_explored' });
        emit('win', { winOk: true });
        if (typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
          window.__craftShowWin('你通过对比卡住、停在接货区与冲过远近，归纳出了合适的倾角区间。');
        }
      }

      function fireTest() {
        if (animating) return;
        const p = params();
        updateLabels();
        testCount += 1;
        if (p.willSlide) sawSlide = true; else sawRest = true;
        if (lastMu !== null && (Math.abs(lastMu - p.mu) > 0.001 || Math.abs(lastTheta - p.thetaDeg) > 0.001)) {
          /* param changed across tests — good */
        }
        lastMu = p.mu;
        lastTheta = p.thetaDeg;

        const emit = window.__emit || window.__traceEmit || function(){};
        emit('action', { control: 'btn-test', value: 'test' });

        animating = true;
        btnTest.disabled = true;
        blockT = T_TOP;
        const start = performance.now();
        const duration = p.willSlide ? (p.outcome === 'overshoot' ? 1300 : 1100) : 700;
        const endT = p.willSlide ? p.stopT : T_TOP;

        function frame(now) {
          const u = Math.min(1, (now - start) / duration);
          if (p.willSlide) {
            // 先加速下坡，再按连续停距冲入/冲过接货区
            const ease = u * u;
            blockT = T_TOP + (endT - T_TOP) * ease;
            drawScene(p.thetaRad, p.mass, blockT, true);
            stateDisplay.textContent = p.outcome === 'overshoot' ? '冲过中…' : '卸货中…';
            hintMsg.textContent = '观察货箱停在接货区还是冲过';
          } else {
            // 坡顶微颤后停住

(function(){

  };

      if (typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase === 'function') {
        window.__platformTraceSetPhase(phase);
      } else if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter && typeof window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase === 'function') {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(phase);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* offline */ }
  }

  function fmt(sec){
    var m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    var s = sec % 60;
    return (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;
  }

  function renderAttempts(){
    var el = $('attemptsDisplay');
    if (el) el.textContent = String(state.attempts);
  }

  function primaryButtons(){
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(
      '#essence-bench .essence-ft button, #essence-bench button.btn, #essence-bench button[id^="btn"]'
    ));
  }

  function gateActions(){
    var disable = state.mode === 'challenge' && state.attempts <= 0;
    primaryButtons().forEach(function(btn){
      if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(btn.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(btn.id || '')) return;
      btn.classList.toggle('dual-disabled', disable);
      if (disable) btn.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
      else btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
    });
  }

  function stopTimer(){
    if (state.timerId) { clearInterval(state.timerId); state.timerId = null; }
  }

  function startExploreTimer(){
    stopTimer();
    state.timeLeft = EXPLORE_SECONDS;
    var td = $('timerDisplay');
    if (td) td.textContent = fmt(state.timeLeft);
    state.timerId = setInterval(function(){
      if (state.mode !== 'explore') return;
      state.timeLeft -= 1;
      if (td) td.textContent = fmt(Math.max(0, state.timeLeft));
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        stopTimer();
        var sel = $('modeSelect');
        if (sel) {
          sel.value = 'challenge';
          sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

    state.mode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    var label = $('modeLabel');
    var stats = $('challengeStats');
    var timerChip = $('dual-timer-chip');
    if (label) label.textContent = state.mode === 'explore' ? '探究模式' : '竞赛模式';
    if (stats) {
      if (state.mode === 'challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible');
      else stats.classList.remove('is-visible');
    }
    if (timerChip) timerChip.style.display = state.mode === 'explore' ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    if (state.mode === 'challenge') {
      stopTimer();
      state.attempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS;
      renderAttempts();
    } else {
      startExploreTimer();
    }
    setPhase(state.mode);
    gateActions();
    if (typeof window.__frictionApplyMode === 'function') {
      try { window.__frictionApplyMode(state.mode); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  function onPrimaryClick(e){
    if (state.mode !== 'challenge') return;
    var t = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!t) return;
    if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(t.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(t.id || '')) return;
    if (state.attempts <= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }
    state.attempts -= 1;
    renderAttempts();
    gateActions();
  }

  function ensureUi(){
    var stage = $('essence-stage') || document.querySelector('#proj-stage, #stage, #canvasContainer, .canvas-wrap')?.parentElement;

      stage.style.position = stage.style.position || 'relative';
      stage.appendChild(hud);
    }

    if (bench && !$('modeSelect')) {
      bench.classList.add('dual-mode-ready');
      var hd = document.createElement('div');
      hd.id = 'essence-bench-hd';
      hd.className = 'dual-bench-hd';
      var title = '环境控制台';
      var tEl = stage.querySelector('.essence-title, h1');
      if (tEl) title = (tEl.textContent || title).trim() || title;
      hd.innerHTML =
        '<h1>' + title.replace(/</g,'<') + '</h1>' +
        '<select id="modeSelect" aria-label="探究阶段">' +
          '<option value="explore">自由探究</option>' +
          '<option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>' +
        '</select>';
      bench.insertBefore(hd, bench.firstChild);
    } else if (!$('modeSelect')) {
      // Fallback: floating select in hud
      var chip = $('dual-timer-chip');
      if (chip && !$('modeSelect')) {
        var sel = document.createElement('select');
        sel.id = 'modeSelect';
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="explore">自由探究</option><option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>';
        chip.appendChild(sel);
      }
    }
    return !!$('modeSelect');
  }

  function boot(){
    if (!ensureUi()) return;
    var sel = $('modeSelect');
    sel.addEventListener('change', function(){ applyMode(sel.value); });
    var ft = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .essence-ft') || $('essence-bench') || document.body;
    ft.addEventListener('click', onPrimaryClick, true);
    applyMode(sel.value || 'explore');
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();

## 事理图谱摘要
- 标题：回旋加速器 · 探究轨道半径
- Play 链：P1(premise) → C1(constraint) → C2(constraint) → C3(constraint) → O1(operation) → O2(operation) → C5(constraint) → C4(constraint) → R1(result) → I1(irrelevant)
- 策略途径：单变量·速度；单变量·磁场；单变量·腔室气压；多参盲调；试探·无关控件
- **连续仿真**：须 RAF + 实时读数 + 可见运动轨迹
## 埋点规格（telemetrySpec）

按事理图谱 traceMap 上报：每次滑条/按钮操作记录 controlId、值、时间戳。
snapshot 事件在「发射/测试/提交」时记录各 control 当前值。
评判时将轨迹节点映射到 KG play 链（P1→O1→C*→R1）与 strategy routes。
混淆变量触碰可选记录，但不计入主探究路径得分。

### 事件列表

- **tuning** `s-magnetic` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `s-velocity` → O1（必采）
- **irrelevant_touch** `s-chamber-p` → I1
- **tuning** `modeSelect` → C1（必采）
- **irrelevant_touch** `val-pressure` → I1

### DT 检查点

- decision: 选择模式?
- decision: 观察半径偏大/偏小?
- result: 过关
- retry: 提示偏差
- decision: 观察半径偏大/偏小?
- decision: 半径在目标环带?
- retry: 未命中重试
- result: 过关

<body>

<div id="craft-intro">
  <div class="craft-card">
    <h2>加速舱 · 回旋半径</h2>
    <p>提取口对不准——轨道半径跟 B、v 怎么走？调磁场与入射速度，看轨道半径怎么变。</p>
    <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--craft-muted)">探究与竞赛目标不同；竞赛环带进入后固定，未命中只扣次数。</p>
    <button type="button" id="craftIntroBtn">开始探究</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="craft-win" hidden>
  <div class="craft-card">
    <h2>过关 · 你学到了什么</h2>
    <div class="formula" id="craftWinFormula">r = mv / (qB)</div>
    <p id="craftWinText">对照多组轨道，你摸清了半径如何随 B 与入射速度变化。</p>
    <button type="button" id="craftWinBtn">再玩一次</button>
  </div>
</div>


<div id="app">
    <!-- 顶部提示 -->
    <div class="top-hint">
        <span>⚡ 同位素束流舱</span>
        <i id="goalMission">探究：自由发射，观察半径如何随 B、v 变化</i>
    </div>

    <!-- 主区域 -->
    <div class="main-layout">
        <div id="simCanvasArea" style="position:relative">
            <div id="dual-mode-hud">
              <div id="dual-timer-chip" class="dual-chip"><span id="modeLabel">探究模式</span><span style="opacity:.35">|</span><span id="timerDisplay">10:00</span></div>
              <div id="challengeStats"><span>剩余机会</span><span id="attemptsDisplay">5</span></div>
            </div>
            <canvas id="simCanvas"></canvas>
        </div>
        <div id="controlsPanel">
            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px">
              <strong style="font-size:13px;color:#1f2a44">束流控制台</strong>
              <select id="modeSelect" aria-label="探究阶段"><option value="explore">自由探究</option><option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option></select>
            </div>
            <p id="sideGoal" style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--craft-text)">调 B、v，看轨道半径怎么变。</p>
            <!-- 调节变量：磁感应强度 -->
            <div class="control-group">
                <label>磁感应强度 B <span class="val" id="val-magnetic">1.0 T</span></label>
                <input type="range" id="s-magnetic" min="0.1" max="2.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">
            </div>
            <!-- 调节变量：入射速度 -->
            <div class="control-group">
                <label>入射速度 v <span class="val" id="val-velocity">5.0 m/s</span></label>
                <input type="range" id="s-velocity" min="1" max="10" step="0.5" value="5.0">
            </div>
            <div class="control-group">
                <label>腔室气压 p <span class="val" id="val-pressure">1.0 atm</span></label>
                <input type="range" id="s-chamber-p" min="0.2" max="2.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">
            </div>

            <!-- 实时读数 -->
            <div class="readout-row">
                <span>磁感应强度 B</span>
                <span id="readout-B">1.0 T</span>
            </div>
            <div class="readout-row">
                <span>入射速度 v</span>
                <span id="readout-v">5.0 m/s</span>
            </div>

            <!-- 按钮组 -->
            <div class="button-row">
                <button class="btn btn-primary" id="btn-fire">🚀 发射</button>
                <button class="btn btn-outline" id="btn-reset">↺ 复位</button>
            </div>

            <!-- 混淆变量说明 (仅教案区) -->
            <!-- Observe 反馈区 -->
            <div class="observe-area" id="observeArea">
                <div class="hint-label">📋 观察反馈</div>
                <div class="feedback" id="feedbackMsg">等待发射……</div>
            </div>

            <!-- 过关 UI (初始隐藏) -->
            <div id="winOverlay">
                <h3>✅ 束流对齐提取环</h3>
                <p style="font-size:0.9rem; color:#1f4a3a;">r = <span id="winRadius"></span> m · <span id="winTargetBand">目标环带</span></p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- trace-adapter-hook -->
<script>
(function() {
    // ---------- 埋点模拟 (emit) ----------
    function emit(eventName, payload) {
        console.log(`[telemetry] ${eventName}`, JSON.stringify(payload));
        // 实际适配器可挂载 window.__traceAdapter
        if (window.__traceAdapter && typeof window.__traceAdapter.emit === 'function') {
            window.__traceAdapter.emit(eventName, payload);
        }
    }

    // ---------- DOM 引用 ----------
    const canvas = document.getElementById('simCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const canvasArea = document.getElementById('simCanvasArea');

    const sMag = document.getElementById('s-magnetic');
    const sVel = document.getElementById('s-velocity');
    const sPress = document.getElementById('s-chamber-p');
    const valMag = document.getElementById('val-magnetic');
    const valVel = document.getElementById('val-velocity');
    const valPress = document.getElementById('val-pressure');
    const readoutB = document.getElementById('readout-B');
    const readoutV = document.getElementById('readout-v');
    const feedbackMsg = document.getElementById('feedbackMsg');
    const winOverlay = document.getElementById('winOverlay');
    const winRadiusSpan = document.getElementById('winRadius');
    const btnFire = document.getElementById('btn-fire');
    const btnReset = document.getElementById('btn-reset');

    // ---------- 物理常量 ----------
    const MASS = 1.0;      // kg (固定)
    const CHARGE = 1.0;    // C (固定)

    // ---------- 仿真状态 ----------
    let simRunning = false;
    let animId = null;
    let lastTime = performance.now();

    // 粒子轨迹 (圆周运动)
    let angle = 0;          // 当前弧度
    let angularVel = 0;     // 角速度 rad/s
    let radius = 0;         // 轨道半径 m
    let centerX = 0, centerY = 0; // 画布坐标系圆心
    let scale = 60;         // 像素/米 (根据画布动态调整)

    // 目标半径范围：探究可观察；竞赛 FixedChallenge 进入时锁定一次
    let TARGET_R_MIN = 2.0;
    let TARGET_R_MAX = 3.5;
    let playMode = 'explore';
    let lockedBand = null; // { min, max } 竞赛锁定
    let challengeWon = false;
    /** 仅发射后揭示轨道半径 r */
    let measuredR = null;
    /** 轨道尾迹（纯视觉） */
    let orbitTrail = [];
    let trailTick = 0;

    // 是否已经过关 (防止重复触发)
    let hasWon = false;

    const MODE_GOALS = {
      explore: {
        hud: '试射：观察半径随 B、v 变化',
        side: '调 B、v，看轨道半径怎么变。'
      },
      challenge: {
        hud: '限次把轨道打进本局提取环（打偏不换环）',
        side: '限次把轨道打进本局提取环（打偏不换环）。'
      }
    };

    function refreshCycloGoals() {
      const g = MODE_GOALS[playMode] || MODE_GOALS.explore;
      const mission = document.getElementById('goalMission');
      const side = document.getElementById('sideGoal');
      if (playMode === 'challenge' && lockedBand) {
        const lo = lockedBand.min.toFixed(1);
        const hi = lockedBand.max.toFixed(1);
        if (mission) mission.textContent = '急单提取环：' + lo + '–' + hi + ' m · 本局固定';
        if (side) side.textContent = '竞赛急单：把轨道半径调进 ' + lo + '–' + hi + ' m 提取环。环带已锁定，打偏不换环。';
      } else {
        if (mission) mission.textContent = g.hud;
        if (side) side.textContent = g.side;
      }
      const bandEl = document.getElementById('winTargetBand');
      if (bandEl) bandEl.textContent = '目标 ' + TARGET_R_MIN.toFixed(1) + '~' + TARGET_R_MAX.toFixed(1) + ' m';
    }

    /** FixedChallenge：仅进入竞赛时锁定一次提取环带 */
    function lockChallengeBand() {
      const mid = 1.6 + Math.random() * 1.8; // 1.6–3.4
      const half = 0.25 + Math.random() * 0.25; // 带宽 0.5–1.0
      lockedBand = {
        min: Math.max(0.8, mid - half),
        max: Math.min(4.0, mid + half)
      };
      TARGET_R_MIN = lockedBand.min;
      TARGET_R_MAX = lockedBand.max;
      // 开局张力：默认参数往往偏出环带（r≈0.75）
      sMag.value = '2.0';
      sVel.value = '1.5';
      challengeWon = false;
      hasWon = false;
      syncUI();
      recalcPhysics();
      refreshCycloGoals();
      feedbackMsg.innerHTML = '急单已锁定提取环（本局不变）';
      winOverlay.classList.remove('show');
      drawStatic();
    }

    function applyExploreBand() {
      lockedBand = null;
      challengeWon = false;
      hasWon = false;
      TARGET_R_MIN = 2.0;
      TARGET_R_MAX = 3.5;
      sMag.value = '1.0';
      sVel.value = '5.0';
      syncUI();
      recalcPhysics();
      refreshCycloGoals();
      feedbackMsg.innerHTML = '自由试调：发射后观察半径随 B、v 的变化。';
      winOverlay.classList.remove('show');
      drawStatic();
    }

    window.__cycloApplyMode = function(mode) {
      playMode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
      if (playMode === 'challenge') lockChallengeBand();
      else applyExploreBand();
    };

    // ---------- 画布尺寸 (DPR) ----------
    function resizeCanvas() {
        const area = canvasArea;
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        const w = area.clientWidth;
        const h = area.clientHeight;
        canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(w * dpr));
        canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(h * dpr));
        canvas.style.width = w + 'px';
        canvas.style.height = h + 'px';
        const ctx2 = canvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx2.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
        // 更新圆心 (画布坐标)
        centerX = w / 2;
        centerY = h / 2;
        // 根据画布大小调整scale，使半径可见
        const maxDim = Math.min(w, h) * 0.38;
        // 默认最大半径约 4m，scale = maxDim/4
        scale = Math.max(30, maxDim / 4.5);
    }

    // ---------- 更新物理 (根据当前滑条) ----------
    function recalcPhysics() {
        const B = parseFloat(sMag.value);
        const v = parseFloat(sVel.value);
        // 回旋半径 r = mv/(qB)
        if (B > 0.001) {
            radius = MASS * v / (CHARGE * B);
        } else {
            radius = 999;
        }
        // 角速度 ω = qB/m (rad/s)
        angularVel = CHARGE * B / MASS;
    }

    // ---------- 更新读数 & 滑条同步 ----------
    function syncUI() {
        const B = parseFloat(sMag.value);
        const v = parseFloat(sVel.value);
        const p = sPress ? parseFloat(sPress.value) : 1;
        valMag.textContent = B.toFixed(1) + ' T';
        valVel.textContent = v.toFixed(1) + ' m/s';
        if (valPress) valPress.textContent = p.toFixed(1) + ' atm';
        readoutB.textContent = B.toFixed(1) + ' T';
        readoutV.textContent = v.toFixed(1) + ' m/s';
    }

    // 滑条事件绑定 (双向同步 + 埋点)
    // 调参时收回实测半径虚线，避免边拖边看到 r 结论
    // UI stays live on input; telemetry only on change (one event per gesture).
    function onTuneControl(controlId, value) {
        if (simRunning) stopSim();
        measuredR = null;
        angle = 0;
        orbitTrail = [];
        trailTick = 0;
        syncUI();
        recalcPhysics();
        drawStatic();
        feedbackMsg.innerHTML = '调节中… 点「发射」后显示轨道半径';
    }
    function emitTune(controlId, value) {
        if (window.__platformTraceControlsBound) return;
        emit('tuning', { controlId: controlId, value: value, timestamp: Date.now() });
    }
    sMag.addEventListener('input', function() {
        onTuneControl('s-magnetic', parseFloat(this.value));
    });
    sMag.addEventListener('change', function() {
        emitTune('s-magnetic', parseFloat(this.value));
    });
    sVel.addEventListener('input', function() {
        onTuneControl('s-velocity', parseFloat(this.value));
    });
    sVel.addEventListener('change', function() {
        emitTune('s-velocity', parseFloat(this.value));
    });
    if (sPress) {
      sPress.addEventListener('input', function() {
        syncUI();
        if (!simRunning) drawStatic();
      });
      sPress.addEventListener('change', function() {
        emitTune('s-chamber-p', parseFloat(this.value));
      });
    }

    // ---------- 绘制 (静态/动态) ----------
    function drawChamber(w, h) {
        var SC = { ink:'#0a1216', mid:'#1e343c', hi:'#80d8e0', glow:'#30c8d8', metal:'#6a7880', accent:'#40b8c8', ok:'#6fae8f' };
        const R = Math.min(w, h) * 0.42;

        // 舱室纵深背景
        const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(centerX, centerY, R * 0.2, centerX, centerY, Math.max(w, h) * 0.72);
        bg.addColorStop(0, '#142830');
        bg.addColorStop(0.45, SC.ink);
        bg.addColorStop(1, '#060a0c');
        ctx.fillStyle = bg;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
        var sideGlow = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, w, 0);
        sideGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(48,200,216,0.06)');
        sideGlow.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(10,18,22,0)');
        sideGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(48,200,216,0.06)');
        ctx.fillStyle = sideGlow;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

        // 金属底板 + 格栅
        ctx.fillStyle = '#121a1e';
        ctx.fillRect(0, h - 52, w, 52);
        const floorG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, h - 52, 0, h);
        floorG.addColorStop(0, SC.mid);
        floorG.addColorStop(1, SC.ink);
        ctx.fillStyle = floorG;
        ctx.fillRect(0, h - 48, w, 48);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(106,120,128,0.35)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (var gi = 0; gi < 14; gi++) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(gi * (w / 13), h - 48);
            ctx.lineTo(gi * (w / 13) - 18, h);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.metal;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, h - 48);
        ctx.lineTo(w, h - 48);
        ctx.stroke();

        // 上下磁极（铜包钢，圆柱截面）
        function drawPole(cy, label) {
            var poleW = R * 1.55, poleH = 28;
            var pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(centerX - poleW / 2, cy, centerX + poleW / 2, cy);
            pg.addColorStop(0, '#4a4038');
            pg.addColorStop(0.25, '#a08058');
            pg.addColorStop(0.5, '#c8a878');
            pg.addColorStop(0.75, '#806848');
            pg.addColorStop(1, '#3a3028');
            ctx.fillStyle = pg;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(centerX, cy, poleW / 2, poleH / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(128,216,224,0.35)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
            ctx.font = 'bold 11px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(label, centerX, cy + 4);
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        }
        drawPole(centerY - R - 22, 'N 极');
        drawPole(centerY + R + 22, 'S 极 · B⊗');

        // 圆柱真空室外壳（双层玻璃感）
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,52,60,0.55)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, R + 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        var shellG = ctx.createRadialGradient(centerX - R * 0.3, centerY - R * 0.3, R * 0.1, centerX, centerY, R + 20);
        shellG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(128,216,224,0.08)');
        shellG.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(30,52,60,0.35)');
        shellG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(64,184,200,0.18)');
        ctx.fillStyle = shellG;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, R + 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.metal;
        ctx.lineWidth = 8;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(128,216,224,0.25)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, R + 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();

        // 舱内真空暗区 + 气压雾感（s-chamber-p 纯外观，不改轨道半径）
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,12,16,0.72)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, R - 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        var pAtm = sPress ? parseFloat(sPress.value) : 1;
        var pNorm = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (pAtm - 0.2) / 1.8));
        if (pNorm > 0.02) {
            var haze = ctx.createRadialGradient(centerX, centerY, R * 0.15, centerX, centerY, R - 6);
            haze.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(160,190,200,' + (0.02 + pNorm * 0.10) + ')');
            haze.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(120,160,170,' + (0.04 + pNorm * 0.16) + ')');
            haze.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(80,120,130,' + (0.06 + pNorm * 0.22) + ')');
            ctx.fillStyle = haze;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, R - 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,220,230,' + (0.12 + pNorm * 0.25) + ')';
            ctx.font = '11px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('气压 ' + pAtm.toFixed(1) + ' atm', centerX, centerY + R - 18);
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
            for (var bi = 0; bi < Math.floor(3 + pNorm * 10); bi++) {
                var ba = (bi * 2.4 + pNorm * 3) % (Math.PI * 2);
                var br = (R - 28) * (0.35 + (bi % 5) * 0.12);
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,210,220,' + (0.08 + pNorm * 0.12) + ')';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(centerX + Math.cos(ba) * br, centerY + Math.sin(ba) * br, 1.2 + (bi % 3) * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }
        }

        // D 形电极（半圆dee）
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(64,184,200,0.14)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, R - 8, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2, false);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, R - 8, Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2, false);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(48,200,216,0.10)';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.accent;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(centerX, centerY - R + 8);
        ctx.lineTo(centerX, centerY + R - 8);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(128,216,224,0.4)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, R - 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();

        // 弱磁场线（⊗ 符号阵列）
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(128,216,224,0.22)';
        ctx.font = '10px ui-monospace,monospace';
        for (var bi = -2; bi <= 2; bi++) {
            for (var bj = -2; bj <= 2; bj++) {
                if (bi * bi + bj * bj > 5) continue;
                ctx.fillText('⊗', centerX + bi * 38 - 4, centerY + bj * 34 + 4);
            }
        }

        // 提取环带（竞赛锁定 / 探究参考）
        if (playMode === 'challenge' || lockedBand) {
          const rLo = TARGET_R_MIN * scale;
          const rHi = TARGET_R_MAX * scale;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, (rLo + rHi) / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(111,174,143,0.55)';
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, rHi - rLo);
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.strokeStyle = SC.ok;
          ctx.lineWidth = 3;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, rHi + 6, -0.35, 0.35);
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,18,22,0.82)';
          ctx.fillRect(12, h - 52, 220, 18);
          ctx.fillStyle = SC.ok;
          ctx.font = 'bold 12px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
          ctx.fillText('急单环 ' + TARGET_R_MIN.toFixed(1) + '–' + TARGET_R_MAX.toFixed(1) + ' m', 16, h - 39);
        } else {
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(106,120,128,0.35)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.setLineDash([5, 6]);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, 2.75 * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.setLineDash([]);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,18,22,0.82)';
          ctx.fillRect(12, h - 52, 168, 18);
          ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
          ctx.font = '12px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
          ctx.fillText('参考环（探究不必命中）', 16, h - 39);
        }
        // 场景标题
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,18,22,0.82)';
        ctx.fillRect(12, h - 32, 168, 18);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = 'bold 12px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('回旋轨道舱 · 真空室', 16, h - 19);
        // 控制台指示灯
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.ok;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(w - 36, h - 22, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.glow;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(w - 20, h - 22, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }

    function drawOrbitTrail() {
        if (orbitTrail.length < 2) return;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(orbitTrail[0].x, orbitTrail[0].y);
        for (var ti = 1; ti < orbitTrail.length; ti++) {
            ctx.lineTo(orbitTrail[ti].x, orbitTrail[ti].y);
        }
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(48,200,216,0.18)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 8;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(128,216,224,0.55)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
    }

    function drawOrbitLabels() {
        const hudSafeTop = 56;
        var SC = { hi:'#80d8e0', glow:'#30c8d8', accent:'#40b8c8', ok:'#6fae8f' };
        if (measuredR != null && measuredR > 0 && measuredR < 100) {
            const rPx = measuredR * scale;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, rPx, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
            ctx.strokeStyle = SC.hi;
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
            ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
            ctx.font = '13px sans-serif';
            const labelY = Math.max(hudSafeTop + 14, centerY - rPx - 8);
            ctx.fillText('r = ' + measuredR.toFixed(2) + ' m', centerX + 8, labelY);
        } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,18,22,0.75)';
            ctx.fillRect(centerX - 72, hudSafeTop + 4, 144, 18);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(128,216,224,0.65)';
            ctx.font = '12px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
            ctx.fillText('轨道半径待测 · 点发射', centerX - 64, hudSafeTop + 17);
        }
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, 5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.glow;
        ctx.shadowColor = SC.glow;
        ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.accent;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = '12px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('粒子源', centerX + 10, centerY - 6);
    }

    function drawStatic() {
        const w = canvas.width / (window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
        const h = canvas.height / (window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
        drawChamber(w, h);
        drawOrbitLabels();
    }

    function draw() {
        const w = canvas.width / (window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
        const h = canvas.height / (window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
        drawChamber(w, h);
        drawOrbitTrail();
        drawOrbitLabels();

        // 粒子仅在已测半径后沿该轨道运动（发射后过程可见）
        if (measuredR != null && measuredR > 0 && measuredR < 100) {
            const rPx = measuredR * scale;
            const px = centerX + rPx * Math.cos(angle);
            const py = centerY + rPx * Math.sin(angle);
            if (simRunning) {
                trailTick++;
                if (trailTick % 2 === 0) {
                    orbitTrail.push({ x: px, y: py });
                    if (orbitTrail.length > 140) orbitTrail.shift();
                }
            }
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(px, py, 7, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffb347';
            ctx.shadowColor = '#30c8d8';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(128,216,224,0.6)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            ctx.stroke();
        }
    }

    // ---------- 更新物理 (dt) ----------
    function update(dt) {
        if (!simRunning) return;
        // 角速度更新角度
        const deltaAngle = angularVel * (dt / 1000);
        angle += deltaAngle;
        // 角度归一化
        if (angle > 2 * Math.PI) angle -= 2 * Math.PI;
    }

    // ---------- RAF 循环 ----------
    function loop(now) {
        const dt = Math.min(50, now - lastTime);
        lastTime = now;
        update(dt);
        draw();
        animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }

    function startSim() {
        if (simRunning) return;
        simRunning = true;
        hasWon = false; // 重置过关状态
        winOverlay.classList.remove('show');
        // 重置角度 (从0开始)
        angle = 0;
        recalcPhysics();
        syncUI();
        lastTime = performance.now();
        if (animId) cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
        animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }

    function stopSim() {
        simRunning = false;
        if (animId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
            animId = null;
        }
    }

    function ensureFeedbackVisible() {
        const area = document.getElementById('observeArea');
        const panel = document.getElementById('controlsPanel');
        if (panel && area) {
          const pr = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
          const ar = area.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (ar.bottom > pr.bottom - 2 || ar.top < pr.top + 2) {
            panel.scrollTop = Math.max(0, panel.scrollHeight - panel.clientHeight);
          }
        }
    }

    // ---------- 发射/测试 ----------
    function fire() {
        // 停止当前动画
        stopSim();
        // 重置角度
        angle = 0;
        orbitTrail = [];
        trailTick = 0;
        recalcPhysics();
        syncUI();
        const r = radius;
        measuredR = r;
        const controlsSnapshot = {
            's-magnetic': parseFloat(sMag.value),
            's-velocity': parseFloat(sVel.value)
        };

        if (playMode === 'explore') {
            // 探究：只反馈半径，不要求命中固定环，不重抽目标
            feedbackMsg.innerHTML = `<span class="win"><span class="win-main">当前 r=${r.toFixed(2)} m</span><span class="win-sub">继续对比不同 B、v</span></span>`;
            winOverlay.classList.remove('show');
            emit('snapshot', { controls: controlsSnapshot, winOk: false, hintKey: 'explore_observe' });
            ensureFeedbackVisible();
            startSim();
            return;
        }

        // 竞赛：命中本局锁定环带；失败不换环
        const winOk = (r >= TARGET_R_MIN && r <= TARGET_R_MAX);
        if (winOk) {
            feedbackMsg.innerHTML = `<span class="win"><span class="win-main">✅ 束流对齐提取环</span><span class="win-sub">r=${r.toFixed(2)} m · 环带 ${TARGET_R_MIN.toFixed(1)}–${TARGET_R_MAX.toFixed(1)} m</span></span>`;
            winRadiusSpan.textContent = r.toFixed(2);
            winOverlay.classList.add('show');
            if (!challengeWon) {
              challengeWon = true;
              emit('snapshot', { controls: controlsSnapshot, winOk: true, hintKey: 'cyclo_rush' });
              emit('win', { winOk: true });
              if (typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
                window.__craftShowWin('提取环本局锁定。半径 r=mv/(qB)：B 增大半径缩小，v 增大半径变大。');
              }
            }
            hasWon = true;
        } else {
            // FixedChallenge：失败不换环；偏大/偏小可区分
            const sideTxt = r < TARGET_R_MIN ? '半径偏小（环内）' : '半径偏大（环外）';
            const hintKey = r < TARGET_R_MIN ? 'r_low' : 'r_high';
            feedbackMsg.innerHTML = `<span class="fail"><span class="fail-main">${sideTxt}</span><span class="fail-sub">r=${r.toFixed(2)} m · 环带 ${TARGET_R_MIN.toFixed(1)}–${TARGET_R_MAX.toFixed(1)} m</span></span>`;
            winOverlay.classList.remove('show');
            emit('snapshot', { controls: controlsSnapshot, winOk: false, hintKey: hintKey });
        }

        ensureFeedbackVisible();
        startSim();
    }

    // ---------- 复位 ----------
    function resetSim() {
        stopSim();
        angle = 0;
        measuredR = null;
        orbitTrail = [];
        trailTick = 0;
        recalcPhysics();
        syncUI();
        drawStatic();
        feedbackMsg.innerHTML = '已复位，读数待测 · 点发射后显示半径';
        winOverlay.classList.remove('show');
        hasWon = false;
    }

    // ---------- 事件绑定 ----------
    btnFire.addEventListener('click', fire);
    btnReset.addEventListener('click', resetSim);

    // ---------- 初始化 ----------
    function init() {
        resizeCanvas();
