(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeShell) return;
  window.__dualModeShell = true;

  var MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
  var EXPLORE_SECONDS = 10 * 60;
  var state = {
    mode: 'explore',
    attempts: MAX_ATTEMPTS,
    timeLeft: EXPLORE_SECONDS,
    timerId: null
  };

  function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }

  function setPhase(phase){
    try {
      if (typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase === 'function') {
        window.__platformTraceSetPhase(phase);
      } else if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter && typeof window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase === 'function') {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(phase);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* offline */ }
  }

  function fmt(sec){
    var m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    var s = sec % 60;
    return (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;
  }

  function renderAttempts(){
    var el = $('attemptsDisplay');
    if (el) el.textContent = String(state.attempts);
  }

  function primaryButtons(){
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(
      '#essence-bench .essence-ft button, #essence-bench button.btn, #essence-bench button[id^="btn"]'
    ));
  }

  function gateActions(){
    var disable = state.mode === 'challenge' && state.attempts <= 0;
    primaryButtons().forEach(function(btn){
      if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(btn.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(btn.id || '')) return;
      btn.classList.toggle('dual-disabled', disable);
      if (disable) btn.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
      else btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
    });
  }

  function stopTimer(){
    if (state.timerId) { clearInterval(state.timerId); state.timerId = null; }
  }

  function startExploreTimer(){
    stopTimer();
    state.timeLeft = EXPLORE_SECONDS;
    var td = $('timerDisplay');
    if (td) td.textContent = fmt(state.timeLeft);
    state.timerId = setInterval(function(){
      if (state.mode !== 'explore') return;
      state.timeLeft -= 1;
      if (td) td.textContent = fmt(Math.max(0, state.timeLeft));
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        stopTimer();
        var sel = $('modeSelect');
        if (sel) {
          sel.value = 'challenge';
          sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  function applyMode(mode){
    state.mode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    var label = $('modeLabel');
    var stats = $('challengeStats');
    var timerChip = $('dual-timer-chip');
    if (label) label.textContent = state.mode === 'explore' ? '探究模式' : '竞赛模式';
    if (stats) {
      if (state.mode === 'challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible');
      else stats.classList.remove('is-visible');
    }
    if (timerChip) timerChip.style.display = state.mode === 'explore' ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    if (state.mode === 'challenge') {
      stopTimer();
      state.attempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS;
      renderAttempts();
    } else {
      startExploreTimer();
    }
    setPhase(state.mode);
    gateActions();
    if (typeof window.__cycloApplyMode === 'function') {
      try { window.__cycloApplyMode(state.mode); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  function onPrimaryClick(e){
    if (state.mode !== 'challenge') return;
    var t = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!t) return;
    if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(t.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(t.id || '')) return;
    if (state.attempts <= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }
    state.attempts -= 1;
    renderAttempts();
    gateActions();
  }

  function ensureUi(){
    var stage = $('essence-stage') || $('simCanvasArea') || document.querySelector('#proj-stage, #stage, #canvasContainer, .canvas-wrap')?.parentElement;
    var bench = $('essence-bench') || $('controlsPanel');
    if (!stage) return false;

    if (!$('dual-mode-hud')) {
      var hud = document.createElement('div');
      hud.id = 'dual-mode-hud';
      hud.innerHTML =
        '<div id="dual-timer-chip" class="dual-chip">' +
          '<span id="modeLabel">探究模式</span><span style="width:1px;height:14px;background:#cbd5e1"></span>' +
          '<span id="timerDisplay">10:00</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="challengeStats"><span>剩余机会</span><span id="attemptsDisplay">5</span></div>';
      stage.style.position = stage.style.position || 'relative';
      stage.appendChild(hud);
    }

    if (bench && !$('modeSelect')) {
      bench.classList.add('dual-mode-ready');
      var hd = document.createElement('div');
      hd.id = 'essence-bench-hd';
      hd.className = 'dual-bench-hd';
      var title = '环境控制台';
      var tEl = stage.querySelector('.essence-title, h1');
      if (tEl) title = (tEl.textContent || title).trim() || title;
      hd.innerHTML =
        '<h1>' + title.replace(/</g,'<') + '</h1>' +
        '<select id="modeSelect" aria-label="探究阶段">' +
          '<option value="explore">自由探究</option>' +
          '<option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>' +
        '</select>';
      bench.insertBefore(hd, bench.firstChild);
    } else if (!$('modeSelect')) {
      // Fallback: floating select in hud
      var chip = $('dual-timer-chip');
      if (chip && !$('modeSelect')) {
        var sel = document.createElement('select');
        sel.id = 'modeSelect';
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="explore">自由探究</option><option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>';
        chip.appendChild(sel);
      }
    }
    return !!$('modeSelect');
  }

  function boot(){
    if (!ensureUi()) return;
    var sel = $('modeSelect');
    sel.addEventListener('change', function(){ applyMode(sel.value); });
    var ft = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .essence-ft') || $('essence-bench') || document.body;
    ft.addEventListener('click', onPrimaryClick, true);
    applyMode(sel.value || 'explore');
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>

## 事理图谱摘要
- 标题：RC电路 · 探究
- Play 链：P1(premise) → C1(constraint) → O1(operation) → C2(constraint) → C3(constraint) → C4(constraint) → R1(result)
- 策略途径：单变量·电源电压；单变量·电阻；单变量·电容；多参盲调
## 埋点规格（telemetrySpec）

按事理图谱 traceMap 上报：每次滑条/按钮操作记录 controlId、值、时间戳。
snapshot 事件在「发射/测试/提交」时记录各 control 当前值。
评判时将轨迹节点映射到 KG play 链（P1→O1→C*→R1）与 strategy routes。
混淆变量触碰可选记录，但不计入主探究路径得分。

### 事件列表

- **tuning** `s-resistance` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `s-capacitance` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `s-supply-v` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `modeSelect` → C1（必采）
- **tuning** `tuning` → tuning（必采）
- **snapshot** `snapshot` → tuning（必采）
- **win** `win` → tuning（必采）

### DT 检查点

- decision: 选择模式?
- decision: τ 达标?
- retry: 未达标重试
- result: 过关

(function(){

  function snapControls() {

  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

    // tuning 绑定 (滑条)
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() {

      });

<script>
(function() {
    // ----- 物理与绘图 (共用公式) -----
    const canvas = document.getElementById('chargeCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const wrap = canvas.parentElement;
    let W = 700, H = 360, dpr = 1, animT = 0;
    /** 事件动画：idle | charge | flash | settle；点击时冻结 drivers */
    let eventAnim = null;
    function resizeCanvas() {
        const rect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
        dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        W = Math.max(320, rect.width);
        H = Math.max(240, rect.height);
        canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
        canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
        canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
        updateUI();
    }

    // DOM 元素
    const sR = document.getElementById('s-resistance');
    const sC = document.getElementById('s-capacitance');
    const sU = document.getElementById('s-supply-v');
    const rVal = document.getElementById('resistanceValue');
    const cVal = document.getElementById('capacitanceValue');
    const uVal = document.getElementById('supplyValue');
    const tauDisplay = document.getElementById('tauDisplay');
    const targetTauDisplay = document.getElementById('targetTauDisplay');
    const hintMsg = document.getElementById('hintMessage');
    const winIndicator = document.getElementById('winIndicator');
    const btnTest = document.getElementById('btn-test');

    // 目标时间常数：探究观察；竞赛 FixedChallenge 进入时锁定一次
    let TARGET_TAU_SEC = 2.0;
    let playMode = 'explore';
    let lockedTau = null;
    let challengeWon = false;
    /** 仅测试后揭示 τ */
    let measuredTau = null;

    const MODE_GOALS = {
      explore: {
        hud: '调 R、C，观察充电快慢',
        side: '调 R、C，看时间常数与曲线怎么变。'
      },
      challenge: {
        hud: '限次把 τ 对准本局目标（打偏不换标）',
        side: '限次把 τ 对准本局目标（打偏不换标）。'
      }
    };

    function refreshRcGoals() {
      const g = MODE_GOALS[playMode] || MODE_GOALS.explore;
      const mission = document.getElementById('goalMission');
      const side = document.getElementById('sideGoal');
      if (playMode === 'challenge' && lockedTau != null) {
        if (mission) mission.textContent = '急单目标 τ≈' + TARGET_TAU_SEC.toFixed(1) + ' s · 本局固定';
        if (side) side.textContent = '竞赛急单：限次把时间常数调到约 ' + TARGET_TAU_SEC.toFixed(1) + ' s（本局固定，打偏不换目标）。';
        targetTauDisplay.textContent = TARGET_TAU_SEC.toFixed(1);
      } else {
        if (mission) mission.textContent = g.hud;
        if (side) side.textContent = g.side;
        targetTauDisplay.textContent = '—';
      }
    }

    /** FixedChallenge：仅进入竞赛时锁定一次目标 τ */
    function lockChallengeTau() {
      lockedTau = 0.8 + Math.random() * 2.4; // 0.8–3.2 s
      TARGET_TAU_SEC = Math.round(lockedTau * 10) / 10;
      challengeWon = false;
      sR.value = '20';
      sC.value = '20';
      refreshRcGoals();
      updateUI();
      hintMsg.textContent = '急单已锁定 · 目标 τ≈' + TARGET_TAU_SEC.toFixed(1) + ' s（本局固定）';
      winIndicator.style.display = 'none';
    }

    function applyExploreTau() {
      lockedTau = null;
      challengeWon = false;
      TARGET_TAU_SEC = 2.0;
      sR.value = '20';
      sC.value = '30';
      refreshRcGoals();
      updateUI();
      hintMsg.textContent = '自由试闪 · 调参后观察曲线快慢';
      winIndicator.style.display = 'none';
    }

    window.__rcApplyMode = function(mode) {
      playMode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
      if (playMode === 'challenge') lockChallengeTau();
      else applyExploreTau();
    };

    // 更新显示数值 & 绘图
    function computeTau() {
        const R = parseFloat(sR.value) || 1;   // kΩ
        const C = parseFloat(sC.value) || 1;   // μF
        // τ = R * C  (ms)
        const tau_ms = R * C;
        const tau_s = tau_ms / 1000;
        return { R, C, tau_ms, tau_s };
    }

    function updateUI() {
        const { R, C, tau_ms, tau_s } = computeTau();
        rVal.textContent = R + ' kΩ';
        cVal.textContent = C + ' μF';
        if (uVal && sU) uVal.textContent = parseFloat(sU.value).toFixed(1) + ' V';
        tauDisplay.textContent = measuredTau != null ? measuredTau.toFixed(3) : '—';
        if (playMode === 'challenge') targetTauDisplay.textContent = TARGET_TAU_SEC.toFixed(1);
        else targetTauDisplay.textContent = '—';
        drawChargeCurve(tau_ms);
    }

    function mapTauToDur(tau_s) {
        // τ 典型 0.001–10s → 可见动画 0.45–1.4s
        const t = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(5, tau_s || 0.05));
        return 0.45 + (Math.log10(t + 0.05) - Math.log10(0.1)) / (Math.log10(5.05) - Math.log10(0.1)) * 0.95;
    }

    function stepEventAnim(dt) {
        if (!eventAnim) return;
        eventAnim.t += dt;
        const d = eventAnim.drivers;
        const chargeDur = d.chargeDur;
        const flashDur = 0.12;
        const settleDur = Math.max(0.25, d.totalDur - chargeDur - flashDur);
        if (eventAnim.phase === 'charge') {
            if (eventAnim.t >= chargeDur) {
                eventAnim.phase = 'flash';
                eventAnim.t = 0;
            }
        } else if (eventAnim.phase === 'flash') {
            if (eventAnim.t >= flashDur) {
                eventAnim.phase = 'settle';
                eventAnim.t = 0;
            }
        } else if (eventAnim.phase === 'settle') {
            if (eventAnim.t >= settleDur) {
                eventAnim = null;
            }
        }
    }

    function drawChargeCurve(tau_ms) {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
        const live = computeTau();
        const Ulive = sU ? (parseFloat(sU.value) || 9) : 9;
        const drv = eventAnim ? eventAnim.drivers : null;
        const tau_ms_draw = drv ? drv.tau_ms : tau_ms;
        const U = drv ? drv.U : Ulive;
        const uNorm = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(1, U / 15));
        const rc = drv ? { R: drv.R, C: drv.C, tau_ms: drv.tau_ms, tau_s: drv.tau_s } : live;
        let charge = 0;
        let flashBoost = 0;
        let scopeFrac = (animT * 0.4) % 1;
        if (eventAnim) {
            const d = eventAnim.drivers;
            if (eventAnim.phase === 'charge') {
                const p = Math.min(1, eventAnim.t / Math.max(0.05, d.chargeDur));
                charge = 1 - Math.exp(-p * 4.5);
                scopeFrac = p;
            } else if (eventAnim.phase === 'flash') {
                charge = 1;
                flashBoost = 1 - eventAnim.t / 0.12;
                scopeFrac = 1;
            } else {
                charge = 0.92 + 0.08 * Math.exp(-eventAnim.t * 3);
                flashBoost = Math.max(0, 0.35 - eventAnim.t);
                scopeFrac = Math.min(1, 0.85 + eventAnim.t * 0.3);
            }
        } else {
            // idle：τ 驱动呼吸充电，U 驱动亮度
            const breath = tau_ms_draw > 0 ? (1 - Math.exp(-((animT * (0.22 + 0.35 / Math.max(0.15, tau_ms_draw / 1000))) % 1) * 4)) : 0;
            charge = breath * (0.55 + 0.45 * uNorm);
        }
        charge = Math.min(1, charge * (0.65 + 0.35 * uNorm) + flashBoost * 0.25);
        const tauNear = playMode === 'challenge' && measuredTau != null && Math.abs(measuredTau - TARGET_TAU_SEC) < 0.05;
        const band = eventAnim ? eventAnim.band : (tauNear ? 'ok' : (measuredTau != null && playMode === 'challenge'
            ? (measuredTau < TARGET_TAU_SEC ? 'low' : 'high') : null));
        let safeR = 255, safeG = 90, safeB = 40;
        if (band === 'ok') { safeR = 125; safeG = 186; safeB = 140; }

        const bandBoost = eventAnim && eventAnim.phase !== 'charge' ? 0.1 : (tauNear ? 0.06 : 0);

        const safe = ctx.createRadialGradient(W - 48, 36, 4, W - 48, 36, 160);

        ctx.fillStyle = safe; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

        ctx.arc(W - 55, 36, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

        // 木工作台

        desk.addColorStop(0, tauNear ? '#3a3428' : '#3a2a1c'); desk.addColorStop(1, '#1a120c');
        ctx.fillStyle = desk; ctx.fillRect(0, deskY, W, H - deskY);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + (tauNear ? 125 : 255) + ',' + (tauNear ? 186 : 106) + ',' + (tauNear ? 140 : 40) + ',' + (0.06 + charge * 0.14) + ')';
        ctx.fillRect(0, deskY, W, 8);

        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(232,160,106,0.12)';
        for (let i = 1; i < 5; i++) {
          const y = deskY + 10 + i * 12;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); ctx.stroke();
        }

        // ── 英雄：闪光电容单元（~40%W，勿放大示波器）──
        const fx = 22, fy = Math.max(110, H * 0.22), fw = Math.min(280, W * 0.40), fh = H * 0.46;
        const body = ctx.createLinearGradient(fx, fy, fx + fw, fy + fh);
        body.addColorStop(0, '#4a5560'); body.addColorStop(0.45, '#2a323a'); body.addColorStop(1, '#1a2026');
        ctx.fillStyle = body;
        roundSoft(fx, fy, fw, fh, 12); ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(232,160,106,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        roundSoft(fx, fy, fw, fh, 12); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#151a1e';
        ctx.fillRect(fx + 14, fy + 14, fw - 28, 22);
        for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#5a6570';

        }
        // R / C 元件块 + 连线
        const rBoxX = fx + 16, rBoxY = fy + fh * 0.55, rBoxW = fw * 0.28, rBoxH = 28;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#a08058';
        roundSoft(rBoxX, rBoxY, rBoxW, rBoxH, 4); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e6d8';
        ctx.font = 'bold 11px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('R', rBoxX + rBoxW * 0.4, rBoxY + 18);
        const cBoxX = fx + fw * 0.38, cBoxY = rBoxY;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#6a7888';
        roundSoft(cBoxX, cBoxY, fw * 0.22, rBoxH, 4); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e6d8';
        ctx.fillText('C', cBoxX + 14, cBoxY + 18);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(232,160,106,' + (0.45 + charge * 0.45) + ')';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5 + charge * 1.5;
        ctx.shadowColor = '#ff6a28';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 4 + charge * 10;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(rBoxX + rBoxW, rBoxY + rBoxH / 2);
        ctx.lineTo(cBoxX, cBoxY + rBoxH / 2);
        ctx.lineTo(cBoxX + fw * 0.11, fy + 70);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        // 电容罐 + 清晰充电环
        const canX = fx + fw * 0.22, canY = fy + 58, canR = 28;
        const canG = ctx.createRadialGradient(canX - 8, canY - 8, 2, canX, canY, canR);
        canG.addColorStop(0, '#c8d0d8'); canG.addColorStop(0.6, '#6a7888'); canG.addColorStop(1, '#2a323c');
        ctx.fillStyle = canG; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(canX, canY, canR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8a7060'; ctx.fillRect(canX - 12, canY - canR - 8, 24, 10);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,30,24,0.55)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 6; ctx.arc(canX, canY, canR + 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,106,40,' + (0.45 + charge * 0.55) + ')';
        ctx.lineWidth = 5; ctx.shadowColor = '#ff6a28'; ctx.shadowBlur = 8 + charge * 10;
        ctx.arc(canX, canY, canR + 9, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + charge * Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        // 闪光灯头
        const hx = fx + fw * 0.7, hy = fy + 58;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1e22';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx - 32, hy - 10); ctx.lineTo(hx + 40, hy - 22); ctx.lineTo(hx + 40, hy + 22); ctx.lineTo(hx - 32, hy + 10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
        const flashPulse = 0.15 + charge * 0.7 * uNorm + 0.1 * Math.sin(animT * 6) + flashBoost * 0.85;
        const beamR = 55 + 40 * uNorm + flashBoost * 50;
        const beam = ctx.createRadialGradient(hx + 24, hy, 2, hx + 24, hy, beamR);
        beam.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,220,160,' + (0.55 * flashPulse) + ')');
        beam.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,106,40,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = beam; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(hx + 24, hy, beamR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        if (eventAnim && eventAnim.phase === 'flash') {
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,245,220,' + (0.25 * flashBoost) + ')';
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        }
        // 充电流光点（R→C→闪光）；事件期加速
        const flowSpeed = eventAnim ? (1.2 + uNorm) : 0.45;
        const flow = eventAnim ? Math.min(1, (eventAnim.phase === 'charge' ? eventAnim.t / Math.max(0.05, eventAnim.drivers.chargeDur) : 1))
          : ((animT * flowSpeed) % 1);
        const fpx = rBoxX + rBoxW + (cBoxX - rBoxX - rBoxW) * Math.min(1, flow * 2);
        const fpy = rBoxY + rBoxH / 2;
        const flowR = 2.5 + charge * 2.5;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6a28'; ctx.shadowColor = '#ff6a28'; ctx.shadowBlur = 6 + charge * 12;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(fpx, fpy, flowR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        if (flow > 0.5) {
          const t2 = (flow - 0.5) * 2;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(cBoxX + fw * 0.11 * (1 - t2) + hx * t2 * 0.15, cBoxY + (hy - cBoxY) * t2, flowR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c48a';
        ctx.font = 'bold 13px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('闪光电容单元', fx + 16, fy + fh - 36);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#a89880';
        ctx.font = '12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('R ' + rc.R + ' kΩ  ·  C ' + rc.C + ' μF', fx + 16, fy + fh - 16);

        // ── 次要：示波器面板（勿作英雄）──
        const ox = fx + fw + 18, oy = H * 0.2, ow = Math.min(W - ox - 16, W * 0.48), oh = H * 0.42;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#12161a';
        roundSoft(ox, oy, ow, oh, 8); ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(138,150,164,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        roundSoft(ox, oy, ow, oh, 8); ctx.stroke();
        // 铍铜旋钮
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          const kx = ox + ow - 28, ky = oy + 28 + i * 28;
          const kg = ctx.createRadialGradient(kx - 2, ky - 2, 1, kx, ky, 8);
          kg.addColorStop(0, '#f5c48a'); kg.addColorStop(1, '#8a5a28');
          ctx.fillStyle = kg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(kx, ky, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        }
        const plotL = ox + 16, plotR = ox + ow - 40, plotT = oy + 36, plotB = oy + oh - 18;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#060a0c';
        ctx.fillRect(plotL - 4, plotT - 8, plotR - plotL + 8, plotB - plotT + 16);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#c8b090';
        ctx.font = 'bold 12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('示波 · 充电曲线', plotL, oy + 22);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(125,186,140,0.12)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (let i = 1; i < 6; i++) {
          const x = plotL + (i / 6) * (plotR - plotL);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, plotT); ctx.lineTo(x, plotB); ctx.stroke();
        }
        for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) {
          const y = plotT + (i / 4) * (plotB - plotT);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(plotL, y); ctx.lineTo(plotR, y); ctx.stroke();
        }
        if (tau_ms_draw > 0) {
          const maxT = 5 * tau_ms_draw;
          const scaleX = (plotR - plotL) / maxT;
          const scaleY = (plotB - plotT);
          const curveCol = band === 'ok' ? '#7dba8c' : (band === 'high' ? '#6eb8e8' : (band === 'low' ? '#ff8a40' : '#7dba8c'));
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.strokeStyle = curveCol;
          ctx.lineWidth = 2.4 + (eventAnim ? 0.8 : 0);
          ctx.shadowColor = curveCol;
          ctx.shadowBlur = 6 + flashBoost * 8;
          for (let t = 0; t <= maxT; t += Math.max(0.5, maxT / 200)) {
            const v = 1 - Math.exp(-t / tau_ms_draw);
            const x = plotL + t * scaleX;
            const y = plotB - v * scaleY;
            if (t === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
          }
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          // 测试点击重启扫描；事件期用 scopeFrac
          const tScan = scopeFrac * maxT;
          const vScan = 1 - Math.exp(-tScan / tau_ms_draw);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(plotL + tScan * scaleX, plotB - vScan * scaleY, 3.5 + uNorm * 2 + flashBoost * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = band === 'ok' ? '#7dba8c' : '#ff6a28';
          ctx.fill();
        }
        const tau_s = tau_ms_draw / 1000;
        const tauTol = playMode === 'challenge' ? 0.05 : 0.08;
        const on = playMode === 'challenge' && measuredTau != null && Math.abs(measuredTau - TARGET_TAU_SEC) < tauTol;
        const badgeX = W - 216, badgeY = H - 112;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,14,10,0.88)';
        roundSoft(badgeX, badgeY, 200, 40, 6); ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = on ? 'rgba(125,186,140,0.65)' : 'rgba(232,160,106,0.4)';
        roundSoft(badgeX, badgeY, 200, 40, 6); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e6d8';
        ctx.font = '12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        if (playMode === 'challenge') {
          ctx.fillText('急单 τ ≈ ' + TARGET_TAU_SEC.toFixed(1) + ' s', badgeX + 10, badgeY + 16);
        } else {
          ctx.fillText('探究观察快慢', badgeX + 10, badgeY + 16);
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = on && measuredTau != null ? '#7dba8c' : '#e8a06a';
        if (measuredTau != null) {
          ctx.fillText('当前 ' + measuredTau.toFixed(3) + ' s', badgeX + 10, badgeY + 32);
        } else {
          ctx.fillText('当前 τ 待测 · 点测试后显示', badgeX + 10, badgeY + 32);
        }
    }
    function roundSoft(x, y, w, h, r) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + r, y); ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
      ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r); ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
      ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r); ctx.closePath();
    }

    // 过关判定 (基于τ)
    function checkWin(tau_s) {
        if (playMode !== 'challenge') return false;
        // 竞赛容差仍紧于探究观感带，但短时可对准
        const diff = Math.abs(tau_s - TARGET_TAU_SEC);
        return diff < 0.05;
    }

    // 测试/发射动作 (snapshot + win)；立即 emit，动画用冻结 drivers
    function onTest() {
        if (eventAnim) return;
        const { R, C, tau_ms, tau_s } = computeTau();
        const U = sU ? (parseFloat(sU.value) || 9) : 9;
        measuredTau = tau_s;
        tauDisplay.textContent = measuredTau.toFixed(3);
        const controls = {};
        controls['s-resistance'] = R;
        controls['s-capacitance'] = C;

        const totalDur = mapTauToDur(tau_s);
        const chargeDur = totalDur * 0.55;
        let band = 'explore';
        let winOk = false;
        let hintKey = 'explore_observe';

        if (playMode === 'explore') {
            hintMsg.textContent = '本次 τ=' + tau_s.toFixed(3) + ' s · 继续对比 R、C';
            winIndicator.style.display = 'none';
        } else {
            winOk = checkWin(tau_s);
            hintKey = winOk ? 'win' : (tau_s < TARGET_TAU_SEC ? 'tau_low' : 'tau_high');
            band = winOk ? 'ok' : (tau_s < TARGET_TAU_SEC ? 'low' : 'high');
            if (winOk) {
                hintMsg.textContent = '急单完成 · 时间常数已对准';
                if (!challengeWon) {
                  challengeWon = true;
                  if (typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
                    window.__craftShowWin('目标 τ 本局锁定。时间常数由 R 与 C 共同决定，乘积越大曲线上升越慢。');
                  }
                }
                winIndicator.style.display = 'inline-block';
            } else {
                const sideTxt = tau_s < TARGET_TAU_SEC ? 'τ 偏小（曲线偏快）' : 'τ 偏大（曲线偏慢）';
                hintMsg.innerHTML = '<strong>' + sideTxt + '</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.82em;opacity:.92">目标仍锁 ≈' + TARGET_TAU_SEC.toFixed(1) + ' s · 再调 R/C</span>';
                winIndicator.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }

        eventAnim = {
            phase: 'charge',
            t: 0,
            band: band,
            drivers: { R: R, C: C, U: U, tau_ms: tau_ms, tau_s: tau_s, totalDur: totalDur, chargeDur: chargeDur }
        };

        try {
            if (window.__emit_snapshot) {
                window.__emit_snapshot(controls, winOk, hintKey);
            }
        } catch(e) {}

        if (winOk) {
            try {
                if (window.__emit_win) {
                    window.__emit_win();
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        }
    }

    // 绑定滑条更新（事件动画期间忽略，避免劫持冻结 drivers）
    sR.addEventListener('input', function() {
        if (eventAnim) return;
        measuredTau = null;
        updateUI();
        winIndicator.style.display = 'none';
        hintMsg.textContent = '调节中 · 点击测试查看 τ';
    });
    sC.addEventListener('input', function() {
        if (eventAnim) return;
        measuredTau = null;
        updateUI();
        winIndicator.style.display = 'none';
        hintMsg.textContent = '调节中 · 点击测试查看 τ';
    });
    if (sU) sU.addEventListener('input', function() {
        if (eventAnim) return;
        measuredTau = null;
        updateUI();
    });

    btnTest.addEventListener('click', onTest);

    window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined' && wrap) new ResizeObserver(resizeCanvas).observe(wrap);
    resizeCanvas();
    hintMsg.textContent = '偏离目标 · 调 R/C 后点测试';
    (function loop() {
      animT += 0.016;
      stepEventAnim(0.016);
      const tauDraw = eventAnim ? eventAnim.drivers.tau_ms : computeTau().tau_ms;
      drawChargeCurve(tauDraw);
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    })();

    // ----- 埋点扩展 (snapshot & win 通过全局函数暴露) -----
    window.__emit_snapshot = function(controls, winOk, hintKey) {
        // 使用 hook 的 emit
        var payload = { controls: controls, winOk: winOk, hintKey: hintKey };
        try {
            if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
                window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record('snapshot', payload);
            } else if (window.parent && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
                window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record('snapshot', payload);
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    };
    window.__emit_win = function() {
        try {
            if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
                window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record('win', { winOk: true });
            } else if (window.parent && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
                window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record('win', { winOk: true });
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    };

    // 额外: 在测试时也通过 hook 直接 emit snapshot (兼容)
    // 但为了确保, 在 onTest 中已经调用了 __emit_snapshot 和 __emit_win
    // 同时保留原有 hook 的 tuning 绑定

})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  function emitWin(hintKey) {
    if (window.__legacyWinEmitted) return;
    window.__legacyWinEmitted = true;
    var emit = window.__emit;
    if (!emit) return;
    var controls = window.__snapControls ? window.__snapControls() : {};
    emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: hintKey || 'legacy_win' });
    emit('win', { winOk: true });
  }
  var WIN_TEXT = [/完美命中/, /游戏胜利/, /过关！/, /命中目标！/, /🎯\s*命中目标/, /🏆\s*过关/];
  function scanWinText() {
    var text = document.body ? document.body.innerText : '';
    for (var i = 0; i < WIN_TEXT.length; i++) {
      if (WIN_TEXT[i].test(text)) {
        emitWin('text_' + i);
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function() { scanWinText(); });
    if (document.body) obs.observe(document.body, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true });
    setInterval(scanWinText, 800);
  });
})();
</script>

  window.addEventListener('resize', fit);

    var st = document.getElementById('essence-stage');
    if (st) new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(st);
  }
  fit();
})();

(function(){

  }

  function gateActions(){
    var disable = state.mode === 'challenge' && state.attempts <= 0;
    primaryButtons().forEach(function(btn){
      if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(btn.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(btn.id || '')) return;
      btn.classList.toggle('dual-disabled', disable);
      if (disable) btn.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
      else btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
    });
  }

  function stopTimer(){
    if (state.timerId) { clearInterval(state.timerId); state.timerId = null; }
  }

  function startExploreTimer(){
    stopTimer();
    state.timeLeft = EXPLORE_SECONDS;
    var td = $('timerDisplay');
    if (td) td.textContent = fmt(state.timeLeft);
    state.timerId = setInterval(function(){
      if (state.mode !== 'explore') return;
      state.timeLeft -= 1;
      if (td) td.textContent = fmt(Math.max(0, state.timeLeft));
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        stopTimer();
        var sel = $('modeSelect');
        if (sel) {
          sel.value = 'challenge';
          sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  function applyMode(mode){
    state.mode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    var label = $('modeLabel');
    var stats = $('challengeStats');
    var timerChip = $('dual-timer-chip');
    if (label) label.textContent = state.mode === 'explore' ? '探究模式' : '竞赛模式';
    if (stats) {
      if (state.mode === 'challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible');
      else stats.classList.remove('is-visible');
    }
    if (timerChip) timerChip.style.display = state.mode === 'explore' ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    if (state.mode === 'challenge') {
      stopTimer();
      state.attempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS;
      renderAttempts();
    } else {
      startExploreTimer();
    }
    setPhase(state.mode);
    gateActions();
    if (typeof window.__rcApplyMode === 'function') {
      try { window.__rcApplyMode(state.mode); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  function onPrimaryClick(e){
    if (state.mode !== 'challenge') return;
    var t = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!t) return;
    if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(t.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(t.id || '')) return;
    if (state.attempts <= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }
    state.attempts -= 1;
    renderAttempts();
    gateActions();
  }

  function ensureUi(){
    var stage = $('essence-stage') || document.querySelector('#proj-stage, #stage, #canvasContainer, .canvas-wrap')?.parentElement;
    var bench = $('essence-bench');
    if (!stage) return false;

    if (!$('dual-mode-hud')) {
      var hud = document.createElement('div');

          '<span id="timerDisplay">10:00</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="challengeStats"><span>剩余机会</span><span id="attemptsDisplay">5</span></div>';
      stage.style.position = stage.style.position || 'relative';
      stage.appendChild(hud);
    }

    if (bench && !$('modeSelect')) {
      bench.classList.add('dual-mode-ready');
      var hd = document.createElement('div');
      hd.id = 'essence-bench-hd';
      hd.className = 'dual-bench-hd';
      var title = '环境控制台';
      var tEl = stage.querySelector('.essence-title, h1');
      if (tEl) title = (tEl.textContent || title).trim() || title;
      hd.innerHTML =
        '<h1>' + title.replace(/</g,'<') + '</h1>' +
        '<select id="modeSelect" aria-label="探究阶段">' +
          '<option value="explore">自由探究</option>' +
          '<option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>' +
        '</select>';
      bench.insertBefore(hd, bench.firstChild);
    } else if (!$('modeSelect')) {
      // Fallback: floating select in hud
      var chip = $('dual-timer-chip');
      if (chip && !$('modeSelect')) {
        var sel = document.createElement('select');
        sel.id = 'modeSelect';
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="explore">自由探究</option><option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>';
        chip.appendChild(sel);
      }
    }
    return !!$('modeSelect');
  }

  function boot(){
    if (!ensureUi()) return;
    var sel = $('modeSelect');
    sel.addEventListener('change', function(){ applyMode(sel.value); });
    var ft = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .essence-ft') || $('essence-bench') || document.body;
    ft.addEventListener('click', onPrimaryClick, true);
    applyMode(sel.value || 'explore');
  }

/* === essence-sidebar-shell (auto) === */
html, body { width:100%; height:100%; margin:0; padding:0 !important; overflow:hidden; }
body { display:block !important; align-items:stretch !important; justify-content:stretch !important; min-height:0 !important; }
#essence-app {
  display:flex; flex-direction:row; width:100%; height:100%; min-height:0;
  background:inherit;
}
#essence-stage {
  position:relative; flex:1; min-width:0; min-height:0;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:#0f172a;
}
#essence-stage canvas {
  display:block; width:100% !important; height:100% !important; max-width:none !important;
  margin:0 !important; border-radius:0 !important; flex:1; min-height:0;
}
#essence-hud {
  position:absolute; top:10px; left:10px; right:10px; z-index:5; pointer-events:none;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; max-width:min(420px, calc(100% - 20px));
}
#essence-hud .essence-title {
  pointer-events:none; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(15,23,42,0.88); color:#e2e8f0; font-size:14px; font-weight:600;
  border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.35);
}
#essence-hud .essence-sub {
  pointer-events:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:10px;
  background:rgba(15,23,42,0.75); color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px;
  border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.25);
}
#essence-bench {
  width:clamp(280px, 28vw, 340px); flex-shrink:0; min-height:0;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  background:#fff; border-left:1px solid #e2e8f0;
  color:#1a202c;
}
#essence-bench .essence-scroll {
  flex:1; overflow-y:auto; padding:14px 16px 8px; min-height:0;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
}
#essence-bench .essence-ft {
  padding:10px 16px 14px; border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0; flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;
}
#essence-bench .slider-group input[type=range],
#essence-bench input[type=range] {
  width:100%; height:28px; margin:0;
}
@media (max-width:720px) {
  #essence-app { flex-direction:column; }
  #essence-stage { flex:1 1 0; min-height:48vh; }
  #essence-bench { width:100%; max-height:min(42vh,360px); border-left:none; border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0; }
}

#essence-stage .canvas-wrap,
#essence-stage .canvas-area,
#essence-stage > div:not(#essence-hud):not(#dual-mode-hud) {
  flex:1; min-height:0; width:100%; height:100%;
  margin:0 !important; padding:0 !important; border-radius:0 !important;
  background:transparent !important; display:flex; align-items:stretch;
}

/* dual-mode HUD 不得吃到舞台 flex 拉伸规则 */
#essence-stage > #dual-mode-hud {
  position:absolute !important; top:10px !important; left:10px !important; right:10px !important;
  width:auto !important; height:auto !important; max-width:none !important;
  flex:none !important; margin:0 !important; padding:0 !important;
  background:transparent !important; align-items:flex-start !important;
  justify-content:flex-start !important; z-index:9; pointer-events:none !important;
}
#essence-stage > #dual-mode-hud .dual-chip,
#essence-stage > #dual-mode-hud #challengeStats {
  height:auto !important; align-self:flex-start !important; flex:none !important;
  pointer-events:auto !important;
}
#essence-bench .essence-scroll > .app,
#essence-bench .essence-scroll > .card,
#essence-bench .essence-scroll > .container,
#essence-bench .essence-scroll > .game {
  display:contents;
}

/* hide original card chrome when wrapped */
.essence-legacy-hide-outer > .app,
.essence-legacy-hide-outer > .card,
.essence-legacy-hide-outer > .container,
.essence-legacy-hide-outer > .game,
.essence-legacy-hide-outer > #app { display:contents; }


/* === dual-mode-shell (auto) === */
#dual-mode-hud {
  position:absolute; top:10px; left:10px; right:10px; z-index:8;
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start;
  gap:8px; pointer-events:none;
}
#dual-mode-hud .dual-chip {
  pointer-events:auto; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  padding:8px 14px; border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.92); border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.45);
  box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(15,23,42,0.12); color:#1e293b; font-size:13px;

#dual-mode-hud #timerDisplay { font-family:var(--font-mono); font-weight:600; color:#334155; }
#challengeStats {
  pointer-events:auto; display:none; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  padding:8px 14px; border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.92); border:1px solid rgba(248,113,113,0.45);
  box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(15,23,42,0.12); color:#1e293b; font-size:13px;
}
#challengeStats.is-visible { display:inline-flex; }
#attemptsDisplay { font-weight:700; color:#dc2626; font-size:16px; }
#essence-bench-hd, .dual-bench-hd {
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  padding:12px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0; background:#fff; flex-shrink:0;
}
#essence-bench-hd h1, .dual-bench-hd h1 {
  margin:0; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; color:#1e293b; line-height:1.3;
}
#modeSelect {
  border:1px solid #93c5fd; border-radius:999px; padding:4px 10px;
  font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:#1d4ed8; background:#eff6ff; cursor:pointer;
}
#essence-bench.dual-mode-ready { display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
button.dual-disabled, .dual-disabled { opacity:0.45; pointer-events:none; cursor:not-allowed; }

<script>
  (function(){
    function emit(type, payload) {
      try {
        if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
          window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
          return;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      try {
        if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
          window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    function snapControls() {
      var o = {};
      document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el) {
        var id = el.id || el.name; if (id) o[id] = el.value;
      });
      return o;
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      emit('puzzle_open', {});

      // 绑定 tuning 事件 (滑条)
      document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]').forEach(function(el) {
        el.addEventListener('change', function() {
          if (window.__platformTraceControlsBound) return;
          emit('tuning', { control: el.id || 'slider', value: el.value });
        });
      });

      // 无关控件 I1
      var i1 = document.getElementById('I1');
      if (i1) {
        i1.addEventListener('click', function() {
          emit('irrelevant_touch', { control: 'I1', value: 'click' });
        });
      }
    });
  })();

<script>
  (function() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('lensCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const sliderU = document.getElementById('s-object-distance');
    const sliderF = document.getElementById('s-focal-length');
    const sliderD = document.getElementById('s-aperture');
    const valU = document.getElementById('objDistVal');
    const valF = document.getElementById('focalLenVal');
    const valD = document.getElementById('apertureVal');
    const btnTest = document.getElementById('btn-test');
    const btnReset = document.getElementById('btn-reset');
    const observeResult = document.getElementById('observeResult');
    const winMessage = document.getElementById('winMessage');
    const hintMessage = document.getElementById('hintMessage');

    let W = 640, H = 360;
    let SCREEN_DIST_CM = 22; // 透镜到光屏距离 (cm)；竞赛时锁定一次
    let layout = { axisY: 220, lensX: 320, screenX: 540, pxPerCm: 10 };
    let playMode = 'explore';
    let lockedScreen = null;
    let challengeWon = false;
    /** 仅测试后揭示成像判定 */
    let measured = false;
    /** 事件动画 FSM：idle(null) | windup | peak | settle；点击时冻结 drivers */
    let eventAnim = null;
    let ambientT = 0;
    let lastFrameTs = 0;
    const MODE_GOALS = {
      explore: {
        hud: '试像：观察像距随 u、f 变化',
        side: '调物距与焦距，看像落点怎么变。'
      },
      challenge: {
        hud: '限次把实像调到本局光屏（打偏不换屏）',
        side: '限次把实像调到本局光屏（打偏不换屏）。'
      }
    };
    function refreshLensGoals() {
      const g = MODE_GOALS[playMode] || MODE_GOALS.explore;
      const mission = document.getElementById('goalMission');
      const side = document.getElementById('sideGoal');
      if (playMode === 'challenge' && lockedScreen != null) {
        if (mission) mission.textContent = '急单光屏距：' + lockedScreen + ' cm · 本局固定';
        if (side) side.textContent = '竞赛急单：限次把实像调到距透镜 ' + lockedScreen + ' cm 的光屏（本局固定，打偏不换屏）。';
      } else {
        if (mission) mission.textContent = g.hud;
        if (side) side.textContent = g.side;
      }
    }
    /** FixedChallenge：仅进入竞赛时锁定一次光屏距 */
    function lockChallengeScreen() {
      const cands = [16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28];
      lockedScreen = cands[Math.floor(Math.random() * cands.length)];
      SCREEN_DIST_CM = lockedScreen;
      challengeWon = false;
      sliderU.value = '30';
      sliderF.value = '12';
      valU.textContent = '30 cm';
      valF.textContent = '12 cm';
      refreshLensGoals();
      drawScene(getU(), getF());
      observeResult.innerHTML = '急单已锁定光屏距 ' + SCREEN_DIST_CM + ' cm（本局不变）';
      winMessage.style.display = 'none';
    }
    function applyExploreScreen() {
      lockedScreen = null;
      SCREEN_DIST_CM = 22;
      challengeWon = false;
      refreshLensGoals();
      drawScene(getU(), getF());
      observeResult.innerHTML = '自由试像：观察像落点（探究不要求固定屏距）';
      winMessage.style.display = 'none';
    }
    window.__lensApplyMode = function(mode) {
      playMode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
      if (playMode === 'challenge') lockChallengeScreen();
      else applyExploreScreen();
    };
    document.addEventListener('dual-mode-change', function(ev) {
      var m = ev && ev.detail && ev.detail.mode;
      if (typeof window.__lensApplyMode === 'function') window.__lensApplyMode(m);
    });
    /* BATCH6-FIXED-20260724 FixedChallenge */

    function syncCanvasSize() {
      var stage = document.getElementById('essence-stage') || canvas.parentElement;
      var cssW = Math.max(2, (stage && stage.clientWidth) || 640);
      var cssH = Math.max(2, (stage && stage.clientHeight) || 360);
      var dpr = Math.min(2.5, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
      canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
      var bw = Math.round(cssW * dpr), bh = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
      if (canvas.width !== bw || canvas.height !== bh) { canvas.width = bw; canvas.height = bh; }
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      W = cssW; H = cssH;
      layout.axisY = Math.round(H * 0.55);
      layout.lensX = Math.round(W * 0.48);
      layout.pxPerCm = Math.min(15, Math.max(8, W / 68));
      layout.screenX = layout.lensX + SCREEN_DIST_CM * layout.pxPerCm;
      return layout;
    }

    function getU() { return parseFloat(sliderU.value); }
    function getF() { return parseFloat(sliderF.value); }

    function computeImageDistance(u, f) {
      if (u <= 0 || f <= 0) return NaN;
      if (Math.abs(u - f) < 0.0001) return Infinity;
      return 1 / ((1/f) - (1/u));
    }

    function isImageOnScreen(u, f) {
      const v = computeImageDistance(u, f);
      if (!isFinite(v) || isNaN(v)) return false;
      // 探究容差较宽；竞赛更紧，同参未必两边同结论
      const tol = playMode === 'challenge' ? 1.2 : 2.0;
      return Math.abs(v - SCREEN_DIST_CM) < tol;
    }

    function getHintKey(u, f) {
      const v = computeImageDistance(u, f);
      if (!isFinite(v) || isNaN(v)) return '当前参数下不成像';
      if (v < 0) return '成虚像，光屏上看不到';
      const tol = playMode === 'challenge' ? 1.2 : 2.0;
      if (Math.abs(v - SCREEN_DIST_CM) >= tol) {
        return v < SCREEN_DIST_CM ? '像偏近（落在屏前）' : '像偏远（落在屏后）';
      }
      return 'success';
    }

    function computeBand(u, f) {
      return isImageOnScreen(u, f) ? 'ok' : 'miss';
    }

    function mapDefocusToDur(defocus) {
      const d = Math.max(0, Math.min(15, defocus || 0));
      return 0.4 + (d / 15) * 1.1;
    }

    function getEventPhaseDurs() {
      if (!eventAnim) return { windupDur: 0.2, peakDur: 0.12, settleDur: 0.3 };
      const d = eventAnim.drivers;
      const windupDur = Math.max(0.12, d.totalDur * 0.28);
      const peakDur = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(0.18, d.totalDur * 0.15));
      const settleDur = Math.max(0.15, d.totalDur - windupDur - peakDur);
      return { windupDur: windupDur, peakDur: peakDur, settleDur: settleDur };
    }

    function stepEventAnim(dt) {
      if (!eventAnim) return;
      eventAnim.t += dt;
      const ph = getEventPhaseDurs();
      const band = eventAnim.drivers.band;
      if (eventAnim.phase === 'windup') {
        if (eventAnim.t >= ph.windupDur) { eventAnim.phase = 'peak'; eventAnim.t = 0; }
      } else if (eventAnim.phase === 'peak') {
        if (eventAnim.t >= ph.peakDur) { eventAnim.phase = 'settle'; eventAnim.t = 0; }
      } else if (eventAnim.phase === 'settle') {
        const p = Math.min(1, eventAnim.t / ph.settleDur);
        if (band === 'ok') eventAnim.flashGreen = Math.max(0, 1 - p * 2.8);
        if (eventAnim.t >= ph.settleDur) eventAnim = null;
      }
    }

    function startEventAnim(u, f) {
      const v = computeImageDistance(u, f);
      const defocus = (isFinite(v) && v > 0) ? Math.abs(v - SCREEN_DIST_CM) : 15;
      const onScreen = isImageOnScreen(u, f);
      const focusTol = playMode === 'challenge' ? 1.2 : 2.0;
      let focusQual = 0;
      if (isFinite(v) && v > 0) focusQual = Math.max(0, 1 - defocus / (focusTol * 3));
      const Dcm = sliderD ? parseFloat(sliderD.value) : 6;
      const totalDur = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(1.5, mapDefocusToDur(defocus)));
      eventAnim = {
        phase: 'windup', t: 0, flashGreen: 0,
        drivers: { u: u, f: f, v: v, defocus: defocus, band: computeBand(u, f), onScreen: onScreen, Dcm: Dcm, focusQual: focusQual, totalDur: totalDur }
      };
    }

    // 三条主光线：交于真实像尖（ideal thin lens），不瞄光屏假 Y
    function getRayWaypoints(ri, L, objX, f, u, v) {
      const fPx = f * L.pxPerCm;
      const tipY = L.axisY - 60;
      const imageX = L.lensX + v * L.pxPerCm;
      const imageTipY = L.axisY + (-v / u) * (tipY - L.axisY);
      if (ri === 0) {
        // 平行主轴 → 过像方焦点 F' → 像尖
        return [
          { x: objX, y: tipY },
          { x: L.lensX, y: tipY },
          { x: imageX, y: imageTipY }
        ];
      }
      if (ri === 1) {
        // 过光心，不偏折
        return [
          { x: objX, y: tipY },
          { x: L.lensX, y: L.axisY },
          { x: imageX, y: imageTipY }
        ];
      }
      // 过物方焦点 F → 透镜后平行主轴（高度 = 像尖 y）
      return [
        { x: objX, y: tipY },
        { x: L.lensX - fPx, y: L.axisY },
        { x: L.lensX, y: imageTipY },
        { x: imageX, y: imageTipY }
      ];
    }

    function polylineLength(pts) {
      let total = 0;
      for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) total += Math.hypot(pts[i].x - pts[i - 1].x, pts[i].y - pts[i - 1].y);
      return total;
    }

    function pointAlongPolyline(pts, t) {
      const total = polylineLength(pts);
      if (total < 0.001) return { x: pts[0].x, y: pts[0].y, segIdx: 0 };
      let dist = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t)) * total;
      for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
        const seg = Math.hypot(pts[i].x - pts[i - 1].x, pts[i].y - pts[i - 1].y);
        if (dist <= seg) {
          const r = seg ? dist / seg : 0;
          return { x: pts[i - 1].x + (pts[i].x - pts[i - 1].x) * r, y: pts[i - 1].y + (pts[i].y - pts[i - 1].y) * r, segIdx: i - 1 };
        }
        dist -= seg;
      }
      return { x: pts[pts.length - 1].x, y: pts[pts.length - 1].y, segIdx: pts.length - 2 };
    }

    function getRaySweepT() {
      if (!eventAnim) return 1;
      const ph = getEventPhaseDurs();
      const t = eventAnim.t;
      if (eventAnim.phase === 'windup') return Math.min(1, t / Math.max(0.05, ph.windupDur)) * 0.33;
      if (eventAnim.phase === 'peak') return 0.33 + Math.min(1, t / Math.max(0.05, ph.peakDur)) * 0.34;
      return 0.67 + Math.min(1, t / Math.max(0.05, ph.settleDur)) * 0.33;
    }

    function drawRayPath(pts, sweepT, style) {
      const end = pointAlongPolyline(pts, sweepT);
      ctx.strokeStyle = style.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = style.width;
      ctx.setLineDash(style.dash || []);
      ctx.shadowColor = style.shadow || 'transparent';
      ctx.shadowBlur = style.blur || 0;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
      for (let i = 1; i <= end.segIdx; i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
      ctx.lineTo(end.x, end.y);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    }

    function drawScene(u, f) {
      const drv = eventAnim ? eventAnim.drivers : null;
      if (drv) { u = drv.u; f = drv.f; }
      const L = syncCanvasSize();
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      var SC = { ink:'#0c1218', mid:'#243038', hi:'#a0c0e8', glow:'#f0d080', metal:'#6a7888', accent:'#6a9ad0', ok:'#6fae8f' };

      // 暗室背景 + 柔光
      const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
      bg.addColorStop(0, '#101820');
      bg.addColorStop(0.4, SC.ink);
      bg.addColorStop(1, '#080c10');
      ctx.fillStyle = bg;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      // FAR：暗室顶管 + 遮光挡板（顶 y<50）
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,12,16,0.72)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 36);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(106,120,136,0.28)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(W * 0.12, 16);
      ctx.lineTo(W * 0.88, 16);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,28,36,0.55)';
      ctx.fillRect(W * 0.04, 118, 18, H * 0.18);
      ctx.fillRect(W * 0.92, 118, 18, H * 0.18);

      const vFocus = computeImageDistance(u, f);
      const focusTol = playMode === 'challenge' ? 1.2 : 2.0;
      const defocus = drv ? drv.defocus : ((isFinite(vFocus) && vFocus > 0) ? Math.abs(vFocus - SCREEN_DIST_CM) : 15);
      let focusQual = drv ? drv.focusQual : 0;
      if (!drv && isFinite(vFocus) && vFocus > 0) {
        focusQual = Math.max(0, 1 - defocus / (focusTol * 3));
      }
      const ambientPulse = eventAnim ? 0 : (0.04 * Math.sin(ambientT * 2.4));
      const lampA = 0.12 + focusQual * 0.22 + ambientPulse;
      var lamp = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.18, H * 0.12, 4, W * 0.32, H * 0.45, Math.max(W, H) * 0.55);
      lamp.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(240,208,128,' + lampA + ')');
      lamp.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(106,154,208,0.08)');
      lamp.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(12,18,24,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = lamp;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      // 暗室侧墙剪影（吃上空）
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,12,16,0.55)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 100, 36, H * 0.55);
      ctx.fillRect(W - 36, 100, 36, H * 0.55);
      for (let sh = 0; sh < 3; sh++) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,28,36,0.65)';
        ctx.fillRect(8, 130 + sh * 48, 22, 36);
        ctx.fillRect(W - 30, 130 + sh * 48, 22, 36);
      }

      // 顶灯
      var lampX = W * 0.16, lampY = 40;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(106,120,136,0.55)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(lampX, 8);
      ctx.lineTo(lampX, lampY);
      ctx.stroke();
      var shadeG = ctx.createLinearGradient(lampX - 28, lampY, lampX + 28, lampY + 22);
      shadeG.addColorStop(0, '#8a7344');
      shadeG.addColorStop(0.5, SC.glow);
      shadeG.addColorStop(1, SC.metal);
      ctx.fillStyle = shadeG;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(lampX - 30, lampY);
      ctx.lineTo(lampX + 30, lampY);
      ctx.lineTo(lampX + 16, lampY + 24);
      ctx.lineTo(lampX - 16, lampY + 24);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      var lampGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(lampX, lampY + 28, 2, lampX, L.axisY, 110);
      lampGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(240,208,128,' + (0.14 + focusQual * 0.22) + ')');
      lampGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(240,208,128,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = lampGlow;
      ctx.fillRect(0, lampY, W * 0.6, L.axisY - lampY + 30);

      // 实验台台面
      ctx.fillStyle = SC.mid;
      ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.76, W, H * 0.24);
      const benchG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, L.axisY + 36, 0, L.axisY + 58);
      benchG.addColorStop(0, '#3a4858');
      benchG.addColorStop(0.5, SC.metal);
      benchG.addColorStop(1, '#4a5868');
      ctx.fillStyle = benchG;
      ctx.fillRect(W * 0.04, L.axisY + 36, W * 0.92, 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,192,232,0.35)';
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        const x = W * 0.06 + i * (W * 0.055);
        ctx.fillRect(x, L.axisY + 36, 1, i % 5 === 0 ? 20 : 12);
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,18,24,0.8)';
      ctx.fillRect(W * 0.06, H * 0.9 - 14, 110, 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
      ctx.font = 'bold 12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('透镜光具座', W * 0.07, H * 0.9);

      // 主光轴
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(W * 0.06, L.axisY);
      ctx.lineTo(W * 0.94, L.axisY);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160,192,232,0.45)';
      ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);

      // 物：发光箭头板
      const objX = L.lensX - u * L.pxPerCm;
      var mountG = ctx.createLinearGradient(objX - 18, L.axisY + 8, objX + 18, L.axisY + 42);
      mountG.addColorStop(0, '#3a4858');
      mountG.addColorStop(0.5, SC.metal);
      mountG.addColorStop(1, '#4a5868');
      ctx.fillStyle = mountG;
      ctx.fillRect(objX - 16, L.axisY + 8, 32, 36);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#1a2430';
      ctx.fillRect(objX - 14, L.axisY - 72, 28, 72);
      ctx.strokeStyle = SC.glow;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.strokeRect(objX - 14, L.axisY - 72, 28, 72);
      const arrowGlow = ctx.createLinearGradient(objX, L.axisY - 72, objX, L.axisY);
      arrowGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(240,208,128,0.95)');
      arrowGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(106,154,208,0.55)');
      ctx.fillStyle = arrowGlow;
      ctx.shadowColor = SC.glow;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(objX, L.axisY - 68);
      ctx.lineTo(objX + 10, L.axisY - 52);
      ctx.lineTo(objX + 4, L.axisY - 52);
      ctx.lineTo(objX + 4, L.axisY - 8);
      ctx.lineTo(objX - 4, L.axisY - 8);
      ctx.lineTo(objX - 4, L.axisY - 52);
      ctx.lineTo(objX - 10, L.axisY - 52);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
      ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
      ctx.font = '12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('物', objX - 8, L.axisY - 78);

      // 透镜支架加大
      var Dcm = drv ? drv.Dcm : (sliderD ? parseFloat(sliderD.value) : 6);
      var lensHalf = 48 + Dcm * 4.2;
      var standG = ctx.createLinearGradient(L.lensX - 14, L.axisY - lensHalf - 18, L.lensX + 14, L.axisY + lensHalf + 18);
      standG.addColorStop(0, '#5a5040');
      standG.addColorStop(0.45, '#b89858');
      standG.addColorStop(1, '#5a5040');
      ctx.fillStyle = standG;
      ctx.fillRect(L.lensX - 12, L.axisY - lensHalf - 18, 24, lensHalf * 2 + 36);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3428';
      ctx.fillRect(L.lensX - 22, L.axisY + 36, 44, 14);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(106,154,208,0.18)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(L.lensX, L.axisY, 16, lensHalf, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = SC.hi;
      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(L.lensX, L.axisY, 14, lensHalf, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160,192,232,0.4)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(L.lensX - 10, L.axisY - lensHalf * 0.85);
      ctx.lineTo(L.lensX + 10, L.axisY + lensHalf * 0.85);
      ctx.moveTo(L.lensX + 10, L.axisY - lensHalf * 0.85);
      ctx.lineTo(L.lensX - 10, L.axisY + lensHalf * 0.85);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
      ctx.fillText('透镜', L.lensX - 14, L.axisY + lensHalf + 28);

      // 焦点标记
      const fPx = f * L.pxPerCm;
      ctx.fillStyle = SC.glow;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(L.lensX - fPx, L.axisY, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(L.lensX + fPx, L.axisY, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

      // 磨砂光屏（加框）
      const screenW = 26, screenH = 120;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#1a2430';
      ctx.fillRect(L.screenX - screenW/2 - 8, L.axisY - screenH/2 - 12, screenW + 16, screenH + 24);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3a4858';
      ctx.fillRect(L.screenX - screenW/2 - 5, L.axisY - screenH/2 - 8, screenW + 10, screenH + 16);
      const frost = ctx.createLinearGradient(L.screenX - screenW/2, 0, L.screenX + screenW/2, 0);
      frost.addColorStop(0, '#d0d8e0');
      frost.addColorStop(0.5, '#f0f4f8');
      frost.addColorStop(1, '#c8d0d8');
      ctx.fillStyle = frost;
      ctx.fillRect(L.screenX - screenW/2, L.axisY - screenH/2, screenW, screenH);
      // 屏上像亮度（随 focusQual / defocus）：测前淡影预览，测后全彩判定
      if (isFinite(vFocus) && vFocus > 0) {
        const blurPx = Math.min(14, defocus * 1.6);
        const band = drv ? drv.band : computeBand(u, f);
        const flashG = eventAnim ? (eventAnim.flashGreen || 0) : 0;
        const imgBright = measured
          ? (0.08 + focusQual * 0.55)
          : (0.03 + focusQual * 0.16 + ambientPulse * 0.5);
        ctx.save();
        if (eventAnim && band !== 'ok' && (eventAnim.phase === 'peak' || eventAnim.phase === 'settle')) {
          ctx.filter = 'blur(' + blurPx + 'px)';
        }
        const imgColor = band === 'ok' && (flashG > 0 || (measured && focusQual > 0.65))
          ? 'rgba(111,174,143,' + (imgBright + flashG * 0.35) + ')'
          : (band !== 'ok' && measured ? 'rgba(253,164,175,' + (imgBright * 0.85) + ')' : 'rgba(240,208,128,' + imgBright + ')');
        ctx.fillStyle = imgColor;
        ctx.fillRect(L.screenX - screenW/2 + 3, L.axisY - screenH/2 + 8, screenW - 6, screenH - 16);
        ctx.filter = 'none';
        ctx.restore();
        if (measured && focusQual > 0.65 && band === 'ok') {
          ctx.shadowColor = SC.glow;
          ctx.shadowBlur = 6 + focusQual * 14 + flashG * 18;
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(111,174,143,' + (0.3 + focusQual * 0.5 + flashG * 0.4) + ')';
          ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.strokeRect(L.screenX - screenW/2, L.axisY - screenH/2, screenW, screenH);
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        } else if (measured && band !== 'ok') {
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(253,164,175,' + (0.35 + (eventAnim ? 0.25 : 0)) + ')';
          ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.strokeRect(L.screenX - screenW/2, L.axisY - screenH/2, screenW, screenH);
        } else if (!measured && focusQual > 0.4) {
          ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(240,208,128,' + (0.12 + focusQual * 0.2 + ambientPulse) + ')';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
          ctx.strokeRect(L.screenX - screenW/2, L.axisY - screenH/2, screenW, screenH);
          ctx.setLineDash([]);
        }
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = SC.accent;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
      ctx.strokeRect(L.screenX - screenW/2, L.axisY - screenH/2, screenW, screenH);
      ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
      ctx.fillText('光屏', L.screenX - 12, L.axisY + screenH/2 + 22);

      const v = computeImageDistance(u, f);
      const onScreen = drv ? drv.onScreen : isImageOnScreen(u, f);
      const band = drv ? drv.band : computeBand(u, f);
      const sweepT = eventAnim ? getRaySweepT() : 1;
      // 主光线：测前虚线淡预览；测后/事件中实线扫掠
      if (isFinite(v) && v > 0) {
        const imageX = L.lensX + v * L.pxPerCm;
        if (measured && imageX > L.lensX && imageX < W * 0.95 && !eventAnim) {
          ctx.globalAlpha = onScreen ? 0.9 : 0.35;
          ctx.strokeStyle = SC.accent;
          ctx.lineWidth = 3;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(imageX, L.axisY);
          ctx.lineTo(imageX, L.axisY + (onScreen ? 40 : 28));
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
          ctx.font = '12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
          ctx.fillText('像', imageX - 6, L.axisY - 10);
          ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        }
        for (let ri = 0; ri < 3; ri++) {
          const pts = getRayWaypoints(ri, L, objX, f, u, v);
          const isAnim = !!eventAnim;
          const rayDone = !isAnim || sweepT >= 1;
          const rayT = isAnim ? sweepT : 1;
          const rayColor = band === 'ok'
            ? 'rgba(111,174,143,' + (0.45 + ri * 0.12) + ')'
            : (measured ? 'rgba(253,164,175,' + (0.4 + ri * 0.1) + ')' : 'rgba(240,208,128,' + (0.12 + ri * 0.05 + ambientPulse) + ')');
          const rayStyle = {
            color: isAnim ? (band === 'ok' ? 'rgba(240,208,128,0.95)' : 'rgba(253,164,175,0.9)') : rayColor,
            width: (measured || isAnim) ? 2.2 : 1.2,
            dash: (!measured && !isAnim) ? [5, 4] : [],
            shadow: isAnim ? SC.glow : 'transparent',
            blur: isAnim ? (6 + (1 - focusQual) * 10) : 0
          };
          if (isAnim) {
            drawRayPath(pts, rayT, rayStyle);
            const head = pointAlongPolyline(pts, rayT);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(head.x, head.y, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = band === 'ok' ? SC.ok : '#fda4af';
            ctx.shadowColor = SC.glow;
            ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          } else {
            drawRayPath(pts, 1, rayStyle);
          }
          if (measured && rayDone) {
            const tip = pts[pts.length - 1];
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(240,208,128,0.06)';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y - 3);
            ctx.lineTo(pts[1].x, pts[1].y - 6 + ri * 2);
            ctx.lineTo(tip.x, tip.y + 6 - ri * 2);
            ctx.lineTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y + 3);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
          }
        }
      } else if (!eventAnim) {
        // 空闲环境光：物→透镜 faint shimmer
        const tipY = L.axisY - 60;
        for (let ri = 0; ri < 2; ri++) {
          const y0 = tipY + ri * 6;
          const a = 0.06 + 0.04 * Math.sin(ambientT * 2.8 + ri);
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(240,208,128,' + a + ')';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.setLineDash([4, 6]);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(objX, y0);
          ctx.lineTo(L.lensX, y0 + (ri ? 4 : 0));
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.setLineDash([]);
        }
      }

      // 读数放右下，避开顶栏 dual-mode / essence-hud
      const boxW = 220, boxH = 48, boxX = W - boxW - 16, boxY = H - boxH - 72;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,18,24,0.85)';
      ctx.fillRect(boxX, boxY, boxW, boxH);
      ctx.strokeStyle = measured
        ? (onScreen ? 'rgba(111,174,143,0.55)' : 'rgba(200,120,160,0.45)')
        : 'rgba(106,154,208,0.4)';
      ctx.strokeRect(boxX, boxY, boxW, boxH);
      ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
      ctx.font = '12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('物距 ' + u + ' cm · 焦距 ' + f + ' cm', boxX + 10, boxY + 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = measured ? (onScreen ? SC.ok : '#fda4af') : 'rgba(160,192,232,0.65)';
      if (measured) {
        ctx.fillText((playMode==='challenge'?'急单屏 ':'对照屏 ') + SCREEN_DIST_CM + 'cm · ' + (onScreen ? '已对准' : '未对准'), boxX + 10, boxY + 38);
      } else {
        ctx.fillText((playMode==='challenge'?'急单屏 ':'对照屏 ') + SCREEN_DIST_CM + 'cm · 成像待测', boxX + 10, boxY + 38);
      }
    }

    // ----- 更新UI (Observe + 过关) -----
    function updateObserveAndWin() {
      const u = getU();
      const f = getF();
      const onScreen = isImageOnScreen(u, f);
      const hintKey = getHintKey(u, f);

      // 更新观察结果
      if (onScreen) {
        observeResult.innerHTML = '像已上屏 · 清晰';
        observeResult.style.color = '#276749';
      } else {
        let reason = hintKey;
        if (reason === 'success') reason = '像距匹配';
        observeResult.innerHTML = '未成像 · ' + reason;
        observeResult.style.color = '#c05621';
      }

      // 过关判定
      const winOk = onScreen;
      if (winOk) {
        winMessage.style.display = 'block';
        hintMessage.style.display = 'none';
      } else {
        winMessage.style.display = 'none';
        if (hintKey !== 'success') {
          hintMessage.style.display = 'block';
          hintMessage.innerText = '未对准 · ' + hintKey + '，调物距或焦距'
        } else {
          hintMessage.style.display = 'none';
        }
      }

      // 绘制场景
      drawScene(u, f);

      // ----- 埋点 snapshot + win (测试/发射时) -----
      // 此函数由 btn-test 调用，确保只在此处 emit snapshot 和 win
      // 但为了统一，每次更新都emit snapshot? 按照规格: 测试/发射/过关时 fire snapshot
      // 我们只在 btn-test 点击时调用此函数，并附带 emit
      // 但为了重置不触发，将 emit 放在 btn-test 回调中
      return { winOk, hintKey };
    }

    // ----- 按钮事件 -----
    function handleTest() {
      if (eventAnim) return;
      const u = getU();
      const f = getF();
      const onScreen = isImageOnScreen(u, f);
      const hintKey = getHintKey(u, f);
      const winOk = onScreen;
      measured = true;

      // 更新UI
      updateObserveAndWin();

      // 埋点 snapshot
      const controls = {
        's-object-distance': u,
        's-focal-length': f
      };
      try {
        const emit = (function() {
          function e(type, payload) {
            try { if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) { window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload); return; } } catch(e) {}
            try { if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) { window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload); } } catch(e) {}
          }
          return e;
        })();
        if (playMode === 'explore') {
          observeResult.innerHTML = (onScreen ? '像碰巧落在对照屏上 · ' : '') + '像位已出 · 对照物距与焦距再调';
          winMessage.style.display = 'none';
          emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: false, hintKey: 'explore_observe' });
        } else if (winOk) {
          observeResult.innerHTML = '急单完成 · 像落在锁定光屏 ' + SCREEN_DIST_CM + ' cm';
          emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: hintKey });
          emit('win', { winOk: true });
          if (!challengeWon && typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
            challengeWon = true;
            window.__craftShowWin('急单光屏距本局锁定。物距、像距与焦距满足透镜成像公式。');
          }
        } else {
          // FixedChallenge：失败不换屏
          const vMiss = computeImageDistance(u, f);
          let missTxt = '未对准';
          if (isFinite(vMiss) && vMiss > 0) {
            missTxt = vMiss < SCREEN_DIST_CM ? '像偏近（屏前）' : '像偏远（屏后）';
          } else if (vMiss < 0) {
            missTxt = '成虚像，屏上看不到';
          }
          observeResult.innerHTML = '<strong>' + missTxt + '</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.82em;opacity:.92">急单屏距 ' + SCREEN_DIST_CM + ' cm</span>';
          emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: false, hintKey: hintKey });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      startEventAnim(u, f);
    }

    function handleReset() {
      eventAnim = null;
      measured = false;
      sliderU.value = 30;
      sliderF.value = 12;
      valU.textContent = '30 cm';
      valF.textContent = '12 cm';
      winMessage.style.display = 'none';
      hintMessage.style.display = 'none';
      observeResult.innerHTML = '等待测试…';
      observeResult.style.color = '#2d3748';
    }

    // 滑条数值更新（事件动画期间忽略，避免劫持冻结 drivers）
    sliderU.addEventListener('input', function() {
      if (eventAnim) return;
      measured = false;
      valU.textContent = sliderU.value + ' cm';
      observeResult.innerHTML = '等待测试…';
      observeResult.style.color = '#2d3748';
      winMessage.style.display = 'none';
    });
    sliderF.addEventListener('input', function() {
      if (eventAnim) return;
      measured = false;
      valF.textContent = sliderF.value + ' cm';
      observeResult.innerHTML = '等待测试…';
      observeResult.style.color = '#2d3748';
      winMessage.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // 连续渲染：空闲环境光 + 事件 FSM
    (function loop(ts) {
      const dt = lastFrameTs ? Math.min(0.05, (ts - lastFrameTs) / 1000) : 0.016;
      lastFrameTs = ts;
      ambientT += dt;
      stepEventAnim(dt);
      const u = eventAnim ? eventAnim.drivers.u : getU();
      const f = eventAnim ? eventAnim.drivers.f : getF();
      drawScene(u, f);
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    })(performance.now());

/* === dual-mode-shell runtime (auto) === */
(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeShell) return;
  window.__dualModeShell = true;

  var MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
  var EXPLORE_SECONDS = 10 * 60;
  var state = {
    mode: 'explore',
    attempts: MAX_ATTEMPTS,
    timeLeft: EXPLORE_SECONDS,
    timerId: null
  };

  function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }

  function setPhase(phase){
    try {
      if (typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase === 'function') {
        window.__platformTraceSetPhase(phase);
      } else if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter && typeof window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase === 'function') {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(phase);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* offline */ }
  }

  function fmt(sec){
    var m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    var s = sec % 60;
    return (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;
  }

  function renderAttempts(){
    var el = $('attemptsDisplay');
    if (el) el.textContent = String(state.attempts);
  }

  function primaryButtons(){
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(
      '#essence-bench .essence-ft button, #essence-bench button.btn, #essence-bench button[id^="btn"]'
    ));
  }

  function gateActions(){
    var disable = state.mode === 'challenge' && state.attempts <= 0;
    primaryButtons().forEach(function(btn){
      if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(btn.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(btn.id || '')) return;
      btn.classList.toggle('dual-disabled', disable);
      if (disable) btn.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
      else btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
    });
  }

  function stopTimer(){
    if (state.timerId) { clearInterval(state.timerId); state.timerId = null; }
  }

  function startExploreTimer(){
    stopTimer();
    state.timeLeft = EXPLORE_SECONDS;
    var td = $('timerDisplay');
    if (td) td.textContent = fmt(state.timeLeft);
    state.timerId = setInterval(function(){
      if (state.mode !== 'explore') return;
      state.timeLeft -= 1;
      if (td) td.textContent = fmt(Math.max(0, state.timeLeft));
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        stopTimer();
        var sel = $('modeSelect');
        if (sel) {
          sel.value = 'challenge';
          sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  function applyMode(mode){
    state.mode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    var label = $('modeLabel');
    var stats = $('challengeStats');
    var timerChip = $('dual-timer-chip');
    if (label) label.textContent = state.mode === 'explore' ? '探究模式' : '竞赛模式';
    if (stats) {
      if (state.mode === 'challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible');
      else stats.classList.remove('is-visible');
    }
    if (timerChip) timerChip.style.display = state.mode === 'explore' ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    if (state.mode === 'challenge') {
      stopTimer();
      state.attempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS;
      renderAttempts();
    } else {
      startExploreTimer();
    }
    setPhase(state.mode);
    gateActions();
    try {
      if (typeof window.__lensApplyMode === 'function') window.__lensApplyMode(state.mode);
    } catch (e) {}
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dual-mode-change', { detail: { mode: state.mode, attempts: state.attempts } }));
  }

  function onPrimaryClick(e){
    if (state.mode !== 'challenge') return;
    var t = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!t) return;
    if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(t.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(t.id || '')) return;
    if (state.attempts <= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }
    state.attempts -= 1;
    renderAttempts();
    gateActions();
  }

  function ensureUi(){
    var stage = $('essence-stage') || document.querySelector('#proj-stage, #stage, #canvasContainer, .canvas-wrap')?.parentElement;
    var bench = $('essence-bench');
    if (!stage) return false;

    if (!$('dual-mode-hud')) {
      var hud = document.createElement('div');
      hud.id = 'dual-mode-hud';
      hud.innerHTML =
        '<div id="dual-timer-chip" class="dual-chip">' +
          '<span id="modeLabel">探究模式</span><span style="width:1px;height:14px;background:#cbd5e1"></span>' +
          '<span id="timerDisplay">10:00</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="challengeStats"><span>剩余机会</span><span id="attemptsDisplay">5</span></div>';
      stage.style.position = stage.style.position || 'relative';
      stage.appendChild(hud);
    }

    if (bench && !$('modeSelect')) {
      bench.classList.add('dual-mode-ready');
      var hd = document.createElement('div');
      hd.id = 'essence-bench-hd';
      hd.className = 'dual-bench-hd';
      var title = '环境控制台';
      var tEl = stage.querySelector('.essence-title, h1');
      if (tEl) title = (tEl.textContent || title).trim() || title;
      hd.innerHTML =
        '<h1>' + title.replace(/</g,'<') + '</h1>' +
        '<select id="modeSelect" aria-label="探究阶段">' +
          '<option value="explore">自由探究</option>' +
          '<option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>' +
        '</select>';
      bench.insertBefore(hd, bench.firstChild);
    } else if (!$('modeSelect')) {
      // Fallback: floating select in hud
      var chip = $('dual-timer-chip');
      if (chip && !$('modeSelect')) {
        var sel = document.createElement('select');
        sel.id = 'modeSelect';
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="explore">自由探究</option><option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>';
        chip.appendChild(sel);
      }
    }
    return !!$('modeSelect');
  }

  function boot(){
    if (!ensureUi()) return;
    var sel = $('modeSelect');
    sel.addEventListener('change', function(){ applyMode(sel.value); });
    var ft = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .essence-ft') || $('essence-bench') || document.body;
    ft.addEventListener('click', onPrimaryClick, true);
    applyMode(sel.value || 'explore');
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>

## 事理图谱摘要
- 标题：折射 · 探究
- Play 链：P1(premise) → C1(constraint) → O1(operation) → C2(constraint) → C3(constraint) → C4(constraint) → C5(constraint) → C6(constraint) → R1(result) → I1(irrelevant)
- 策略途径：单变量·入射角；单变量·折射率；多参盲调；试探·水温
## 埋点规格（telemetrySpec）

按事理图谱 traceMap 上报：每次滑条/按钮操作记录 controlId、值、时间戳。
snapshot 事件在「发射/测试/提交」时记录各 control 当前值。
评判时将轨迹节点映射到 KG play 链（P1→O1→C*→R1）与 strategy routes。
混淆变量触碰可选记录，但不计入主探究路径得分。

### 事件列表

- **tuning** `s-incident-angle` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `s-refractive-index` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `modeSelect` → C1（必采）
- **irrelevant_touch** `s-water-temp` → I1
- **irrelevant_touch** `I1` → I1
- **tuning** `tuning` → tuning（必采）
- **irrelevant_touch** `irrelevant_touch` → irrelevant_touch

### DT 检查点

- decision: 模式选择?
- decision: 入射角在范围?
- retry: 提示重试
- decision: 折射率在范围?
- retry: 提示重试
- decision: 光路有效?
- retry: 全反射重试
- decision: 命中靶?
