<script>
(function(){
  function emit(type, payload) {
    try {
      if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  function snapControls() {
    var o = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el) {
      var id = el.id || el.name; if (id) o[id] = el.value;
    });
    return o;
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // puzzle_open
    emit('puzzle_open', {});

    // tuning 绑定 (所有 range)
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() {
        if (window.__platformTraceControlsBound) return;
        emit('tuning', { control: el.id || 'slider', value: el.value });
      });
    });

    // irrelevant_touch 绑定 I1
    var i1 = document.getElementById('I1');
    if (i1) {
      i1.addEventListener('click', function() {
        emit('irrelevant_touch', { control: 'I1' });
      });
    }
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('refractionCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const angleSlider = document.getElementById('s-incident-angle');
  const indexSlider = document.getElementById('s-refractive-index');
  const tempSlider = document.getElementById('s-water-temp');
  const angleValueSpan = document.getElementById('angleValue');
  const indexValueSpan = document.getElementById('indexValue');
  const tempValueSpan = document.getElementById('tempValue');
  const refractionDisplay = document.getElementById('refractionAngleDisplay');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedbackMsg');
  const winMessageDiv = document.getElementById('winMessage');
  const fireBtn = document.getElementById('btn-fire');

  const n1 = 1.0;
  const FIXED_LAM_NM = 550; // 固定光束色，不进入折射角计算
  let W = 700, H = 400;
  let layout = { groundY: 240, launchX: 100, launchY: 70, target: { x: 520, y: 310, radius: 18 } };
  let playMode = 'explore';
  let lockedTargetFrac = null; // FixedChallenge：横向比例
  let challengeWon = false;
  let measuredTheta2 = null; // 测后门控：发射后才揭示 θ₂
  /** 事件动画 FSM：idle(null) | windup | peak | settle；点击时冻结 drivers */
  let eventAnim = null;
  let ambientT = 0;
  let lastFrameTs = 0;
  let lastFireHit = null;
  let lastFireMissSide = null;
  let tempTouchedSinceFire = false;
  let lastFireAvKey = null; // θ1|n2 快照，用于「只拧水温」复盘提示
  const MODE_GOALS = {
    explore: {
      hud: '试照：观察折射光随 θ₁、n₂ 变化',
      side: '调入射角与折射率，看折射光怎么拐。'
    },
    challenge: {
      hud: '限次命中本局水下靶（打偏不换靶）',
      side: '限次命中本局水下靶（打偏不换靶）。'
    }
  };
  function refreshRefractGoals() {
    const g = MODE_GOALS[playMode] || MODE_GOALS.explore;
    const mission = document.getElementById('goalMission');
    const side = document.getElementById('sideGoal');
    if (playMode === 'challenge' && lockedTargetFrac != null) {
      if (mission) mission.textContent = '急单靶位已锁定 · 本局固定';
      if (side) side.textContent = '限次命中本局水下靶（打偏不换靶）。';
    } else {
      if (mission) mission.textContent = g.hud;
      if (side) side.textContent = g.side;
    }
  }
  /** FixedChallenge：仅进入竞赛时锁定一次靶位 */
  function lockChallengeTarget() {
    lockedTargetFrac = 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.28; // 0.55–0.83
    challengeWon = false;
    angleSlider.value = '45';
    indexSlider.value = '1.3';
    tempTouchedSinceFire = false;
    lastFireAvKey = '45|1.3';
    refreshRefractGoals();
    updateExperiment(false);
    feedback.textContent = '急单已锁定 · 水下靶位本局固定';
    winMessageDiv.innerHTML = '';
  }
  function applyExploreTarget() {
    lockedTargetFrac = null;
    challengeWon = false;
    tempTouchedSinceFire = false;
    lastFireAvKey = parseFloat(angleSlider.value).toFixed(0) + '|' + parseFloat(indexSlider.value).toFixed(1);
    refreshRefractGoals();
    updateExperiment(false);
    feedback.textContent = '调入射角与折射率，看光路';
    winMessageDiv.innerHTML = '';
  }
  window.__refractApplyMode = function(mode) {
    playMode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    if (playMode === 'challenge') lockChallengeTarget();
    else applyExploreTarget();
  };
  document.addEventListener('dual-mode-change', function(ev) {
    var m = ev && ev.detail && ev.detail.mode;
    if (typeof window.__refractApplyMode === 'function') window.__refractApplyMode(m);
  });
  /* BATCH6-FIXED-20260724 FixedChallenge */

  function syncCanvasSize() {
    var stage = document.getElementById('essence-stage') || canvas.parentElement;
    var cssW = Math.max(2, (stage && stage.clientWidth) || 700);
    var cssH = Math.max(2, (stage && stage.clientHeight) || 400);
    var dpr = Math.min(2.5, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
    var bw = Math.round(cssW * dpr), bh = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
    if (canvas.width !== bw || canvas.height !== bh) { canvas.width = bw; canvas.height = bh; }
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    W = cssW; H = cssH;
    layout.groundY = Math.round(H * 0.52);
    layout.launchX = Math.round(W * 0.16);
    layout.launchY = Math.round(H * 0.18);
    var txFrac = (playMode === 'challenge' && lockedTargetFrac != null) ? lockedTargetFrac : 0.72;
    // 探究靶较大；竞赛靶更小，目视可辨且同参未必两边同命中
    var rFrac = playMode === 'challenge' ? 0.022 : 0.042;
    layout.target = {
      x: Math.round(W * txFrac),
      y: Math.round(H * 0.72),
      radius: Math.max(playMode === 'challenge' ? 10 : 16, Math.round(Math.min(W, H) * rFrac))
    };
    return layout;
  }

  function calcRefractionAngle(theta1Deg, n2) {
    const theta1Rad = theta1Deg * Math.PI / 180;
    const sinTheta2 = (n1 * Math.sin(theta1Rad)) / n2;
    if (sinTheta2 > 1.0) return NaN;
    return Math.asin(sinTheta2) * 180 / Math.PI;
  }

  function wavelengthToRgb(nm) {
    // 固定色相用；λ 不进入折射角计算
    var t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (nm - 400) / 300));
    var r = Math.round(255 * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, t < 0.25 ? (0.25 - t) * 4 : t > 0.55 ? (t - 0.55) / 0.45 : 0)));
    var g = Math.round(255 * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, t < 0.5 ? t * 2 : (1 - t) * 2)));
    var b = Math.round(255 * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, t < 0.45 ? 1 : (0.7 - t) / 0.25)));
    return 'rgb(' + r + ',' + g + ',' + b + ')';
  }

  function readWaterTemp() {
    if (!tempSlider) return 22;
    var v = parseFloat(tempSlider.value);
    return isNaN(v) ? 22 : Math.max(5, Math.min(40, v));
  }

  function mapAngleToDur(theta1) {
    const t = Math.max(10, Math.min(80, theta1 || 30));
    return 0.4 + ((t - 10) / 70) * 1.1;
  }

  function getEventPhaseDurs() {
    if (!eventAnim) return { windupDur: 0.2, peakDur: 0.12, settleDur: 0.3 };
    const d = eventAnim.drivers;
    const windupDur = Math.max(0.12, d.totalDur * 0.28);
    const peakDur = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(0.18, d.totalDur * 0.15));
    const settleDur = Math.max(0.15, d.totalDur - windupDur - peakDur);
    return { windupDur: windupDur, peakDur: peakDur, settleDur: settleDur };
  }

  function stepEventAnim(dt) {
    if (!eventAnim) return;
    eventAnim.t += dt;
    const ph = getEventPhaseDurs();
    if (eventAnim.phase === 'windup') {
      if (eventAnim.t >= ph.windupDur) { eventAnim.phase = 'peak'; eventAnim.t = 0; }
    } else if (eventAnim.phase === 'peak') {
      if (eventAnim.t >= ph.peakDur) { eventAnim.phase = 'settle'; eventAnim.t = 0; }
    } else if (eventAnim.phase === 'settle') {
      const p = Math.min(1, eventAnim.t / ph.settleDur);
      if (eventAnim.drivers.hit) eventAnim.flashHit = Math.max(0, 1 - p * 2.5);
      if (eventAnim.t >= ph.settleDur) eventAnim = null;
    }
  }

  function getBeamSweepT() {
    if (!eventAnim) return 1;
    const ph = getEventPhaseDurs();
    const t = eventAnim.t;
    if (eventAnim.phase === 'windup') return Math.min(1, t / Math.max(0.05, ph.windupDur));
    if (eventAnim.phase === 'peak') return Math.min(1, t / Math.max(0.05, ph.peakDur));
    return Math.min(1, t / Math.max(0.05, ph.settleDur));
  }

  function drawBeamSegment(x1, y1, x2, y2, sweepT, color, width, glow) {
    const ex = x1 + (x2 - x1) * sweepT;
    const ey = y1 + (y2 - y1) * sweepT;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = color;
    ctx.shadowBlur = glow || 0;
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = width;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
    ctx.lineTo(ex, ey);
    ctx.stroke();
    if (sweepT > 0.02 && sweepT < 1) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ex, ey, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawScene(theta1Deg, n2, waterTemp) {
    const drv = eventAnim ? eventAnim.drivers : null;
    if (drv) { theta1Deg = drv.theta1; n2 = drv.n2; waterTemp = drv.waterTemp; }
    var beamColor = wavelengthToRgb(FIXED_LAM_NM);
    const L = syncCanvasSize();
    const groundY = L.groundY, launchX = L.launchX, launchY = L.launchY, target = L.target;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    var SC = { accent:'#3a9e9a', bg:'#0a1414', hi:'#8ad4c8', glow:'#f0d060', metal:'#6a7880', mid:'#1e3430' };
    var tankL = 18, tankR = W - 18, tankBot = H - 14, benchTh = 16;
    // 水温只改水色冷暖与雾气/气泡观感；不改 groundY / 发射几何 / 靶位
    var tempVal = waterTemp != null && !isNaN(waterTemp) ? waterTemp : 22;
    var tempT = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (tempVal - 5) / 35)); // 0=冷青 → 1=暖绿
    var rW = Math.round(36 + tempT * 42);
    var gW = Math.round(148 + tempT * 18);
    var bW = Math.round(162 - tempT * 78);
    var waterAlpha = 0.42 + tempT * 0.18;
    var bubbleN = 4 + Math.round(tempT * 7);
    var fogAlpha = 0.03 + tempT * 0.11;
    var ripMax = 2 + Math.round((0.35 + tempT * 0.65) * 3);

    // 空气层
    const air = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, groundY);
    air.addColorStop(0, SC.bg);
    air.addColorStop(0.55, SC.mid);
    air.addColorStop(1, '#163532');
    ctx.fillStyle = air;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, groundY);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(138,212,200,0.04)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, Math.round(groundY * 0.45));

    // 对准度（发射后光路距靶心）
    const pathRevealedEarly = measuredTheta2 != null || !!eventAnim;
    let alignQual = 0;
    const theta2Pre = drv ? drv.theta2 : calcRefractionAngle(theta1Deg, n2);
    const validPre = drv ? drv.valid : !(isNaN(theta2Pre) || theta2Pre < 0 || theta2Pre > 89);
    if (pathRevealedEarly && validPre) {
      const theta2RadP = theta2Pre * Math.PI / 180;
      const lenP = Math.min(H - groundY - 20, W * 0.35);
      const ixP = launchX + (groundY - launchY) * Math.tan(theta1Deg * Math.PI / 180);
      const endXP = ixP + lenP * Math.sin(theta2RadP);
      const endYP = groundY + lenP * Math.cos(theta2RadP);
      const dxP = endXP - ixP, dyP = endYP - groundY;
      const l2P = dxP * dxP + dyP * dyP;
      if (l2P > 0.0001) {
        let tP = ((target.x - ixP) * dxP + (target.y - groundY) * dyP) / l2P;
        tP = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tP));
        const cxP = ixP + tP * dxP, cyP = groundY + tP * dyP;
        const distP = Math.hypot(cxP - target.x, cyP - target.y);
        alignQual = Math.max(0, 1 - distP / (target.radius * 3));
      }
    } else if (!pathRevealedEarly) {
      alignQual = 0.25 + 0.08 * Math.sin(ambientT * 2.2);
    }
    const ambientBoost = eventAnim ? 0 : (0.04 * Math.sin(ambientT * 2.5));
    const beamAlpha = 0.55 + alignQual * 0.45 + ambientBoost;
    const causticAlpha = 0.12 + alignQual * 0.28;

    // 木架剪影（水槽后方，吃上空）
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(60,40,24,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(W * 0.72, 110, 28, groundY - 118);
    ctx.fillRect(W * 0.88, 110, 28, groundY - 118);
    ctx.fillRect(W * 0.72, 110, W * 0.18, 14);
    for (var rs = 0; rs < 3; rs++) {
      ctx.fillRect(W * 0.74, 140 + rs * 40, W * 0.14, 6);
    }

    // 光学木台（承托水槽）
    var benchY = groundY - 1;
    const woodG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, benchY, 0, benchY + benchTh);
    woodG.addColorStop(0, '#6b4a32');
    woodG.addColorStop(0.35, '#8f6238');
    woodG.addColorStop(0.7, '#5c3f28');
    woodG.addColorStop(1, '#4a3220');
    ctx.fillStyle = woodG;
    ctx.fillRect(0, benchY, W, benchTh);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.18)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (var wg = 0; wg < Math.ceil(W / 28); wg++) {
      var gx = wg * 28 + (wg % 3) * 4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(gx, benchY + 2);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(gx + 8, benchY + benchTh * 0.4, gx + 18, benchY + benchTh * 0.75, gx + 26, benchY + benchTh - 1);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = SC.metal;
    ctx.fillRect(0, benchY + benchTh - 2, W, 2);

    // 界面以下整槽介质区（折射界面固定在 groundY；水温不抬界面、不造第二液面）
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,52,48,0.22)';
    ctx.fillRect(tankL, groundY, tankR - tankL, tankBot - groundY);

    // 水体填充：整槽（groundY → 槽底），色相随水温冷暖变化
    const water = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, tankBot);
    water.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rW + ',' + gW + ',' + bW + ',' + (0.30 + tempT * 0.16).toFixed(2) + ')');
    water.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(' + Math.round(rW * 0.55) + ',' + Math.round(gW * 0.42) + ',' + Math.round(bW * 0.48) + ',' + waterAlpha.toFixed(2) + ')');
    water.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(10,20,20,' + Math.min(0.9, 0.68 + tempT * 0.14).toFixed(2) + ')');
    ctx.fillStyle = water;
    ctx.fillRect(tankL, groundY, tankR - tankL, tankBot - groundY);

    // 暖水时界面附近薄雾（观感，不改几何）
    if (fogAlpha > 0.04) {
      const fog = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, groundY + 36);
      fog.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(220,235,230,' + fogAlpha.toFixed(2) + ')');
      fog.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(220,235,230,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = fog;
      ctx.fillRect(tankL + 2, groundY, tankR - tankL - 4, 36);
    }

    // 水底焦散 shimmer（整槽介质区内）
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.rect(tankL + 2, groundY + 2, tankR - tankL - 4, Math.max(4, tankBot - groundY - 6));
    ctx.clip();
    ctx.globalAlpha = causticAlpha * (0.55 + tempT * 0.35);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + Math.min(220, rW + 80) + ',' + Math.min(230, gW + 60) + ',' + Math.min(220, bW + 40) + ',0.85)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.1;
    for (var ci = 0; ci < 10 + Math.round(tempT * 4); ci++) {
      var cx0 = tankL + 12 + (ci * 37) % (tankR - tankL - 24);
      var cy0 = groundY + 10 + (ci * 23) % Math.max(12, tankBot - groundY - 24);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx0, cy0);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx0 + 14, cy0 - 6, cx0 + 28, cy0 + 10, cx0 + 42, cy0 + 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = causticAlpha * 0.55;
    ctx.fillStyle = SC.glow;
    for (var si = 0; si < 6 + Math.round(tempT * 4); si++) {
      var sx = tankL + 20 + (si * 53) % (tankR - tankL - 40);
      var sy = groundY + 16 + (si * 41) % Math.max(10, tankBot - groundY - 40);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(sx, sy, 10 + (si % 3) * 4, 5 + (si % 2) * 3, si * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    // 气泡：数量随水温略增
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.32 + tempT * 0.28;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,240,235,0.75)';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,230,220,0.18)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (var bi = 0; bi < bubbleN; bi++) {
      var bx = tankL + 16 + ((bi * 47 + Math.floor(ambientT * 18)) % Math.max(20, tankR - tankL - 32));
      var by = groundY + 12 + ((bi * 31 + Math.floor(ambientT * (10 + tempT * 8))) % Math.max(10, tankBot - groundY - 28));
      var br = 2 + (bi % 4) * 0.7 + tempT * 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx, by, br, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // 加厚玻璃槽壁 + 金属底框
    function drawGlassWall(x, w, inner) {
      var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, groundY, inner ? x + w : x - w, groundY);
      g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(106,120,128,0.82)');
      g.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(138,212,200,0.22)');
      g.addColorStop(0.65, 'rgba(58,158,154,0.35)');
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(30,52,48,0.65)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.fillRect(x, groundY, w, tankBot - groundY);
      ctx.strokeStyle = inner ? 'rgba(138,212,200,0.65)' : 'rgba(106,120,128,0.55)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(inner ? x + w - 1 : x + 1, groundY);
      ctx.lineTo(inner ? x + w - 1 : x + 1, tankBot);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    drawGlassWall(0, tankL, true);
    drawGlassWall(tankR, W - tankR, false);
    // 整槽涟漪（界面 groundY 本身不动；疏密随水温微调）
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + Math.min(210, rW + 90) + ',' + Math.min(230, gW + 70) + ',' + Math.min(220, bW + 50) + ',' + (0.18 + tempT * 0.22).toFixed(2) + ')';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    for (var rip = 0; rip < ripMax; rip++) {
      var ry = groundY + 8 + rip * 11;
      if (ry >= tankBot - 18) break;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(tankL + 8, ry);
      for (var rx = tankL + 8; rx < tankR - 8; rx += 24) {
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(rx + 12, ry + (rip % 2 ? 3 : -3) * Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.003 + rip), rx + 24, ry);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    const floorG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, tankBot - 16, 0, tankBot);
    floorG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(58,158,154,0.35)');
    floorG.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(106,120,128,0.5)');
    floorG.addColorStop(1, '#4a3220');
    ctx.fillStyle = floorG;
    ctx.fillRect(0, tankBot - 16, W, 16);
    ctx.strokeStyle = SC.metal;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(0.5, tankBot - 16.5, W - 1, 15);

    // 水面高光与液面
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(tankL, groundY);
    ctx.lineTo(tankR, groundY);
    ctx.strokeStyle = SC.hi;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(240,208,96,0.35)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(tankL + 4, groundY - 1);
    ctx.lineTo(tankR - 4, groundY - 1);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.font = '12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
    ctx.fillText('空气', 18, groundY - 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(138,212,200,0.85)';
    ctx.fillText('水槽介质 n₂=' + n2.toFixed(1), 18, groundY + 22);
    // 槽壁水温刻度（中性标注，不剧透）
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,220,215,0.7)';
    ctx.font = '11px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('水温 ' + tempVal.toFixed(0) + ' °C', tankR - 96, groundY + 38);

    // 探照灯 — 加大灯座 + 黄铜灯室
    ctx.fillStyle = SC.metal;
    ctx.fillRect(launchX - 16, launchY + 14, 32, 10);
    ctx.fillRect(launchX - 6, launchY + 8, 12, 8);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = SC.glow;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 28;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(launchX, launchY, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(240,208,96,0.4)';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    const brass = ctx.createLinearGradient(launchX - 28, launchY - 16, launchX + 16, launchY + 16);
    brass.addColorStop(0, '#8a7344');
    brass.addColorStop(0.45, SC.glow);
    brass.addColorStop(0.75, SC.metal);
    brass.addColorStop(1, '#4a4030');
    ctx.fillStyle = brass;
    ctx.fillRect(launchX - 28, launchY - 14, 44, 28);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.strokeRect(launchX - 28, launchY - 14, 44, 28);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3530';
    ctx.fillRect(launchX - 8, launchY - 20, 16, 8);
    const lensG = ctx.createRadialGradient(launchX - 2, launchY - 1, 1, launchX, launchY, 12);
    lensG.addColorStop(0, '#fff8dc');
    lensG.addColorStop(0.5, SC.glow);
    lensG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(240,160,40,0.85)');
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(launchX, launchY, 11, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.fillStyle = lensG;
    ctx.shadowColor = SC.glow;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = SC.glow;
    ctx.font = '12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('探照灯', launchX - 20, launchY - 26);

    const theta1Rad = theta1Deg * Math.PI / 180;
    let ix = launchX + (groundY - launchY) * Math.tan(theta1Rad);
    if (ix < 16) ix = 16;
    if (ix > W - 16) ix = W - 16;

    const isTIR = drv ? drv.isTIR : !validPre;
    const animActive = !!eventAnim;
    const windupT = animActive && eventAnim.phase === 'windup' ? getBeamSweepT() : (animActive ? 1 : 0);
    const peakT = animActive && eventAnim.phase === 'peak' ? getBeamSweepT() : (animActive && eventAnim.phase === 'settle' ? 1 : 0);
    const settleT = animActive && eventAnim.phase === 'settle' ? getBeamSweepT() : (animActive ? 0 : 1);

    // 入射光：空闲虚线预览 / 事件实线扫入 / 测后实线
    if (animActive) {
      drawBeamSegment(launchX, launchY, ix, groundY, windupT, beamColor, 2.5 + alignQual * 1.5, 8 + alignQual * 12);
    } else if (pathRevealedEarly) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowColor = beamColor;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 6 + alignQual * 16;
      ctx.globalAlpha = beamAlpha;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(launchX, launchY);
      ctx.lineTo(ix, groundY);
      ctx.strokeStyle = beamColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2 + alignQual * 1.5;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    } else {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([6, 5]);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.38 + ambientBoost;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(launchX, launchY);
      ctx.lineTo(ix, groundY);
      ctx.strokeStyle = beamColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
    ctx.moveTo(ix, groundY - 56);
    ctx.lineTo(ix, groundY + 56);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,0.7)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ix, groundY, 28, -Math.PI/2, -Math.PI/2 + theta1Rad, false);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#fdba74';
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fdba74';
    ctx.fillText('θ₁=' + theta1Deg.toFixed(0) + '°', ix + 18, groundY - 26);

    // 测前不预计算/绘制正确 θ₂ 路径（避免剧透）；hit 判定仅在发射后使用
    const theta2Deg = pathRevealedEarly
      ? (drv ? drv.theta2 : calcRefractionAngle(theta1Deg, n2))
      : NaN;
    let valid = pathRevealedEarly
      ? (drv ? drv.valid : !(isNaN(theta2Deg) || theta2Deg < 0 || theta2Deg > 89))
      : false;
    let refrEndX = ix, refrEndY = groundY;
    const pathRevealed = measuredTheta2 != null || animActive;
    if (pathRevealed && valid) {
      const theta2Rad = theta2Deg * Math.PI / 180;
      const len = Math.min(H - groundY - 20, W * 0.35);
      refrEndX = ix + len * Math.sin(theta2Rad);
      refrEndY = groundY + len * Math.cos(theta2Rad);
      if (animActive) {
        const incDone = eventAnim.phase !== 'windup';
        if (incDone) {
          drawBeamSegment(ix, groundY, refrEndX, refrEndY,
            eventAnim.phase === 'peak' ? peakT : (eventAnim.phase === 'settle' ? settleT : 0),
            beamColor, 2.5 + alignQual * 1.5, 6 + alignQual * 14);
        }
      } else {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(ix, groundY);
        ctx.lineTo(refrEndX, refrEndY);
        ctx.strokeStyle = beamColor;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2 + alignQual * 1.5;
        ctx.globalAlpha = beamAlpha;
        ctx.shadowColor = beamColor;
        ctx.shadowBlur = 4 + alignQual * 12;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ix, groundY, 26, Math.PI/2, Math.PI/2 + theta2Rad, false);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#7dd3fc';
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7dd3fc';
      if (!isNaN(measuredTheta2) && measuredTheta2 != null) {
        ctx.fillText('θ₂=' + measuredTheta2.toFixed(1) + '°', ix + 18, groundY + 44);
      }
    } else if (pathRevealed && !valid) {
      // TIR：沿界面滑动光带
      const slideLen = Math.min(W * 0.22, 120);
      const slideT = animActive
        ? (eventAnim.phase === 'windup' ? 0 : (eventAnim.phase === 'peak' ? peakT : 1))
        : 1;
      const dir = theta1Deg > 45 ? 1 : -1;
      const sx0 = ix - slideLen * 0.5 * dir;
      const sx1 = ix + slideLen * 0.5 * dir;
      const slideX = sx0 + (sx1 - sx0) * slideT;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(253,164,175,0.85)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.shadowColor = '#fda4af';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx0, groundY);
      ctx.lineTo(slideX, groundY);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(slideX, groundY, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fda4af';
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
      // 反射回空气
      if (animActive && eventAnim.phase === 'settle') {
        const reflLen = Math.min(groundY - launchY - 10, 80);
        const reflX = slideX - reflLen * Math.sin(theta1Rad) * dir;
        const reflY = groundY - reflLen * Math.cos(theta1Rad);
        drawBeamSegment(slideX, groundY, reflX, reflY, settleT, 'rgba(253,164,175,0.7)', 2, 8);
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fda4af';
      ctx.fillText('全反射 / 无效', ix + 16, groundY + 36);
    } else {
      // 发射前：界面下不确定雾扇（不编码正确 θ₂），中性提示
      ctx.save();
      const fogLen = Math.min(H - groundY - 28, 70);
      const fog = ctx.createRadialGradient(ix, groundY, 4, ix, groundY + fogLen * 0.45, fogLen);
      fog.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(148,163,184,0.16)');
      fog.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(100,120,130,0.08)');
      fog.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(100,120,130,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = fog;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(ix, groundY);
      ctx.arc(ix, groundY, fogLen, Math.PI * 0.15, Math.PI - Math.PI * 0.15, false);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
      ctx.fillText('点发射后观察水下光路', ix + 16, groundY + 36);
    }

    // 水下靶 — 信标盘 + 十字准星（竞赛命中/未中视觉区分）
    var tr = target.radius;
    const flashHit = eventAnim ? (eventAnim.flashHit || 0) : 0;
    const frozenHit = drv ? drv.hit : (pathRevealedEarly ? lastFireHit : null);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(target.x, target.y, tr + 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    var haloG = ctx.createRadialGradient(target.x, target.y, tr * 0.3, target.x, target.y, tr + 10);
    if (playMode === 'challenge' && pathRevealed && frozenHit === true) {
      haloG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(45,212,191,' + (0.35 + flashHit * 0.45) + ')');
      haloG.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(45,212,191,0.15)');
      haloG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(45,212,191,0)');
    } else if (playMode === 'challenge' && pathRevealed && frozenHit === false) {
      haloG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(248,113,113,0.22)');
      haloG.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(248,113,113,0.08)');
      haloG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(248,113,113,0)');
    } else {
      haloG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(240,208,96,0.28)');
      haloG.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(240,120,80,0.12)');
      haloG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(240,80,60,0)');
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = haloG;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(target.x, target.y + tr + 14);
    ctx.lineTo(target.x, tankBot - 4);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(106,120,128,0.55)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = SC.metal;
    ctx.fillRect(target.x - 4, tankBot - 6, 8, 6);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(target.x, target.y, tr + 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(240,208,96,0.45)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(target.x, target.y, tr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    var discG = ctx.createRadialGradient(target.x - tr * 0.25, target.y - tr * 0.25, 1, target.x, target.y, tr);
    if (playMode === 'challenge' && pathRevealed && frozenHit === true) {
      discG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(167,243,208,0.75)');
      discG.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(45,212,191,0.55)');
      discG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(20,120,100,0.5)');
    } else if (playMode === 'challenge' && pathRevealed && frozenHit === false) {
      discG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(254,202,202,0.45)');
      discG.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(180,50,50,0.35)');
      discG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(100,30,30,0.4)');
    } else {
      discG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,200,180,0.55)');
      discG.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(240,100,90,0.38)');
      discG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(180,50,50,0.45)');
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = discG;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = (playMode === 'challenge' && pathRevealed && frozenHit === true) ? '#2dd4bf' : ((playMode === 'challenge' && pathRevealed && frozenHit === false) ? '#f87171' : '#f87171');
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(target.x, target.y, tr * 0.55, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,200,0.7)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(target.x - tr * 0.65, target.y);
    ctx.lineTo(target.x + tr * 0.65, target.y);
    ctx.moveTo(target.x, target.y - tr * 0.65);
    ctx.lineTo(target.x, target.y + tr * 0.65);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(target.x, target.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = SC.glow;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fecaca';
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(playMode==='challenge'?'急单靶':'对照靶', target.x - 22, target.y - tr - 8);

    let hit = drv ? drv.hit : false;
    let missSide = drv ? drv.missSide : null;
    if (!drv && pathRevealed && valid) {
      const dx = refrEndX - ix, dy = refrEndY - groundY;
      const l2 = dx*dx + dy*dy;
      if (l2 > 0.0001) {
        let t = ((target.x - ix)*dx + (target.y - groundY)*dy) / l2;
        t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
        const cx = ix + t * dx, cy = groundY + t * dy;
        if ((cx - target.x)*(cx - target.x) + (cy - target.y)*(cy - target.y) <= target.radius*target.radius) hit = true;
        else missSide = cx < target.x ? 'left' : 'right';
      }
    }

    const boxW = 210, boxH = 44, boxX = W - boxW - 16, boxY = H - boxH - 72;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15,23,42,0.85)';
    ctx.fillRect(boxX, boxY, boxW, boxH);
    ctx.strokeStyle = (pathRevealed && hit) ? 'rgba(45,212,191,0.7)' : 'rgba(148,163,184,0.35)';
    ctx.strokeRect(boxX, boxY, boxW, boxH);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ccfbf1';
    ctx.font = '12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
    if (!pathRevealed) {
      ctx.fillText('光路待测 · 点发射后判定', boxX + 10, boxY + 28);
    } else if (!valid) {
      ctx.fillText('全反射 · 未见折射光路', boxX + 10, boxY + 28);
    } else if (playMode === 'challenge') {
      ctx.fillText(hit ? '光线已命中锁定信标' : '光线尚未命中信标', boxX + 10, boxY + 28);
    } else {
      ctx.fillText(hit ? '碰巧扫到参考信标' : '探究观察折射走向', boxX + 10, boxY + 28);
    }

    return { hit, missSide, theta2Deg: valid ? theta2Deg : NaN, valid };
  }

  // ----- 更新UI & 判定 -----
  function updateExperiment(fireAction = false) {
    const theta1 = parseFloat(angleSlider.value);
    const n2 = parseFloat(indexSlider.value);
    const waterTemp = readWaterTemp();
    const avKey = theta1.toFixed(0) + '|' + n2.toFixed(1);
    angleValueSpan.textContent = theta1 + '°';
    indexValueSpan.textContent = n2.toFixed(1);
    if (tempValueSpan) tempValueSpan.textContent = waterTemp.toFixed(0) + ' °C';

    // 发射时先揭示，再绘制，使出射光路与读数同帧出现
    if (fireAction) {
      const t2pre = calcRefractionAngle(theta1, n2);
      const validPre = !(isNaN(t2pre) || t2pre < 0 || t2pre > 89);
      measuredTheta2 = validPre ? t2pre : NaN; // NaN = 已测但无效/全反射
    }

    const result = drawScene(theta1, n2, waterTemp);
    const theta2 = result.theta2Deg;
    const valid = result.valid;

    // 显示折射角（测前待测）
    if (measuredTheta2 != null && !isNaN(measuredTheta2)) {
      refractionDisplay.textContent = measuredTheta2.toFixed(1) + '°';
    } else if (measuredTheta2 != null && isNaN(measuredTheta2)) {
      refractionDisplay.textContent = '无效';
    } else {
      refractionDisplay.textContent = '—';
    }

    // 约束检查 (C1, C2)
    let c1ok = (theta1 >= 0 && theta1 <= 89);
    let c2ok = (n2 >= 1.0 && n2 <= 2.5);
    if (!c1ok) {
      feedback.textContent = '入射角超范围 · 调回 0°–89°';
      winMessageDiv.innerHTML = '';
      return { winOk: false, hintKey: 'C1' };
    }
    if (!c2ok) {
      feedback.textContent = '折射率超范围 · 调回 1.0–2.5';
      winMessageDiv.innerHTML = '';
      return { winOk: false, hintKey: 'C2' };
    }

    // 如果点击发射 或 自动检测 (fireAction)
    if (fireAction) {
      const onlyTempProbe = tempTouchedSinceFire && lastFireAvKey != null && lastFireAvKey === avKey;
      if (!valid || isNaN(theta2)) {
        feedback.textContent = onlyTempProbe
          ? '光路仍无效 · 水温不改变折射角；本关 n₂ 已给定'
          : '光路无效 · 可能全反射';
        winMessageDiv.innerHTML = '';
        tempTouchedSinceFire = false;
        lastFireAvKey = avKey;
        return { winOk: false, hintKey: 'C3', hit: false, missSide: null, valid: false, theta2: NaN };
      }
      const hit = result.hit;
      const missSide = result.missSide;
      if (playMode === 'explore') {
        if (onlyTempProbe && !hit) {
          feedback.textContent = '水温不改变折射角 · 本关 n₂ 已给定，请调 θ₁ 或 n₂';
        } else {
          feedback.textContent = hit
            ? '光路已出 · 对照入射角与折射率再瞄'
            : (missSide === 'left' ? '光路偏左未中靶 · 继续对比' : (missSide === 'right' ? '光路偏右未中靶 · 继续对比' : '未命中对照靶 · 继续对比光路'));
        }
        winMessageDiv.innerHTML = '';
        tempTouchedSinceFire = false;
        lastFireAvKey = avKey;
        return { winOk: false, hintKey: 'explore_observe', hit: hit, missSide: missSide, valid: valid, theta2: theta2 };
      }
      if (hit) {
        feedback.textContent = '急单完成 · 命中锁定水下靶';
        winMessageDiv.innerHTML = '<span class="win-badge">🎉 过关！命中锁定靶</span>';
        if (!challengeWon && typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
          challengeWon = true;
          window.__craftShowWin('急单靶位本局锁定。折射角由 θ₁ 与 n₂ 决定；水温不改变折射角，本关 n₂ 已给定。');
        }
        tempTouchedSinceFire = false;
        lastFireAvKey = avKey;
        return { winOk: true, hintKey: null, hit: hit, missSide: missSide, valid: valid, theta2: theta2 };
      } else {
        // FixedChallenge：失败不换靶
        const sideTxt = missSide === 'left' ? '光路偏左' : (missSide === 'right' ? '光路偏右' : '未命中');
        feedback.textContent = onlyTempProbe
          ? '水温不改变折射角 · 本关 n₂ 已给定，请改 θ₁ 或 n₂ 后发射'
          : (sideTxt + ' · 靶位仍锁定，对照光路再调参后发射');
        winMessageDiv.innerHTML = '';
        tempTouchedSinceFire = false;
        lastFireAvKey = avKey;
        return { winOk: false, hintKey: missSide === 'left' ? 'miss_left' : (missSide === 'right' ? 'miss_right' : 'C3'), hit: hit, missSide: missSide, valid: valid, theta2: theta2 };
      }
    } else {
      // 非发射：不剧透全反射/命中结论
      feedback.textContent = '调节参数，点击「发射光线」测试光路';
      winMessageDiv.innerHTML = '';
      return { winOk: false, hintKey: null };
    }
  }

  // ----- 发射/测试 事件 (含埋点 snapshot & win) -----
  function fireAndEmit() {
    if (eventAnim) return;
    const status = updateExperiment(true);
    const winOk = status.winOk;
    const hintKey = status.hintKey;

    // 启动事件动画（冻结 drivers；约束未通过时不启动）
    if (measuredTheta2 != null) {
      lastFireHit = !!status.hit;
      lastFireMissSide = status.missSide || null;
      const theta1 = parseFloat(angleSlider.value);
      const n2 = parseFloat(indexSlider.value);
      const waterTemp = readWaterTemp();
      const valid = status.valid != null ? status.valid : !isNaN(measuredTheta2);
      const totalDur = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(1.5, mapAngleToDur(theta1)));
      eventAnim = {
        phase: 'windup', t: 0, flashHit: 0,
        drivers: {
          theta1: theta1, n1: n1, n2: n2, theta2: measuredTheta2,
          isTIR: !valid, valid: valid, hit: !!status.hit, missSide: status.missSide || null,
          waterTemp: waterTemp, lam: FIXED_LAM_NM, totalDur: totalDur
        }
      };
    }

    // 构造 controls 快照
    const controls = {
      's-incident-angle': angleSlider.value,
      's-refractive-index': indexSlider.value,
      's-water-temp': tempSlider ? tempSlider.value : String(readWaterTemp())
    };

    // snapshot 事件
    try {
      const snapPayload = { controls: controls, winOk: winOk, hintKey: hintKey };
      if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record('snapshot', snapPayload);
      } else if (window.parent && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record('snapshot', snapPayload);
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // 如果过关，额外 fire win
    if (winOk) {
      try {
        const winPayload = { winOk: true };
        if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
          window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record('win', winPayload);
        } else if (window.parent && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
          window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record('win', winPayload);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  // ----- 绑定事件（事件动画期间忽略滑条，避免劫持冻结 drivers）-----
  angleSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
    if (eventAnim) return;
    measuredTheta2 = null;
    lastFireHit = null;
    lastFireMissSide = null;
    updateExperiment(false);
  });
  indexSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
    if (eventAnim) return;
    measuredTheta2 = null;
    lastFireHit = null;
    lastFireMissSide = null;
    updateExperiment(false);
  });
  if (tempSlider) tempSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
    if (eventAnim) return;
    tempTouchedSinceFire = true;
    updateExperiment(false);
  });
  fireBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    fireAndEmit();
  });

  // 初始化 UI 读数（canvas 由 loop 驱动）
  lastFireAvKey = parseFloat(angleSlider.value).toFixed(0) + '|' + parseFloat(indexSlider.value).toFixed(1);
  updateExperiment(false);

  // 连续渲染：空闲环境光 + 事件 FSM
  (function loop(ts) {
    const dt = lastFrameTs ? Math.min(0.05, (ts - lastFrameTs) / 1000) : 0.016;
    lastFrameTs = ts;
    ambientT += dt;
    stepEventAnim(dt);
    const theta1 = eventAnim ? eventAnim.drivers.theta1 : parseFloat(angleSlider.value);
    const n2 = eventAnim ? eventAnim.drivers.n2 : parseFloat(indexSlider.value);
    const waterTemp = eventAnim ? eventAnim.drivers.waterTemp : readWaterTemp();
    drawScene(theta1, n2, waterTemp);
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  })(performance.now());
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  function emit(type, payload) {
    try {
      if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  function snapControls() {
    var o = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"], select').forEach(function(el) {
      var id = el.id || el.name;
      if (id) o[id] = el.value;
    });
    return o;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    emit('puzzle_open', {});
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() {
        if (window.__platformTraceControlsBound) return;
        emit('tuning', { control: el.id || el.name || 'slider', value: el.value });
      });
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('click', function() {
        emit('action', { control: el.id || (el.textContent || '').trim().slice(0, 24) || 'button' });
      });
    });
    window.__emit = emit;
    window.__snapControls = snapControls;
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  function emitWin(hintKey) {
    if (window.__legacyWinEmitted) return;
    window.__legacyWinEmitted = true;
    var emit = window.__emit;
    if (!emit) return;
    var controls = window.__snapControls ? window.__snapControls() : {};
    emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: hintKey || 'legacy_win' });
    emit('win', { winOk: true });
  }
  var WIN_TEXT = [/完美命中/, /游戏胜利/, /过关！/, /命中目标！/, /🎯\s*命中目标/, /🏆\s*过关/];
  function scanWinText() {
    var text = document.body ? document.body.innerText : '';
    for (var i = 0; i < WIN_TEXT.length; i++) {
      if (WIN_TEXT[i].test(text)) {
        emitWin('text_' + i);
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function() { scanWinText(); });
    if (document.body) obs.observe(document.body, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true });
    setInterval(scanWinText, 800);
  });
})();
</script>

    // keep design buffer; CSS scales visually

  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', fit);

    var st = document.getElementById('essence-stage');
    if (st) new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(st);
  }
  fit();
})();

<script>
/* === dual-mode-shell runtime (auto) === */
(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeShell) return;
  window.__dualModeShell = true;

  var MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
  var EXPLORE_SECONDS = 10 * 60;
  var state = {
    mode: 'explore',
    attempts: MAX_ATTEMPTS,
    timeLeft: EXPLORE_SECONDS,
    timerId: null
  };

  function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }

  function setPhase(phase){
    try {
      if (typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase === 'function') {
        window.__platformTraceSetPhase(phase);
      } else if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter && typeof window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase === 'function') {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(phase);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* offline */ }
  }

  function fmt(sec){
    var m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    var s = sec % 60;
    return (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;
  }

  function renderAttempts(){
    var el = $('attemptsDisplay');
    if (el) el.textContent = String(state.attempts);
  }

  function primaryButtons(){
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(
      '#essence-bench .essence-ft button, #essence-bench button.btn, #essence-bench button[id^="btn"]'
    ));
  }

  function gateActions(){
    var disable = state.mode === 'challenge' && state.attempts <= 0;
    primaryButtons().forEach(function(btn){
      if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(btn.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(btn.id || '')) return;
      btn.classList.toggle('dual-disabled', disable);
      if (disable) btn.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
      else btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
    });
  }

  function stopTimer(){
    if (state.timerId) { clearInterval(state.timerId); state.timerId = null; }
  }

  function startExploreTimer(){
    stopTimer();
    state.timeLeft = EXPLORE_SECONDS;
    var td = $('timerDisplay');
    if (td) td.textContent = fmt(state.timeLeft);
    state.timerId = setInterval(function(){
      if (state.mode !== 'explore') return;
      state.timeLeft -= 1;
      if (td) td.textContent = fmt(Math.max(0, state.timeLeft));
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        stopTimer();
        var sel = $('modeSelect');
        if (sel) {
          sel.value = 'challenge';
          sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  function applyMode(mode){
    state.mode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    var label = $('modeLabel');
    var stats = $('challengeStats');
    var timerChip = $('dual-timer-chip');
    if (label) label.textContent = state.mode === 'explore' ? '探究模式' : '竞赛模式';
    if (stats) {
      if (state.mode === 'challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible');
      else stats.classList.remove('is-visible');
    }
    if (timerChip) timerChip.style.display = state.mode === 'explore' ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    if (state.mode === 'challenge') {
      stopTimer();
      state.attempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS;
      renderAttempts();
    } else {
      startExploreTimer();
    }
    setPhase(state.mode);
    gateActions();
    if (typeof window.__snellApplyMode === 'function') {
      try { window.__snellApplyMode(state.mode); } catch (e) {}
    }
    try {
      if (typeof window.__refractApplyMode === 'function') window.__refractApplyMode(state.mode);
    } catch (e) {}
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dual-mode-change', { detail: { mode: state.mode, attempts: state.attempts } }));
  }

  function onPrimaryClick(e){
    if (state.mode !== 'challenge') return;
    var t = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!t) return;
    if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(t.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(t.id || '')) return;
    if (state.attempts <= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }
    state.attempts -= 1;
    renderAttempts();
    gateActions();
  }

  function ensureUi(){
    var stage = $('essence-stage') || document.querySelector('#proj-stage, #stage, #canvasContainer, .canvas-wrap')?.parentElement;
    var bench = $('essence-bench');
    if (!stage) return false;

    if (!$('dual-mode-hud')) {
      var hud = document.createElement('div');
      hud.id = 'dual-mode-hud';
      hud.innerHTML =
        '<div id="dual-timer-chip" class="dual-chip">' +
          '<span id="modeLabel">探究模式</span><span style="width:1px;height:14px;background:#cbd5e1"></span>' +
          '<span id="timerDisplay">10:00</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="challengeStats"><span>剩余机会</span><span id="attemptsDisplay">5</span></div>';
      stage.style.position = stage.style.position || 'relative';
      stage.appendChild(hud);
    }

    if (bench && !$('modeSelect')) {
      bench.classList.add('dual-mode-ready');
      var hd = document.createElement('div');
      hd.id = 'essence-bench-hd';
      hd.className = 'dual-bench-hd';
      var title = '环境控制台';
      var tEl = stage.querySelector('.essence-title, h1');
      if (tEl) title = (tEl.textContent || title).trim() || title;
      hd.innerHTML =
        '<h1>' + title.replace(/</g,'<') + '</h1>' +
        '<select id="modeSelect" aria-label="探究阶段">' +
          '<option value="explore">自由探究</option>' +
          '<option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>' +
        '</select>';
      bench.insertBefore(hd, bench.firstChild);
    } else if (!$('modeSelect')) {
      // Fallback: floating select in hud
      var chip = $('dual-timer-chip');
      if (chip && !$('modeSelect')) {
        var sel = document.createElement('select');
        sel.id = 'modeSelect';
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="explore">自由探究</option><option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>';
        chip.appendChild(sel);
      }
    }
    return !!$('modeSelect');
  }

  function boot(){
    if (!ensureUi()) return;
    var sel = $('modeSelect');
    sel.addEventListener('change', function(){ applyMode(sel.value); });
    var ft = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .essence-ft') || $('essence-bench') || document.body;
    ft.addEventListener('click', onPrimaryClick, true);
    applyMode(sel.value || 'explore');
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>


<script>
/* === craft-gold-runtime === */
(function(){
  if (window.__craftGold) return; window.__craftGold = true;
  var intro = document.getElementById('craft-intro');
  var win = document.getElementById('craft-win');
  var btn = document.getElementById('craftIntroBtn');
  var wbtn = document.getElementById('craftWinBtn');
  if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', function(){ if(intro) intro.hidden = true; });
  function replayLevel(){
    if (typeof window.__craftReplay === 'function') {
      try { window.__craftReplay(); return; } catch (e) {}
    }
    var rbtn = document.getElementById('btn-reset')
      || document.querySelector('#btnReset, button.btn-reset, [data-action="reset"]');
    if (rbtn) { try { rbtn.click(); } catch (e) {} }
  }
  if (wbtn) wbtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    window.__craftWinDismissed = true;
    if (win) win.hidden = true;
    replayLevel();
  });

  // gauge into hud
  var hud = document.getElementById('essence-hud') || document.getElementById('dual-mode-hud') || document.getElementById('hud');
  if (hud && !document.getElementById('craft-gauge')) {
    var g = document.createElement('div');
    g.id = 'craft-gauge';
    g.innerHTML = '<span>目标仪表</span><strong id="craftGaugeVal">待测</strong>';
    hud.appendChild(g);
  }
function showWin(extra){
    if (win) {
      window.__craftWinDismissed = false;
      win.hidden = false;
      var t = document.getElementById('craftWinText');
      if (t && extra) t.textContent = extra;
    }
  }
  window.__craftShowWin = showWin;

  // Hook common win paths
  var _emit = window.__emit;
  window.__emit = function(type, payload){
    if (typeof _emit === 'function') _emit(type, payload);
    if (type === 'win') showWin();
  };
  // Observe win banners
  var obs = new MutationObserver(function(){
    if (window.__craftWinDismissed) return;
    var el = document.querySelector('.win-banner,.win-badge,#winBanner,[data-win="1"]');
    if (el && el.offsetParent !== null) showWin();
  });
  obs.observe(document.body, {childList:true, subtree:true, attributes:true, attributeFilter:['class','style','hidden']});

  // Live gauge from first range readout if possible
  function tick(){
    var val = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .value-badge, #essence-bench .value, .observe-box .state, .observe-value, #craftGaugeVal');
    var src = document.querySelector('.observe-box .state, .observe-value, #hud-dist, #g-T, .gauge .gval');
    var gval = document.getElementById('craftGaugeVal');
    if (gval && src && src !== gval) gval.textContent = (src.textContent || '').trim() || '观测中';
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
})();
</script>

</body>

<script>
(function(){
  function emit(type, payload) {
    try {
      if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  function snapControls() {
    var o = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el) {
      var id = el.id || el.name; if (id) o[id] = el.value;
    });
    return o;
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // puzzle_open
    emit('puzzle_open', {});

    // tuning 绑定 (滑条)
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() {
        if (window.__platformTraceControlsBound) return;
        emit('tuning', { control: el.id || 'slider', value: el.value });
      });
    });

    // irrelevant_touch I1
    var i1 = document.getElementById('I1');
    if (i1) {
      i1.addEventListener('click', function() {
        emit('irrelevant_touch', { control: 'I1', value: 'click' });
        document.getElementById('irrMsg').innerText = '点击了装饰 (已上报)';
        setTimeout(function(){ document.getElementById('irrMsg').innerText = ''; }, 1500);
      });
    }

    // 全局暴露 emit 和 snap 以便业务调用
    window.__emit = emit;
    window.__snap = snapControls;
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
(function() {
  // ----- 物理常量 & DOM 引用 -----
  const canvas = document.getElementById('simCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const L = 0.8; // 固定导线长度 (m)

  const sCurrent = document.getElementById('s-current');
  const sMagnetic = document.getElementById('s-magnetic');
  const sWireTemp = document.getElementById('s-wire-temp');
  const currentVal = document.getElementById('currentVal');
  const magneticVal = document.getElementById('magneticVal');
  const wireTempVal = document.getElementById('wireTempVal');
  const forceDisplay = document.getElementById('forceDisplay');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedbackArea');
  const winIndicator = document.getElementById('winIndicator');

  // 目标安培力：探究观察；竞赛 FixedChallenge 进入时锁定一次
  let F_TARGET = 2.4; // N
  // 探究/竞赛分流：竞赛容差更紧，同参未必两边同结论
  const TOL_MODE = { explore: 0.22, challenge: 0.08 };
  function forceTol() { return TOL_MODE[playMode] || TOL_MODE.explore; }
  let playMode = 'explore';
  let lockedF = null;
  let challengeWon = false;

  const MODE_GOALS = {
    explore: {
      hud: '试吊：观察托力随 I、B 变化',
      side: '调 I、B，看托力怎么变。'
    },
    challenge: {
      hud: '限次把托力打进本局目标（打偏不换单）',
      side: '限次把托力打进本局目标（打偏不换单）。'
    }
  };
  function refreshMagGoals() {
    const g = MODE_GOALS[playMode] || MODE_GOALS.explore;
    const mission = document.getElementById('goalMission');
    const side = document.getElementById('sideGoal');
    if (playMode === 'challenge' && lockedF != null) {
      if (mission) mission.textContent = '急单托力：' + lockedF.toFixed(1) + ' N · 本局固定';
      if (side) side.textContent = '竞赛急单：限次把托力调到约 ' + lockedF.toFixed(1) + ' N（本局固定，打偏不换单）。';
    } else {
      if (mission) mission.textContent = g.hud;
      if (side) side.textContent = g.side;
    }
  }
  /** FixedChallenge：仅进入竞赛时锁定一次目标力 */
  function lockChallengeF() {
    // 可达：I∈[0,5], B∈[0,2], L=0.8 → F∈[0,8]
    const candidates = [1.6, 2.0, 2.4, 2.8, 3.2, 3.6, 4.0];
    lockedF = candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)];
    F_TARGET = lockedF;
    challengeWon = false;
    eventAnim = null;
    measuredF = null;
    sCurrent.value = '1.0';
    sMagnetic.value = '0.5';
    refreshMagGoals();
    updateAll();
    displayLift = liftFromF(computeForce(parseFloat(sCurrent.value) || 0, parseFloat(sMagnetic.value) || 0));
    feedback.textContent = '急单已锁定托力 ' + F_TARGET.toFixed(1) + ' N（本局不变）';
    winIndicator.style.display = 'none';
  }
  function applyExploreF() {
    lockedF = null;
    F_TARGET = 2.4;
    challengeWon = false;
    eventAnim = null;
    measuredF = null;
    sCurrent.value = '2.0';
    sMagnetic.value = '1.0';
    refreshMagGoals();
    updateAll();
    displayLift = liftFromF(computeForce(parseFloat(sCurrent.value) || 0, parseFloat(sMagnetic.value) || 0));
    feedback.textContent = '调 I、B，读托力';
    winIndicator.style.display = 'none';
  }
  window.__magApplyMode = function(mode) {
    playMode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    if (playMode === 'challenge') lockChallengeF();
    else applyExploreF();
  };
  document.addEventListener('dual-mode-change', function(ev) {
    var m = ev && ev.detail && ev.detail.mode;
    if (typeof window.__magApplyMode === 'function') window.__magApplyMode(m);
  });
  /* BATCH5-FIXED-20260724 FixedChallenge */

  // ----- 物理计算 (唯一公式) -----
  function computeForce(I, B) {
    return B * I * L;
  }

  /** 仅测试后揭示 F */
  let measuredF = null;

  /** 事件动画 FSM：idle → windup → peak → settle；点击时冻结 drivers */
  let eventAnim = null;
  /** 空闲时平滑托力位移；事件中由 FSM 驱动 */
  let displayLift = 0;
  let lastFrameTime = performance.now();

  function liftFromF(F) {
    return Math.min(50, F * 12);
  }

  function mapFToDur(F) {
    const fNorm = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (F || 0) / 8));
    return 0.45 + fNorm * 0.85;
  }

  function classifyBand(F) {
    if (Math.abs(F - F_TARGET) <= forceTol()) return 'ok';
    return F > F_TARGET + forceTol() ? 'high' : 'low';
  }

  function stepEventAnim(dt) {
    if (!eventAnim) {
      const I = parseFloat(sCurrent.value) || 0;
      const B = parseFloat(sMagnetic.value) || 0;
      const targetLift = liftFromF(computeForce(I, B));
      displayLift += (targetLift - displayLift) * Math.min(1, dt * 4.2);
      return;
    }
    eventAnim.t += dt;
    const d = eventAnim.drivers;
    const windupDur = d.totalDur * 0.38;
    const peakDur = d.totalDur * 0.22;
    const settleDur = Math.max(0.12, d.totalDur - windupDur - peakDur);
    const liftTarget = d.liftTarget;
    const band = d.band;

    if (eventAnim.phase === 'windup') {
      const p = Math.min(1, eventAnim.t / Math.max(0.05, windupDur));
      const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 2.4);
      const windTarget = band === 'low' ? liftTarget * 0.62 : liftTarget;
      displayLift = eventAnim.windupStartLift + (windTarget - eventAnim.windupStartLift) * ease;
      eventAnim.springOffset = (windTarget - eventAnim.windupStartLift) * ease * 0.06;
      if (eventAnim.t >= windupDur) {
        eventAnim.phase = 'peak';
        eventAnim.t = 0;
        eventAnim.peakBase = displayLift;
      }
    } else if (eventAnim.phase === 'peak') {
      const p = Math.min(1, eventAnim.t / Math.max(0.05, peakDur));
      let overshoot = 0;
      if (band === 'ok') overshoot = liftTarget * 0.09 * Math.sin(p * Math.PI);
      else if (band === 'high') overshoot = liftTarget * 0.38 * Math.sin(p * Math.PI);
      else overshoot = liftTarget * 0.05 * Math.sin(p * Math.PI);
      displayLift = liftTarget + overshoot;
      eventAnim.springOffset = overshoot * 0.22;
      if (eventAnim.t >= peakDur) {
        eventAnim.phase = 'settle';
        eventAnim.t = 0;
        eventAnim.settleStartLift = displayLift;
      }
    } else if (eventAnim.phase === 'settle') {
      const p = Math.min(1, eventAnim.t / settleDur);
      if (band === 'high') {
        const decay = Math.exp(-p * 3.8);
        const bounce = Math.sin(p * Math.PI * 3.2) * decay * liftTarget * 0.28;
        displayLift = liftTarget + bounce;
        eventAnim.springOffset = bounce * 0.28;
      } else if (band === 'low') {
        const ease = 1 - Math.exp(-p * 7);
        const lowTarget = liftTarget * 0.72;
        displayLift = eventAnim.settleStartLift + (lowTarget - eventAnim.settleStartLift) * ease;
        eventAnim.springOffset = (1 - ease) * liftTarget * 0.04;
      } else {
        const ease = 1 - Math.exp(-p * 5.5);
        displayLift = eventAnim.settleStartLift + (liftTarget - eventAnim.settleStartLift) * ease;
        eventAnim.springOffset = (1 - ease) * liftTarget * 0.05;
        eventAnim.flashGreen = Math.max(0, 1 - p * 2.8);
      }
      if (eventAnim.t >= settleDur) {
        displayLift = band === 'low' ? liftTarget * 0.72 : liftTarget;
        eventAnim = null;
      }
    }
  }

  // ----- 更新UI + canvas + 判定 -----
  function updateAll() {
    const I = parseFloat(sCurrent.value) || 0;
    const B = parseFloat(sMagnetic.value) || 0;
    currentVal.textContent = I.toFixed(1);
    magneticVal.textContent = B.toFixed(1);
    if (wireTempVal && sWireTemp) wireTempVal.textContent = parseFloat(sWireTemp.value).toFixed(0);

    const F = computeForce(I, B);
    forceDisplay.textContent = measuredF != null ? measuredF.toFixed(2) : '—';

    // 绘制 canvas (极简示意图)
    drawCanvas(I, B, F);

    if (playMode === 'explore') {
      feedback.textContent = measuredF != null
        ? ('本次托力 ' + measuredF.toFixed(2) + ' N · 换参再测')
        : '读数待测 · 调 I、B 后点测试';
    } else {
      feedback.textContent = measuredF != null
        ? ('本次 ' + measuredF.toFixed(2) + ' N · 急单锁定 ' + F_TARGET.toFixed(1) + ' N')
        : ('读数待测 · 急单锁定 ' + F_TARGET.toFixed(1) + ' N · 点测试');
    }
  }

  let W = 600, H = 360, dpr = 1, pulse = 0;
  const wrap = canvas.parentElement;
  function resizeCanvas() {
    const rect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    W = Math.max(320, rect.width);
    H = Math.max(240, rect.height);
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    const I = parseFloat(sCurrent.value) || 0;
    const B = parseFloat(sMagnetic.value) || 0;
    drawCanvas(I, B, computeForce(I, B));
  }

  function drawCanvas(I, B, F) {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    var INK = '#0a1410', MID = '#1e3428', ACCENT = '#4aaa78';
    var GLOW = '#40c878', METAL = '#6a7870', HI = '#80d0a0', OK = '#6fae8f';
    const drv = eventAnim ? eventAnim.drivers : null;
    const drawI = drv ? drv.I : I;
    const drawB = drv ? drv.B : B;
    const drawF = drv ? drv.F : F;
    const band = drv ? drv.band : classifyBand(drawF);
    const onBand = band === 'ok';
    const animActive = !!eventAnim;
    const power = Math.min(1, (drawI * drawB) / 8);
    const fNorm = Math.min(1, drawF / 8);
    const lift = displayLift;
    const springOff = eventAnim ? (eventAnim.springOffset || 0) : 0;
    const flashG = eventAnim ? (eventAnim.flashGreen || 0) : 0;
    const bandColor = onBand ? OK : (band === 'high' ? '#f87171' : '#fb923c');

    function rr(x, y, w, h, r) {
      r = Math.min(r, w * 0.5, h * 0.5);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
      ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
      ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
      ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
      ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
      ctx.closePath();
    }

    // 测力台背景
    var bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    bg.addColorStop(0, '#101c16');
    bg.addColorStop(0.55, INK);
    bg.addColorStop(1, '#060c08');
    ctx.fillStyle = bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // FAR: 天花板线槽 + 侧设备架 + 墙板（y≥100 避 HUD，在磁轭后）
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(64,200,120,0.07)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let p = 0; p < 5; p++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(W * 0.1, 12 + p * 6);
      ctx.lineTo(W * 0.9, 12 + p * 6);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,16,12,0.68)';
    for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
      ctx.fillRect(W * 0.14 + c * W * 0.2, 8, W * 0.11, 5);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,20,16,0.72)';
    ctx.fillRect(4, 100, 46, 88);
    ctx.fillRect(W - 50, 100, 46, 88);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(74,170,120,0.06)';
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      ctx.strokeRect(56 + i * (W - 112) / 4, 102, (W - 112) / 4 - 4, 76);
    }

    var ambGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.5, H * 0.45, 30, W * 0.5, H * 0.45, W * 0.6);
    const ambScale = animActive ? 0.22 : 1;
    ambGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(64,200,120,' + ((0.03 + power * 0.14) * ambScale + flashG * 0.18) + ')');
    ambGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(64,200,120,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = ambGlow;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // 实验台地面
    var floorY = H - 70;
    var floorG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, floorY, 0, H);
    floorG.addColorStop(0, MID);
    floorG.addColorStop(1, INK);
    ctx.fillStyle = floorG;
    ctx.fillRect(0, floorY, W, H - floorY);
    ctx.fillStyle = METAL;
    ctx.fillRect(0, floorY, W, 10);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(64,200,120,0.12)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, floorY);
    ctx.lineTo(W, floorY);
    ctx.stroke();

    // 磁轭框架加厚（HERO ~50%H）
    var yokeX = W * 0.1, yokeY = 100, yokeW = W * 0.78, yokeH = H * 0.52;
    var yokeG = ctx.createLinearGradient(yokeX, yokeY, yokeX + yokeW, yokeY + yokeH);
    yokeG.addColorStop(0, '#2a4034');
    yokeG.addColorStop(0.45, MID);
    yokeG.addColorStop(1, '#142018');
    ctx.fillStyle = yokeG;
    rr(yokeX, yokeY, yokeW, yokeH, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(74,170,120,0.42)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    rr(yokeX, yokeY, yokeW, yokeH, 8);
    ctx.stroke();
    // 侧立柱加厚
    ctx.fillStyle = '#243828';
    rr(yokeX + 4, yokeY + 10, 28, yokeH - 20, 4);
    ctx.fill();
    rr(yokeX + yokeW - 32, yokeY + 10, 28, yokeH - 20, 4);
    ctx.fill();
    var poleH = yokeH * 0.2;
    var poleG = ctx.createLinearGradient(yokeX, yokeY + 8, yokeX, yokeY + 8 + poleH);
    poleG.addColorStop(0, '#889890');
    poleG.addColorStop(0.5, METAL);
    poleG.addColorStop(1, '#4a5850');
    ctx.fillStyle = poleG;
    rr(yokeX + 36, yokeY + 10, yokeW - 72, poleH, 4);
    ctx.fill();
    var botPoleY = yokeY + yokeH - poleH - 10;
    ctx.fillStyle = poleG;
    rr(yokeX + 36, botPoleY, yokeW - 72, poleH, 4);
    ctx.fill();

    // 铜绕组（上下极）
    for (var wi = 0; wi < 8; wi++) {
      var wy1 = yokeY + 14 + wi * (poleH / 8);
      var wy2 = botPoleY + 4 + wi * (poleH / 8);
      ctx.strokeStyle = wi % 2 ? '#c89050' : '#e8b060';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(yokeX + 40, wy1);
      ctx.lineTo(yokeX + yokeW - 40, wy1);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(yokeX + 40, wy2);
      ctx.lineTo(yokeX + yokeW - 40, wy2);
      ctx.stroke();

    // B × 标记（轻微脉动；事件中让位）
    const dens = Math.max(4, Math.round(drawB * 7));
    const bPulseBase = animActive ? 0.18 : (0.3 + 0.15 * Math.sin((typeof pulse === 'number' ? pulse : 0) * 6 + Date.now() * 0.003));
    const bPulse = bPulseBase + drawB * 0.06;
    for (let i = 0; i < dens; i++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
        const x = W * 0.18 + i * (W * 0.64) / dens;
        const y = yokeY + poleH + 18 + j * ((yokeH - poleH * 2 - 36) / 4);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(64,200,120,' + Math.min(0.95, bPulse + drawB * 0.2 + power * 0.1) + ')';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2 + drawB * 0.35;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = ACCENT;
        ctx.font = '13px sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('×', x, y + 4);

    }

    // 左电源柱
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3830';
    rr(16, H * 0.38, 36, 70, 4);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c04040';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(34, H * 0.42, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3040c0';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(34, H * 0.52, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    ctx.font = '10px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';

    // 磁轨 + 载流导线

    railG.addColorStop(0.5, METAL);
    railG.addColorStop(1, '#4a5850');
    ctx.fillStyle = railG;
    ctx.fillRect(W * 0.1, yWire + 28, W * 0.72, 12);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(128,208,160,0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W * 0.1, yWire + 28);
    ctx.lineTo(W * 0.82, yWire + 28);

    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(52, H * 0.52);
    ctx.lineTo(W * 0.1, yWire + 48);
    ctx.lineTo(W * 0.82, yWire + 48);
    ctx.lineTo(W * 0.86, yWire);
    ctx.stroke();

    var wireY = yWire - lift;
    // 导线温度：冷蓝→暖铜→微红晕（不进 F=BIL 计算）
    var tWire = sWireTemp ? parseFloat(sWireTemp.value) : 25;
    var tNorm = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (tWire - 10) / 70));
    var wireCool = 'rgb(' + Math.round(120 + tNorm * 80) + ',' + Math.round(150 - tNorm * 40) + ',' + Math.round(200 - tNorm * 140) + ')';
    var wireHot = 'rgb(' + Math.round(200 + tNorm * 40) + ',' + Math.round(176 - tNorm * 60) + ',' + Math.round(96 - tNorm * 40) + ')';
    var wireDeep = 'rgb(' + Math.round(140 + tNorm * 60) + ',' + Math.round(100 - tNorm * 30) + ',' + Math.round(60 - tNorm * 20) + ')';
    var wireG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, wireY - 5, 0, wireY + 5);
    wireG.addColorStop(0, wireCool);
    wireG.addColorStop(0.45, wireHot);
    wireG.addColorStop(1, wireDeep);
    ctx.strokeStyle = wireG;
    ctx.lineWidth = 10;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(' + Math.round(180 + tNorm * 60) + ',' + Math.round(140 - tNorm * 40) + ',' + Math.round(80 - tNorm * 40) + ',' + (0.22 + Math.min(1, drawI / 5) * 0.5 + tNorm * 0.2) + ')';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6 + drawI * 3 + tNorm * 4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(52, wireY);
    ctx.lineTo(W * 0.82, wireY);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    // 电源→导线
    ctx.strokeStyle = wireG;
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(34, H * 0.42);
    ctx.lineTo(52, wireY);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = HI;
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('I →', W * 0.74, wireY - 14);

    var scaleX = W * 0.9, scaleY = yWire - 10;

    scaleG.addColorStop(0, '#3a4840');

    if (drawF > 0.05) {

      ctx.moveTo(ax, wireY + 10);
      ctx.lineTo(ax, wireY + 10 + 36 + arrowPulse);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
      ctx.fillStyle = onBand ? OK : (flashG > 0 ? OK : GLOW);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(ax, wireY + 52 + arrowPulse);
      ctx.lineTo(ax - 8, wireY + 40 + arrowPulse);
      ctx.lineTo(ax + 8, wireY + 40 + arrowPulse);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = HI;
      ctx.font = 'bold 12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillText('F', ax + 12, wireY + 40);
    }

    // 目标力读数牌
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,20,16,0.85)';
    rr(16, H - 58, 260, 40, 4);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = onBand ? 'rgba(111,174,143,0.6)' : (band === 'high' ? 'rgba(248,113,113,0.55)' : 'rgba(251,146,60,0.5)');
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    rr(16, H - 58, 260, 40, 4);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = HI;
    ctx.font = '12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText((playMode==='challenge'?'急单':'参考') + ' F ≈ ' + F_TARGET.toFixed(1) + ' N (±' + forceTol() + ')', 26, H - 42);
    ctx.fillStyle = measuredF != null ? (Math.abs(measuredF - F_TARGET) <= forceTol() ? OK : '#fca5a5') : '#7a9a88';
    if (measuredF != null) {
      ctx.fillText('当前 ' + measuredF.toFixed(2) + ' N · I=' + drawI.toFixed(1) + 'A B=' + drawB.toFixed(1) + 'T', 26, H - 26);
    } else {
      ctx.fillText('当前 F 待测 · I=' + drawI.toFixed(1) + 'A B=' + drawB.toFixed(1) + 'T', 26, H - 26);
    }
  }

  // ----- 测试/发射 事件 (snapshot + win) -----
  function onTest() {
    if (eventAnim) return;
    const I = parseFloat(sCurrent.value) || 0;
    const B = parseFloat(sMagnetic.value) || 0;
    const F = computeForce(I, B);
    const band = classifyBand(F);
    const totalDur = mapFToDur(F);
    const liftTarget = liftFromF(F);

    measuredF = F;
    forceDisplay.textContent = measuredF.toFixed(2);

    eventAnim = {
      phase: 'windup',
      t: 0,
      drivers: { I: I, B: B, F: F, band: band, totalDur: totalDur, liftTarget: liftTarget },
      springOffset: 0,
      flashGreen: 0,
      windupStartLift: displayLift
    };

    // 约束检查
    let hintKey = '';
    let winOk = false;

    if (I < 0 || I > 5) {
      hintKey = '电流超出范围 (0~5A)';
      feedback.innerHTML = '电流超范围 · 调回 0~5 A';
    } else if (B < 0 || B > 2) {
      hintKey = '磁感应强度超出范围 (0~2T)';
      feedback.innerHTML = '磁场超范围 · 调回 0~2 T';
    } else if (playMode === 'explore') {
      hintKey = 'explore_observe';
      feedback.textContent = '托力已出 · 对照电流与磁场再测';
      winIndicator.style.display = 'none';
    } else if (Math.abs(F - F_TARGET) <= forceTol()) {
      winOk = true;
      hintKey = '过关！安培力达标';
      feedback.textContent = '急单完成 · 托力已入目标';
      winIndicator.style.display = 'inline-block';
      if (!challengeWon && typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
        challengeWon = true;
        window.__craftShowWin('急单托力本局锁定。导线长度固定时，F 与 B、I 成正比。');
      }
    } else {
      // FixedChallenge：失败不换目标；偏大/偏小可区分
      const tooHigh = F > F_TARGET + forceTol();
      hintKey = tooHigh ? 'force_high' : 'force_low';
      feedback.innerHTML = '<strong>' + (tooHigh ? '托力偏大' : '托力偏小') + '</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.82em;opacity:.92">当前 ' + F.toFixed(2) + ' N · 急单 ' + F_TARGET.toFixed(1) + ' N</span>';
      winIndicator.style.display = 'none';
    }

    // 构造 controls 快照
    var controlsSnapshot = {};
    controlsSnapshot['s-current'] = I.toString();
    controlsSnapshot['s-magnetic'] = B.toString();

    // emit snapshot
    if (window.__emit) {
      window.__emit('snapshot', { controls: controlsSnapshot, winOk: winOk, hintKey: hintKey });
    }

    // 如果过关，额外 emit win
    if (winOk) {
      if (window.__emit) {
        window.__emit('win', { winOk: true });
      }
    }
  }

  // ----- 重置 -----
  function onReset() {
    measuredF = null;
    eventAnim = null;
    displayLift = liftFromF(computeForce(parseFloat(sCurrent.value) || 0, parseFloat(sMagnetic.value) || 0));
    sCurrent.value = '2.0';
    sMagnetic.value = '1.0';
    winIndicator.style.display = 'none';
    feedback.innerHTML = '← 已重置，读数待测 · 点击测试';
    updateAll();
  }

  // ----- 绑定事件 -----
  sCurrent.addEventListener('input', function() {
    if (eventAnim) return;
    measuredF = null;
    updateAll();
  });
  sMagnetic.addEventListener('input', function() {
    if (eventAnim) return;
    measuredF = null;
    updateAll();
  });
  if (sWireTemp) sWireTemp.addEventListener('input', function() { updateAll(); });

  document.getElementById('btn-test').addEventListener('click', onTest);
  document.getElementById('btn-reset').addEventListener('click', onReset);

  window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined' && wrap) new ResizeObserver(resizeCanvas).observe(wrap);
  resizeCanvas();
  updateAll();
  (function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastFrameTime) / 1000);
    lastFrameTime = now;
    if (!eventAnim) pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(now / 280);
    stepEventAnim(dt);
    const I = parseFloat(sCurrent.value) || 0;
    const B = parseFloat(sMagnetic.value) || 0;
    const F = eventAnim ? eventAnim.drivers.F : computeForce(I, B);
    const drawI = eventAnim ? eventAnim.drivers.I : I;
    const drawB = eventAnim ? eventAnim.drivers.B : B;
    drawCanvas(drawI, drawB, F);
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  })(performance.now());
})();

(function(){

    try {
      if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  function snapControls() {
    var o = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"], select').forEach(function(el) {
      var id = el.id || el.name;
      if (id) o[id] = el.value;
    });
    return o;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    emit('puzzle_open', {});
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() {
        if (window.__platformTraceControlsBound) return;
        emit('tuning', { control: el.id || el.name || 'slider', value: el.value });
      });

    document.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('click', function() {
        emit('action', { control: el.id || (el.textContent || '').trim().slice(0, 24) || 'button' });
      });
    });
    window.__emit = emit;
    window.__snapControls = snapControls;
  });
})();

(function(){

  window.__dualModeShell = true;

  };

  function setPhase(phase){

      if (typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase === 'function') {
        window.__platformTraceSetPhase(phase);
      } else if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter && typeof window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase === 'function') {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(phase);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* offline */ }
  }

  function fmt(sec){
    var m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    var s = sec % 60;
    return (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;
  }

  function renderAttempts(){
    var el = $('attemptsDisplay');
    if (el) el.textContent = String(state.attempts);
  }

  function primaryButtons(){
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(
      '#essence-bench .essence-ft button, #essence-bench button.btn, #essence-bench button[id^="btn"]'
    ));
  }

  function gateActions(){
    var disable = state.mode === 'challenge' && state.attempts <= 0;
    primaryButtons().forEach(function(btn){
      if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(btn.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(btn.id || '')) return;
      btn.classList.toggle('dual-disabled', disable);
      if (disable) btn.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
      else btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
    });
  }

  function stopTimer(){
    if (state.timerId) { clearInterval(state.timerId); state.timerId = null; }
  }

  function startExploreTimer(){
    stopTimer();
    state.timeLeft = EXPLORE_SECONDS;
    var td = $('timerDisplay');
    if (td) td.textContent = fmt(state.timeLeft);
    state.timerId = setInterval(function(){
      if (state.mode !== 'explore') return;
      state.timeLeft -= 1;
      if (td) td.textContent = fmt(Math.max(0, state.timeLeft));
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        stopTimer();
        var sel = $('modeSelect');
        if (sel) {
          sel.value = 'challenge';
          sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  function applyMode(mode){
    state.mode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    var label = $('modeLabel');
    var stats = $('challengeStats');
    var timerChip = $('dual-timer-chip');
    if (label) label.textContent = state.mode === 'explore' ? '探究模式' : '竞赛模式';
    if (stats) {
      if (state.mode === 'challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible');
      else stats.classList.remove('is-visible');
    }
    if (timerChip) timerChip.style.display = state.mode === 'explore' ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    if (state.mode === 'challenge') {
      stopTimer();
      state.attempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS;
      renderAttempts();
    } else {
      startExploreTimer();
    }
    setPhase(state.mode);
    gateActions();
    try {
      if (typeof window.__magApplyMode === 'function') window.__magApplyMode(state.mode);
    } catch (e) {}
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dual-mode-change', { detail: { mode: state.mode, attempts: state.attempts } }));
  }

  function onPrimaryClick(e){
    if (state.mode !== 'challenge') return;
    var t = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!t) return;
    if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(t.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(t.id || '')) return;
    if (state.attempts <= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }
    state.attempts -= 1;
    renderAttempts();
    gateActions();
  }

  function ensureUi(){
    var stage = $('essence-stage') || document.querySelector('#proj-stage, #stage, #canvasContainer, .canvas-wrap')?.parentElement;

    if (!$('dual-mode-hud')) {

      stage.style.position = stage.style.position || 'relative';
      stage.appendChild(hud);
    }

    if (bench && !$('modeSelect')) {
      bench.classList.add('dual-mode-ready');
      var hd = document.createElement('div');
      hd.id = 'essence-bench-hd';
      hd.className = 'dual-bench-hd';
      var title = '环境控制台';
      var tEl = stage.querySelector('.essence-title, h1');
      if (tEl) title = (tEl.textContent || title).trim() || title;
      hd.innerHTML =
        '<h1>' + title.replace(/</g,'<') + '</h1>' +
        '<select id="modeSelect" aria-label="探究阶段">' +
          '<option value="explore">自由探究</option>' +
          '<option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>' +
        '</select>';
      bench.insertBefore(hd, bench.firstChild);
    } else if (!$('modeSelect')) {
      // Fallback: floating select in hud
      var chip = $('dual-timer-chip');
      if (chip && !$('modeSelect')) {
        var sel = document.createElement('select');
        sel.id = 'modeSelect';
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="explore">自由探究</option><option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>';
        chip.appendChild(sel);
      }
    }
    return !!$('modeSelect');
  }

  function boot(){
    if (!ensureUi()) return;
    var sel = $('modeSelect');
    sel.addEventListener('change', function(){ applyMode(sel.value); });
    var ft = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .essence-ft') || $('essence-bench') || document.body;
    ft.addEventListener('click', onPrimaryClick, true);
    applyMode(sel.value || 'explore');
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>
