      }

      const iNorm = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, I / 5));
      var canEscape = drv ? drv.canEscape : (I > 0);
      var timeBase = eventAnim ? animT : ambientT;
      var lampX = W * 0.11, lampY = H * 0.42;
      var lampFlick = eventAnim
        ? (0.92 + surge * 0.28 + (animPhase === 'peak' ? 0.12 : 0))
        : (0.88 + 0.12 * Math.sin(ambientT * 5.1) * Math.sin(ambientT * 3.3 + 1.2));
      var lampBoost = 0.22 + inten * 0.18 + (canEscape ? iNorm * 0.2 : 0) + surge * 0.35;
      var lampRad = ctx.createRadialGradient(lampX, lampY, 6, lampX, lampY, W * 0.52);
      lampRad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',' + (lampBoost * lampFlick) + ')');
      lampRad.addColorStop(0.28, 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',' + (0.10 * lampFlick + inten * 0.08) + ')');
      lampRad.addColorStop(0.62, 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',0.05)');
      lampRad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = lampRad;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      // 腔室地面
      var floorY = H * 0.84;
      var floorG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, floorY, 0, H);
      floorG.addColorStop(0, '#1a1624');
      floorG.addColorStop(1, '#080610');
      ctx.fillStyle = floorG;
      ctx.fillRect(0, floorY, W, H - floorY);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(212,168,75,0.12)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, floorY);
      ctx.lineTo(W, floorY);
      ctx.stroke();

      // 密封暗箱外壳（HERO）
      var chX = W * 0.06, chY = H * 0.10, chW = W * 0.88, chH = H * 0.70;
      var shellG = ctx.createLinearGradient(chX, chY, chX + chW, chY + chH);
      shellG.addColorStop(0, '#1e1a28');
      shellG.addColorStop(0.45, MID);
      shellG.addColorStop(1, '#14101c');
      ctx.fillStyle = shellG;
      rr(chX, chY, chW, chH, 10);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(212,168,75,0.38)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      rr(chX, chY, chW, chH, 10);
      ctx.stroke();
      // 内腔阴影
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
      rr(chX + 8, chY + 8, chW - 16, chH - 16, 7);
      ctx.fill();
      // 顶沿高光
      var topSheen = ctx.createLinearGradient(chX, chY, chX, chY + 28);
      topSheen.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(240,208,144,0.10)');
      topSheen.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(240,208,144,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = topSheen;
      rr(chX + 2, chY + 2, chW - 4, 26, 8);
      ctx.fill();

      // 标题铭牌
      ctx.fillStyle = HI;
      ctx.font = '12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillText(
        playMode === 'challenge' && lockedMat ? ('暗箱光电管 · ' + lockedMat.name) : '暗箱光电管',
        chX + 16, chY - 6
      );

      // 汞/UV 灯罩（左侧）
      var housX = chX + 18, housY = chY + chH * 0.22, housW = W * 0.13, housH = chH * 0.56;
      var housG = ctx.createLinearGradient(housX, housY, housX + housW, housY);
      housG.addColorStop(0, '#3a3448');
      housG.addColorStop(0.5, METAL);
      housG.addColorStop(1, '#4a5060');
      ctx.fillStyle = housG;
      rr(housX, housY, housW, housH, 5);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(212,168,75,0.28)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      rr(housX, housY, housW, housH, 5);
      ctx.stroke();
      // 石英窗（色相随频率）
      var winX = housX + housW * 0.18, winY = housY + housH * 0.28;
      var winW = housW * 0.64, winH = housH * 0.44;
      var winG = ctx.createLinearGradient(winX, winY, winX + winW, winY + winH);
      winG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',0.55)');
      winG.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',0.32)');
      winG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',0.22)');
      ctx.fillStyle = winG;
      rr(winX, winY, winW, winH, 3);
      ctx.fill();
      var bulbCore = ctx.createRadialGradient(winX + winW * 0.5, winY + winH * 0.5, 1, winX + winW * 0.5, winY + winH * 0.5, winW * 0.55);
      bulbCore.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,248,230,' + (0.9 * lampFlick) + ')');
      bulbCore.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',' + (0.78 * lampFlick) + ')');
      bulbCore.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = bulbCore;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(winX + winW * 0.5, winY + winH * 0.5, winW * 0.42 * (0.9 + inten * 0.12), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',0.9)';
      ctx.font = '9px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('Hg UV', winX + winW * 0.5, housY + housH + 14);

      // 真空光电管（玻璃 + 电极）
      var tubeX = chX + W * 0.22, tubeY = chY + chH * 0.18;
      var tubeW = chW * 0.62, tubeH = chH * 0.58;
      // 玻璃管体
      var glassG = ctx.createLinearGradient(tubeX, tubeY, tubeX + tubeW, tubeY);
      glassG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(110,184,232,0.06)');
      glassG.addColorStop(0.18, 'rgba(180,210,230,0.14)');
      glassG.addColorStop(0.50, 'rgba(120,150,180,0.08)');
      glassG.addColorStop(0.82, 'rgba(180,210,230,0.12)');
      glassG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(110,184,232,0.05)');
      ctx.fillStyle = glassG;
      rr(tubeX, tubeY, tubeW, tubeH, 8);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(110,184,232,0.42)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      rr(tubeX, tubeY, tubeW, tubeH, 8);
      ctx.stroke();
      // 玻璃高光
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(tubeX + 14, tubeY + 10);
      ctx.lineTo(tubeX + 14, tubeY + tubeH - 16);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(tubeX + tubeW * 0.72, tubeY + tubeH * 0.22, tubeH * 0.12, -0.6, 0.9);
      ctx.stroke();

      // 阴极 / 阳极金属板
      var cy = tubeY + tubeH * 0.18, ch = tubeH * 0.64, plateW = Math.max(22, tubeW * 0.055);
      var cathG = ctx.createLinearGradient(tubeX + 24, cy, tubeX + 24 + plateW, cy);
      cathG.addColorStop(0, '#4a5060');
      cathG.addColorStop(0.45, METAL);
      cathG.addColorStop(1, '#5a6474');
      ctx.fillStyle = cathG;
      rr(tubeX + 24, cy, plateW, ch, 2);
      ctx.fill();
      if (iNorm > 0.05) {
        ctx.shadowColor = '#e06060';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 4 + iNorm * 14;
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(224,96,96,' + (0.25 + iNorm * 0.55) + ')';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        rr(tubeX + 24, cy, plateW, ch, 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(240,208,144,0.25)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      rr(tubeX + 24, cy, plateW, ch, 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      var anG = ctx.createLinearGradient(tubeX + tubeW - 24 - plateW, cy, tubeX + tubeW - 24, cy);
      anG.addColorStop(0, '#5a6474');
      anG.addColorStop(0.55, '#9aa4b4');
      anG.addColorStop(1, '#6a7484');
      ctx.fillStyle = anG;
      rr(tubeX + tubeW - 24 - plateW, cy, plateW, ch, 2);
      ctx.fill();
      if (iNorm > 0.05) {
        ctx.shadowColor = ACCENT;
        ctx.shadowBlur = 3 + iNorm * 12;
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(212,168,75,' + (0.3 + iNorm * 0.5) + ')';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        rr(tubeX + tubeW - 24 - plateW, cy, plateW, ch, 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(240,208,144,0.30)';
      rr(tubeX + tubeW - 24 - plateW, cy, plateW, ch, 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(154,142,120,0.9)';
      ctx.font = '10px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillText('阴极', tubeX + 24, cy + ch + 16);
      ctx.fillText('阳极', tubeX + tubeW - 24 - plateW, cy + ch + 16);

      // 入射光子（数量 ∝ 光强；色相 ∝ 频率；事件 burst ∝ intensity）
      var photonStart = winX + winW;
      var photonEnd = tubeX + 24 + plateW;
      var photonN = Math.max(3, Math.round(2 + inten * 5 + surge * 14));
      var photonSpeed = eventAnim ? (0.55 + surge * 1.8) : (0.4 + inten * 0.25);
      for (var pi = 0; pi < photonN; pi++) {
        var pt = ((timeBase * photonSpeed + pi / photonN) % 1);
        var px = photonStart + pt * (photonEnd - photonStart);
        var py = tubeY + tubeH * 0.18 + (pi / Math.max(1, photonN - 1)) * (tubeH * 0.55) + Math.sin(timeBase * 4 + pi) * 3;
        var pSz = canEscape ? (4.5 + inten * 1.2 + surge * 2.5) : (3 + inten * 0.8 + surge * 1.2);
        var pAlpha = canEscape ? 0.95 : (0.45 + surge * 0.35);
        var pRad = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, pSz + 2);
        if (!canEscape && eventAnim && animPhase !== 'idle') {
          pRad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(140,150,170,' + pAlpha + ')');
          pRad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',' + (pAlpha * 0.55) + ')');
          pRad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',0)');
        } else {
          pRad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',' + pAlpha + ')');
          pRad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',' + (pAlpha * 0.58) + ')');
          pRad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',0)');
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = pRad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(px, py, pSz, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      // 未逸出：阴极吸收波纹（hf≤W）
      if (!canEscape && eventAnim && surge > 0.05) {
        var blockR = 14 + surge * 22;
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,140,180,' + (0.25 + surge * 0.45) + ')';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2 + surge * 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(tubeX + 24 + plateW * 0.5, tubeY + tubeH * 0.5, blockR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,120,160,' + (surge * 0.18) + ')';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(tubeX + 24 + plateW * 0.5, tubeY + tubeH * 0.5, blockR * 0.55, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + lampCss + ',0.95)';
      ctx.font = '11px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('入射光 f=' + fVal.toFixed(1) + '×10¹⁴ Hz', tubeX + tubeW * 0.22, tubeY + 16);

      // 电子流（阴极 → 阳极）：逸出时数量/速度随 (hf>W) 与强度 live 变化
      var eStart = tubeX + 24 + plateW + 6;
      var eEnd = tubeX + tubeW - 24 - plateW - 6;
      if (canEscape) {
        var eBoost = eventAnim ? (1 + surge * 2.2) : 1;
        var eN = Math.max(3, Math.round((2 + iNorm * 8 + inten * 2) * eBoost));
        for (var ei = 0; ei < eN; ei++) {
          var eSpeed = eventAnim ? (0.75 + iNorm * 0.65 + surge * 1.4) : (0.55 + iNorm * 0.55);
          var et = (timeBase * eSpeed + ei / eN) % 1;
          var ex = eStart + et * (eEnd - eStart);
          var ey = tubeY + tubeH * 0.48 + Math.sin(timeBase * 3 + ei) * (5 + iNorm * 4 + surge * 3);
          var eRad = ctx.createRadialGradient(ex, ey, 0, ex, ey, 5 + surge * 4);
          eRad.addColorStop(0, escFlash > 0 ? '#ffd0d0' : '#ffb4b4');
          eRad.addColorStop(0.6, '#e06060');
          eRad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(224,96,96,0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = eRad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(ex, ey, 2.8 + iNorm * 1.4 + surge * 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
        // 阴极逸出提示晕（live，不剧透 μA 数值）
        ctx.shadowColor = escFlash > 0 ? OK : '#e06060';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 6 + iNorm * 16 + surge * 18 + escFlash * 12;
        ctx.strokeStyle = escFlash > 0
          ? 'rgba(126,207,154,' + (0.35 + escFlash * 0.45) + ')'
          : 'rgba(224,96,96,' + (0.2 + iNorm * 0.45 + surge * 0.35) + ')';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5 + surge;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(tubeX + 24 + plateW * 0.5, tubeY + tubeH * 0.5, 10 + iNorm * 8 + surge * 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fda4af';
        ctx.font = 'bold 13px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        if (measuredI != null) {
          ctx.fillText('e⁻  ·  I=' + measuredI.toFixed(1) + ' μA', tubeX + tubeW * 0.30, tubeY + tubeH * 0.38);
        } else {
          ctx.fillText('e⁻ 逸出中 · I 待测', tubeX + tubeW * 0.30, tubeY + tubeH * 0.38);
        }
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(154,142,120,0.85)';
        ctx.font = '12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(measuredI != null ? '尚无光电子逸出' : '未见逸出', tubeX + tubeW * 0.28, tubeY + tubeH * 0.52);
      }

      // 接线柱（琥珀点缀）
      ctx.fillStyle = ACCENT;
      for (var wi = 0; wi < 2; wi++) {
        var wx = chX + chW - 28 - wi * 22, wy = chY + chH - 18;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(wx, wy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      // 状态铭牌（右下，逻辑不变）
      var boxW = 220, boxH = 48, boxX = W - boxW - 16, boxY = H - boxH - 72;
      var badgeG = ctx.createLinearGradient(boxX, boxY, boxX, boxY + boxH);
      badgeG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(26,22,36,0.92)');
      badgeG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(12,10,18,0.95)');
      ctx.fillStyle = badgeG;
      rr(boxX, boxY, boxW, boxH, 4);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = I > 0 ? 'rgba(212,168,75,0.65)' : 'rgba(122,132,148,0.35)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5 + iNorm * 1.5;
      ctx.shadowColor = ACCENT;
      ctx.shadowBlur = I > 0 ? (4 + iNorm * 10) : 0;
      rr(boxX, boxY, boxW, boxH, 4);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e8d0';
      ctx.font = '12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillText('逸出功 W = ' + wVal.toFixed(1) + ' eV', boxX + 10, boxY + 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = measuredI != null ? (measuredI > 0 ? '#f0d090' : '#fda4af') : 'rgba(154,142,120,0.95)';
      if (measuredI == null) {
        ctx.fillText('电流待测 · 点发射后显示', boxX + 10, boxY + 38);
      } else if (playMode === 'challenge') {
        ctx.fillText(measuredI > 0 ? '门禁已开锁' : '打偏换新目标', boxX + 10, boxY + 38);
      } else {
        ctx.fillText(measuredI > 0 ? '回路已导通' : '回路未导通', boxX + 10, boxY + 38);
      }
    }

    // 辅助 snapControls (埋点)
    function snapControls() {
      var o = {};
      document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el) {
        var id = el.id || el.name; if (id) o[id] = el.value;
      });
      return o;
    }

    // 发射动作
    function fire() {
      if (eventAnim) return;
      hasFired = true;
      const { freqHz, workEv, fVal, intensity } = getPhysicalValues();
      const I = computePhotocurrent(freqHz, workEv, intensity);
      const canEscape = I > 0;
      measuredI = I;
      startEventAnim(fVal, workEv, I, intensity, canEscape);
      updateUI(true, true);  // 立即 snapshot / win，不延迟 emit
    }

    // 重置
    function resetAll() {
      eventAnim = null;
      if (playMode === 'challenge' && lockedMat) {
        freqSlider.value = '4.0';
        workSlider.value = String(lockedMat.W);
        workSlider.disabled = true;
        hintDiv.textContent = '已重置频率 · 材料仍为 ' + lockedMat.name + '（失败才会换料）';
      } else {
        freqSlider.value = '5.0';
        workSlider.value = '2.5';
        workSlider.disabled = false;
        hintDiv.textContent = '已重置，调节参数后点击发射光。';
      }
      winAchieved = false;
      challengeWon = false;
      winBanner.style.display = 'none';
      hasFired = false;
      measuredI = null;
      updateUI(false, false);
    }

    // 滑条事件 (更新UI但不发射snapshot, tuning由埋点hook处理)
    freqSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
      if (eventAnim) return;
      measuredI = null;
      hasFired = false;
      updateUI(false, false);
    });
    workSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
      if (eventAnim) return;
      measuredI = null;
      hasFired = false;
      updateUI(false, false);
    });
    if (intensitySlider) intensitySlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
      if (eventAnim) return;
      measuredI = null;
      hasFired = false;
      updateUI(false, false);
    });

    // 发射按钮
    fireBtn.addEventListener('click', fire);

    // 重置按钮
    resetBtn.addEventListener('click', resetAll);

    // I1 无关控件: 点击 emit irrelevant_touch
    I1btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      emit('irrelevant_touch', { control: 'I1', value: 'click' });
    });

    // 暴露 emit 给内部使用 (与 hook 一致)
    function emit(type, payload) {
      try {
        if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
          window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
          return;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      try {
        if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
          window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    window.__emit = emit;

    function tick(ts) {
      const dt = rafLastTs ? Math.min(0.05, (ts - rafLastTs) / 1000) : 0.016;
      rafLastTs = ts;
      if (!eventAnim) ambientT += dt;
      animT += dt;
      stepEventAnim(dt);
      const { freqHz, workEv, fVal, intensity } = getPhysicalValues();
      const I = computePhotocurrent(freqHz, workEv, intensity);
      drawCanvas(fVal, workEv, I, intensity);
      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', function(){ updateUI(false, false); });
    updateUI(false, false);
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  })();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  function emitWin(hintKey) {
    if (window.__legacyWinEmitted) return;
    window.__legacyWinEmitted = true;
    var emit = window.__emit;
    if (!emit) return;
    var controls = window.__snapControls ? window.__snapControls() : {};
    emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: hintKey || 'legacy_win' });
    emit('win', { winOk: true });
  }
  var WIN_TEXT = [/完美命中/, /游戏胜利/, /过关！/, /命中目标！/, /🎯\s*命中目标/, /🏆\s*过关/];
  function scanWinText() {
    var text = document.body ? document.body.innerText : '';
    for (var i = 0; i < WIN_TEXT.length; i++) {
      if (WIN_TEXT[i].test(text)) {
        emitWin('text_' + i);
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function() { scanWinText(); });
    if (document.body) obs.observe(document.body, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true });
    setInterval(scanWinText, 800);
  });
})();
</script>


<script>
(function(){
  if (window.__essenceStageResize) return;
  window.__essenceStageResize = true;
  function fit(){
    var stage = document.getElementById('essence-stage');
    var cvs = stage && stage.querySelector('canvas');
    if (!stage || !cvs) return;
    var w = stage.clientWidth, h = stage.clientHeight;
    if (w < 2 || h < 2) return;
    var dw = Number(cvs.getAttribute('width')) || cvs.width || 600;
    var dh = Number(cvs.getAttribute('height')) || cvs.height || 400;
    // keep design buffer; CSS scales visually
    if (!cvs._essenceDesign) cvs._essenceDesign = { dw: dw, dh: dh };
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', fit);
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
    var st = document.getElementById('essence-stage');
    if (st) new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(st);
  }
  fit();
})();
</script>

<script>
/* === dual-mode-shell runtime (auto) === */
(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeShell) return;
  window.__dualModeShell = true;

  var MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
  var EXPLORE_SECONDS = 10 * 60;
  var state = {
    mode: 'explore',
    attempts: MAX_ATTEMPTS,
    timeLeft: EXPLORE_SECONDS,
    timerId: null
  };

  function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }

  function setPhase(phase){
    try {
      if (typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase === 'function') {
        window.__platformTraceSetPhase(phase);
      } else if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter && typeof window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase === 'function') {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(phase);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* offline */ }
  }

  function fmt(sec){
    var m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    var s = sec % 60;
    return (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;
  }

  function renderAttempts(){
    var el = $('attemptsDisplay');
    if (el) el.textContent = String(state.attempts);
  }

  function primaryButtons(){
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(
      '#essence-bench .essence-ft button, #essence-bench button.btn, #essence-bench button[id^="btn"]'
    ));
  }

  function gateActions(){
    var disable = state.mode === 'challenge' && state.attempts <= 0;
    primaryButtons().forEach(function(btn){
      if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(btn.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(btn.id || '')) return;
      btn.classList.toggle('dual-disabled', disable);
      if (disable) btn.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
      else btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
    });
  }

  function stopTimer(){
    if (state.timerId) { clearInterval(state.timerId); state.timerId = null; }
  }

  function startExploreTimer(){
    stopTimer();
    state.timeLeft = EXPLORE_SECONDS;
    var td = $('timerDisplay');
    if (td) td.textContent = fmt(state.timeLeft);
    state.timerId = setInterval(function(){
      if (state.mode !== 'explore') return;
      state.timeLeft -= 1;
      if (td) td.textContent = fmt(Math.max(0, state.timeLeft));
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        stopTimer();
        var sel = $('modeSelect');
        if (sel) {
          sel.value = 'challenge';
          sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  function applyMode(mode){
    state.mode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    var label = $('modeLabel');
    var stats = $('challengeStats');
    var timerChip = $('dual-timer-chip');
    if (label) label.textContent = state.mode === 'explore' ? '探究模式' : '竞赛模式';
    if (stats) {
      if (state.mode === 'challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible');
      else stats.classList.remove('is-visible');
    }
    if (timerChip) timerChip.style.display = state.mode === 'explore' ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    if (state.mode === 'challenge') {
      stopTimer();
      state.attempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS;
      renderAttempts();
    } else {
      startExploreTimer();
    }
    setPhase(state.mode);
    gateActions();
    if (typeof window.__peApplyMode === 'function') {
      try { window.__peApplyMode(state.mode); } catch (e) {}
    }
    try {
      if (typeof window.__photoApplyMode === 'function') window.__photoApplyMode(state.mode);
    } catch (e) {}
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dual-mode-change', { detail: { mode: state.mode, attempts: state.attempts } }));
  }

  function onPrimaryClick(e){
    if (state.mode !== 'challenge') return;
    var t = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!t) return;
    if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(t.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(t.id || '')) return;
    if (state.attempts <= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }
    state.attempts -= 1;
    renderAttempts();
    gateActions();
  }

  function ensureUi(){
    var stage = $('essence-stage') || document.querySelector('#proj-stage, #stage, #canvasContainer, .canvas-wrap')?.parentElement;
    var bench = $('essence-bench');
    if (!stage) return false;

    if (!$('dual-mode-hud')) {
      var hud = document.createElement('div');
      hud.id = 'dual-mode-hud';
      hud.innerHTML =
        '<div id="dual-timer-chip" class="dual-chip">' +
          '<span id="modeLabel">探究模式</span><span style="width:1px;height:14px;background:#cbd5e1"></span>' +
          '<span id="timerDisplay">10:00</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="challengeStats"><span>剩余机会</span><span id="attemptsDisplay">5</span></div>';
      stage.style.position = stage.style.position || 'relative';
      stage.appendChild(hud);
    }

    if (bench && !$('modeSelect')) {
      bench.classList.add('dual-mode-ready');
      var hd = document.createElement('div');
      hd.id = 'essence-bench-hd';
      hd.className = 'dual-bench-hd';
      var title = '环境控制台';
      var tEl = stage.querySelector('.essence-title, h1');
      if (tEl) title = (tEl.textContent || title).trim() || title;
      hd.innerHTML =
        '<h1>' + title.replace(/</g,'<') + '</h1>' +
        '<select id="modeSelect" aria-label="探究阶段">' +
          '<option value="explore">自由探究</option>' +
          '<option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>' +
        '</select>';
      bench.insertBefore(hd, bench.firstChild);
    } else if (!$('modeSelect')) {
      // Fallback: floating select in hud
      var chip = $('dual-timer-chip');
      if (chip && !$('modeSelect')) {
        var sel = document.createElement('select');
        sel.id = 'modeSelect';
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="explore">自由探究</option><option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>';
        chip.appendChild(sel);
      }
    }
    return !!$('modeSelect');
  }

  function boot(){
    if (!ensureUi()) return;
    var sel = $('modeSelect');
    sel.addEventListener('change', function(){ applyMode(sel.value); });
    var ft = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .essence-ft') || $('essence-bench') || document.body;
    ft.addEventListener('click', onPrimaryClick, true);
    applyMode(sel.value || 'explore');
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();

- 策略途径：单变量·摆角；单变量·摆长；多参盲调；试探·质量
## 埋点规格（telemetrySpec）

按事理图谱 traceMap 上报：每次滑条/按钮操作记录 controlId、值、时间戳。
snapshot 事件在「发射/测试/提交」时记录各 control 当前值。
评判时将轨迹节点映射到 KG play 链（P1→O1→C*→R1）与 strategy routes。
混淆变量触碰可选记录，但不计入主探究路径得分。

### 事件列表

- **tuning** `s-len` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `s-angle` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `s-mass` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `modeSelect` → C1（必采）
- **tuning** `tuning` → tuning（必采）
- **action** `action` → action

### DT 检查点

- decision: 模式选择?
- decision: 探究超时?
- decision: 竞赛机会耗尽?
- retry: 失败结束
- decision: 启动计时?
- retry: 提示启动
- decision: 参数改动?
- retry: 提示重新计时
## 输出
只输出完整 HTML 文档，不要 markdown 代码块包裹。

<script>
/* ═══════════════ 物理与状态 ═══════════════ */
const G = 9.81;
let T_TARGET = 2.000, T_HALF = 0.020;   // 探究较宽；竞赛进入时收紧并可能换目标
const TH_MIN = 15;                          // 擒纵最小摆幅约束
let playMode = 'explore';
let L = 1.310, thetaDeg = 20, mass = 1.5;
let phase = 'intro';                        // intro | puzzle | win | end
let won = false;
let lastMeasT = null;      // 最近一次实测周期
let measStale = false;     // 测后参数被改动
let measuring = false;
let measureCount = 0;

function period() {
  const th = thetaDeg * Math.PI / 180;
  return 2 * Math.PI * Math.sqrt(L / G) * (1 + th * th / 16);
}
function inTBand(T)  { return Math.abs(T - T_TARGET) <= T_HALF; }
function thetaOk()   { return thetaDeg >= TH_MIN; }
function winOk(T)    { return inTBand(T) && thetaOk(); }
function dayErrSec(T){ return (2 / T - 1) * 86400; }  // >0 快，<0 慢

function fmtTargetBand() {
  return T_TARGET.toFixed(3) + ' ± ' + T_HALF.toFixed(3) + ' s';
}
function refreshClockGoals() {
  const side = document.getElementById('sideGoal');
  const hud = document.getElementById('hudTargetBand');
  const sub = document.getElementById('benchGoalSub');
  const cap = document.getElementById('tbandCap');
  if (hud) hud.textContent = fmtTargetBand();
  if (playMode === 'challenge') {
    if (side) side.textContent = '竞赛急单：把周期校进 ' + fmtTargetBand() + '（本局锁定，校偏不换题）。摆幅仍须 ≥' + TH_MIN + '°。';
    if (sub) sub.textContent = '竞赛：T ≈ ' + T_TARGET.toFixed(3) + ' s · 严公差 · 本局固定';
    if (cap) cap.innerHTML = '周期尺 · <em>绿区 = 急单 ±' + Math.round(T_HALF * 1000) + ' ms</em>';
  } else {
    if (side) side.textContent = '调摆长与摆角，看周期怎么变。';
    if (sub) sub.textContent = '自由校时：对照计时看周期变化';
    if (cap) cap.innerHTML = '周期尺 · <em>绿区 = 探究带</em>';
  }
}
/** FixedChallenge：仅进入竞赛时锁定一次目标周期（与探究 2.000 不同） */
function lockChallengePeriod() {
  let next = 1.90 + Math.random() * 0.28;
  if (Math.abs(next - 2.000) < 0.04) next = next > 2 ? 2.08 : 1.92;
  T_TARGET = Math.round(next * 1000) / 1000;
  T_HALF = 0.012;
  L = 1.31; thetaDeg = 20; mass = 1.5;
  lastMeasT = null; measStale = false; won = false;
  var elLen = document.getElementById('s-len');
  var elAng = document.getElementById('s-angle');
  var elMass = document.getElementById('s-mass');
  if (elLen) elLen.value = String(L);
  if (elAng) elAng.value = String(thetaDeg);
  if (elMass) elMass.value = String(mass);
  refreshClockGoals();
  if (typeof syncUI === 'function') syncUI();
}
function applyExplorePeriod() {
  T_TARGET = 2.000;
  T_HALF = 0.020;
  lastMeasT = null; measStale = false; won = false;
  refreshClockGoals();
  if (typeof syncUI === 'function') syncUI();
}

/* ═══════════════ 埋点（与电容系列同一套约定） ═══════════════ */
const Telemetry = (function () {
  const qs = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const sid = qs.get('sid') || ('anon-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8));
  const endpoint = qs.get('ep') || ''; // platform owns ingest
  const session = {
    session_id: sid + '-' + Date.now().toString(36),
    student_id: sid,
    game_id: 'pendulum-clock',
    game_ver: 'sample-v1',
    started_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    ua: navigator.userAgent,
  };
  const buf = [], all = [];
  const t0 = performance.now();
  let seq = 0;

  function snapshot() {
    const T = period();
    return { L: +L.toFixed(3), theta: thetaDeg, m: +mass.toFixed(1),
      T: +T.toFixed(4), day_err_s: Math.round(dayErrSec(T)), phase: phase };
  }
  function log(type, data) {
    const ev = Object.assign({ seq: seq++, rel_ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0),
      ts: new Date().toISOString(), type: type }, data || {});
    buf.push(ev); all.push(ev); mirror();
  }
  let mirrorTimer = null;
  function mirror() {
    if (mirrorTimer) return;
    mirrorTimer = setTimeout(() => { mirrorTimer = null;
      try { localStorage.setItem('telemetry:' + session.session_id,
        JSON.stringify({ session, events: all })); } catch (e) {} }, 800);
  }
  function flush(final) {
    if (!buf.length || !endpoint) return;
    const payload = JSON.stringify({ session, events: buf.splice(0) });
    if (final && navigator.sendBeacon) {
      navigator.sendBeacon(endpoint, new Blob([payload], { type: 'application/json' }));
      return;
    }
    fetch(endpoint, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: payload, keepalive: true }).catch(() => {});
  }
  setInterval(() => flush(false), 5000);
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { log('page_hide', {}); flush(true); });

  // 滑块手势聚合：input 记微操作，change 提交一次调整
  const VAR_OF = { 's-len': 'L', 's-angle': 'theta', 's-mass': 'm' };
  const commit = { 's-len': 1.31, 's-angle': 20, 's-mass': 1.5 };
  const gest = {};
  document.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    const id = e.target && e.target.id;
    if (!(id in VAR_OF)) return;
    const v = +e.target.value;
    if (!gest[id]) gest[id] = { from: null, micro: 0, vmin: v, vmax: v, t0: performance.now() };
    const g = gest[id];
    if (g.from === null) g.from = commit[id] !== undefined ? commit[id] : v;
    g.micro++; g.vmin = Math.min(g.vmin, v); g.vmax = Math.max(g.vmax, v);
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    const id = e.target && e.target.id;
    if (!(id in VAR_OF)) return;
    const v = +e.target.value;
    const g = gest[id] || { from: commit[id], micro: 1, vmin: v, vmax: v, t0: performance.now() };
    log('var_adjust', { var: VAR_OF[id], from: g.from, to: v,
      micro: g.micro, vmin: g.vmin, vmax: g.vmax,
      dur_ms: Math.round(performance.now() - g.t0), after: snapshot() });
    commit[id] = v; delete gest[id];
  }, true);

  // 状态转变：T 带 / 胜利条件 / 擒纵约束阻挡
  let _tbPrev = false, _winPrev = false, _blockPrev = false;
  function trackState() {
    const T = period();
    const tb = inTBand(T), w = winOk(T), blocked = tb && !thetaOk();
    if (tb !== _tbPrev)   { log(tb ? 'enter_t_band' : 'leave_t_band', { after: snapshot() }); _tbPrev = tb; }
    if (blocked !== _blockPrev) { log(blocked ? 'constraint_block' : 'constraint_clear', { after: snapshot() }); _blockPrev = blocked; }
    if (w !== _winPrev)   { log(w ? 'enter_win_band' : 'leave_win_band', { after: snapshot() }); _winPrev = w; }
  }

  // phase 看守
  let _pPrev = null;
  setInterval(() => {
    if (phase !== _pPrev) { log('phase_change', { from: _pPrev, to: phase }); _pPrev = phase; }
  }, 200);

  function exportData() {
    const lines = [JSON.stringify({ type: 'session_meta', ...session })]
      .concat(all.map(e => JSON.stringify(e))).join('\n');
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([lines], { type: 'application/x-ndjson' }));
    a.download = session.session_id + '.jsonl';
    a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const b = document.createElement('div');
    b.textContent = '⬇ 实验数据';
    b.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:10px;bottom:10px;z-index:30;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;color:rgba(201,151,63,0.5);border:1px solid rgba(201,151,63,0.25);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;background:rgba(20,13,6,0.6)';
    b.onclick = exportData;
    document.body.appendChild(b);
  });

  log('session_start', { href: location.href });
  return { log, flush, snapshot, trackState, exportData, session };
})();

/* ═══════════════ 滴答声 ═══════════════ */
const Tick = (function () {
  let ctx = null, on = true;
  function ensure() {
    if (!ctx) { try { ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); } catch (e) {} }
    if (ctx && ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();
  }
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', ensure, { once: true });
  function play(isTock) {
    if (!on || !ctx || ctx.state !== 'running') return;
    const t = ctx.currentTime;
    const o = ctx.createOscillator(), g = ctx.createGain(), f = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    o.type = 'square';
    o.frequency.value = isTock ? 1550 : 2100;
    f.type = 'bandpass'; f.frequency.value = isTock ? 1600 : 2200; f.Q.value = 9;
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(isTock ? 0.055 : 0.07, t + 0.002);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 0.045);
    o.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
    o.start(t); o.stop(t + 0.06);
  }
  const btn = document.getElementById('sfx');
  btn.onclick = () => { on = !on; btn.classList.toggle('on', on); ensure(); };
  return { play };
})();

/* ═══════════════ 画布场景 ═══════════════ */
const cvs = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx2d = cvs.getContext('2d');
const DW = 1280, DH = 720;                 // 设计坐标
let scale = 1, offX = 0, offY = 0;
const reduceMotion = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

function resize() {
  const stage = document.getElementById('stage');
  const w = stage ? stage.clientWidth : innerWidth;
  const h = stage ? stage.clientHeight : innerHeight;
  const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  cvs.width = w * dpr; cvs.height = h * dpr;
  cvs.style.width = w + 'px'; cvs.style.height = h + 'px';
  scale = Math.min(w / DW, h / DH);
  offX = (w - DW * scale) / 2;
  offY = (h - DH * scale) / 2;
  ctx2d.setTransform(dpr * scale, 0, 0, dpr * scale, dpr * offX, dpr * offY);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
  const st = document.getElementById('stage');
  if (st) new ResizeObserver(() => resize()).observe(st);
}
resize();

/* 摆运动：相位连续累积，避免调参跳变 */
let swingPhase = 0;
let lastTs = performance.now();
let lastSign = 1;

/* 钟自身走时（速率 = 2/T）与标准授时 */
let clockSec = 19 * 3600 + 36 * 0;         // 此钟显示 19:36:00 起
let stdSec = clockSec;                      // 标准授时同起点
clockSec += 0; stdSec += 0;

/* 尘埃微粒 */
const motes = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) motes.push({
  x: Math.random() * DW, y: Math.random() * DH * 0.8,
  r: 0.6 + Math.random() * 1.6, a: 0.04 + Math.random() * 0.08,
  vx: 4 + Math.random() * 9, vy: -2 - Math.random() * 4, ph: Math.random() * 6.28,
});

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx2d.beginPath();
  ctx2d.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx2d.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx2d.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx2d.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx2d.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx2d.closePath();
}

function drawRoom(t) {
  // 墙面
  const wall = ctx2d.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, DH);
  wall.addColorStop(0, '#4a3824'); wall.addColorStop(0.65, '#3a2c1c'); wall.addColorStop(1, '#2a1e12');
  ctx2d.fillStyle = wall; ctx2d.fillRect(-offX / scale, -offY / scale, DW + 2 * offX / scale, DH + 2 * offY / scale);
  // 木护墙板缝
  ctx2d.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.14)'; ctx2d.lineWidth = 1.5;
  for (let x = 60; x < DW; x += 130) {
    ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.moveTo(x, 0); ctx2d.lineTo(x, DH * 0.72); ctx2d.stroke();
  }
  ctx2d.strokeStyle = 'rgba(201,151,63,0.12)';
  ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.moveTo(0, DH * 0.72); ctx2d.lineTo(DW, DH * 0.72); ctx2d.stroke();
  // 地板
  const floor = ctx2d.createLinearGradient(0, DH * 0.72, 0, DH);
  floor.addColorStop(0, '#3a2c1a'); floor.addColorStop(1, '#24180e');
  ctx2d.fillStyle = floor; ctx2d.fillRect(0, DH * 0.72, DW, DH * 0.28);
  ctx2d.strokeStyle = 'rgba(201,151,63,0.1)';
  for (let i = 1; i < 6; i++) {
    const y = DH * 0.72 + i * i * 3.2;
    ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.moveTo(0, y); ctx2d.lineTo(DW, y); ctx2d.stroke();
  }
  // 煤气灯暖光（右上）
  const lampFlick = reduceMotion ? 1 : 0.96 + 0.04 * Math.sin(t * 0.0021) * Math.sin(t * 0.0013 + 2);
  const glow = ctx2d.createRadialGradient(1150, 90, 10, 1150, 90, 640);
  glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,200,120,${0.28 * lampFlick})`);
  glow.addColorStop(0.4, `rgba(255,180,90,${0.12 * lampFlick})`);
  glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,157,69,0)');
  ctx2d.fillStyle = glow; ctx2d.fillRect(0, 0, DW, DH);
  // 灯具剪影
  ctx2d.strokeStyle = '#3a2a16'; ctx2d.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.moveTo(1150, 0); ctx2d.lineTo(1150, 52); ctx2d.stroke();
  ctx2d.fillStyle = '#2b1e0e';
  ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.moveTo(1126, 52); ctx2d.lineTo(1174, 52); ctx2d.lineTo(1162, 78); ctx2d.lineTo(1138, 78); ctx2d.closePath(); ctx2d.fill();
  const flame = ctx2d.createRadialGradient(1150, 86, 1, 1150, 86, 15);
  flame.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,220,150,${0.9 * lampFlick})`);
  flame.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,157,69,0)');
  ctx2d.fillStyle = flame;
  ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.arc(1150, 86, 15, 0, 6.29); ctx2d.fill();
  // 工作台影（左下，暗示柜台）
  ctx2d.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
  ctx2d.fillRect(0, DH * 0.86, DW, DH * 0.14);
}

function drawMotes(dt, t) {
  if (reduceMotion) return;
  ctx2d.fillStyle = '#f0cf8a';
  for (const p of motes) {
    p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt * 0.4 + Math.sin(t * 0.001 + p.ph) * 0.08;
    if (p.x > DW + 10) { p.x = -10; p.y = Math.random() * DH * 0.8; }
    if (p.y < -10) p.y = DH * 0.8;
    ctx2d.globalAlpha = p.a * (0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(t * 0.002 + p.ph));
    ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, 6.29); ctx2d.fill();
  }
  ctx2d.globalAlpha = 1;
}

/* 维修中的挂摆座钟：钟头 + 背板 + 外露摆（签名元素）；柜门卸下斜靠墙边 */
const CLK = { cx: 320, dialY: 150, dialR: 80, pivotY: 250 };

function drawRemovedDoor() {
  // 卸下的柜门，斜靠左墙——叙事道具
  ctx2d.save();
  ctx2d.translate(96, 700);
  ctx2d.rotate(-0.10);
  const g = ctx2d.createLinearGradient(-50, -420, 50, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#3c2a14'); g.addColorStop(0.5, '#553d20'); g.addColorStop(1, '#2b1c0c');
  ctx2d.fillStyle = g;
  roundRect(-46, -430, 92, 430, 6); ctx2d.fill();
  ctx2d.strokeStyle = 'rgba(201,151,63,0.3)'; ctx2d.lineWidth = 2;
  roundRect(-38, -418, 76, 406, 4); ctx2d.stroke();
  const sheen = ctx2d.createLinearGradient(-46, -430, 46, 0);
  sheen.addColorStop(0.30, 'rgba(240,220,180,0)');
  sheen.addColorStop(0.48, 'rgba(240,220,180,0.07)');
  sheen.addColorStop(0.62, 'rgba(240,220,180,0)');
  ctx2d.fillStyle = sheen;
  roundRect(-38, -418, 76, 406, 4); ctx2d.fill();
  ctx2d.fillStyle = '#a87826';
  ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.arc(30, -210, 3.5, 0, 6.29); ctx2d.fill();
  ctx2d.restore();
}

function drawClockHead() {
  const { cx, dialY, dialR, pivotY } = CLK;
  // 挂墙背板（窄条，摆在其前方摆动）
  const bbW = 96;
  const bb = ctx2d.createLinearGradient(cx - bbW / 2, 0, cx + bbW / 2, 0);
  bb.addColorStop(0, '#241708'); bb.addColorStop(0.5, '#4a3319'); bb.addColorStop(1, '#1c1106');
  ctx2d.fillStyle = bb;
  roundRect(cx - bbW / 2, dialY + dialR, bbW, 460, 5); ctx2d.fill();
  ctx2d.strokeStyle = 'rgba(201,151,63,0.18)'; ctx2d.lineWidth = 1;
  roundRect(cx - bbW / 2 + 5, dialY + dialR + 5, bbW - 10, 450, 3); ctx2d.stroke();
  // 底部黄铜托架
  ctx2d.fillStyle = '#3a2812';
  ctx2d.beginPath();
  ctx2d.moveTo(cx - bbW / 2 - 14, dialY + dialR + 460);
  ctx2d.lineTo(cx + bbW / 2 + 14, dialY + dialR + 460);
  ctx2d.lineTo(cx + bbW / 2 - 4, dialY + dialR + 485);
  ctx2d.lineTo(cx - bbW / 2 + 4, dialY + dialR + 485);
  ctx2d.closePath(); ctx2d.fill();
  // 钟头柜
  const w = 250;
  const hoodG = ctx2d.createLinearGradient(cx - w / 2, 0, cx + w / 2, 0);
  hoodG.addColorStop(0, '#3a2812'); hoodG.addColorStop(0.5, '#6e5130'); hoodG.addColorStop(1, '#2b1c0c');
  ctx2d.fillStyle = hoodG;
  roundRect(cx - w / 2, dialY - dialR - 34, w, dialR * 2 + 86, 9); ctx2d.fill();
  // 拱顶
  ctx2d.beginPath();
  ctx2d.moveTo(cx - w / 2, dialY - dialR - 26);
  ctx2d.quadraticCurveTo(cx, dialY - dialR - 92, cx + w / 2, dialY - dialR - 26);
  ctx2d.lineTo(cx + w / 2, dialY - dialR - 6); ctx2d.lineTo(cx - w / 2, dialY - dialR - 6);
  ctx2d.closePath(); ctx2d.fillStyle = hoodG; ctx2d.fill();
  // 顶饰黄铜球
  for (const [dx, dy, r] of [[-w / 2 + 6, dialY - dialR - 30, 6], [0, dialY - dialR - 74, 8], [w / 2 - 6, dialY - dialR - 30, 6]]) {
    const fg = ctx2d.createRadialGradient(cx + dx - 2, dy - 2, 1, cx + dx, dy, r);
    fg.addColorStop(0, '#f0cf8a'); fg.addColorStop(0.6, '#c9973f'); fg.addColorStop(1, '#6e4f18');
    ctx2d.fillStyle = fg;
    ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.arc(cx + dx, dy, r, 0, 6.29); ctx2d.fill();
    ctx2d.fillStyle = '#4a3314'; ctx2d.fillRect(cx + dx - 1.5, dy + r - 2, 3, 7);
  }
  // 悬点座（钟头下缘）
  ctx2d.fillStyle = '#2b1e0e';
  ctx2d.fillRect(cx - 18, pivotY - 14, 36, 14);
  const pv = ctx2d.createRadialGradient(cx - 1, pivotY - 3, 0.5, cx, pivotY - 2, 6);
  pv.addColorStop(0, '#f0cf8a'); pv.addColorStop(1, '#6e4f18');
  ctx2d.fillStyle = pv;
  ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.arc(cx, pivotY - 2, 5, 0, 6.29); ctx2d.fill();
}

function drawDial(t) {
  const { cx, dialY, dialR } = CLK;
  // 黄铜圈
  const bez = ctx2d.createRadialGradient(cx - 20, dialY - 24, dialR * 0.4, cx, dialY, dialR + 12);
  bez.addColorStop(0, '#e8c377'); bez.addColorStop(0.7, '#a87826'); bez.addColorStop(1, '#5e4014');
  ctx2d.fillStyle = bez;
  ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.arc(cx, dialY, dialR + 11, 0, 6.29); ctx2d.fill();
  // 珐琅盘
  const face = ctx2d.createRadialGradient(cx - 18, dialY - 22, 6, cx, dialY, dialR);
  face.addColorStop(0, '#f6ecd6'); face.addColorStop(0.8, '#e8dabb'); face.addColorStop(1, '#cdbd97');
  ctx2d.fillStyle = face;
  ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.arc(cx, dialY, dialR, 0, 6.29); ctx2d.fill();
  // 刻度
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    const a = i * Math.PI / 30, hour = i % 5 === 0;
    const r1 = dialR - (hour ? 14 : 8), r2 = dialR - 3;
    ctx2d.strokeStyle = hour ? '#3a2c14' : 'rgba(58,44,20,0.5)';
    ctx2d.lineWidth = hour ? 2.6 : 1;
    ctx2d.beginPath();
    ctx2d.moveTo(cx + r1 * Math.sin(a), dialY - r1 * Math.cos(a));
    ctx2d.lineTo(cx + r2 * Math.sin(a), dialY - r2 * Math.cos(a));
    ctx2d.stroke();
  }
  // 品牌小字
  ctx2d.fillStyle = 'rgba(58,44,20,0.55)';
  ctx2d.font = '9px "Noto Serif SC", serif'; ctx2d.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx2d.fillText('橡  巷  钟  表  行', cx, dialY + 34);
  // 指针（此钟自己的走时）
  const cs = clockSec;
  const ha = ((cs / 3600) % 12) / 12 * 2 * Math.PI;
  const ma = ((cs / 60) % 60) / 60 * 2 * Math.PI;
  const sa = (Math.floor(cs) % 60) / 60 * 2 * Math.PI;
  function hand(a, len, wid, color) {
    ctx2d.strokeStyle = color; ctx2d.lineWidth = wid; ctx2d.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.moveTo(cx - 0.14 * len * Math.sin(a), dialY + 0.14 * len * Math.cos(a));
    ctx2d.lineTo(cx + len * Math.sin(a), dialY - len * Math.cos(a)); ctx2d.stroke();
  }
  hand(ha, dialR * 0.5, 4.5, '#2b2010');
  hand(ma, dialR * 0.74, 3, '#2b2010');
  hand(sa, dialR * 0.8, 1.4, '#8a2f1d');
  const cap = ctx2d.createRadialGradient(cx - 1, dialY - 1, 0.5, cx, dialY, 5);
  cap.addColorStop(0, '#f0cf8a'); cap.addColorStop(1, '#6e4f18');
  ctx2d.fillStyle = cap;
  ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.arc(cx, dialY, 5, 0, 6.29); ctx2d.fill();
}

function drawPendulum() {
  const { cx, pivotY } = CLK;
  const amp = thetaDeg * Math.PI / 180;
  const phi = reduceMotion ? amp * 0.6 : amp * Math.sin(swingPhase);
  // 摆长映射：0.5–1.5 m → 130–320 px
  const rodPx = 130 + (L - 0.5) * 190;
  const bobR = 12 + Math.pow(mass, 0.72) * 8;   // 0.5→16.8, 3→29.7
  const bx = cx + rodPx * Math.sin(phi);
  const by = pivotY + rodPx * Math.cos(phi);

  // 地面摆影
  ctx2d.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.30)';
  ctx2d.beginPath();
  ctx2d.ellipse(bx, DH * 0.72 + 130, bobR * 1.5, bobR * 0.32, 0, 0, 6.29);
  ctx2d.fill();

  // 摆杆
  const rodG = ctx2d.createLinearGradient(cx, pivotY, bx, by);
  rodG.addColorStop(0, '#8a6a2e'); rodG.addColorStop(0.5, '#d9b365'); rodG.addColorStop(1, '#8a6a2e');
  ctx2d.strokeStyle = rodG; ctx2d.lineWidth = 4.5; ctx2d.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.moveTo(cx, pivotY); ctx2d.lineTo(bx, by); ctx2d.stroke();
  // 摆锤（黄铜圆盘，大小∝质量）
  const bobG = ctx2d.createRadialGradient(bx - bobR * 0.35, by - bobR * 0.4, bobR * 0.1, bx, by, bobR);
  bobG.addColorStop(0, '#f6dc9e'); bobG.addColorStop(0.45, '#cf9d43');
  bobG.addColorStop(0.85, '#8a6420'); bobG.addColorStop(1, '#5a3f10');
  ctx2d.fillStyle = bobG;
  ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.arc(bx, by, bobR, 0, 6.29); ctx2d.fill();
  ctx2d.strokeStyle = 'rgba(58,40,10,0.7)'; ctx2d.lineWidth = 1.4;
  ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.arc(bx, by, bobR * 0.62, 0, 6.29); ctx2d.stroke();
  // 摆锤高光弧
  ctx2d.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,240,200,0.5)'; ctx2d.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.arc(bx, by, bobR * 0.8, -2.4, -1.4); ctx2d.stroke();
  // 校准螺母（锤下沿）
  ctx2d.save();
  ctx2d.translate(bx, by); ctx2d.rotate(phi);
  ctx2d.fillStyle = '#a87826';
  ctx2d.fillRect(-5, bobR + 2, 10, 8);
  ctx2d.restore();
}

/* 授时黄铜牌（右侧 HUD） */
function fmtHMS(s) {
  s = Math.floor(s);
  const h = Math.floor(s / 3600) % 24, m = Math.floor(s / 60) % 60, x = s % 60;
  return String(h).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(m).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(x).padStart(2, '0');
}
function fmtErr(sec) {
  const a = Math.abs(sec), h = Math.floor(a / 3600), m = Math.floor(a % 3600 / 60), s = Math.floor(a % 60);
  let str = '';
  if (h) str += h + ' 时 ';
  if (h || m) str += m + ' 分 ';
  str += s + ' 秒';
  return (sec < 0 ? '慢 ' : '快 ') + str + ' / 天';
}
function drawPlaque() {
  const x = 742, y = 74, w = 300;
  function plate(py, lines, big) {
    const g = ctx2d.createLinearGradient(x, py, x + w, py);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#2b1e0e'); g.addColorStop(0.5, '#3c2b14'); g.addColorStop(1, '#241708');
    ctx2d.fillStyle = g;
    roundRect(x, py, w, big ? 76 : 58, 5); ctx2d.fill();
    ctx2d.strokeStyle = 'rgba(201,151,63,0.4)'; ctx2d.lineWidth = 1;
    roundRect(x + 3, py + 3, w - 6, (big ? 76 : 58) - 6, 3); ctx2d.stroke();
    for (const dx of [10, w - 10]) for (const dy of [10, (big ? 76 : 58) - 10]) {
      ctx2d.fillStyle = '#a87826';
      ctx2d.beginPath(); ctx2d.arc(x + dx, py + dy, 2.2, 0, 6.29); ctx2d.fill();
    }
    ctx2d.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx2d.fillStyle = '#a8823f'; ctx2d.font = '10px "PingFang SC", sans-serif';
    ctx2d.fillText(lines[0], x + 20, py + 21);
    ctx2d.fillStyle = lines[2] || '#f0cf8a';
    ctx2d.font = (big ? '26px' : '20px') + ' "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx2d.fillText(lines[1], x + 20, py + (big ? 54 : 45));
  }
  plate(y, ['标 准 授 时（电台报时）', fmtHMS(stdSec)]);
  plate(y + 68, ['此 钟 走 时', fmtHMS(clockSec), Math.abs(clockSec - stdSec) < 1 ? '#6fae8f' : '#ff9d45']);
  ctx2d.font = '13px "PingFang SC", sans-serif';
  if (won) {
    ctx2d.fillStyle = '#6fae8f';
    ctx2d.fillText('✓ 走时精准 — 秒摆归位', x + 4, y + 160);
  } else if (lastMeasT === null) {
    ctx2d.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,157,69,0.75)';
    ctx2d.fillText('日误差：待测（启动光电计时）', x + 4, y + 160);
  } else {
    ctx2d.fillStyle = '#ff9d45';
    ctx2d.fillText(fmtErr(dayErrSec(lastMeasT)) + (measStale ? '（读数已过期）' : ''), x + 4, y + 160);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════ 主循环 ═══════════════ */
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastTs) / 1000);
  lastTs = now;
  const T = period();

  if (phase !== 'intro') {
    swingPhase += dt * 2 * Math.PI / T;
    const s = Math.sign(Math.sin(swingPhase)) || 1;
    if (s !== lastSign) { Tick.play(s < 0); lastSign = s; }
    stdSec += dt;
    clockSec += dt * (2 / T);
  }

  drawRoom(now);
  drawRemovedDoor();
  drawClockHead();
  drawPendulum();
  drawDial(now);
  drawPlaque();
  drawMotes(dt, now);

  Telemetry.trackState();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);

/* ═══════════════ 控件与流程 ═══════════════ */
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const sLen = $('s-len'), sAng = $('s-angle'), sMass = $('s-mass');

function lockControls(lock) {
  [sLen, sAng, sMass].forEach(s => s.disabled = lock);
}

function syncUI() {
  $('v-len').textContent = L.toFixed(2) + ' m';
  $('v-angle').textContent = thetaDeg + '\u00b0';
  $('v-mass').textContent = mass.toFixed(1) + ' kg';
  const gT = $('g-T');
  const nd = $('needle');
  const dr = $('drift');
  const lo = 1.85, hi = 2.45;
  const pct = v => Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * 100));
  const bw = $('band-win');
  bw.style.left = pct(T_TARGET - T_HALF) + '%';
  bw.style.width = (pct(T_TARGET + T_HALF) - pct(T_TARGET - T_HALF)) + '%';
  if (measuring) {
    gT.textContent = '· · ·';
    gT.className = 'gval';
  } else if (lastMeasT === null) {
    gT.textContent = '\u2014.\u2014\u2014\u2014';
    gT.className = 'gval';
    nd.style.display = 'none';
    dr.textContent = '日误差：待测';
    dr.className = '';
  } else {
    gT.textContent = lastMeasT.toFixed(3);
    gT.className = 'gval' + (measStale ? ' stale' : (won ? ' ok' : ''));
    nd.style.display = 'block';
    nd.style.left = 'calc(' + pct(lastMeasT) + '% - 1px)';
    nd.classList.toggle('ok', won);
    nd.style.opacity = measStale ? 0.35 : 1;
    dr.textContent = won ? '\u2713 秒摆归位' : fmtErr(dayErrSec(lastMeasT)) + (measStale ? '\u2005·\u2005已过期' : '');
    dr.className = won ? 'ok' : '';
  }
  // 提示
  const hint = $('hint');
  hint.className = '';
  if (won) { hint.textContent = '\u2713 周期 ' + T_TARGET.toFixed(3) + ' s \u2014\u2014 擒纵接管，钟声归位'; hint.className = 'ok'; }
  else if (measuring) hint.textContent = '光电门计时中\u2026\u2026';
  else if (lastMeasT === null) hint.textContent = '计时未启动 · 先点启动，再调摆长对照读数';
  else if (measStale) hint.textContent = '参数已改动\u2014\u2014读数过期，需重新计时确认';

  else if (lastMeasT > T_TARGET + T_HALF) hint.textContent = '实测偏慢 ' + Math.round((lastMeasT - T_TARGET) * 1000) + ' ms \u2014\u2014 想想什么决定周期';
  else if (lastMeasT < T_TARGET - T_HALF) hint.textContent = '实测偏快 ' + Math.round((T_TARGET - lastMeasT) * 1000) + ' ms';
  Telemetry.trackState();
}

/* 光电计时：一次实测一个周期（等待真实 T 秒） */
function startMeasure() {
  if (measuring || won || phase !== 'puzzle') return;
  measuring = true;
  lockControls(true);
  const btn = $('btn-measure');
  btn.classList.add('busy');
  btn.textContent = '\u23f1 计时中\u2026';
  Telemetry.log('measure_start', { n: measureCount + 1, after: Telemetry.snapshot() });
  const T = period();
  syncUI();
  setTimeout(() => {
    measuring = false;
    measureCount++;
    lastMeasT = T;
    measStale = false;
    btn.classList.remove('busy');
    btn.textContent = '\u23f1 启动计时 · 测一个周期';
    Telemetry.log('measure_result', { n: measureCount, T: +T.toFixed(4),
      in_band: inTBand(T), theta_ok: thetaOk(), after: Telemetry.snapshot() });
    if (winOk(T)) {
      won = true;   // 滑块保持锁定
      Telemetry.log('solution_locked', { after: Telemetry.snapshot() });
      setTimeout(tryShowWin, 1000);
    } else {
      lockControls(false);
    }
    syncUI();
  }, Math.min(4000, Math.round(T * 1000)));
}

function tryShowWin() {
  if (!won) return;
  const T = period();
  if (!winOk(T)) { won = false; lockControls(false); 
    Telemetry.log('solution_retracted', { after: Telemetry.snapshot() }); syncUI(); return; }
  phase = 'win';
  Telemetry.log('win', { after: Telemetry.snapshot() });

    <div class="sumrow"><span class="k">周期 T</span><span class="v" style="color:var(--verdigris)">${T.toFixed(3)} s ✓</span></div>`;
  const th = thetaDeg * Math.PI / 180;
  $('sum-formula').textContent =
    `T = 2π·√(L/g)·(1 + θ²/16)\n` +
    `  = 2π × √(${L.toFixed(3)}/9.81) × (1 + ${th.toFixed(3)}²/16)\n` +
    `  = ${T.toFixed(3)} s`;
  $('sum-rules').innerHTML = `
    <div class="rule"><b>T ∝ √L</b> —— 摆长是周期的主宰：调准秒摆，先调摆长</div>
    <div class="rule"><b>θ²/16</b> —— 摆角只带来二阶小修正，是精校的最后一颗螺丝</div>
    <div class="rule"><b>质量 m 不出现在公式里</b> —— 换多重的锤，周期都不变（伽利略在比萨早已知晓）</div>
    <div class="rule"><b>擒纵约束</b> —— 摆幅太小，机构无法补充能量，钟会停摆</div>`;
  $('veil-win').classList.add('show');
}

<script>
/* === dual-mode-manual runtime === */
(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeManual) return;
  window.__dualModeManual = true;
  var MAX=5;
  var EXP=600;
  var state={mode:'explore',attempts:MAX,timeLeft:EXP,timerId:null};
  function $(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
  function setPhase(p){
    try{
      if(typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase==='function') window.__platformTraceSetPhase(p);
      else if(window.PlatformTraceAdapter&&window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase) window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(p);
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function fmt(sec){var m=Math.floor(sec/60),s=sec%60;return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':'+(s<10?'0':'')+s;}
  function stop(){if(state.timerId){clearInterval(state.timerId);state.timerId=null;}}
  function render(){
    var label=$('modeLabel'),stats=$('challengeStats'),att=$('attemptsDisplay'),td=$('timerDisplay'),chip=$('dual-timer-chip');
    if(label) label.textContent=state.mode==='explore'?'探究模式':'竞赛模式';
    if(stats){ if(state.mode==='challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible'); else stats.classList.remove('is-visible'); }
    if(att) att.textContent=String(state.attempts);
    if(chip) chip.style.display=state.mode==='explore'?'inline-flex':'none';
    if(td) td.textContent=fmt(Math.max(0,state.timeLeft));
  }
  function startTimer(){
    stop(); state.timeLeft=EXP; render();
    state.timerId=setInterval(function(){
      if(state.mode!=='explore') return;
      state.timeLeft--; render();
      if(state.timeLeft<=0){
        stop();
        var sel=$('modeSelect');
        if(sel){ sel.value='challenge'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); }
      }
    },1000);
  }
  function apply(mode){
    state.mode=mode==='challenge'?'challenge':'explore';
    if(state.mode==='challenge'){ stop(); state.attempts=MAX; }
    else startTimer();
    render(); setPhase(state.mode);
    try{
      playMode=state.mode;
      if(state.mode==='challenge') lockChallengePeriod();
      else applyExplorePeriod();
    }catch(e){}
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dual-mode-change',{detail:{mode:state.mode,attempts:state.attempts}}));
  }
  function consume(){
    if(state.mode!=='challenge') return true;
    if(state.attempts<=0) return false;
    state.attempts--; render();
    return state.attempts>=0;
  }
  window.__dualModeConsumeAttempt=consume;
  window.__dualModeGet=function(){return {mode:state.mode,attempts:state.attempts};};
  function boot(){
    var sel=$('modeSelect');
    if(!sel) return;
    sel.addEventListener('change',function(){ apply(sel.value); });
    apply(sel.value||'explore');
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>

## 事理图谱摘要
- 标题：单摆投靶 · 第1关
- Play 链：P1(premise) → C1(constraint) → O1(operation) → C2(constraint) → C3(constraint) → C4(constraint) → R1(result) → I1(irrelevant)
- 策略途径：单变量·摆长；单变量·摆角；多参盲调；试探·质量
## 埋点规格（telemetrySpec）

按事理图谱 traceMap 上报：每次滑条/按钮操作记录 controlId、值、时间戳。
snapshot 事件在「发射/测试/提交」时记录各 control 当前值。
评判时将轨迹节点映射到 KG play 链（P1→O1→C*→R1）与 strategy routes。
混淆变量触碰可选记录，但不计入主探究路径得分。

### 事件列表

- **tuning** `s-length` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `s-angle` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `s-mass` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `modeSelect` → C1（必采）
- **tuning** `releaseBtn` → O1（必采）

### DT 检查点

- decision: 模式选择?
- decision: 落点命中矿车?
- retry: 未达标重试
- result: 过关
- decision: 竞赛机会用尽?
- retry: 失败重试

<body>

<div id="craft-intro">
  <div class="craft-card">
    <h2>投靶台 · 单摆</h2>
    <p>接矿车在轨上往返——落点跟释放角怎么对齐？调摆长与释放角，看落点与矿车的相对位置。</p>

  </div>
</div>

<div id="app">
    <div id="stage">
        <canvas id="simCanvas" width="800" height="400"></canvas>
        <div id="dual-mode-hud">
  <div id="dual-timer-chip" class="dual-chip"><span id="modeLabel">探究模式</span><span style="opacity:.35">|</span><span id="timerDisplay">10:00</span></div>

        <div id="essence-hud">

            <div class="essence-sub" id="goalMission">试摆：观察落点与矿车相对位置</div>

              <div class="bench-hd-title">调节摆参数</div>

        </div>

            <p id="sideGoal" style="margin:0 0 10px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--craft-text)">调摆长与释放角，看落点怎么变。</p>
            <div class="slider-group">

                    <div class="row"><label>摆长</label><span class="slider-value" id="lengthValue">150</span></div>

                </div>
                <div class="slider-item">

                    <input type="range" id="s-angle" min="-80" max="80" value="-45" step="1">

                    <div class="row"><label>质量 m</label><span class="slider-value" id="massValue">3.0</span></div>
                    <input type="range" id="s-mass" min="1" max="5" value="3" step="0.5">
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="mode-group" style="display:none" aria-hidden="true">
                <button id="freeMode" class="active">自由</button>
                <button id="compMode">竞赛</button>

                <span>关卡</span>

        </div>

            <div class="status" id="statusMsg">就绪，调节参数</div>
            <div class="action-buttons">
                <button class="btn" id="releaseBtn">释放摆锤</button>
                <button class="btn btn-reset" id="resetBtn">重置</button>
