<script>
(function() {
    const G = 980;
    const DW = 800, DH = 400;
    const GROUND_Y = 360;
    const PIVOT_X = 200, PIVOT_Y = 70;
    const canvas = document.getElementById('simCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const stage = document.getElementById('stage');
    let scale = 1, offX = 0, offY = 0;

    function resize() {
        const w = stage.clientWidth || innerWidth;
        const h = stage.clientHeight || innerHeight;
        const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        canvas.width = w * dpr;
        canvas.height = h * dpr;
        canvas.style.width = w + 'px';
        canvas.style.height = h + 'px';
        scale = Math.min(w / DW, h / DH);
        offX = (w - DW * scale) / 2;
        offY = (h - DH * scale) / 2;
        ctx.setTransform(dpr * scale, 0, 0, dpr * scale, dpr * offX, dpr * offY);
        if (typeof drawScene === 'function') drawScene();
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(stage);
    const lengthSlider = document.getElementById('s-length');
    const angleSlider = document.getElementById('s-angle');
    const massSlider = document.getElementById('s-mass');
    const lengthVal = document.getElementById('lengthValue');
    const angleVal = document.getElementById('angleValue');
    const massVal = document.getElementById('massValue');
    const releaseBtn = document.getElementById('releaseBtn');
    const resetBtn = document.getElementById('resetBtn');
    const freeModeBtn = document.getElementById('freeMode');
    const compModeBtn = document.getElementById('compMode');
    const healthSpan = document.getElementById('healthCount');
    const statusMsg = document.getElementById('statusMsg');
    const confuseToggle = document.getElementById('confuseToggle');
    const levelBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.level-select button');

    let isFreeMode = true;
    let playMode = 'explore';
    let health = 5;
    let maxHealth = 5;
    let currentLevel = 1;
    /** 探究默认关闭噪声；竞赛仅保留很弱扰动，避免不公平不可达 */
    let confuseOn = false;
    let confuseScale = 0;
    let L = 150, theta = -45 * Math.PI / 180, omega = 0, theta0 = -45 * Math.PI / 180, mass = 3.0;
    let lastShotParams = null;
    let elasticDelta = 0, shakeAccel = 0;
    const STATE_READY = 'ready', STATE_SWING = 'swing', STATE_FLYING = 'flying';
    let state = STATE_READY;
    let bobX = PIVOT_X + L * Math.sin(theta);
    let bobY = PIVOT_Y + L * Math.cos(theta);
    let flyX = 0, flyY = 0, flyVx = 0, flyVy = 0, flyTime = 0;
    let cartX = 600, cartWidth = 80, cartSpeed = 80, cartDir = 1, cartMinX = 480, cartMaxX = 720;
    let hit = false, attemptUsed = false;
    let lastTime = 0, animId = null;
    let challengeWon = false;
    let lockedCartSpec = null; // FixedChallenge：进竞赛锁定一次

    const MODE_GOALS = {
      explore: {
        hud: '试摆：观察落点与矿车相对位置',
        side: '调摆长与释放角，看落点怎么变。',
        tag: '自由试摆',
        sub: '探究：摸清释放角与落点'
      },
      challenge: {
        hud: '限次命中本局锁定工况的接矿车',
        side: '限次命中本局锁定工况的接矿车（打偏不换车）。',
        tag: '急单投递',
        sub: '竞赛：矿车工况本局固定'
      }
    };

    function refreshGoalUI() {
      const g = MODE_GOALS[playMode] || MODE_GOALS.explore;
      const mission = document.getElementById('goalMission');
      const side = document.getElementById('sideGoal');
      const sub = document.getElementById('benchGoalSub');
      const tag = document.getElementById('hudModeTag');
      if (playMode === 'challenge' && lockedCartSpec) {
        if (mission) mission.textContent = '急单：车宽 ' + Math.round(lockedCartSpec.w) + ' · 速 ' + Math.round(lockedCartSpec.spd) + ' · 本局固定';
        if (side) side.textContent = '竞赛急单：把矿石摆进宽约 ' + Math.round(lockedCartSpec.w) + '、速度约 ' + Math.round(lockedCartSpec.spd) + ' 的接矿车。工况已锁定，打偏不换车。';
        if (sub) sub.textContent = '竞赛：工况锁定 · 限次命中';
        if (tag) tag.textContent = g.tag;
      } else {
        if (mission) mission.textContent = g.hud;
        if (side) side.textContent = g.side;
        if (sub) sub.textContent = g.sub;
        if (tag) tag.textContent = g.tag;
      }
    }

    /** 理想能量近似下的落点包络（与 detachBob 同号：自左侧释放向右飞） */
    function landingEnvelope() {
      let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity;
      for (let len = 60; len <= 220; len += 4) {
        for (let deg = 12; deg <= 80; deg += 4) {
          const th = deg * Math.PI / 180;
          const fall = GROUND_Y - 6 - PIVOT_Y - len;
          if (fall < 18) continue;
          const v = Math.sqrt(2 * G * len * (1 - Math.cos(th)));
          const t = Math.sqrt(2 * fall / G);
          const land = PIVOT_X + v * t;
          minX = Math.min(minX, PIVOT_X + 20);
          maxX = Math.max(maxX, land);
        }
      }
      if (!isFinite(minX) || !isFinite(maxX)) return { minX: 220, maxX: 430 };
      // 留一点边距，避免矿车贴极限落点
      return {
        minX: Math.max(180, Math.floor(minX)),
        maxX: Math.min(460, Math.ceil(maxX - 8))
      };
    }
    function clampCartRange(minX, maxX, width) {
      const env = landingEnvelope();
      let lo = Math.max(minX, env.minX);
      let hi = Math.min(maxX, env.maxX);
      if (hi - lo < width + 30) {
        lo = env.minX;
        hi = Math.max(env.minX + width + 40, env.maxX);
      }
      if (hi <= lo) { lo = env.minX; hi = env.maxX; }
      return { minX: lo, maxX: hi };
    }
    function syncConfuseForMode() {
      if (playMode === 'challenge') {
        confuseOn = true;
        confuseScale = 0.18; // 竞赛极弱扰动
      } else {
        confuseOn = false;
        confuseScale = 0;
      }
      if (confuseToggle) confuseToggle.checked = confuseOn;
    }

    /** FixedChallenge：仅进入竞赛时锁定一次矿车工况（车更窄更快，目视可辨） */
    function lockChallengeCart() {
      syncConfuseForMode();
      const env = landingEnvelope();
      const w = 34 + Math.random() * 14; // 明显窄于探究关卡 50–90
      const span = Math.max(70, env.maxX - env.minX - w);
      const minX = env.minX + Math.random() * Math.max(8, span * 0.25);
      const maxX = Math.min(env.maxX, minX + 80 + Math.random() * 90);
      const clamped = clampCartRange(minX, maxX, w);
      lockedCartSpec = {
        w: w,
        spd: 90 + Math.random() * 40,
        minX: clamped.minX,
        maxX: clamped.maxX
      };
      cartWidth = lockedCartSpec.w;
      cartSpeed = lockedCartSpec.spd;
      cartMinX = lockedCartSpec.minX;
      cartMaxX = lockedCartSpec.maxX;
      cartX = cartMinX + (cartMaxX - cartMinX) * 0.35;
      cartDir = 1;
      // 开局张力：偏角偏极端，默认不易一次命中
      L = 120; theta0 = -60 * Math.PI / 180; mass = 3.0;
      lengthSlider.value = String(L);
      angleSlider.value = '-60';
      massSlider.value = '3';
      challengeWon = false;
      resetPhysics();
      updateUI();
      refreshGoalUI();
      statusMsg.textContent = '急单已锁定矿车工况（本局不变）';
      drawScene();
    }

    function applyExploreCart() {
      lockedCartSpec = null;
      challengeWon = false;
      syncConfuseForMode();
      loadLevel(currentLevel || 1);
      refreshGoalUI();
    }

    function challengeAttemptsLeft() {
      var st = window.__dualModeGet && window.__dualModeGet();
      return st && typeof st.attempts === 'number' ? st.attempts : maxHealth;
    }
    function syncHealthHudForMode() {
      var chip = document.getElementById('healthDisplay');
      if (chip) chip.style.display = playMode === 'challenge' ? 'none' : '';
      if (playMode !== 'challenge') healthSpan.textContent = health;
    }
    window.__pendApplyMode = function(mode) {
      playMode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
      isFreeMode = playMode === 'explore';
      if (playMode === 'challenge') {
        health = maxHealth; // 竞赛以 attempts 为准，health 仅作兼容占位
        lockChallengeCart();
      } else {
        applyExploreCart();
      }
      syncHealthHudForMode();
    };
    document.addEventListener('dual-mode-change', function(ev) {
      var m = ev && ev.detail && ev.detail.mode;
      if (typeof window.__pendApplyMode === 'function') window.__pendApplyMode(m);
    });

    function degToRad(deg) { return deg * Math.PI / 180; }
    function clamp(v, min, max) { return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, v)); }

    function updateUI() {
        lengthVal.textContent = L.toFixed(0);
        angleVal.textContent = (theta0 * 180 / Math.PI).toFixed(0) + '°';
        massVal.textContent = mass.toFixed(1);
        healthSpan.textContent = health;
        levelBtns.forEach(btn => {
            btn.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(btn.dataset.level) === currentLevel);
        });
        freeModeBtn.classList.toggle('active', isFreeMode);
        compModeBtn.classList.toggle('active', !isFreeMode);
    }

    function resetPhysics() {
        theta = theta0;
        omega = 0;
        elasticDelta = 0;
        shakeAccel = 0;
        bobX = PIVOT_X + L * Math.sin(theta);
        bobY = PIVOT_Y + L * Math.cos(theta);
        state = STATE_READY;
        hit = false;
        attemptUsed = false;
        flyTime = 0;
        statusMsg.textContent = '就绪，点击释放';
        releaseBtn.disabled = false;
    }

    function resetGame() {
        resetPhysics();
        if (!isFreeMode) { health = maxHealth; healthSpan.textContent = health; }
        cartX = 600; cartDir = 1;
        statusMsg.textContent = '已重置';
        drawScene();
    }

    // ----- 修改小车运动范围（扩大） -----
    function loadLevel(level) {
        if (playMode === 'challenge') {
          statusMsg.textContent = '竞赛中矿车工况已锁定，切回探究后再换关卡';
          return;
        }
        currentLevel = level;
        switch (level) {
            case 1:
                cartWidth = 90;
                cartSpeed = 50;
                cartMinX = 300;
                cartMaxX = 720;
                break;
            case 2:
                cartWidth = 70;
                cartSpeed = 80;
                cartMinX = 250;
                cartMaxX = 750;
                break;
            case 3:
                cartWidth = 50;
                cartSpeed = 120;
                cartMinX = 200;
                cartMaxX = 780;
                break;
        }
        var clamped = clampCartRange(cartMinX, cartMaxX, cartWidth);
        cartMinX = clamped.minX;
        cartMaxX = clamped.maxX;
        cartX = cartMinX + (cartMaxX - cartMinX) / 2; // 初始居中
        cartDir = 1;
        resetGame();
        statusMsg.textContent = `关卡 ${level} 已加载`;
        updateUI();
        drawScene();
    }

    function physicsStep(dt) {
        if (state === STATE_SWING) {
            if (confuseOn && confuseScale > 0) {
                elasticDelta += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4 * dt * 20 * confuseScale;
                elasticDelta = clamp(elasticDelta, -12 * confuseScale, 12 * confuseScale);
                shakeAccel = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 150 * confuseScale;
            } else {
                elasticDelta = 0;
                shakeAccel = 0;
            }
            let effectiveL = Math.max(30, L + elasticDelta);
            let alpha = -(G / effectiveL) * Math.sin(theta) + (shakeAccel / effectiveL) * Math.cos(theta);
            omega += alpha * dt;
            omega *= 0.9995;
            theta += omega * dt;
            if (theta > Math.PI / 1.8) theta = Math.PI / 1.8;
            if (theta < -Math.PI / 1.8) theta = -Math.PI / 1.8;
            bobX = PIVOT_X + effectiveL * Math.sin(theta);
            bobY = PIVOT_Y + effectiveL * Math.cos(theta);
            if (Math.abs(theta) < 0.04 && Math.abs(omega) > 1.0 && !attemptUsed) {
                detachBob();
            }
        } else if (state === STATE_FLYING) {
            flyX += flyVx * dt;
            flyY += flyVy * dt;
            flyVy += G * dt;
            flyTime += dt;
            if (flyY >= GROUND_Y - 6) {
                flyY = GROUND_Y - 6;
                checkLanding(flyX);
                state = STATE_READY;
                releaseBtn.disabled = false;
                if (hit) {
                    statusMsg.textContent = playMode === 'challenge' ? '命中急单矿车！' : '命中！';
                } else {
                    // FixedChallenge：失败不换矿车工况；保留偏近/偏远（checkLanding 已写）
                    var baseMiss = statusMsg.textContent || '';
                    if (baseMiss.indexOf('偏近') < 0 && baseMiss.indexOf('偏远') < 0) {
                      statusMsg.textContent = playMode === 'challenge'
                        ? '未命中 · 矿车工况仍锁定（本局不变）'
                        : '未命中';
                    } else if (playMode === 'challenge' && baseMiss.indexOf('锁定') < 0) {
                      statusMsg.textContent = baseMiss + ' · 工况仍锁定';
                    }
                }
                // FixedChallenge：竞赛次数只走 dual-mode attempts（按钮门禁已扣），禁止再扣 health
                if (!hit && playMode !== 'challenge' && !isFreeMode) {
                    health = Math.max(0, health - 1);
                    healthSpan.textContent = health;
                    if (health === 0) statusMsg.textContent = '机会用尽 · 可切回探究后再接急单';
                } else if (!hit && playMode === 'challenge') {
                    var stMiss = window.__dualModeGet && window.__dualModeGet();
                    if (stMiss && stMiss.attempts <= 0) {
                      statusMsg.textContent = '机会用尽 · 可切回探究后再接急单';
                    }
                }
                attemptUsed = true;
                drawScene();
            }
        }
    }

    function detachBob() {
        if (state !== STATE_SWING) return;
        let effectiveL = L + elasticDelta;
        let v = effectiveL * omega;
        flyX = PIVOT_X + effectiveL * Math.sin(theta);
        flyY = PIVOT_Y + effectiveL * Math.cos(theta);
        flyVx = v;
        flyVy = 0;
        state = STATE_FLYING;
        releaseBtn.disabled = true;
        statusMsg.textContent = '🪝 脱钩！飞行中...';
        attemptUsed = true;
    }

    function checkLanding(x) {
        let left = cartX, right = cartX + cartWidth;
        hit = (x >= left && x <= right);
        if (hit && window.__emit) {
          var c = window.__snapControls ? window.__snapControls() : {
            's-length': L, 's-angle': theta0 * 180 / Math.PI, 's-mass': mass
          };
          if (playMode === 'challenge') {
            if (!challengeWon) {
              challengeWon = true;
              window.__emit('snapshot', { controls: c, winOk: true, hintKey: 'pendulum_rush' });
              window.__emit('win', { winOk: true });
              if (typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
                window.__craftShowWin('急单矿车工况本局锁定：落点由摆长与释放角决定，与质量 m 无关。');
              }
            }
          } else {
            window.__emit('snapshot', { controls: c, winOk: true, hintKey: 'pendulum_target' });
            window.__emit('win', { winOk: true });
          }
        } else if (!hit && window.__emit) {
          const missSide = x < left ? 'miss_short' : 'miss_long';
          const missTxt = x < left ? '落点偏近（车前）' : '落点偏远（车后）';
          let missHint = missTxt + ' · 对照落点再调释放角';
          if (lastShotParams
              && Math.abs(mass - lastShotParams.mass) > 0.05
              && Math.abs(L - lastShotParams.L) < 0.5
              && Math.abs(theta0 - lastShotParams.theta0) < 1e-3) {
            missHint = missTxt + ' · 只改质量时落点几乎不变，试试摆长或释放角';
          }
          if (statusMsg) statusMsg.textContent = missHint;
          window.__emit('snapshot', {
            controls: { 's-length': L, 's-angle': theta0 * 180 / Math.PI, 's-mass': mass },
            winOk: false, hintKey: playMode === 'challenge' ? missSide : 'pendulum_miss'
          });
        }
        lastShotParams = { L: L, theta0: theta0, mass: mass };
    }

    function drawScene() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 800, 400);
        // 矿井巷道场景
        const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, GROUND_Y);
        sky.addColorStop(0, '#0f1c28');
        sky.addColorStop(1, '#1e3347');
        ctx.fillStyle = sky;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 400);
        // 木支撑
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            const sx = 80 + i * 150;
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#6b4f2a';
            ctx.lineWidth = 8;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(sx, 20);
            ctx.lineTo(sx, GROUND_Y);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(sx - 40, 36);
            ctx.lineTo(sx + 40, 36);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
        // 巷道顶灯
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(250,204,21,0.15)';
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const lx = 140 + i * 160;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(lx, 40);
            ctx.lineTo(lx - 50, GROUND_Y);
            ctx.lineTo(lx + 50, GROUND_Y);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fde68a';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(lx, 44, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(250,204,21,0.15)';
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3d4f3a';
        ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, 800, 400 - GROUND_Y);
        // 铁轨
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#94a3b8';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y - 4);
        ctx.lineTo(800, GROUND_Y - 4);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        for (let x = 20; x < 800; x += 36) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(x, GROUND_Y - 10);
            ctx.lineTo(x + 16, GROUND_Y + 6);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = '#86efac';
        ctx.font = 'bold 12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        /* scene title lives in #essence-hud / sidebar */
        // 加大支点座
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4a5564';
        ctx.fillRect(PIVOT_X - 22, PIVOT_Y - 10, 44, 18);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(PIVOT_X, PIVOT_Y, 14, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#c0d0e0';
        ctx.shadowColor = '#00000066';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#8a9aaa';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
        let effL = L + (confuseOn ? elasticDelta : 0);
        let drawTheta = theta;
        let endX = PIVOT_X + effL * Math.sin(drawTheta);
        let endY = PIVOT_Y + effL * Math.cos(drawTheta);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(PIVOT_X, PIVOT_Y);
        ctx.lineTo(endX, endY);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#b0c8e0';
        ctx.lineWidth = 4;
        ctx.stroke();
        if (state === STATE_READY || state === STATE_SWING) {
            // 加大锤头
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(endX, endY, 22, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
            let grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(endX-5, endY-5, 4, endX, endY, 26);
            grad.addColorStop(0, '#f8e080');
            grad.addColorStop(1, '#c08030');
            ctx.fillStyle = grad;
            ctx.shadowColor = '#00000066';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#8a6020';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = 'bold 12px sans-serif';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.fillText(mass.toFixed(1)+'kg', endX, endY-2);
        } else if (state === STATE_FLYING) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(flyX, flyY, 18, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
            let grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(flyX-3, flyY-3, 3, flyX, flyY, 22);
            grad.addColorStop(0, '#f8d080');
            grad.addColorStop(1, '#b07030');
            ctx.fillStyle = grad;
            ctx.shadowColor = '#00000066';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        }
        let left = cartX, right = cartX + cartWidth;
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        // 加大接矿车
        ctx.fillStyle = '#6a5438';
        ctx.fillRect(left - 4, GROUND_Y - 30, cartWidth + 8, 30);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8a6e4b';
        ctx.fillRect(left, GROUND_Y - 26, cartWidth, 26);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#a08060';
        ctx.fillRect(left+4, GROUND_Y - 36, cartWidth-8, 12);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3a3a';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(left+14, GROUND_Y-2, 10, 0, 2*Math.PI);
        ctx.arc(right-14, GROUND_Y-2, 10, 0, 2*Math.PI);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fde68a';
        ctx.font = 'bold 13px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
        ctx.fillText('接矿车', (left+right)/2, GROUND_Y-38);
        if (state === STATE_READY) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffcc44';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
            ctx.strokeRect(left-2, GROUND_Y-28, cartWidth+4, 30);
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
        }
        if (state === STATE_READY && attemptUsed && !hit) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6666';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(flyX, GROUND_Y-4, 6, 0, 2*Math.PI);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaaaa';
            ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
            ctx.fillText('✖', flyX+12, GROUND_Y-20);
        } else if (state === STATE_READY && attemptUsed && hit) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#66ff66';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(flyX, GROUND_Y-4, 8, 0, 2*Math.PI);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#aaffaa';
            ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
            ctx.fillText('✔', flyX+16, GROUND_Y-30);
        }
        // 读数贴右下，避开左上双模式条
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15,23,42,0.75)';
        ctx.fillRect(560, 330, 220, 44);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(96,165,250,0.45)';
        ctx.strokeRect(560, 330, 220, 44);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#bfdbfe';
        ctx.font = '12px ui-monospace,Consolas,sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
        ctx.fillText(`L=${L.toFixed(0)}  θ=${(theta0*180/Math.PI).toFixed(0)}°  m=${mass.toFixed(1)}`, 572, 338);
        ctx.fillText(`关卡 ${currentLevel}`, 572, 356);
        var outOfTries = playMode === 'challenge'
          ? challengeAttemptsLeft() <= 0
          : (!isFreeMode && health === 0);
        if (outOfTries) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
            ctx.font = 'bold 36px sans-serif';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.fillText('💀 挑战失败', 400, 180);
        } else if (state === STATE_READY && hit && isFreeMode) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#66ff66';
            ctx.font = 'bold 30px sans-serif';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.fillText('🎉 命中！过关！', 400, 180);
        }
    }

    function gameLoop(timestamp) {
        if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
        let dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.03);
        lastTime = timestamp;
        if (state === STATE_READY || state === STATE_SWING || state === STATE_FLYING) {
            cartX += cartSpeed * cartDir * dt;
            if (cartX > cartMaxX) { cartX = cartMaxX; cartDir = -1; }
            if (cartX < cartMinX) { cartX = cartMinX; cartDir = 1; }
        }
        if (state === STATE_SWING || state === STATE_FLYING) {
            physicsStep(dt);
        }
        drawScene();
        var noTriesLeft = playMode === 'challenge'
          ? challengeAttemptsLeft() <= 0
          : (!isFreeMode && health === 0);
        if (noTriesLeft) {
            releaseBtn.disabled = true;
            if (playMode === 'challenge') statusMsg.textContent = '机会用尽 · 可切回探究后再接急单';
            else statusMsg.textContent = '💔 已失败，点击重置';
        } else if (state === STATE_READY && !attemptUsed) {
            releaseBtn.disabled = false;
        }
        animId = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
    }

    lengthSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
        if (state !== STATE_READY) return;
        L = parseFloat(this.value);
        theta0 = degToRad(parseFloat(angleSlider.value));
        theta = theta0;
        omega = 0;
        resetPhysics();
        updateUI();
        drawScene();
    });
    angleSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
        if (state !== STATE_READY) return;
        theta0 = degToRad(parseFloat(this.value));
        theta = theta0;
        omega = 0;
        resetPhysics();
        updateUI();
        drawScene();
    });
    massSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
        mass = parseFloat(this.value);
        massVal.textContent = mass.toFixed(1);
        drawScene();
    });

    freeModeBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        isFreeMode = true;
        health = maxHealth;
        healthSpan.textContent = health;
        resetGame();
        updateUI();
        drawScene();
    });
    compModeBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        isFreeMode = false;
        health = maxHealth;
        healthSpan.textContent = health;
        resetGame();
        updateUI();
        drawScene();
    });

    levelBtns.forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            let level = parseInt(this.dataset.level);
            loadLevel(level);
            updateUI();
            drawScene();
        });
    });

    releaseBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (state !== STATE_READY) return;
        if (playMode === 'challenge' ? challengeAttemptsLeft() <= 0 : (!isFreeMode && health === 0)) return;
        attemptUsed = false;
        hit = false;
        theta0 = theta;
        omega = 0;
        state = STATE_SWING;
        releaseBtn.disabled = true;
        statusMsg.textContent = '摆动中…';
        elasticDelta = 0;
        drawScene();
    });

    resetBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        resetGame();
        if (!isFreeMode) { health = maxHealth; healthSpan.textContent = health; }
        updateUI();
        drawScene();
    });

    // 探究默认关闭随机扰动；竞赛弱扰动在 syncConfuseForMode 中开启
    syncConfuseForMode();

    function init() {
        loadLevel(1);
        updateUI();
        resetGame();
        resize();
        lastTime = 0;
        if (animId) cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
        animId = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
    }
    init();
})();
</script>
<!-- trace-adapter-hook -->
<script>
(function(){
  function emit(type, payload) {
    try {
      if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  function snapControls() {
    var o = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"], select').forEach(function(el) {
      var id = el.id || el.name;
      if (id) o[id] = el.value;
    });
    return o;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    emit('puzzle_open', {});
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() {
        if (window.__platformTraceControlsBound) return;
        emit('tuning', { control: el.id || el.name || 'slider', value: el.value });
      });
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('click', function() {
        emit('action', { control: el.id || (el.textContent || '').trim().slice(0, 24) || 'button' });
      });
    });
    window.__emit = emit;
    window.__snapControls = snapControls;
  });
})();
</script>
<!-- legacy-win-bridge -->
<script>
(function(){
  function emitWin(hintKey) {
    if (window.__legacyWinEmitted) return;
    window.__legacyWinEmitted = true;
    var emit = window.__emit;
    if (!emit) return;
    var controls = window.__snapControls ? window.__snapControls() : {};
    emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: hintKey || 'legacy_win' });
    emit('win', { winOk: true });
  }
  var WIN_TEXT = [/完美命中/, /游戏胜利/, /过关！/, /命中目标！/, /🎯\s*命中目标/, /🏆\s*过关/];
  function scanWinText() {
    var text = document.body ? document.body.innerText : '';
    for (var i = 0; i < WIN_TEXT.length; i++) {
      if (WIN_TEXT[i].test(text)) {
        emitWin('text_' + i);
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function() { scanWinText(); });

(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeManual) return;
  window.__dualModeManual = true;
  var MAX=5;
  var EXP=600;
  var state={mode:'explore',attempts:MAX,timeLeft:EXP,timerId:null};
  function $(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
  function setPhase(p){
    try{
      if(typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase==='function') window.__platformTraceSetPhase(p);
      else if(window.PlatformTraceAdapter&&window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase) window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(p);
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function fmt(sec){var m=Math.floor(sec/60),s=sec%60;return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':'+(s<10?'0':'')+s;}
  function stop(){if(state.timerId){clearInterval(state.timerId);state.timerId=null;}}
  function render(){
    var label=$('modeLabel'),stats=$('challengeStats'),att=$('attemptsDisplay'),td=$('timerDisplay'),chip=$('dual-timer-chip');
    if(label) label.textContent=state.mode==='explore'?'探究模式':'竞赛模式';
    if(stats){ if(state.mode==='challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible'); else stats.classList.remove('is-visible'); }
    if(att) att.textContent=String(state.attempts);
    if(chip) chip.style.display=state.mode==='explore'?'inline-flex':'none';
    if(td) td.textContent=fmt(Math.max(0,state.timeLeft));
  }
  function startTimer(){
    stop(); state.timeLeft=EXP; render();
    state.timerId=setInterval(function(){
      if(state.mode!=='explore') return;
      state.timeLeft--; render();
      if(state.timeLeft<=0){
        stop();
        var sel=$('modeSelect');
        if(sel){ sel.value='challenge'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); }
      }
    },1000);
  }
  function apply(mode){
    state.mode=mode==='challenge'?'challenge':'explore';
    if(state.mode==='challenge'){ stop(); state.attempts=MAX; }
    else startTimer();
    render(); setPhase(state.mode);
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dual-mode-change',{detail:{mode:state.mode,attempts:state.attempts}}));
  }
  function consume(){
    if(state.mode!=='challenge') return true;
    if(state.attempts<=0) return false;
    state.attempts--; render();
    return state.attempts>=0;
  }
  window.__dualModeConsumeAttempt=consume;
  window.__dualModeGet=function(){return {mode:state.mode,attempts:state.attempts};};
  function boot(){
    var sel=$('modeSelect');
    if(!sel) return;
    sel.addEventListener('change',function(){ apply(sel.value); });
    apply(sel.value||'explore');
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>

评判时将轨迹节点映射到 KG play 链（P1→O1→C*→R1）与 strategy routes。
混淆变量触碰可选记录，但不计入主探究路径得分。

### 事件列表

- **tuning** `in-angle` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `in-power` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `in-grav` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `in-drag` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `in-wind` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `in-mass` → O1（必采）
- **irrelevant_touch** `in-material` → I1
- **tuning** `modeSelect` → O1（必采）
- **tuning** `tuning` → tuning（必采）
- **action** `action` → tuning（必采）

### DT 检查点

- decision: 飞出边界?
- retry: 出界重试
- decision: 撞到障碍物?
- decision: 命中要塞目标?
- result: 过关
- retry: 未命中重试

                    <h3>空气阻力与风（调参提示）</h3>
                    <p>阻力越大，弹道越「矮、短」；顺风推远、逆风推近。</p>
                    <p class="highlight">重点：风靠空气传递——只有阻力大于 0 时，风速才会改变落点。过关后可对照阻力公式归纳。</p>
                </div>
                <div class="guide-section">
                    <h3>6. 弹药质量</h3>
                    <p>质量越大，惯性越强。重物受风力和阻力减速的影响较小。</p>
                </div>
                <div class="guide-section" style="border: none;">
                    <h3>7. 弹种</h3>
                    <p>可选铅、钢、铁等弹种外观。</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="btn-group">
                <button class="pixel-btn pixel-btn-close" id="btn-close-guide">关闭手册</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

<script>
class PixelGame {
    constructor() {
        this.dom = {
            canvas: document.getElementById('game-canvas'),
            stage: document.getElementById('stage'),
            inputs: {
                angle: document.getElementById('in-angle'),
                power: document.getElementById('in-power'),
                grav: document.getElementById('in-grav'),
                drag: document.getElementById('in-drag'),
                wind: document.getElementById('in-wind'),
                mass: document.getElementById('in-mass'),
                material: document.getElementById('in-material') // 弹种外观（不进轨迹）
            },
            groups: {
                angle: document.getElementById('group-angle'),
                power: document.getElementById('group-power'),
                grav: document.getElementById('group-grav'),
                drag: document.getElementById('group-drag'),
                wind: document.getElementById('group-wind'),
                mass: document.getElementById('group-mass'),
                material: document.getElementById('group-material')
            },
            displays: {
                angle: document.getElementById('val-angle'),
                power: document.getElementById('val-power'),
                grav: document.getElementById('val-grav'),
                drag: document.getElementById('val-drag'),
                wind: document.getElementById('val-wind'),
                mass: document.getElementById('val-mass'),
                material: document.getElementById('val-material')
            },
            hud: {
                panel: document.getElementById('hud-panel'),
                time: document.getElementById('hud-time'),
                dist: document.getElementById('hud-dist'),
                high: document.getElementById('hud-high'),
                spd: document.getElementById('hud-spd'),
                drag: document.getElementById('hud-drag'),
                potential: document.getElementById('hud-potential')
            },
            wind: {
                arrow: document.getElementById('wind-arrow'),
                text: document.getElementById('wind-text')
            },
            btnFire: document.getElementById('btn-fire'),
            btnGuide: document.getElementById('btn-guide'),
            modal: {
                overlay: document.getElementById('modal-overlay'),
                title: document.getElementById('modal-title'),
                msg: document.getElementById('modal-msg'),
                retry: document.getElementById('btn-retry'),
                next: document.getElementById('btn-next')
            },
            levelClear: {
                overlay: document.getElementById('level-clear-overlay'),
                btnEnter: document.getElementById('btn-enter-free')
            },
            guide: {
                overlay: document.getElementById('guide-overlay'),
                close: document.getElementById('btn-close-guide')
            },
            level: document.getElementById('level-display'),
            totalScore: document.getElementById('total-score')
        };

        this.ctx = this.dom.canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false; 

        this.state = 'READY';
        this.level = 1;
        this.playMode = 'explore'; // explore | challenge
        
        this.totalScore = 0;
        this.attemptsInLevel = 0; 
        
        this.pixelsPerMeter = 4;
        this.timeScale = 0.05;
        
        this.proj = null;
        this.target = null;
        this.obstacles = []; 
        this.particles = [];
        this.muzzleFlash = null;
        this.recoil = 0;
        
        this.landingPoints = [];
        this.rangePosts = [];
        this.exploreShots = 0;
        this.exploreDragSeen = new Set();
        this.exploreWindSeen = new Set();
        this.exploreWon = false;
        
        this.width = 0;
        this.height = 0;
        this.groundY = 0;

        this.init();
    }

    init() {
        this.resize();
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => this.resize());
        if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
            new ResizeObserver(() => this.resize()).observe(this.dom.stage);
        }

        Object.keys(this.dom.inputs).forEach(k => {
            this.dom.inputs[k].addEventListener('input', () => this.updateUI());
        });

        this.dom.btnFire.addEventListener('click', () => this.fire());
        this.dom.btnGuide.addEventListener('click', () => this.openGuide());
        this.dom.guide.close.addEventListener('click', () => this.closeGuide());
        
        this.dom.modal.retry.addEventListener('click', () => this.closeModal());
        this.dom.modal.next.addEventListener('click', () => this.nextLevel());
        
        this.dom.levelClear.btnEnter.addEventListener('click', () => this.enterFreeMode());

        document.addEventListener('dual-mode-change', (ev) => {
            this.applyPlayMode(ev.detail && ev.detail.mode);
        });

        setTimeout(() => {
            this.resize();
            const dm = window.__dualModeGet ? window.__dualModeGet() : null;
            this.applyPlayMode(dm ? dm.mode : 'explore');
            this.updateScoreDisplay();
            this.updateUI();
            this.loop();
        }, 100);
    }

    applyPlayMode(mode) {
        this.playMode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
        this.state = 'READY';
        this.proj = null;
        this.particles = [];
        this.landingPoints = [];
        this.attemptsInLevel = 0;
        if (this.playMode === 'explore') {
            this.level = 0;
            this.exploreShots = 0;
            this.exploreDragSeen = new Set();
            this.exploreWindSeen = new Set();
            this.exploreWon = false;
            this.dom.modal.overlay.classList.remove('active');
        } else {
            this.level = 1;
            this.exploreWon = false;
        }
        this.generateLevel();
        this.updateLevelTag();
        this.refreshGoalUI();
        if (this.dom.hud && this.dom.hud.panel) this.dom.hud.panel.style.display = 'none';
        this.draw();
    }

    refreshGoalUI() {
        const mission = document.getElementById('goalMission');
        const side = document.getElementById('sideGoal');
        if (this.playMode === 'challenge') {
            if (this.target) {
                const distM = ((this.target.x - 60) / this.pixelsPerMeter).toFixed(0);
                const heightM = Math.max(0, ((this.groundY - this.target.y) / this.pixelsPerMeter)).toFixed(0);
                const bunker = this.obstacles && this.obstacles.length ? '（需越过掩体）' : '（开阔）';
                if (mission) mission.textContent = `当前要塞：约 ${distM} m · 高度 ${heightM} m ${bunker} · 本关固定，打偏不换`;
                if (side) side.textContent = `竞赛·要塞突击：限次命中约 ${distM} m、高约 ${heightM} m 的标志物${bunker}（本关固定，打偏不换）。`;
            } else {
                if (mission) mission.textContent = '目标：限次命中掩体后的要塞标志物（本关固定）';
                if (side) side.textContent = '限次命中掩体后的目标（打偏不换靶）。';
            }
        } else {
            if (mission) mission.textContent = '试射：对比落点，弄清阻力与风';
            if (side) side.textContent = '换阻力或风速，看落点怎么变。';
        }
    }

    openGuide() { this.dom.guide.overlay.classList.add('active'); }
    closeGuide() { this.dom.guide.overlay.classList.remove('active'); }

    resize() {
        const rect = this.dom.stage.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) {
            this.width = rect.width;
            this.height = rect.height;
            const dpr = Math.min(2.5, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
            this.dom.canvas.style.width = this.width + 'px';
            this.dom.canvas.style.height = this.height + 'px';
            this.dom.canvas.width = Math.round(this.width * dpr);
            this.dom.canvas.height = Math.round(this.height * dpr);
            this.ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
            this.groundY = this.height * 0.85;
            
            // FixedChallenge：竞赛期已有目标时 resize 只重绘，不重 roll
            if (this.state === 'READY') {
                if (this.playMode !== 'challenge' || !this.target) this.generateLevel();
                this.draw();
            }
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        const getVal = (id) => this.dom.inputs[id].value;
        this.dom.displays.angle.innerText = getVal('angle') + '°';
        this.dom.displays.power.innerText = getVal('power') + ' m/s';
        this.dom.displays.grav.innerText = getVal('grav') + ' m/s²';
        this.dom.displays.drag.innerText = parseFloat(getVal('drag')).toFixed(3);
        this.dom.displays.wind.innerText = getVal('wind') + ' m/s';
        this.dom.displays.mass.innerText = getVal('mass') + ' kg';

        const materials = ["铅", "钢", "铁"];
        const matIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(2, parseInt(getVal('material'), 10) - 1));
        this.dom.displays.material.innerText = materials[matIndex];

        const windSpeed = parseFloat(getVal('wind'));
        this.dom.wind.text.innerText = windSpeed;
        if (windSpeed > 0) {
            this.dom.wind.arrow.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)'; 
            this.dom.wind.arrow.style.color = '#7af2cc'; 
        } else if (windSpeed < 0) {
            this.dom.wind.arrow.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)'; 
            this.dom.wind.arrow.style.color = '#ff7eb3'; 
        } else {
            this.dom.wind.arrow.style.color = '#ccc'; 
        }
        if(this.state === 'READY') this.draw();
    }

    highlightInputs(inputKeys) {
        Object.values(this.dom.groups).forEach(el => el.classList.remove('highlight'));
        inputKeys.forEach(key => {
            if(this.dom.groups[key]) this.dom.groups[key].classList.add('highlight');
        });
    }

    updateLevelTag() {
        if (this.playMode === 'explore') {
            this.dom.level.innerText = '试射场';
            this.dom.level.classList.add('free-mode');
            return;
        }
        if (this.level > 4) {
            this.dom.level.innerText = '随机要塞';
            this.dom.level.classList.add('free-mode');
        } else {
            this.dom.level.innerText = `突击 ${this.level}`;
            this.dom.level.classList.remove('free-mode');
        }
    }

    calculatePotentialScore() {
        let score = 100 - (this.attemptsInLevel - 1) * 10;
        return Math.max(60, score);
    }

    updateScoreDisplay() {
        this.dom.totalScore.innerText = this.totalScore;
    }

    generateLevel() {
        if (this.width === 0) return;
        this.obstacles = [];
        this.rangePosts = [];
        this.target = null;

        if (this.playMode === 'explore') {
            this.highlightInputs(['drag', 'wind']);
            const marks = [40, 80, 120, 160];
            marks.forEach((m) => {
                const x = 60 + m * this.pixelsPerMeter;
                if (x < this.width - 30) this.rangePosts.push({ x, meters: m });
            });
            this.refreshGoalUI();
            return;
        }

        const type = ((Math.max(1, this.level) - 1) % 4) + 1;
        const obstacleColor = '#5d4037';
        if (type === 4) this.highlightInputs(['drag', 'wind']);
        else this.highlightInputs([]);

        if (type === 1) {
            const minX = this.width * 0.35; const maxX = this.width * 0.88;
            const x = Math.random() * (maxX - minX) + minX;
            const isAir = Math.random() > 0.45;
            const y = isAir ? this.groundY - (80 + Math.random() * (this.height * 0.28)) : this.groundY;
            this.target = { x, y, w: 26, h: 26, color: '#e74c3c' };
        } else if (type === 2) {
            const wallW = 32, wallH = this.height * 0.55, wallX = this.width * 0.38;
            this.obstacles.push({ x: wallX, y: this.groundY - wallH, w: wallW, h: wallH, color: obstacleColor });
            const targetX = wallX + wallW + 30 + Math.random() * 90;
            const isAir = Math.random() > 0.35;
            const targetY = isAir ? this.groundY - (50 + Math.random() * 110) : this.groundY;
            this.target = { x: targetX, y: targetY, w: 26, h: 26, color: '#e74c3c' };
        } else if (type === 3) {
            const platW = 180, platH = 18, platY = this.height * 0.32, platX = this.width * 0.32;
            this.obstacles.push({ x: platX, y: platY, w: platW, h: platH, color: '#546e7a' });
            const targetX = Math.min(this.width - 40, platX + platW + 80 + Math.random() * 100);
            this.target = { x: targetX, y: this.groundY, w: 26, h: 26, color: '#e74c3c' };
        } else {
            const wallW = 30, wallH = this.height * 0.65, wallX = this.width * 0.42;
            this.obstacles.push({ x: wallX, y: this.groundY - wallH, w: wallW, h: wallH, color: obstacleColor });
            const targetX = wallX + wallW + 36;
            const targetY = this.groundY - (90 + Math.random() * 100);
            this.target = { x: targetX, y: targetY, w: 26, h: 26, color: '#e74c3c' };
            const forcedWind = -15 - Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
            this.dom.inputs.wind.value = String(forcedWind);
            this.updateUI();
        }
        this.refreshGoalUI();
    }

    fire() {
        if(this.state !== 'READY') return;
        
        this.attemptsInLevel++;

        const angle = parseFloat(this.dom.inputs.angle.value) * Math.PI / 180;
        const v0 = parseFloat(this.dom.inputs.power.value);
        const g = parseFloat(this.dom.inputs.grav.value);
        const k = parseFloat(this.dom.inputs.drag.value);
        const wind = parseFloat(this.dom.inputs.wind.value);
        const m = parseFloat(this.dom.inputs.mass.value);

        // 弹种仅改外观颜色，不进入轨迹积分
        const matIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(2, parseInt(this.dom.inputs.material.value, 10) - 1));
        const matColors = ['#6b7280', '#94a3b8', '#475569'];

        this.proj = {
            x: 60, y: this.groundY - 25,
            vx: v0 * Math.cos(angle), vy: -v0 * Math.sin(angle),
            m, k, g, wind, t: 0,
            ke0: 0.5 * m * v0 * v0,
            active: true, size: 8,
            color: matColors[matIndex] // 仅改变视觉表现
        };

        this.state = 'SIMULATING';
        this.recoil = 15;
        this.muzzleFlash = { life: 1.0 };
        
        this.dom.hud.panel.style.display = 'block';
        this.dom.hud.potential.innerText = this.calculatePotentialScore();
        
        this.dom.btnFire.disabled = true;
        this.dom.btnFire.innerText = "发射中...";
    }

    updatePhysics() {
        if(!this.proj || !this.proj.active) return;
        const p = this.proj;
        const dt = this.timeScale;

        // 【注意】物理公式依然严格基于初速、质量、引力、阻力和风速计算，完全忽略了 p.color 或材质变量
        const vrX = p.vx - p.wind;
        const vrY = p.vy;
        const vr = Math.sqrt(vrX*vrX + vrY*vrY);

        const FdMag = p.k * vr * vr;
        const FdX = -FdMag * (vrX / vr) || 0;
        const FdY = -FdMag * (vrY / vr) || 0;

        const FgY = p.m * p.g;
        const FnetX = FdX;
        const FnetY = FgY + FdY;

        const ax = FnetX / p.m;
        const ay = FnetY / p.m;

        p.vx += ax * dt;
        p.vy += ay * dt;
        p.x += p.vx * dt;
        p.y += p.vy * dt;
        p.t += dt;

        // 飞行烟迹（过程可见，非调参时落点预览）
        if (Math.random() < 0.65) {
            this.particles.push({
                x: p.x, y: p.y,
                vx: -p.vx * 0.02 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8,
                vy: -0.4 + Math.random() * 0.6,
                life: 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.25,
                color: 'rgba(226,232,240,0.85)',
                size: 2 + Math.random() * 3
            });
        }

        const ke = 0.5 * p.m * (p.vx*p.vx + p.vy*p.vy);
        const loss = ((p.ke0 - ke) / p.ke0 * 100);

        this.dom.hud.time.innerText = p.t.toFixed(1) + 's';
        this.dom.hud.dist.innerText = ((p.x - 60) / this.pixelsPerMeter).toFixed(0) + 'm';
        this.dom.hud.high.innerText = ((this.groundY - p.y) / this.pixelsPerMeter).toFixed(0) + 'm';
        this.dom.hud.spd.innerText = Math.sqrt(p.vx*p.vx + p.vy*p.vy).toFixed(0) + 'm/s';
        this.dom.hud.drag.innerText = Math.max(0, loss).toFixed(0) + '%';

        // 将爆炸的颜色替换为当前的材质颜色，增强混淆性
        for (let obs of this.obstacles) {
            if (p.x > obs.x && p.x < obs.x + obs.w && p.y > obs.y && p.y < obs.y + obs.h) {
                this.endSim(false, "撞到障碍物!");
                this.createExplosion(p.x, p.y, p.color, 15);
                return;
            }
        }

        if(p.y + p.size >= this.groundY) {
            if (this.playMode === 'explore') {
                this.endSim(false, "落点已记录");
            } else {
                let missMsg = "未命中要塞!";
                if (this.target) {
                    const dx = p.x - this.target.x;
                    const nearFar = Math.abs(dx) < 18 ? '落点接近水平位置但未中'
                      : (dx < 0 ? '落点偏近（未及要塞）' : '落点偏远（越过要塞）');
                    missMsg = nearFar;
                }
                this.endSim(false, missMsg);
                this.createExplosion(p.x, p.y, p.color, 10);
            }
            return;
        }
        if(p.x > this.width || p.x < 0) {
            let reason = p.x > this.width ? "飞出右边界" : "飞出左边界";
            this.endSim(false, reason);
            return;
        }

        if (!this.target) return;
        const dx = p.x - this.target.x;
        const dy = p.y - this.target.y;
        if(Math.abs(dx) < (p.size + this.target.w/2) && Math.abs(dy) < (p.size + this.target.h/2)) {
            this.createExplosion(this.target.x, this.target.y, p.color, 30);
            this.shakeScreen();
            this.endSim(true, "要塞目标击中!");
        }
    }

    createExplosion(x, y, color, count) {
        for(let i=0; i<count; i++) {
            this.particles.push({
                x: x, y: y,
                vx: (Math.random()-0.5) * 10, vy: (Math.random()-0.5) * 10,
                life: 1.0, color: color, size: Math.random() * 6 + 4
            });
        }
    }

    shakeScreen() {
        this.dom.stage.classList.add('shake');
        setTimeout(() => this.dom.stage.classList.remove('shake'), 500);
    }

    maybeExploreWin() {
        if (this.exploreWon) return;
        const dragOk = this.exploreDragSeen.size >= 2;
        const windOk = this.exploreWindSeen.size >= 2;
        if (this.exploreShots < 3 || !(dragOk || windOk)) return;
        this.exploreWon = true;
        if (window.__emit) {
            var c = window.__snapControls ? window.__snapControls() : {};
            window.__emit('snapshot', { controls: c, winOk: true, hintKey: 'cannon_explore_compare' });
            window.__emit('win', { winOk: true });
        }
        this.dom.modal.title.innerText = '试射归纳完成';
        this.dom.modal.title.style.color = '#06d6a0';
        this.dom.modal.msg.innerText = '你已对比不同阻力/风速下的落点。可切换「要塞突击」——那里要限次命中掩体后的目标。';
        this.dom.modal.retry.style.display = 'none';
        this.dom.modal.next.style.display = 'inline-block';
        this.dom.modal.next.innerText = '继续试射';
        this.dom.modal.next.onclick = () => {
            this.closeModal();
            this.dom.modal.next.innerText = '下一关';
            this.dom.modal.next.onclick = () => this.nextLevel();
        };
        setTimeout(() => this.dom.modal.overlay.classList.add('active'), 400);
    }

    endSim(win, msg) {
        this.state = 'ENDED';
        this.proj.active = false;
        this.dom.btnFire.disabled = false;
        this.dom.btnFire.innerText = "发射!";

        let landX = this.proj ? this.proj.x : 0;
        let landY = this.proj ? this.proj.y : 0;
        if (landX > this.width) landX = this.width - 10;
        if (landX < 0) landX = 10;
        if (landY < 0) landY = 10;
        if (landY > this.groundY) landY = this.groundY;
        const dist = Math.floor((landX - 60) / this.pixelsPerMeter);
        this.landingPoints.push({ x: landX, y: landY, win: win, dist: dist, explore: this.playMode === 'explore' });

        if (this.playMode === 'explore') {
            const drag = parseFloat(this.dom.inputs.drag.value).toFixed(3);
            const wind = String(parseFloat(this.dom.inputs.wind.value));
            this.exploreDragSeen.add(drag);
            this.exploreWindSeen.add(wind);
            this.exploreShots += 1;
            const tip = document.createElement('div');
            tip.className = 'score-pop';
            tip.innerText = `落点 ${dist}m`;
            tip.style.left = '50%';
            tip.style.top = '28%';
            tip.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)';
            tip.style.color = '#7af2cc';
            this.dom.stage.appendChild(tip);
            setTimeout(() => tip.remove(), 900);
            this.maybeExploreWin();
            this.state = 'READY';
            this.proj = null;
            this.dom.hud.panel.style.display = 'none';
            return;
        }

        let earnedScore = 0;
        if (win) {
            if (window.__emit) {
              var c = window.__snapControls ? window.__snapControls() : {};
              window.__emit('snapshot', { controls: c, winOk: true, hintKey: 'cannon_fort_hit' });
              window.__emit('win', { winOk: true });
            }
            earnedScore = this.calculatePotentialScore();
            this.totalScore += earnedScore;
            this.updateScoreDisplay();
            const scorePop = document.createElement('div');
            scorePop.className = 'score-pop';
            scorePop.innerText = `+${earnedScore}`;
            scorePop.style.left = '50%';
            scorePop.style.top = '30%';
            scorePop.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)';
            this.dom.stage.appendChild(scorePop);
            setTimeout(() => scorePop.remove(), 1000);
        }

        this.dom.modal.title.innerText = win ? "突击成功!" : "未攻破";
        this.dom.modal.title.style.color = win ? "#06d6a0" : "#e74c3c";
        let msgContent = `${msg}`;
        if (win) {
            msgContent += `\n获得积分: +${earnedScore}`;
            msgContent += `\n当前总分: ${this.totalScore}`;
        } else {
            // FixedChallenge：失败不重 roll，保持本关要塞位置
            this.landingPoints = [];
            const distM = this.target ? ((this.target.x - 60) / this.pixelsPerMeter).toFixed(0) : '?';
            const heightM = this.target ? Math.max(0, ((this.groundY - this.target.y) / this.pixelsPerMeter)).toFixed(0) : '?';
            msgContent += `\n要塞仍在 → 约 ${distM} m / 高 ${heightM} m（本关固定）`;
            const dm = window.__dualModeGet ? window.__dualModeGet() : null;
            if (dm && typeof dm.attempts === 'number') msgContent += `\n剩余机会：${dm.attempts}`;
        }
        this.dom.modal.msg.innerText = msgContent;
        this.dom.modal.retry.style.display = win ? "none" : "inline-block";
        this.dom.modal.retry.innerText = '再瞄一发';
        this.dom.modal.next.style.display = win ? "inline-block" : "none";
        this.dom.modal.next.innerText = '下一关';
        this.dom.modal.next.onclick = () => this.nextLevel();
        setTimeout(() => { this.dom.modal.overlay.classList.add('active'); }, 500);
    }

    closeModal() {
        this.dom.modal.overlay.classList.remove('active');
        this.reset();
    }

    nextLevel() {
        if (this.level === 4) {
            this.dom.modal.overlay.classList.remove('active');
            this.dom.levelClear.overlay.classList.add('active');
        } else {
            this.dom.modal.overlay.classList.remove('active');
            this.level++;
            this.updateLevelTag();
            this.landingPoints = []; 
            this.attemptsInLevel = 0; 
            this.generateLevel();
            this.reset();
        }
    }

    enterFreeMode() {
        this.dom.levelClear.overlay.classList.remove('active');
        this.level++;
        this.updateLevelTag();
        this.landingPoints = []; 
        this.attemptsInLevel = 0; 
        this.generateLevel();
        this.reset();
    }

    reset() {
        this.state = 'READY';
        this.proj = null;
        this.particles = [];
        this.dom.hud.panel.style.display = 'none';
        this.draw();
    }

    drawRect(x, y, w, h, color) {
        this.ctx.fillStyle = color;
        this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y), w, h);
    }

    drawEnvironment() {
        const sky = this.ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, this.groundY);
        sky.addColorStop(0, '#4a90b8');
        sky.addColorStop(0.45, '#6eb6e0');
        sky.addColorStop(0.75, '#a8d4ef');
        sky.addColorStop(1, '#cfe8f5');
        this.ctx.fillStyle = sky;
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.width, this.height);

        // 太阳光晕
        const sunX = this.width * 0.82, sunY = 48;
        const sg = this.ctx.createRadialGradient(sunX, sunY, 2, sunX, sunY, 55);
        sg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(254,243,199,0.9)');
        sg.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(253,224,71,0.35)');
        sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(253,224,71,0)');
        this.ctx.fillStyle = sg;
        this.ctx.beginPath();
        this.ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, 55, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        this.ctx.fill();

        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#6b8799';
        this.ctx.beginPath();
        this.ctx.moveTo(0, this.groundY - 40);
        this.ctx.lineTo(this.width * 0.18, this.groundY - 95);
        this.ctx.lineTo(this.width * 0.32, this.groundY - 50);
        this.ctx.lineTo(this.width * 0.5, this.groundY - 110);
        this.ctx.lineTo(this.width * 0.7, this.groundY - 55);
        this.ctx.lineTo(this.width, this.groundY - 85);
        this.ctx.lineTo(this.width, this.groundY);
        this.ctx.lineTo(0, this.groundY);
        this.ctx.fill();
        // 近景山脊第二层
        this.ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(71,85,105,0.35)';
        this.ctx.beginPath();
        this.ctx.moveTo(0, this.groundY);
        this.ctx.lineTo(0, this.groundY - 28);
        this.ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.width * 0.35, this.groundY - 70, this.width * 0.55, this.groundY - 32);
        this.ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.width * 0.75, this.groundY - 58, this.width * 0.7, this.groundY);
        this.ctx.fill();

        const grass = this.ctx.createLinearGradient(0, this.groundY, 0, this.height);
        grass.addColorStop(0, '#5aa34f');
        grass.addColorStop(1, '#2f6b32');
        this.ctx.fillStyle = grass;
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, this.groundY, this.width, this.height - this.groundY);
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#2f6b32';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, this.groundY, this.width, 3);

        const seaX = this.width * 0.72;
        const sea = this.ctx.createLinearGradient(seaX, this.groundY, this.width, this.height);
        sea.addColorStop(0, '#3d8ea8');
        sea.addColorStop(1, '#1f5f78');
        this.ctx.fillStyle = sea;
        this.ctx.fillRect(seaX, this.groundY + 8, this.width - seaX, this.height - this.groundY - 8);
        this.ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
        const tw = Date.now() * 0.003;
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const wx = seaX + 20 + i * 36 + Math.sin(tw + i) * 6;
            this.ctx.fillRect(wx, this.groundY + 18 + (i % 2) * 8, 18, 3);
        }

        // 沙袋掩体（材质条纹）
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            const bx = 18 + i * 14;
            const bag = this.ctx.createLinearGradient(bx, this.groundY - 12, bx + 12, this.groundY);
            bag.addColorStop(0, '#d4b896');
            bag.addColorStop(1, '#a67c52');
            this.ctx.fillStyle = bag;
            this.ctx.fillRect(bx, this.groundY - 10, 12, 10);
            this.ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)';
            this.ctx.fillRect(bx + 2, this.groundY - 6, 8, 1);
        }

        // 炮台旗帜（有意微摆）
        const flagPoleX = 108;
        const fw = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005) * 4;
        this.ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
        this.ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        this.ctx.beginPath();
        this.ctx.moveTo(flagPoleX, this.groundY);
        this.ctx.lineTo(flagPoleX, this.groundY - 52);
        this.ctx.stroke();
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#ef4444';
        this.ctx.beginPath();
        this.ctx.moveTo(flagPoleX, this.groundY - 52);
        this.ctx.lineTo(flagPoleX + 22 + fw, this.groundY - 44);
        this.ctx.lineTo(flagPoleX, this.groundY - 36);
        this.ctx.fill();

        this.ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
        const time = Date.now() * 0.0005;
        const cx = (time * 50) % (this.width + 200) - 100;
        this.drawRect(cx, 50, 60, 20, '#fff');
        this.drawRect(cx + 20, 40, 40, 10, '#fff');

        if (this.playMode === 'explore' && this.rangePosts) {
            this.ctx.font = "12px 'VT323', monospace";
            this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            this.rangePosts.forEach((p) => {
                this.ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,40,50,0.55)';
                this.ctx.fillRect(p.x - 1, this.groundY - 28, 2, 28);
                this.ctx.fillStyle = '#1e293b';
                this.ctx.fillRect(p.x - 10, this.groundY - 32, 20, 10);
                this.ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
                this.ctx.fillText(p.meters + 'm', p.x, this.groundY - 24);
            });
        }
    }

    drawObstacles() {
        for (let obs of this.obstacles) {
            this.ctx.fillStyle = obs.color;
            this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(obs.x), Math.floor(obs.y), Math.floor(obs.w), Math.floor(obs.h));
            this.ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
            this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(obs.x), Math.floor(obs.y + obs.h - 10), Math.floor(obs.w), 10);
            this.ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
            for(let i = 10; i < obs.w; i+=20) {
                this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(obs.x + i), Math.floor(obs.y), 4, obs.h);
            }
        }
    }

    drawTarget() {
        if (!this.target) return;
        const t = this.target;
        
        const floatY = Math.sin(Date.now() / 300) * 5;
        const drawY = t.y + floatY;

        if (t.y < this.groundY) {
            this.ctx.strokeStyle = '#555';
            this.ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            this.ctx.beginPath();
            this.ctx.moveTo(t.x, t.y + t.h/2);
            this.ctx.lineTo(t.x, this.groundY);
            this.ctx.stroke();
        }

        this.ctx.fillStyle = t.color;
        this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(t.x - t.w/2), Math.floor(drawY - t.h/2), t.w, t.h);
        
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(t.x - t.w/2) + 4, Math.floor(drawY - t.h/2) + 4, 4, 4);
        this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(t.x) - 4, Math.floor(drawY) - 4, 8, 8);
    }

    drawLandingPoints() {
        this.ctx.font = "12px 'VT323'";
        this.ctx.textAlign = "center";

        for (let p of this.landingPoints) {
            if (p.win) {
                this.ctx.strokeStyle = '#2ecc71';
                this.ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                this.ctx.beginPath();
                this.ctx.arc(Math.floor(p.x), Math.floor(p.y), 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                this.ctx.stroke();
                this.ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
                this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(p.x)-1, Math.floor(p.y)-1, 2, 2);
            } else {
                this.ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
                this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(p.x - 4), Math.floor(p.y - 5), 2, 10);
                this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(p.x + 2), Math.floor(p.y - 5), 2, 10);
                this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(p.x - 1), Math.floor(p.y - 6), 2, 12);
                this.ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
                this.ctx.fillText(`${p.dist}m`, Math.floor(p.x), Math.floor(p.y + 20));
            }
        }
    }

    drawCannon() {
        this.recoil *= 0.9;
        if(this.recoil < 0.5) this.recoil = 0;

        const angle = parseFloat(this.dom.inputs.angle.value) * Math.PI / 180;
        const cx = 60 - this.recoil;
        const cy = this.groundY - 18; 

        // 沙袋（户外轻触）
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#6b5344';
        this.ctx.beginPath();
        this.ctx.ellipse(cx - 48, this.groundY - 6, 22, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        this.ctx.fill();
        this.ctx.beginPath();
        this.ctx.ellipse(cx + 52, this.groundY - 5, 20, 9, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        this.ctx.fill();

        this.drawRect(cx - 24, cy, 52, 20, '#2c3e50'); 
        this.drawRect(cx - 26, cy + 4, 56, 16, '#1a1a1a'); 
        this.drawRect(cx - 22, cy + 4, 3, 16, '#3e3e3e');
        this.drawRect(cx - 12, cy + 4, 3, 16, '#3e3e3e');
        this.drawRect(cx, cy + 4, 3, 16, '#3e3e3e');
        this.drawRect(cx + 12, cy + 4, 3, 16, '#3e3e3e');

        this.ctx.save();
        this.ctx.translate(cx, cy);
        this.ctx.rotate(-angle);

        this.drawRect(-18, -18, 36, 36, '#2c3e50');
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#5d6d7e'; 
        this.drawRect(-20, -22, 5, 7); 
        this.drawRect(15, -22, 5, 7);  
        this.drawRect(-20, 15, 5, 7);  
        this.drawRect(15, 15, 5, 7);   
        this.drawRect(-22, -12, 5, 7); 
        this.drawRect(17, -12, 5, 7);
        this.drawRect(-22, 6, 5, 7);
        this.drawRect(17, 6, 5, 7);

        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#7af2cc';
        this.drawRect(-5, -5, 10, 10);
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; 
        this.drawRect(-2, -2, 4, 4);

        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, -10, 60, 20);
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#34495e'; 
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, -7, 60, 14);
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#7af2cc'; 
        this.ctx.fillRect(4, -2, 50, 3);
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#2c3e50';
        this.ctx.fillRect(54, -11, 7, 22);
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(58, -9, 5, 18);

        this.ctx.restore();
    }

    drawMuzzleFlash() {
        if(!this.muzzleFlash) return;
        
        this.muzzleFlash.life -= 0.2;
        if(this.muzzleFlash.life <= 0) {
            this.muzzleFlash = null;
            return;
        }

        const angle = parseFloat(this.dom.inputs.angle.value) * Math.PI / 180;
        const cx = 60 - this.recoil;
        const cy = this.groundY - 18;

        const dist = 65;
        const fx = cx + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
        const fy = cy - Math.sin(angle) * dist;

        this.ctx.globalAlpha = this.muzzleFlash.life;
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
        const size = (1.5 - this.muzzleFlash.life) * 22 + 12;
        this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(fx - size/2), Math.floor(fy - size/2), size, size);
        // 尾烟加粗
        this.ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,200,200,0.45)';
        this.ctx.beginPath();
        this.ctx.arc(fx - Math.cos(angle) * 12, fy + Math.sin(angle) * 12, size * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        this.ctx.fill();
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        const innerSize = size * 0.6;
        this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(fx - innerSize/2), Math.floor(fy - innerSize/2), innerSize, innerSize);
        this.ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
    }

    drawProj() {
        if(this.proj) {
            const p = this.proj;
            // 使用弹种外观颜色
            this.ctx.fillStyle = p.color || '#ffaf40';
            this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(p.x - p.size/2), Math.floor(p.y - p.size/2), p.size, p.size);
            
            this.ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
            this.ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            this.ctx.strokeRect(Math.floor(p.x - p.size/2), Math.floor(p.y - p.size/2), p.size, p.size);
        }
    }

    drawParticles() {
        for (let i = this.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const p = this.particles[i];
            p.x += p.vx;
            p.y += p.vy;
            p.vy += 0.3; 
            p.life -= 0.03;

            if (p.life <= 0) {
                this.particles.splice(i, 1);
                continue;
            }

            this.ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
            this.ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
            this.ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(p.x), Math.floor(p.y), p.size, p.size);
            this.ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
        }
    }

    draw() {
        if(this.width === 0 || this.height === 0) return;

        this.ctx.clearRect(0, 0, this.width, this.height);
        
        this.drawEnvironment();
        this.drawObstacles();
        this.drawTarget();
        this.drawLandingPoints();
        this.drawCannon();
        this.drawMuzzleFlash();

        if (this.state === 'SIMULATING') {
            this.drawProj();
        }
        
        this.drawParticles();
    }

    loop() {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => this.loop());
        
        if (this.width === 0 || this.height === 0) {
            this.resize();
        }

        if (this.state === 'SIMULATING') {
            this.updatePhysics();
        }
        
        this.draw();
    }
}

window.onload = () => {
    new PixelGame();
};
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  function emit(type, payload) {
    try {
      if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  function snapControls() {
    var o = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"], select').forEach(function(el) {
      var id = el.id || el.name;
      if (id) o[id] = el.value;
    });
    return o;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    emit('puzzle_open', {});
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() {
        if (window.__platformTraceControlsBound) return;
        emit('tuning', { control: el.id || el.name || 'slider', value: el.value });
      });
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('click', function() {
        emit('action', { control: el.id || (el.textContent || '').trim().slice(0, 24) || 'button' });
      });
    });
    window.__emit = emit;
    window.__snapControls = snapControls;
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  function emitWin(hintKey) {
    if (window.__legacyWinEmitted) return;
    window.__legacyWinEmitted = true;
    var emit = window.__emit;
    if (!emit) return;
    var controls = window.__snapControls ? window.__snapControls() : {};
    emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: hintKey || 'legacy_win' });
    emit('win', { winOk: true });
  }
  var WIN_TEXT = [/完美命中/, /游戏胜利/, /过关！/, /命中目标！/, /🎯\s*命中目标/, /🏆\s*过关/];
  function scanWinText() {
    var text = document.body ? document.body.innerText : '';
    for (var i = 0; i < WIN_TEXT.length; i++) {
      if (WIN_TEXT[i].test(text)) {
        emitWin('text_' + i);
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function() { scanWinText(); });
    if (document.body) obs.observe(document.body, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true });
    setInterval(scanWinText, 800);
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* === dual-mode-manual runtime === */
(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeManual) return;
  window.__dualModeManual = true;
  var MAX=6;
  var EXP=600;
  var state={mode:'explore',attempts:MAX,timeLeft:EXP,timerId:null};
  function $(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
  function setPhase(p){
    try{
      if(typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase==='function') window.__platformTraceSetPhase(p);
      else if(window.PlatformTraceAdapter&&window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase) window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(p);
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function fmt(sec){var m=Math.floor(sec/60),s=sec%60;return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':'+(s<10?'0':'')+s;}
  function stop(){if(state.timerId){clearInterval(state.timerId);state.timerId=null;}}
  function render(){
    var label=$('modeLabel'),stats=$('challengeStats'),att=$('attemptsDisplay'),td=$('timerDisplay'),chip=$('dual-timer-chip');
    if(label) label.textContent=state.mode==='explore'?'探究模式':'竞赛模式';
    if(stats){ if(state.mode==='challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible'); else stats.classList.remove('is-visible'); }
    if(att) att.textContent=String(state.attempts);
    if(chip) chip.style.display=state.mode==='explore'?'inline-flex':'none';
    if(td) td.textContent=fmt(Math.max(0,state.timeLeft));
  }
  function startTimer(){
    stop(); state.timeLeft=EXP; render();
    state.timerId=setInterval(function(){
      if(state.mode!=='explore') return;
      state.timeLeft--; render();
      if(state.timeLeft<=0){
        stop();
        var sel=$('modeSelect');
        if(sel){ sel.value='challenge'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); }
      }
    },1000);
  }
  function apply(mode){
    state.mode=mode==='challenge'?'challenge':'explore';
    if(state.mode==='challenge'){ stop(); state.attempts=MAX; }
    else startTimer();
    render(); setPhase(state.mode);
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dual-mode-change',{detail:{mode:state.mode,attempts:state.attempts}}));
  }
  function consume(){
    if(state.mode!=='challenge') return true;
    if(state.attempts<=0) return false;
    state.attempts--; render();
    return state.attempts>=0;
  }
  window.__dualModeConsumeAttempt=consume;
  window.__dualModeGet=function(){return {mode:state.mode,attempts:state.attempts};};
  function boot(){
    var sel=$('modeSelect');
    if(!sel) return;
    sel.addEventListener('change',function(){ apply(sel.value); });
    apply(sel.value||'explore');
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>

<script>/* dualModeFireGate */
(function(){
  function bind(){
    var btn=document.getElementById('btn-fire');
    if(!btn||btn.__dualGate) return;
    btn.__dualGate=true;
    btn.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      if(window.__dualModeGet && window.__dualModeGet().mode==='challenge'){
        if(window.__dualModeConsumeAttempt && !window.__dualModeConsumeAttempt()){
          e.stopImmediatePropagation(); e.preventDefault();
          btn.disabled=true;
          setTimeout(function(){ if(window.__dualModeGet().attempts>0) btn.disabled=false; },0);
        }
      }
    }, true);
    document.addEventListener('dual-mode-change',function(ev){
      if(ev.detail.mode==='explore') btn.disabled=false;
      else if(ev.detail.attempts<=0) btn.disabled=true;
      else btn.disabled=false;
    });
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',bind); else bind();
})();
</script>

<script>
/* === craft-gold-runtime === */
(function(){
  if (window.__craftGold) return; window.__craftGold = true;
  var intro = document.getElementById('craft-intro');
  var win = document.getElementById('craft-win');
  var btn = document.getElementById('craftIntroBtn');
  var wbtn = document.getElementById('craftWinBtn');
  if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', function(){ if(intro) intro.hidden = true; });
  function replayLevel(){
    if (typeof window.__craftReplay === 'function') {
      try { window.__craftReplay(); return; } catch (e) {}
    }
    var rbtn = document.getElementById('btn-reset')
      || document.querySelector('#btnReset, button.btn-reset, [data-action="reset"]');
    if (rbtn) { try { rbtn.click(); } catch (e) {} }
  }
  if (wbtn) wbtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    window.__craftWinDismissed = true;
    if (win) win.hidden = true;
    replayLevel();
  });

  // 大炮已有 #hud-panel 读数板，不再注入 craft-gauge，避免遮挡
  function showWin(extra){
    if (win) {
      window.__craftWinDismissed = false;
      win.hidden = false;
      var t = document.getElementById('craftWinText');
      if (t && extra) t.textContent = extra;
    }
  }
  window.__craftShowWin = showWin;

  // Hook common win paths
  var _emit = window.__emit;
  window.__emit = function(type, payload){
    if (typeof _emit === 'function') _emit(type, payload);
    if (type === 'win') showWin();
  };
  // Observe win banners

#mat-label { font-size:10px; letter-spacing:3px; color:rgba(0,200,255,0.78); text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:8px; text-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(0,200,255,0.22); }
#mat-grid { display:flex; gap:7px; }
.mcard { flex:1; padding:8px 6px; text-align:center; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid rgba(0,200,255,0.17); border-radius:5px; background:rgba(0,16,32,0.55); transition:all 0.18s; }
