.mcard.sel { border-color:#00c8ff; background:rgba(0,52,88,0.65); }
.mdot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; margin:0 auto 5px; }
.mname { font-size:12px; color:#b8d4dc; }
.mer { font-size:10px; color:rgba(0,200,255,0.74); margin-top:2px; }
.mdesc { font-size:10px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.74); margin-top:5px; line-height:1.4; letter-spacing:0.3px; }
.mcard.sel .mdesc { color:rgba(195,235,255,0.78); }
.mcard-mica.sel { box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(185,130,255,0.25); }
.mcard-ceramic.sel { box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(250,162,70,0.22); }
.mcard-glass.sel { box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(110,195,255,0.22); }
.srow { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; margin:8px 0; }
.slabel { font-size:12px; color:#7eb8c8; width:138px; flex-shrink:0; }
.slabel small { display:block; font-size:10px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.80); margin-top:2px; }
input[type=range] { flex:1; height:28px; -webkit-appearance:none; appearance:none; background:transparent; border-radius:2px; outline:none; margin:0; }
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height:5px; background:rgba(0,200,255,0.14); border-radius:2px; }
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance:none; width:18px; height:18px; margin-top:-6.5px; border-radius:50%; background:#00c8ff; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(0,200,255,0.85); }
.sval { font-size:12px; color:#00c8ff; width:74px; text-align:right; flex-shrink:0; }
#bd-warn { background:rgba(255,36,36,0.12); border:1px solid rgba(255,80,80,0.34); border-radius:5px; padding:7px 12px; font-size:12px; color:#ff8888; margin-top:8px; display:none; }
#ch0-constraint, #ch1-constraint, .cap-constraint { display:none; margin-top:8px; font-size:11px; text-align:center; color:rgba(255,200,80,0.85); letter-spacing:0.5px; }
.prog-wrap { margin-top:10px; }
.prog-bg { background:rgba(0,200,255,0.08); border-radius:3px; height:6px; position:relative; overflow:visible; }
.prog-fill { height:100%; border-radius:3px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#005f70,#00c8ff); box-shadow:0 0 9px rgba(0,200,255,0.45); transition:width 0.12s; }
.prog-fill.is-dragging { transition:none; }
.prog-mark { position:absolute; top:-4px; width:2px; height:14px; background:rgba(255,208,80,0.62); border-radius:1px; }
.prog2-win-band {
  position:absolute; top:0; bottom:0; z-index:0;
  background:rgba(80,255,140,0.14);
  border-left:1px solid rgba(80,255,180,0.42);
  border-right:1px solid rgba(80,255,180,0.42);
  border-radius:2px; pointer-events:none; transition:background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s;
}
.prog2-win-band.ok { background:rgba(80,255,140,0.28); box-shadow:inset 0 0 12px rgba(80,255,160,0.35); }
#prog-win-lo, #prog-win-hi, #prog2-win-lo, #prog2-win-hi { background:rgba(80,255,180,0.55); z-index:2; }
.prog-lbl { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-top:4px; font-size:10px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.72); }
.prog-lbl .mid { color:rgba(255,213,95,0.86); }
#hint { margin-top:10px; font-size:12px; text-align:center; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.86); transition:color 0.35s; text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); }
#hint.ok { color:rgba(110,255,195,0.92); }

/* ── Victory ── */
#victory { position:fixed; inset:0; display:none; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; text-align:center; pointer-events:none; background:rgba(0,26,44,0); transition:background 2.2s; z-index:95; }
#v-title { font-size:34px; color:#00c8ff; letter-spacing:5px; text-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(0,200,255,0.9),0 0 60px rgba(0,200,255,0.4); opacity:0; transform:translateY(18px); transition:all 1.8s ease; }
#v-sub { font-size:15px; color:rgba(214,236,255,0.92); margin-top:14px; opacity:0; transform:translateY(14px); transition:all 1.8s ease 0.6s; text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.85),0 0 14px rgba(0,30,55,0.7); }
#v-btn { margin-top:30px; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:2px; color:rgba(120,222,255,0.92); opacity:0; transition:opacity 1.8s ease 2.2s; cursor:pointer; pointer-events:none; border:1px solid rgba(0,200,255,0.45); padding:9px 26px; border-radius:4px; animation:blink 2s infinite 2.5s; text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); }
#v-btn:hover { background:rgba(0,200,255,0.09); }
.srow-irrelevant { margin:4px 0; }
.srow-irrelevant .slabel { width:138px; }
.srow-irrelevant .slabel small { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.80); }
.srow-irrelevant .sval { color:#00c8ff; }

body.victory-nav-ready #top-chrome { z-index: 110; }
body.victory-nav-ready #v-title,
body.victory-nav-ready #v-sub { pointer-events: none; }
body.victory-nav-ready #v-btn {
  pointer-events: all;
  opacity: 1;
  transition: opacity 0.45s ease;
}

/* ── Chapter transition ── */
#trans { position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,0); display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; pointer-events:none; transition:background 0.75s; }
#trans-cv { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; pointer-events:none; z-index:0; }
#trans-title { font-size:26px; color:#00c8ff; letter-spacing:8px; opacity:0; transition:opacity 0.75s; position:relative; z-index:1; text-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(0,200,255,0.55),0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); }
#trans-sub { font-size:12px; color:rgba(150,224,255,0.82); letter-spacing:5px; margin-top:10px; opacity:0; transition:opacity 0.75s 0.25s; position:relative; z-index:1; text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.85); }

/* ── Summary ── */
.sum-hd { font-size:15px; letter-spacing:5px; color:#00c8ff; text-align:center; margin-bottom:24px; padding-bottom:14px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,200,255,0.15); }
.sum-sec { margin-bottom:22px; }
.sum-sec-lbl { font-size:10px; letter-spacing:3px; color:rgba(0,200,255,0.44); text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:10px; }
.sum-kv { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:5px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); font-size:13px; }
.sum-kv .k { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.62); }
.sum-kv .v { color:#c8dce8; }
.sum-mat { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:4px; margin-bottom:5px; font-size:12px; border:1px solid rgba(0,200,255,0.08); }
.sum-mat.final { border-color:rgba(0,200,255,0.35); background:rgba(0,50,80,0.4); }
.sum-mat.was-broken { border-color:rgba(255,80,80,0.25); background:rgba(40,0,0,0.3); }
.sum-mat-dot { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0; }
.sum-mat-name { width:44px; color:#b0ccd6; flex-shrink:0; }
.sum-mat-er { width:62px; color:rgba(0,200,255,0.55); flex-shrink:0; }
.sum-mat-ebd { flex:1; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55); font-size:11px; }
.sum-mat-st { font-size:11px; }
.sum-rule { padding:5px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); font-size:13px; color:rgba(210,228,238,0.86); line-height:1.6; }
.sum-rule span { color:#00c8ff; }
.formula-block {
  background:rgba(0,200,255,0.05); border:1px solid rgba(0,200,255,0.12);
  border-radius:4px; padding:10px 14px; margin:10px 0;
  font-size:13px; line-height:2.0; color:rgba(200,225,235,0.78);
  white-space:pre; overflow-x:auto;
}
.formula-hl { color:#00c8ff; font-weight:bold; }

/* ── Ch2 Controls ── */









#ch2-overload { background:rgba(255,60,0,0.12); border:1px solid rgba(255,80,0,0.38); border-radius:5px; padding:7px 12px; font-size:12px; color:#ff8860; margin-top:8px; display:none; }

/* 开场标题：外观与原先 canvas 一致，仅用 HTML 避免 shadowBlur 糊字 */
#intro-title-wrap {
  position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:45; display:none; pointer-events:none;
  background:none; border:none; padding:0; margin:0;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}

  position:absolute; top:7%; left:0; right:0; margin:0; text-align:center;
  font:10px 'Courier New',Consolas,monospace;
}
#intro-main {
  position:absolute; top:14.5%; left:0; right:0; margin:0; text-align:center;
  font:bold 30px 'Courier New',Consolas,monospace;
}
#map-overlay {
  position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.82); display:none;
  align-items:center; justify-content:center; z-index:200;
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px); opacity:0; transition:opacity 0.4s;
}
#map-panel {
  width:min(860px,96vw); background:rgba(2,6,18,0.97);
  border:1px solid rgba(0,200,255,0.20); border-radius:10px;

}
.map-hd { font-size:10px; letter-spacing:6px; color:rgba(0,200,255,0.40); margin-bottom:8px; text-align:center; }

.map-node.clickable:hover .map-dot { transform:scale(1.10); }
.map-dot {
  width:48px; height:48px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid rgba(0,200,255,0.18);

#map-dev-win-wrap {
  display:none; justify-content:center; margin-top:12px;
}
#map-dev-win {
  font-size:11px; letter-spacing:3px;
  color:rgba(255,190,30,0.72); border:1px solid rgba(255,190,30,0.32);

}

/* ── Ch3 Controls ── */

#c3-btn-row { display:flex; gap:9px; margin-top:9px; align-items:stretch; }

#c3-result-msg.c3-fail { color:rgba(255,100,45,0.88); }

<script>
/* ===== js/core/registry.js ===== */
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Game shell — chapter registry & navigation
//
//  Chapter API (via Game.register):
//    init()              — enter chapter
//    frame(ctx)          — per-frame render + tick (required)
//    usesCanvas          — true: chapter uses #c canvas (default); Ch8 uses clearCanvas: false
//    clearCanvas         — false: skip clearRect even when usesCanvas is true (Ch8 sky overlay)
//    syncSize()          — optional resize hook
//    skipToPhase2()      — optional dev skip
//    showSummary()       — optional victory epilogue
//    onCanvasClick/Move/Down/Up/RightClick — optional input hooks
//    onCanvasTouchStart/Move/End — optional touch hooks
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
window.Game = window.Game || {
  ch: 0,
  chapters: [],

  register(index, api) {
    this.chapters[index] = api;
  },

  getModule(n) {
    return this.chapters[n] || null;
  }
};

Object.defineProperty(window, 'ch', {
  get() { return Game.ch; },
  set(v) { Game.ch = v; },
  configurable: true
});

(function (Game) {
  Game.frame = function (ctx) {
    const mod = Game.getModule(Game.ch);
    if (!mod || !mod.frame) return false;
    if (mod.usesCanvas !== false && mod.clearCanvas !== false) ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    mod.frame(ctx);
    return true;
  };

  Game.syncActiveChapterSize = function () {
    const mod = Game.getModule(Game.ch);
    if (mod && mod.syncSize) mod.syncSize();
  };

  Game.dispatchCanvas = function (hook, ...args) {
    const mod = Game.getModule(Game.ch);
    if (mod && typeof mod[hook] === 'function') mod[hook](...args);
  };

  Game._jumpToCore = function (n) {
    if (typeof resetChapterUI === 'function') resetChapterUI();
    Game.ch = n;
    if (typeof SFX !== 'undefined' && SFX.scene) SFX.scene(n); // ambient per chapter
    const mod = Game.getModule(n);
    if (mod && mod.init) mod.init();
    if (typeof saveGameProgress === 'function') saveGameProgress();
  };

  Game.jumpTo = function (n) {
    Game.ensureChapter(n).then(() => {
      Game._jumpToCore(n);
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.error(err);
    });
  };
})(window.Game);

function jumpToChapter(n) {
  Game.jumpTo(n);
}

</script>

/* ===== js/core/chapter-loader.js ===== */
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Lazy chapter script / Ch8 CSS loader
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
(function (Game) {
  const loadedScripts = new Set();
  let ch8CssLoaded = false;
  let ch8BundleLoaded = false;

  const CHAPTER_SCRIPTS = {
    0: ['js/chapters/ch0.js'],
    1: ['js/chapters/ch1.js'],
    2: ['js/chapters/ch2.js'],
    3: ['js/chapters/ch3.js'],
    4: ['js/chapters/ch4.js'],
    5: ['js/chapters/ch5.js'],
    6: [
      'js/chapters/ch6/state.js',
      'js/chapters/ch6/armor.js',
      'js/chapters/ch6/circuit.js',
      'js/chapters/ch6/main.js',
    ],
    7: [
      'js/chapters/ch7/state.js',
      'js/chapters/ch7/phase1.js',
      'js/chapters/ch7/iso.js',
      'js/chapters/ch7/main.js',
    ],
  };

  const CH8_SCRIPTS = [
    'js/chapters/ch8/init.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/experiment.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/phase-3-transition-lab-d.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/phase-4-the-console.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/pulse-resolution-single.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/sky.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/climax.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/main.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/assemble.js',
  ];

  function loadScript(src) {
    if (loadedScripts.has(src)) return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const el = document.createElement('script');
      el.src = src;
      el.onload = () => {
        loadedScripts.add(src);
        resolve();
      };
      el.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load ' + src));
      document.body.appendChild(el);
    });
  }

  function loadScriptsSequential(urls) {
    return urls.reduce(
      (chain, url) => chain.then(() => loadScript(url)),
      Promise.resolve()
    );
  }

  function ensureCh8Css() {
    if (ch8CssLoaded) return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const link = document.createElement('link');
      link.rel = 'stylesheet';
      link.href = 'css/ch8.css';
      link.onload = () => {
        ch8CssLoaded = true;
        resolve();
      };
      link.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load css/ch8.css'));
      document.head.appendChild(link);
    });
  }

  Game.ensureChapter = function (n) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 0 || n > 8) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error('Invalid chapter: ' + n));
    }
    if (Game.getModule(n)) return Promise.resolve();

    if (n === 8) {
      if (ch8BundleLoaded) return Promise.resolve();
      return ensureCh8Css()
        .then(() => loadScriptsSequential(CH8_SCRIPTS))
        .then(() => {
          ch8BundleLoaded = true;
        });
    }

    const urls = CHAPTER_SCRIPTS[n];
    if (!urls) return Promise.reject(new Error('No scripts for chapter ' + n));
    return loadScriptsSequential(urls);
  };
})(window.Game);

</script>
<script>
/* ===== js/core/audio.js ===== */
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Procedural SFX — single AudioContext, zero files
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const STORAGE_KEY = 'nus-capacitor-era-sfx-v1';
  const TICK_MS = 45;

  let ctx = null;
  let master = null;     // global volume/mute gain
  let comp = null;       // safety compressor before destination
  let sfxBus = null;     // all one-shot SFX route here
  let muted = false;
  let volume = 1;
  const tickLast = {};

  function loadSettings() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (!raw) return;
      const s = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (typeof s.muted === 'boolean') muted = s.muted;
      if (typeof s.volume === 'number') volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s.volume));
    } catch (_) {}
    updateUi();
    syncMusic();
  }

  function saveSettings() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ muted, volume }));
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  function applyMaster() {
    if (!master) return;
    master.gain.value = muted ? 0 : volume;
  }

  // The top speaker button is the single master audio control: keep the
  // background-music engine (window.MUSIC, defined in music.js) in lockstep
  // with the SFX mute state so one click silences / restores everything.
  function syncMusic() {
    try {
      if (window.MUSIC && typeof window.MUSIC.applyVolume === 'function') {
        window.MUSIC.applyVolume(muted ? 0 : volume);
      } else if (window.MUSIC && typeof window.MUSIC.setOn === 'function') {
        window.MUSIC.setOn(!muted);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  function ensure() {
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AC) return false;
    if (!ctx) {
      ctx = new AC();
      master = ctx.createGain();
      comp = ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();   // tame overlapping peaks
      comp.threshold.value = -10;
      comp.knee.value = 18;
      comp.ratio.value = 4;
      comp.attack.value = 0.003;
      comp.release.value = 0.25;
      sfxBus = ctx.createGain();
      sfxBus.gain.value = 1;
      sfxBus.connect(master);
      master.connect(comp);
      comp.connect(ctx.destination);
      applyMaster();
    }
    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
    return true;
  }

  function setVolume(v) {
    volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
    if (volume <= 0) muted = true;
    else muted = false;
    applyMaster();
    syncMusic();
    saveSettings();
    updateUi();
  }

  function setMuted(m) {
    muted = m;
    applyMaster();
    syncMusic();
    saveSettings();
    updateUi();
  }

  function toggleMute() {
    setMuted(!muted);
  }

  function cycleVolume() {
    if (muted || volume <= 0.01) {
      muted = false;
      volume = 1;
    } else if (volume > 0.6) {
      volume = 0.5;
    } else {
      muted = true;
    }
    applyMaster();
    syncMusic();
    saveSettings();
    updateUi();
  }

  function syncVolumeSlider() {
    const slider = document.getElementById('audio-volume');
    if (!slider) return;
    slider.value = String(Math.round(volume * 100));
    slider.disabled = false;
  }

  function updateUi() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('sfx-btn');
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.textContent = muted ? '\u{1F507}' : (volume < 0.99 ? '\u{1F509}' : '\u{1F50A}');
    btn.title = muted
      ? '\u97F3\u6548\uFF1A\u9759\u97F3\uFF08\u70B9\u51FB\u6062\u590D \u00b7 \u62D6\u52A8\u6ED1\u5757\u8C03\u8282\uFF09'
      : `\u97F3\u6548\uFF1A${Math.round(volume * 100)}%\uFF08\u70B9\u51FB\u9759\u97F3 \u00b7 \u62D6\u52A8\u6ED1\u5757\u8C03\u8282\uFF09`;
    btn.classList.toggle('muted', muted);
    syncVolumeSlider();
  }

  // Interactive controls that should give a faint hover blip.
  const HOVER_SEL = 'button, .c6-btn, .c5-lcard, .map-node.clickable, .map-dev-btn,' +
    ' #v-btn, #map-btn, #map-close, #c3-start-btn, #c3-activate-btn, #c4-discharge-btn,' +
    ' [id^="sum"][id$="-close"], #ch8-sum-close';

  function initUi() {
    // Delegated hover feedback across all interactive controls.
    document.addEventListener('pointerover', (e) => {
      if (muted) return;
      const t = e.target;
      if (t && t.closest && t.closest(HOVER_SEL)) tick('uiHover', 80);
    }, true);

    const btn = document.getElementById('sfx-btn');
    const slider = document.getElementById('audio-volume');
    if (slider) {
      slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
        ensure();
        const v = parseInt(slider.value, 10) / 100;
        volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
        if (volume > 0) muted = false;
        else muted = true;
        applyMaster();
        syncMusic();
        saveSettings();
        updateUi();
      });
      slider.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
    }
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      ensure();
      if (e.shiftKey) cycleVolume();
      else toggleMute();
    });
    updateUi();
  }

  function t0() { return ctx ? ctx.currentTime : 0; }

  // ── Core synth primitive ────────────────────────────────
  // opts: { type, freq, freqEnd, gain, attack, dur, delay, detune,
  //         filter:{type,freq,q} }
  function voice(opts) {
    if (!ensure() || muted) return;
    const o = opts || {};
    const start = t0() + (o.delay || 0);
    const gain = o.gain != null ? o.gain : 0.05;
    const attack = o.attack != null ? o.attack : 0.008;
    const dur = o.dur != null ? o.dur : 0.2;
    const f0 = o.freq || 440;
    const f1 = o.freqEnd != null ? o.freqEnd : f0;

    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    osc.type = o.type || 'sine';
    if (o.detune) osc.detune.value = o.detune;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0, start);
    if (f1 !== f0) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(1, f1), start + dur);

    const g = ctx.createGain();
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, start);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.0002, gain), start + attack);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, start + dur);

    if (o.filter) {
      const flt = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      flt.type = o.filter.type || 'lowpass';
      flt.frequency.value = o.filter.freq || 1200;
      if (o.filter.q != null) flt.Q.value = o.filter.q;
      osc.connect(flt);
      flt.connect(g);
    } else {
      osc.connect(g);
    }
    g.connect(sfxBus);
    osc.start(start);
    osc.stop(start + dur + 0.03);
  }

  // Soft chord/pad of stacked voices with optional spread + detune.
  function chord(freqs, opts) {
    const o = opts || {};
    const n = freqs.length;
    freqs.forEach((f, i) => voice({
      type: o.type || 'sine',
      freq: f,
      gain: o.gain != null ? o.gain : 0.05,
      attack: o.attack != null ? o.attack : 0.01,
      dur: o.dur != null ? o.dur : 0.4,
      delay: (o.spread || 0) * i,
      detune: (i - (n - 1) / 2) * (o.detune || 0),
      filter: o.filter ? { type: 'lowpass', freq: o.filter } : null,
    }));
  }

  // Short, lightly filtered plucked note (ticks / keys / gears).
  function pluck(freq, opts) {
    const o = opts || {};
    const gain = o.gain != null ? o.gain : 0.05;
    const dur = o.dur != null ? o.dur : 0.08;
    voice({
      type: o.type || 'triangle',
      freq, gain, attack: 0.003, dur,
      filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: o.filter || 2200 },
    });
    if (o.harmonic) {
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: freq * 2, gain: gain * 0.4, attack: 0.003, dur: dur * 0.7 });
    }
  }

  // Cheap reverb-ish tail: a few decaying, low-passed echoes.
  function tail(freq, gain, dur) {
    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
      voice({
        type: 'sine', freq,
        gain: gain * Math.pow(0.5, i),
        attack: 0.01, dur,
        delay: i * 0.11,
        filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1600 },
      });
    }
  }

  // Filtered noise burst. opts: { q, curve, tame, filterType, smooth }
  // The raw signal is a one-pole-smoothed noise (softer "air" rather than
  // harsh static) with a non-linear decay and a soft attack to kill clicks;
  // a fixed lowpass ("tame") shaves the fizz off the top end.
  function noiseBurst(gain, dur, filterFreq, opts) {
    if (!ensure() || muted) return;
    const o = opts || {};
    const start = t0();
    const len = Math.ceil(ctx.sampleRate * dur);
    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, len, ctx.sampleRate);
    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
    const smooth = o.smooth != null ? o.smooth : 0.4; // 1 = white, →0 = darker
    const curve = o.curve != null ? o.curve : 2;      // higher = faster, softer tail
    let prev = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
      prev += smooth * ((Math.random() * 2 - 1) - prev);
      d[i] = prev * Math.pow(1 - i / len, curve);
    }
    const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = buf;
    const g = ctx.createGain();
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, start);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.0002, gain), start + 0.006); // soft attack
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, start + dur);
    let node = src;
    if (filterFreq) {
      const flt = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      flt.type = o.filterType || 'bandpass';
      flt.frequency.value = filterFreq;
      flt.Q.value = o.q != null ? o.q : 0.7;
      node.connect(flt);
      node = flt;
    }
    const tame = ctx.createBiquadFilter();   // gentle high cut → no grit/fizz
    tame.type = 'lowpass';
    tame.frequency.value = o.tame || 3000;
    tame.Q.value = 0.5;
    node.connect(tame);
    tame.connect(g);
    g.connect(sfxBus);
    src.start(start);
  }

  // Legacy single-tone helper (kept for compatibility), now softened
  // with a short attack + lowpass and routed through the SFX bus.
  function tone(type, freq, gain, dur) {
    voice({ type, freq, gain, attack: 0.006, dur, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: Math.min(6000, freq * 5 + 600) } });
  }

  function arpeggio(freqs, gain, step) {
    freqs.forEach((f, i) => voice({
      type: 'triangle', freq: f, gain,
      attack: 0.006, dur: step * 1.7, delay: i * step,
      filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: Math.min(5000, f * 4) },
    }));
  }

  // tiny random detune (cents) so repeated ticks don't feel mechanical
  function jit(c) { return (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (c || 6); }

  const PRESETS = {
    // ── UI ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    uiClick: () => pluck(330, { gain: 0.06, dur: 0.07, filter: 1500, harmonic: true }),
    uiHover: () => voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 900, gain: 0.016, attack: 0.004, dur: 0.05,
                           filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 2600 } }),
    uiOpen: () => {
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 520, gain: 0.05, dur: 0.1, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1900 } });
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 780, gain: 0.04, dur: 0.13, delay: 0.05, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 2300 } });
    },
    uiClose: () => {
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 660, gain: 0.045, dur: 0.1, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 2000 } });
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 420, gain: 0.04, dur: 0.13, delay: 0.05, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1500 } });
    },
    dlgAdvance: () => pluck(560, { gain: 0.038, dur: 0.06, filter: 1900 }),

    // ── Win / transitions ────────────────────────────────
    winFanfare: () => {
      arpeggio([261.63, 329.63, 392, 523.25], 0.07, 0.12);
      tail(523.25, 0.05, 0.5);
    },
    chapterTransition: () => {
      voice({ type: 'sawtooth', freq: 90, freqEnd: 60, gain: 0.05, dur: 0.45, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 600 } });
      chord([110, 164.81, 220], { type: 'triangle', gain: 0.03, dur: 0.6, detune: 5 });
    },

    // ── Sliders / ticks ──────────────────────────────────
    sliderTick: () => voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 760, detune: jit(), gain: 0.024, attack: 0.002, dur: 0.03,
                              filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 3000 } }),
    sliderEdge: () => pluck(440, { gain: 0.05, dur: 0.09, filter: 1400, harmonic: true }),
    errorBuzz: () => {
      // soft low "no" — a muffled minor-second wobble instead of a raw saw rasp
      voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 174.61, freqEnd: 146.83, gain: 0.055, dur: 0.18, detune: -6, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 620 } });
      voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 185, freqEnd: 155.56, gain: 0.04, dur: 0.18, detune: 7, delay: 0.015, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 560 } });
    },
    breakdownZap: () => {
      // capacitor breakdown — a tamed crackle plus a pitched discharge "tzap"
      noiseBurst(0.06, 0.08, 2000, { q: 1.3, tame: 2600 });
      voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 1400, freqEnd: 320, gain: 0.05, dur: 0.09, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 2200 } });
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 660, gain: 0.03, dur: 0.13, delay: 0.02, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1300 } });
    },
    bandEnter: () => { voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 640, gain: 0.06, dur: 0.14 }); tail(640, 0.03, 0.3); },
    puzzleComplete: () => { arpeggio([523.25, 659.25, 783.99], 0.06, 0.09); tail(783.99, 0.04, 0.4); },

    // ── Chapter 3 ────────────────────────────────────────
    ch3ChargeStart: () => voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 220, freqEnd: 340, gain: 0.06, dur: 0.25, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1200 } }),
    ch3ActivateOk: () => { arpeggio([440, 554, 660], 0.06, 0.08); tail(660, 0.035, 0.35); },
    ch3ActivateFail: () => {
      voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 200, freqEnd: 120, gain: 0.06, dur: 0.22, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 760 } });
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 100, freqEnd: 70, gain: 0.035, dur: 0.24, delay: 0.02, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 480 } });
    },
    ch3Awaken: () => { chord([110, 138.59, 164.81, 220], { type: 'sine', gain: 0.04, dur: 0.55, spread: 0.05, detune: 4 }); },

    // ── Chapter 4 ────────────────────────────────────────
    ch4RunePulse: () => voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 380, gain: 0.05, dur: 0.12, filter: { type: 'bandpass', freq: 760, q: 2 } }),
    ch4DoorOpen: () => { arpeggio([220, 277, 330, 440], 0.06, 0.1); tail(440, 0.04, 0.45); },

    // ── Chapter 5 ────────────────────────────────────────
    ch5CalLocked: () => { voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 500, gain: 0.06, dur: 0.22 }); tail(500, 0.03, 0.3); },
    ch5Handshake: () => arpeggio([392, 494, 587], 0.05, 0.07),
    ch5TrackLocked: () => pluck(720, { gain: 0.045, dur: 0.09, filter: 2600, harmonic: true }),
    ch5TrackLost: () => voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 320, freqEnd: 220, gain: 0.05, dur: 0.16, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 900 } }),

  };

  // ══ Background music ════════════════════════════════════
  // The adaptive BGM (per-chapter melody, harmony, pad bed) is now
  // owned by the standalone engine in music.js (window.MUSIC). The old
  // ambient-pad layer that used to live here was removed so the two
  // music beds never play on top of each other and bleed between
  // chapters. scene()/stopScene() stay as no-ops so the existing
  // per-chapter calls (registry, prologue, victory) keep working.
  function scene() {}
  function stopScene() {}

  function play(preset) {
    if (muted) return;
    const fn = PRESETS[preset];
    if (fn) fn();
  }

  function tick(preset, ms) {
    if (muted) return;
    const interval = ms != null ? ms : TICK_MS;
    const now = performance.now();
    if (tickLast[preset] && now - tickLast[preset] < interval) return;
    tickLast[preset] = now;
    play(preset);
  }

  function edge(key, cond, preset) {
    if (!window._sfxEdge) window._sfxEdge = {};
    const prev = window._sfxEdge[key];
    window._sfxEdge[key] = !!cond;
    if (cond && !prev) play(preset);
    return !!cond;
  }

  function bindGestureUnlock() {
    const unlock = () => {
      ensure();
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', unlock, true);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', unlock, true);
    };
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', unlock, true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', unlock, true);
  }

  window.SFX = {
    ensure,
    play,
    tick,
    edge,
    scene,
    stopScene,
    setVolume,
    setMuted,
    toggleMute,
    cycleVolume,
    loadSettings,
    saveSettings,
    get muted() { return muted; },
    get volume() { return volume; },
  };

  loadSettings();
  bindGestureUnlock();
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initUi);
  } else {
    initUi();
  }
})();

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Local progress persistence (localStorage)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
const PROGRESS_KEY = 'nus-capacitor-era-v1';

function saveGameProgress() {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(PROGRESS_KEY, JSON.stringify({
      v: 1,
      completed: [...completedChapters].sort((a, b) => a - b),
      chapter: Game.ch,
      devUnlocked: !!devUnlocked,
    }));
  } catch (_) { /* quota / private browsing */ }
}

function loadGameProgress() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(PROGRESS_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const data = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!data || data.v !== 1 || !Array.isArray(data.completed)) return null;
    return data;
  } catch (_) {
    return null;
  }
}

function applyGameProgress(data) {
  if (!data) return;
  completedChapters.clear();
  for (const i of data.completed) {
    if (Number.isInteger(i) && i >= 0 && i < UNLOCKED_CH) completedChapters.add(i);
  }
  devUnlocked = !!data.devUnlocked;
}

function getProgressResumeChapter(data) {
  const n = data.chapter;
  if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 0 || n >= UNLOCKED_CH) return 0;
  return n;
}

function markChapterComplete(idx) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(idx) || idx < 0 || idx >= UNLOCKED_CH) return;
  completedChapters.add(idx);
  saveGameProgress();
}

function resetGameProgress() {
  if (!confirm('确定要重置所有进度吗？\n已完成的章节记录将被清除，将回到序章。')) return;
  try { localStorage.removeItem(PROGRESS_KEY); } catch (_) {}
  completedChapters.clear();
  devUnlocked = false;
  closeMap();
  Game.jumpTo(0);
}

<script>
/* ===== js/core/canvas-world.js ===== */
// ── City ─────────────────────────────────────
let buildings = [];
function genCity() {
  buildings = []; let sx = 0x2A3F91;
  function r() { sx^=sx<<13; sx^=sx>>17; sx^=sx<<5; return (sx>>>0)/4294967296; }
  let x = 0; const gY = typeof getCityGroundY === 'function' ? getCityGroundY() : H * 0.58;
  const towerXs = TOWER_FX.map(fx => fx * W);
  const CLEAR = 62, NEAR = 170; // px: clear zone / near-tower influence zone
  while (x < W + 10) {
    const w=30+r()*54, h=65+r()*(H*0.33);
    const bCx = x + w/2;
    // Skip buildings that would overlap a tower silhouette
    if (!towerXs.some(tx => Math.abs(bCx - tx) < CLEAR)) {
      const fc=Math.max(2,Math.floor(h/22)), cc=Math.max(1,Math.floor(w/14));
      const wins=[];
      for(let f=0;f<fc;f++) for(let c=0;c<cc;c++) wins.push({f,c,lit:r()>0.42});
      const nearTower = towerXs.some(tx => Math.abs(bCx - tx) < NEAR);
      buildings.push({x,w,h,fc,cc,wins,nearTower});
    }
    x+=w+3+r()*8;
  }
}
function drawCity() {
  const gY = typeof getCityGroundY === 'function' ? getCityGroundY() : H * 0.58;
  for (const b of buildings) {
    const top = gY - b.h;
    ctx.fillStyle='#0c0c1e'; ctx.fillRect(b.x,top,b.w,b.h);
    ctx.fillStyle='#181830'; ctx.fillRect(b.x,top,b.w,2);
    // Buildings near towers lose power when breakdown danger rises
    const bMult = (ch===1 && b.nearTower && phase!=='win')
      ? Math.max(0.08, 1 - dangerPulse * 0.94) : 1.0;
    const ww=Math.max(3,(b.w/b.cc)*0.44), wh=4;
    for (const win of b.wins) {
      const wx=b.x+(win.c+0.28)*(b.w/b.cc), wy=top+10+win.f*((b.h-12)/b.fc);
      const br=Math.max(CITY_BRIGHT_MIN*0.55,cityBright)*bMult*(win.lit?1.0:CITY_WIN_UNLIT);
      if(br<0.01) continue;
      if(win.lit&&br>0.25){ctx.shadowColor=`rgba(255,200,80,${br*0.55})`;ctx.shadowBlur=5;}
      ctx.fillStyle=win.lit?`rgba(255,${Math.floor(215*br)},${Math.floor(70*br)},${br})`:`rgba(${Math.floor(90*br)},${Math.floor(70*br)},${Math.floor(50*br)},${br})`;
      ctx.fillRect(wx,wy,ww,wh); ctx.shadowBlur=0;
    }
  }
}

// ── Signal towers (ch1) ──────────────────────
const TOWER_FX = [0.20, 0.62, 0.85];
function drawTowers() {
  if (ch !== 1) return;
  const gY = typeof getCityGroundY === 'function' ? getCityGroundY() : H * 0.58;
  const bd = broken();
  const isWin = phase === 'win';

  for (let ti=0; ti<TOWER_FX.length; ti++) {
    const tx = TOWER_FX[ti] * W;
    const tH = 130 + ti * 40;
    const tW = 9;

    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111128'; ctx.fillRect(tx-tW/2, gY-tH, tW, tH);
    // Cross struts
    for (let k=0.3; k<1; k+=0.28) {
      ctx.fillStyle='#1a1a32'; ctx.fillRect(tx-tW*1.5, gY-tH*k-2, tW*3, 2);
    }
    // Antenna
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx,gY-tH-40); ctx.lineTo(tx-2,gY-tH); ctx.lineTo(tx+2,gY-tH); ctx.fillStyle='#20203a'; ctx.fill();

    if (isWin) {
      // Blue glow on victory
      const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(tick*0.05+ti*2);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, gY-tH-40, 4+pulse*2, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(0,200,255,${0.6+pulse*0.4})`; ctx.shadowColor='rgba(0,200,255,0.9)'; ctx.shadowBlur=16; ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur=0;
      // Ring pulse
      const ring = (tick*0.8+ti*60) % 120;
      const rAlpha = Math.max(0, 1-ring/120)*0.5;
      if (rAlpha>0.02){
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, gY-tH-40, ring*0.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(0,200,255,${rAlpha})`; ctx.lineWidth=1.5; ctx.stroke();
      }
    } else {
      // Red warning blink
      const blink = Math.sin(tick*0.08+ti*2.1) > 0;
      if (blink) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, gY-tH-40, 3, 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,50,50,0.9)'; ctx.shadowColor='rgba(255,40,40,0.8)'; ctx.shadowBlur=10; ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur=0;
      }
      // Sparks when dangerous
      if (bd && Math.random()<0.12) {
        const sx=tx+(Math.random()-.5)*20, sy=gY-tH-30+Math.random()*20;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx,sy); ctx.lineTo(sx+(Math.random()-.5)*18,sy+(Math.random()-.5)*18);
        ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,160,50,${Math.random()*0.8})`; ctx.lineWidth=0.8;
        ctx.shadowColor='rgba(255,100,20,0.6)'; ctx.shadowBlur=5; ctx.stroke(); ctx.shadowBlur=0;
      }
    }
  }
}

// ── Lightning ────────────────────────────────
let bolts=[], boltT=40;
function spawnBolt() {
  const x0=W*0.08+Math.random()*W*0.84, segs=[]; let cx=x0,cy=-5;
  const boltLimit = (typeof getCityGroundY === 'function' ? getCityGroundY() : H * 0.58) - H * 0.02;
  while(cy<boltLimit){const nx=cx+(Math.random()-.5)*62,ny=cy+22+Math.random()*45;segs.push([cx,cy,nx,ny]);cx=nx;cy=ny;}
  const intensity=0.6+stormIntensity*0.4;
  bolts.push({segs,life:(12+Math.random()*16)*intensity});

  ctx.fillStyle = pad;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(g.cx, padY, g.pw * 0.6, 9 + I * 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  // Soft backglow halo behind the plates
  const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(g.cx, g.cy, 8, g.cx, g.cy, g.pw * 0.78);
  halo.addColorStop(0, `rgba(180,120,40,${0.06 + I * 0.16})`);
  halo.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = halo;
  ctx.fillRect(g.gx - 45, g.topY - 34, g.pw + 90, (g.botY + g.ph) - g.topY + 68);
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawCh0HoloFront(g, I) {
  const t = tick;
  ctx.save();
  // Scan sweep gliding down through the gap
  if (I > 0.03) {
    const sy = g.gy + ((t * 0.9) % g.gh);
    const sg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, sy - 6, 0, sy + 6);
    sg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,220,255,0)');
    sg.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(240,200,120,${0.22 + I * 0.42})`);
    sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,220,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = sg; ctx.fillRect(g.gx, sy - 6, g.gw, 12);
  }
  // HUD corner brackets framing the device
  const pad = 18, L = 16;
  const x0 = g.gx - pad, y0 = g.topY - pad, x1 = g.gx + g.pw + pad, y1 = g.botY + g.ph + pad;
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(224,144,48,${0.28 + I * 0.26})`; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(224,144,48,0.4)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 5;
  for (const [x, y, sx, sy] of [[x0, y0, 1, 1], [x1, y0, -1, 1], [x0, y1, 1, -1], [x1, y1, -1, -1]]) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + sx * L, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y + sy * L); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.restore();
}

// ── Ring capacitor (ch1) ────────────────────
function geomRing() {
  const cx=W/2;
  const nA=Math.min(1,areaCm2/300), nD=distMm/10;
  let R=82+nA*78;
  const gap=14+nD*40;
  const ptk=10;
  const hudPad=28, labelDrop=28;
  const minR=28;
  let cy=H*0.40;

  if (typeof getCapPlayfield === 'function') {
    const pf=getCapPlayfield();
    const chromeTop=typeof getTopChromeInset==='function'?getTopChromeInset():52;
    const ringSafeTop=Math.min(pf.safeTop, chromeTop+16);
    const availH=Math.max(80, pf.safeBottom-ringSafeTop);
    const maxRForHeight=(availH-hudPad-labelDrop)/2;
    R=Math.min(R, Math.max(minR, maxRForHeight));
    while (R>minR) {
      const minCy=ringSafeTop+R+hudPad;
      const maxCy=pf.safeBottom-R-labelDrop;
      if (minCy<=maxCy) {
        const band=Math.max(0, availH-(R+hudPad)-(R+labelDrop));
        cy=ringSafeTop+R+hudPad+band*0.45;
        cy=Math.min(maxCy, Math.max(minCy, cy));
        break;
      }
      R-=2;
    }
    if (R<=minR) {
      R=Math.max(minR, maxRForHeight);
      cy=(ringSafeTop+pf.safeBottom)/2;
    }
  }

  const r2=Math.max(20, R-ptk-gap);
  const r1=Math.max(8, r2-Math.max(12, r2*0.32));
  return { cx, cy, R, r2, r1, gap, ptk };
}

function drawRingCapacitor() {
  const m=mat(), er=m.er;
  const C=calcC(areaCm2,distMm,er), tgt=TARGETS[ch];
  const I=Math.min(1,C/tgt), bd=broken();
  const g=geomRing();
  const rOut=g.R-g.ptk, rIn=g.r2;
  const SEG=10, SGAP=0.030;

  ctx.save();
  const t=performance.now()/1000;

  // Backplate glow disc — breathing halo behind the device
  drawRingBackglow(g, I, bd, t);
  // HUD tick + rotating scan ring around the outside
  drawRingHud(g, I, bd, t);

  // Dielectric — N trapezoidal annular segments
  const fills={
    air:    bd?'rgba(40,8,4,0.62)':'rgba(140,170,210,0.14)',
    paper:  'rgba(215,183,84,0.50)',
    glass:  'rgba(118,208,252,0.46)',
    ceramic:'rgba(240,152,58,0.50)',
    mica:   'rgba(168,105,242,0.50)',
  };
  for(let i=0;i<SEG;i++){
    const a0=(i/SEG)*Math.PI*2+SGAP, a1=((i+1)/SEG)*Math.PI*2-SGAP;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rOut,a0,a1);
    ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rIn,a1,a0,true);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle=fills[m.id]||'rgba(150,150,150,0.35)';
    ctx.fill();
    // Material texture overlays per id
    if(m.id==='glass'){
      ctx.save(); ctx.clip();
      const aMid=(a0+a1)/2, sx=g.cx+Math.cos(aMid)*rOut, sy=g.cy+Math.sin(aMid)*rOut;
      const ex=g.cx+Math.cos(aMid)*rIn, ey=g.cy+Math.sin(aMid)*rIn;
      const sg=ctx.createLinearGradient(sx,sy,ex,ey);
      sg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(205,242,255,0.30)'); sg.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
      ctx.fillStyle=sg; ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    } else if(m.id==='ceramic'){
      ctx.save(); ctx.clip();
      for(let k=0;k<6;k++){
        const aa=a0+(a1-a0)*(0.15+k*0.14), rr=rIn+(rOut-rIn)*((k*0.17+0.10)%1);
        ctx.fillStyle='rgba(195,112,22,0.28)';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx+Math.cos(aa)*rr,g.cy+Math.sin(aa)*rr,1.6,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    } else if(m.id==='mica'){
      ctx.save(); ctx.clip();
      for(let k=1;k<5;k++){
        const rr=rIn+(rOut-rIn)*(k/5);
        ctx.strokeStyle=k%2===0?'rgba(222,182,255,0.32)':'rgba(188,124,255,0.40)';
        ctx.lineWidth=1.2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rr,a0,a1); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    } else if(m.id==='paper'){
      ctx.save(); ctx.clip();
      for(let k=1;k<4;k++){
        const rr=rIn+(rOut-rIn)*(k/4);
        ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(172,138,42,0.42)'; ctx.lineWidth=0.7;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rr,a0,a1); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
    // Segment outline
    ctx.strokeStyle=bd?`rgba(255,100,40,${.45+I*.3})`:`rgba(120,180,255,${.22+I*.30})`;
    ctx.lineWidth=0.9;
    if(I>0.06 && !bd){ ctx.shadowColor=m.dot; ctx.shadowBlur=Math.min(10,I*12); }
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  }

  // Radial field arrows (outer → inner)
  if(!bd && I>0.04){
    const n=Math.max(8,Math.floor(8+I*14)); ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(0,188,255,${.18+I*.50})`; ctx.lineWidth=.8+I*.4;
    ctx.shadowColor='rgba(0,200,255,0.25)'; ctx.shadowBlur=5;
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const a=(i+0.5)/n*Math.PI*2;
      const x0=g.cx+Math.cos(a)*rOut, y0=g.cy+Math.sin(a)*rOut;
      const x1=g.cx+Math.cos(a)*rIn,  y1=g.cy+Math.sin(a)*rIn;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0,y0); ctx.lineTo(x1,y1); ctx.stroke();
      // Arrowhead midway
      const mx=g.cx+Math.cos(a)*((rOut+rIn)/2), my=g.cy+Math.sin(a)*((rOut+rIn)/2);
      const dx=Math.cos(a), dy=Math.sin(a);
      const px=-dy, py=dx;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(mx+dx*3, my+dy*3);
      ctx.lineTo(mx+px*3, my+py*3);
      ctx.lineTo(mx-px*3, my-py*3);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(0,188,255,${.30+I*.50})`; ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Breakdown arcs (radial zigzags)
  if(bd) drawRingBreakdownArcs(g, rOut, rIn);

  // Outer electrode (metallic ring with shadow glow)
  function drawRing(rO, rI, glow, accent){
    ctx.save();
    // Brushed-metal body
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rO,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rI,0,Math.PI*2,true); ctx.closePath();
    const grad=ctx.createRadialGradient(g.cx-rO*0.4,g.cy-rO*0.4,rI*0.5,g.cx,g.cy,rO);
    grad.addColorStop(0,'#d2e0ef'); grad.addColorStop(0.42,'#90a0b2');
    grad.addColorStop(0.72,'#5d6d80'); grad.addColorStop(1,'#374556');
    ctx.fillStyle=grad; ctx.shadowColor=glow; ctx.shadowBlur=18; ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;
    // Rotating specular sweep across the metal
    ctx.save(); ctx.clip();
    const aS=t*0.7;
    const sg=ctx.createLinearGradient(g.cx+Math.cos(aS)*rO,g.cy+Math.sin(aS)*rO,g.cx-Math.cos(aS)*rO,g.cy-Math.sin(aS)*rO);
    sg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); sg.addColorStop(0.46,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    sg.addColorStop(0.5,'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); sg.addColorStop(0.54,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    sg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle=sg; ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    // Neon rims pick up the charge color
    ctx.lineWidth=1.4; ctx.strokeStyle=accent; ctx.shadowColor=accent; ctx.shadowBlur=8;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rO-0.7,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rI+0.7,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;
    // Mid hairline groove
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(235,245,255,0.28)'; ctx.lineWidth=0.6;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,(rO+rI)/2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  drawRing(g.R, g.R-g.ptk, bd?'rgba(255,90,50,0.6)':`rgba(255,75,75,${.22+I*.36})`,
           bd?'rgba(255,125,70,0.85)':`rgba(255,115,125,${.42+I*.45})`);
  drawRing(g.r2, g.r1,     bd?'rgba(255,90,50,0.6)':`rgba(75,135,255,${.22+I*.36})`,
           bd?'rgba(255,125,70,0.85)':`rgba(110,180,255,${.42+I*.45})`);

  // Charge symbols on each ring
  const SC=Math.max(8, Math.floor(g.R/12));
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle'; ctx.font='bold 10px monospace';
  for(let i=0;i<SC;i++){
    const a=(i+0.5)/SC*Math.PI*2;
    const oR=g.R-g.ptk*0.5;
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,100,100,${.40+I*.55})`;
    ctx.fillText('+', g.cx+Math.cos(a)*oR, g.cy+Math.sin(a)*oR);
    const iR=(g.r2+g.r1)/2;
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(120,140,255,${.40+I*.55})`;
    ctx.fillText('−', g.cx+Math.cos(a)*iR, g.cy+Math.sin(a)*iR);
  }
  ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';

  // Tech hub — concentric crosshair inside the center hole
  drawRingHub(g, I, bd, t);

  // Burn sparks during breakdown
  if(bd){
    if(Math.random()<0.30){
      const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
      const r=rIn+Math.random()*(rOut-rIn);
      sparks.push({x:g.cx+Math.cos(a)*r, y:g.cy+Math.sin(a)*r, life:8+Math.random()*8});
    }
    for(let i=sparks.length-1;i>=0;i--) if(--sparks[i].life<=0) sparks.splice(i,1);
    drawSparks();
  }

  // Dimension labels
  ctx.font='11px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,200,255,0.42)'; ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText(`A = ${areaCm2} cm²`, g.cx-g.R-12, g.cy-6);
  ctx.fillText(`εᵣ = ${m.er}`,        g.cx-g.R-12, g.cy+10);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText(`d = ${distMm.toFixed(1)} mm`, g.cx+g.R+12, g.cy-6);
  const E=(V_APP/(distMm*1e-3)/1e6).toFixed(1);
  ctx.fillStyle=bd?'rgba(255,120,80,0.65)':'rgba(0,200,255,0.42)';
  ctx.fillText(`E = ${E} MV/m`, g.cx+g.R+12, g.cy+10);

  // Material name label at center hole
  if(m.id!=='air'){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.font='bold 12px Courier New'; ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillStyle=bd?'rgba(255,100,40,0.80)':m.dot;
    ctx.shadowColor=m.dot; ctx.shadowBlur=bd?0:7;
    ctx.fillText(m.name, g.cx, g.cy);
    ctx.shadowBlur=0; ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic'; ctx.restore();
  }

  // HUD corner brackets framing the device
  drawRingBrackets(g, I, bd, t);

  // C / breakdown readout below
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.font='bold 14px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle=bd?'rgba(255,110,70,0.90)':`rgba(0,${Math.floor(200+I*29)},255,0.88)`;
  ctx.shadowColor=bd?'rgba(255,60,10,0.55)':'rgba(0,200,255,0.55)'; ctx.shadowBlur=10;
  if (measuredCap == null) ctx.fillText('C 待测', g.cx, g.cy+g.R+24);
  else ctx.fillText(measuredCap.bd?'击穿！':`C = ${measuredCap.C.toFixed(1)} pF`, g.cx, g.cy+g.R+24);
  ctx.shadowBlur=0; ctx.textAlign='left';

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawRingBreakdownArcs(g, rOut, rIn){
  ctx.save();
  // Charred halo over dielectric
  const halo=ctx.createRadialGradient(g.cx,g.cy,rIn,g.cx,g.cy,rOut);
  halo.addColorStop(0,'rgba(40,10,4,0.50)');
  halo.addColorStop(1,'rgba(80,18,4,0.18)');
  ctx.fillStyle=halo;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rOut,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rIn,0,Math.PI*2,true); ctx.fill();

  const nb=2+Math.floor(Math.random()*2);
  for(let k=0;k<nb;k++){
    const baseA=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    const steps=6+Math.floor(Math.random()*3);
    const pts=[];
    for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
      const t=i/steps;
      const r=rOut-(rOut-rIn)*t;
      const aJ=baseA+(Math.random()-0.5)*0.22;
      pts.push([g.cx+Math.cos(aJ)*r, g.cy+Math.sin(aJ)*r]);
    }
    function drawBolt(w, col, blur){
      ctx.lineJoin='round'; ctx.lineCap='round';
      ctx.strokeStyle=col; ctx.lineWidth=w;
      ctx.shadowColor='rgba(255,120,30,0.70)'; ctx.shadowBlur=blur;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
      for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    drawBolt(3.2,'rgba(255,155,35,0.55)',13);
    drawBolt(1.6,'rgba(255,215,90,0.90)',5);
    drawBolt(0.7,'rgba(255,252,230,1.0)',3);
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;
    // Impact flashes
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,215,140,0.55)';
    ctx.shadowColor='rgba(255,190,40,0.9)'; ctx.shadowBlur=14;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pts[0][0],pts[0][1],4,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pts[pts.length-1][0],pts[pts.length-1][1],3.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

// ── Ring capacitor sci-fi HUD layers ─────────
function drawRingBackglow(g, I, bd, t){
  ctx.save();
  const pulse=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(t*1.6);
  const rad=g.R*(1.7+0.06*pulse);
  const gl=ctx.createRadialGradient(g.cx,g.cy,g.r1*0.4,g.cx,g.cy,rad);
  if(bd){
    gl.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,90,30,${0.20+0.06*pulse})`);
    gl.addColorStop(0.5,'rgba(150,30,10,0.10)');
    gl.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  } else {
    const a=0.10+I*0.22;
    gl.addColorStop(0,`rgba(40,150,255,${a*(0.7+0.3*pulse)})`);
    gl.addColorStop(0.55,`rgba(20,90,200,${a*0.4})`);
    gl.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  }
  ctx.fillStyle=gl;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rad,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawRingHud(g, I, bd, t){
  ctx.save();
  const base=bd?'rgba(255,120,70,':'rgba(0,200,255,';
  const rT=g.R+10;                 // tick ring radius
  const N=72;
  // Static tick ring
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const a=(i/N)*Math.PI*2;
    const major=i%6===0;
    const len=major?7:3;
    const r0=rT, r1=rT+len;
    ctx.strokeStyle=base+(major?(0.30+I*0.25):(0.14+I*0.12))+')';
    ctx.lineWidth=major?1.3:0.8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(g.cx+Math.cos(a)*r0, g.cy+Math.sin(a)*r0);
    ctx.lineTo(g.cx+Math.cos(a)*r1, g.cy+Math.sin(a)*r1);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // Thin guide circle
  ctx.strokeStyle=base+(0.16+I*0.14)+')'; ctx.lineWidth=0.8;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rT,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  // Rotating dashed orbit ring (outside ticks)
  const rO=rT+13;
  ctx.setLineDash([14,12]); ctx.lineDashOffset=-t*22;
  ctx.strokeStyle=base+(0.22+I*0.30)+')';
  ctx.lineWidth=1.4; ctx.shadowColor=base+'0.5)'; ctx.shadowBlur=6;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rO,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]); ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  // Rotating scan sweep — bright arc gliding over the tick ring
  const aSweep=t*0.9%(Math.PI*2);
  ctx.lineWidth=8; ctx.lineCap='round';
  ctx.strokeStyle=base+(0.10+I*0.30)+')'; ctx.shadowColor=base+'0.55)'; ctx.shadowBlur=12;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rT+3,aSweep,aSweep+0.5); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0; ctx.lineCap='butt';
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawRingHub(g, I, bd, t){
  if(g.r1<14) return;
  ctx.save();
  const base=bd?'rgba(255,120,70,':'rgba(0,200,255,';
  const rh=g.r1*0.72;
  // Soft hub glow
  const gl=ctx.createRadialGradient(g.cx,g.cy,0,g.cx,g.cy,rh);
  gl.addColorStop(0,base+(0.18+I*0.25)+')'); gl.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=gl; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rh,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // Counter-rotating dashed ring
  ctx.setLineDash([6,7]); ctx.lineDashOffset=t*16;
  ctx.strokeStyle=base+(0.30+I*0.30)+')'; ctx.lineWidth=1.1;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,rh*0.78,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  // Crosshair
  ctx.strokeStyle=base+(0.28+I*0.28)+')'; ctx.lineWidth=0.9;
  const cl=rh*0.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(g.cx-cl,g.cy); ctx.lineTo(g.cx-cl*0.35,g.cy);
  ctx.moveTo(g.cx+cl*0.35,g.cy); ctx.lineTo(g.cx+cl,g.cy);
  ctx.moveTo(g.cx,g.cy-cl); ctx.lineTo(g.cx,g.cy-cl*0.35);
  ctx.moveTo(g.cx,g.cy+cl*0.35); ctx.lineTo(g.cx,g.cy+cl);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Pulsing core dot
  const pulse=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(t*3.2);
  ctx.fillStyle=base+(0.45+I*0.4*pulse)+')';
  ctx.shadowColor=base+'0.7)'; ctx.shadowBlur=8;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.cx,g.cy,1.6+pulse*1.2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawRingBrackets(g, I, bd, t){
  ctx.save();
  const base=bd?'rgba(255,120,70,':'rgba(0,200,255,';
  const d=g.R+30;                  // bracket half-extent from center
  const L=18;                      // corner arm length
  ctx.strokeStyle=base+(0.28+I*0.22)+')'; ctx.lineWidth=1.4;
  ctx.shadowColor=base+'0.4)'; ctx.shadowBlur=5;
  const corners=[[-1,-1],[1,-1],[-1,1],[1,1]];
  for(const [sx,sy] of corners){
    const x=g.cx+sx*d, y=g.cy+sy*d;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x-sx*L, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y-sy*L);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCh0Lamp() {
  const t = tick;
  const C = calcC(areaCm2, distMm, mat().er);
  const I = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, C / TARGETS[0]));
  const won0 = (phase === 'win');
  const pulse = 0.92 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 0.12);
  const b = won0 ? pulse : I * I;   // I² keeps it dark until close to target
  const lx = W * 0.5, bulbY = H * 0.155, bulbR = 13;

  ctx.save();

  // ── Strong room flood ────────────────────────
  if (b > 0.02) {
    const floodR = Math.max(W, H) * (0.65 + 0.35 * b);
    const flood = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx, bulbY, bulbR, lx, bulbY, floodR);
    flood.addColorStop(0,   `rgba(255,220,145,${0.60 * b})`);
    flood.addColorStop(0.25,`rgba(255,195,95,${0.38 * b})`);
    flood.addColorStop(0.55,`rgba(220,155,55,${0.18 * b})`);
    flood.addColorStop(1,   'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = flood;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  // ── Light rays fanning downward ───────────────
  if (b > 0.12) {
    ctx.save();
    for (let r = 0; r < 7; r++) {
      const angle = Math.PI * 0.5 + (r - 3) * 0.21 + Math.sin(t * 0.015 + r * 1.3) * 0.008;
      const rayLen = H * (0.60 + 0.18 * b);
      const spread = 0.055 + 0.025 * b;
      const rayG = ctx.createLinearGradient(lx, bulbY, lx + Math.cos(angle)*rayLen, bulbY + Math.sin(angle)*rayLen);
      rayG.addColorStop(0,   `rgba(255,235,155,${0.28 * b})`);
      rayG.addColorStop(0.35,`rgba(255,210,110,${0.14 * b})`);
      rayG.addColorStop(1,   'rgba(255,185,70,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = rayG;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(lx, bulbY);
      ctx.lineTo(lx + Math.cos(angle - spread) * rayLen, bulbY + Math.sin(angle - spread) * rayLen);
      ctx.lineTo(lx + Math.cos(angle + spread) * rayLen, bulbY + Math.sin(angle + spread) * rayLen);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ── Elliptical workbench pool directly below ──
  if (b > 0.04) {
    const benchY = H * 0.475;
    const poolR  = W * (0.16 + 0.24 * b);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(lx, benchY);
    ctx.scale(1, 0.28);  // flatten circle → ellipse
    const pg = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 4, 0, 0, poolR);
    pg.addColorStop(0,   `rgba(255,225,145,${0.52 * b})`);
    pg.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(245,190,85,${0.26 * b})`);
    pg.addColorStop(1,   'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = pg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, poolR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ── Hanging cord + socket ────────────────────
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,34,30,0.85)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(lx, 0); ctx.lineTo(lx, bulbY - bulbR - 4); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(35,30,26,0.95)';
  ctx.fillRect(lx - 5, bulbY - bulbR - 7, 10, 7);

  // ── Glass envelope ────────────────────────────
  const glass = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx - bulbR * 0.3, bulbY - bulbR * 0.3, 1, lx, bulbY, bulbR);
  glass.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,${235 - 40*(1-b)|0},${190 - 90*(1-b)|0},${0.30 + 0.55*b})`);
  glass.addColorStop(1, `rgba(120,110,90,${0.18 + 0.20*b})`);
  ctx.fillStyle = glass;
  ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(255,205,115,${0.90 * b})`; ctx.shadowBlur = 6 + 48 * b;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(lx, bulbY, bulbR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // ── Win corona: starburst rays ────────────────
  if (b > 0.45) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(255,235,165,${b * 0.85})`; ctx.shadowBlur = 22 * b;
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,245,190,${0.55 * b})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.0;
    for (let s = 0; s < 10; s++) {
      const sa = (s / 10) * Math.PI * 2 + t * 0.006;
      const sl = bulbR * (1.2 + 0.8 * (s % 2));
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(lx + Math.cos(sa) * (bulbR * 0.8), bulbY + Math.sin(sa) * (bulbR * 0.8));
      ctx.lineTo(lx + Math.cos(sa) * (bulbR + sl),  bulbY + Math.sin(sa) * (bulbR + sl));
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Bulb neck
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(150,140,120,${0.4 + 0.3 * b})`;
  ctx.fillRect(lx - 4, bulbY + bulbR - 3, 8, 5);

  // Filament
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,${(200 + 40*b)|0},${(120 + 60*b)|0},${0.35 + 0.65*b})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.1; ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(255,190,90,${b})`; ctx.shadowBlur = 6 * b;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i <= 12; i++) {
    const fx = lx - 5 + (i / 12) * 10;
    const fy = bulbY + 1 + Math.sin(i * 1.9) * 3.2;
    i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(fx, fy) : ctx.lineTo(fx, fy);
  }
  ctx.stroke(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // Specular glint
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,240,${0.22 + 0.48 * b})`;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(lx - bulbR * 0.35, bulbY - bulbR * 0.4, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

// Atmospheric overlay for ch0 — candle-lit basement workshop.
// Walls, workbench surface, and candle all react to how bright the pendant lamp is.
function drawCh0WorkshopAtmosphere() {
  const t = tick;
  const C = calcC(areaCm2, distMm, mat().er);
  const I = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, C / TARGETS[0]));
  const won0 = (phase === 'win');
  const pulse = 0.92 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 0.12);
  const b = won0 ? pulse : I * I;   // lamp brightness, matches drawCh0Lamp

  // ── Room structure: floor + back wall ─────────
  // Back wall (upper portion of canvas)
  const wallG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H * 0.52);
  wallG.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${18 + b*28|0},${14 + b*18|0},${10 + b*10|0},0.80)`);
  wallG.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${8  + b*12|0},${6  + b*8|0}, ${4  + b*5|0}, 0.65)`);
  ctx.fillStyle = wallG;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H * 0.52);

  // Workbench surface (plank texture under capacitor)
  const benchTop = H * 0.455, benchH = 18;
  const benchG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, benchTop, 0, benchTop + benchH);
  benchG.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${50 + b*80|0},${38 + b*55|0},${25 + b*30|0},0.82)`);
  benchG.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${28 + b*35|0},${20 + b*25|0},${12 + b*14|0},0.75)`);
  ctx.fillStyle = benchG;
  ctx.fillRect(W * 0.08, benchTop, W * 0.84, benchH);
  // Plank edge highlight
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${90+b*80|0},${68+b*55|0},${40+b*30|0},${0.25+b*0.35})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W*0.08, benchTop); ctx.lineTo(W*0.92, benchTop); ctx.stroke();
  // A few plank grain lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(20,14,8,${0.18 + b*0.08})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
  for (let pl = 0; pl < 4; pl++) {
    const px = W * (0.22 + pl * 0.17);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px, benchTop); ctx.lineTo(px, benchTop + benchH); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // ── Side walls with lamp illumination ─────────
  // Left wall slab
  if (b > 0.05) {
    const lwG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, W * 0.18, 0);
    lwG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    lwG.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${200+b*40|0},${145+b*30|0},${70+b*20|0},${0.10 * b})`);
    ctx.fillStyle = lwG;
    ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.04, W * 0.18, H * 0.48);
    // Wall panel lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${160+b*60|0},${110+b*40|0},${55+b*25|0},${0.08*b})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
    for (let wp = 1; wp <= 2; wp++) {
      const wy = H * (0.12 + wp * 0.12);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W*0.02, wy); ctx.lineTo(W*0.17, wy); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  // Right wall slab
  if (b > 0.05) {
    const rwG = ctx.createLinearGradient(W * 0.82, 0, W, 0);
    rwG.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${200+b*40|0},${145+b*30|0},${70+b*20|0},${0.10 * b})`);
    rwG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = rwG;
    ctx.fillRect(W * 0.82, H * 0.04, W * 0.18, H * 0.48);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${160+b*60|0},${110+b*40|0},${55+b*25|0},${0.08*b})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
    for (let wp = 1; wp <= 2; wp++) {
      const wy = H * (0.12 + wp * 0.12);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W*0.83, wy); ctx.lineTo(W*0.98, wy); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // ── Candle in upper-left ──────────────────────
  const flickerT = t * 0.18;
  const flameX = W * 0.10;
  const flameY = H * 0.18 + Math.sin(flickerT * 0.7) * 1.5;
  const flameH = 14 + Math.sin(flickerT) * 1.5;
  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,200,170,0.60)';
  ctx.fillRect(flameX - 3, flameY + flameH + 2, 6, 22);
  // Flame glow
  const fg = ctx.createRadialGradient(flameX, flameY + flameH * 0.6, 0, flameX, flameY + flameH * 0.6, flameH * 2.2);
  fg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,240,180,0.95)');
  fg.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(255,180,80,0.55)');
  fg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,120,40,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = fg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(flameX, flameY + flameH * 0.6, flameH * 0.7, flameH * 1.2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Inner core
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,210,${0.65 + 0.25 * Math.sin(flickerT * 1.3)})`;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(flameX, flameY + flameH * 0.6, flameH * 0.25, flameH * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Candle halo (dims as lamp takes over)
  const candleStr = Math.max(0.04, 0.20 - b * 0.14);
  const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(flameX, flameY + flameH * 0.6, 0, flameX, flameY + flameH * 0.6, 90);
  halo.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,200,120,${candleStr + 0.06 * Math.sin(flickerT)})`);
  halo.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,200,120,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = halo;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(flameX, flameY + flameH * 0.6, 90, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // ── Blueprint / manuscript (upper-right) ──────
  ctx.save();
  const bpAlpha = 0.06 + b * 0.08;  // gets more visible as lamp lights it up
  ctx.globalAlpha = bpAlpha * 1.5;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(140,190,230,1)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
  for (let gx = W * 0.77; gx < W * 0.97; gx += 13) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(gx, H * 0.10); ctx.lineTo(gx, H * 0.26); ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let gy = H * 0.10; gy < H * 0.26; gy += 13) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W * 0.77, gy); ctx.lineTo(W * 0.97, gy); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(180,215,245,1)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W * 0.81, H * 0.13); ctx.lineTo(W * 0.93, H * 0.13);
  ctx.moveTo(W * 0.81, H * 0.20); ctx.lineTo(W * 0.93, H * 0.20);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.globalAlpha = bpAlpha * 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(210,225,240,0.90)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.strokeRect(W * 0.75, H * 0.08, W * 0.23, H * 0.20);
  ctx.restore();

  // ── Dust motes (more visible when lit) ────────
  const dustCount = 8 + (b > 0.5 ? 10 : 0);
  for (let i = 0; i < dustCount; i++) {
    const px = (i * 89 + t * (0.3 + b * 0.2)) % W;
    const py = ((i * 47 + t * (0.12 + b * 0.08)) % (H * 0.40)) + H * 0.04;
    const dustA = (0.15 + 0.28 * Math.sin(t * 0.04 + i * 1.3)) * (0.3 + b * 0.7);
    if (dustA < 0.03) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,${210+b*35|0},${150+b*60|0},${dustA})`;
    ctx.fillRect(px, py, 1.3, 1.3);
  }

  // ── Win: warm vignette overlay on walls ───────
  if (b > 0.6) {
    const vign = ctx.createRadialGradient(W*0.5, H*0.45, H*0.12, W*0.5, H*0.45, H*0.68);
    vign.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    vign.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    vign.addColorStop(1, `rgba(12,6,2,${0.55 * (b - 0.6) / 0.4})`);
    ctx.fillStyle = vign;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
}

const CAP_WIN_HALF = { 0: 0.03, 1: 0.015 };
let _capBandPrev = false;
let _capBdPrev = false;
// 探究较宽；竞赛收紧约一半，同参未必两边同结论
function capHalfBand() {
  const base = CAP_WIN_HALF[ch] ?? 0.03;
  return (_capEraPlayMode === 'challenge') ? base * 0.45 : base;
}

function capWinLo(tgt) { return tgt * (1 - capHalfBand()); }
function capWinHi(tgt) { return tgt * (1 + capHalfBand()); }

function capPuzzleInBand() {
  const C = calcC(areaCm2, distMm, mat().er);
  const tgt = TARGETS[ch];
  return C >= capWinLo(tgt) && C <= capWinHi(tgt);
}

function ch0DistOk()  { return distMm >= CH0_D_MIN; }
function ch0AreaOk() { return areaCm2 <= CH0_A_MAX; }
function ch0ConstraintsOk() { return ch0DistOk() && ch0AreaOk(); }

function ch1DistOk()  { return distMm >= CH1_D_MIN; }
function ch1AreaOk() { return areaCm2 <= CH1_A_MAX; }
function ch1MatOk()  { return matId !== 'air'; }
function ch1ConstraintsOk() { return ch1DistOk() && ch1AreaOk() && ch1MatOk(); }

function capPuzzleOk() {
  if (ch === 0) return capPuzzleInBand() && ch0ConstraintsOk();
  if (ch === 1) return capPuzzleInBand() && ch1ConstraintsOk();
  return capPuzzleInBand();
}

  const midPct = (tgt / max) * 100;
  const inBand = winOk !== undefined ? winOk : (!bd && C >= lo && C <= hi);

  const band = document.getElementById('prog-win-band');
  if (band) {
    band.style.left = loPct + '%';
    band.style.width = (hiPct - loPct) + '%';
    band.classList.toggle('ok', inBand);
  }
  const loMk = document.getElementById('prog-win-lo');
  const hiMk = document.getElementById('prog-win-hi');
  if (loMk) loMk.style.left = loPct + '%';
  if (hiMk) hiMk.style.left = hiPct + '%';
  const tgtMk = document.getElementById('prog-mark');
  if (tgtMk) tgtMk.style.left = midPct + '%';

  const lbl = document.getElementById('prog-mid');
  if (lbl) {
    lbl.textContent = `过关 ${Math.round(lo)}–${Math.round(hi)} pF`;
    lbl.style.color = inBand ? 'rgba(80,255,180,0.65)' : '';
  }

  const fill = document.getElementById('prog');
  if (fill) {
    fill.style.width = bd ? '0%' : Math.min(100, C / max * 100) + '%';
    if (bd) {
      fill.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg,#005f70,#00c8ff)';
      fill.style.boxShadow = '0 0 9px rgba(0,200,255,0.45)';
    } else if (inBand) {
      fill.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg,#3a5800,#50ff8c)';
      fill.style.boxShadow = '0 0 11px rgba(80,255,140,0.55)';
    } else {
      fill.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg,#005f70,#00c8ff)';
      fill.style.boxShadow = '0 0 9px rgba(0,200,255,0.45)';
    }
  }
}

function buildMats() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('mat-grid');
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  const list = ch === 1 ? MATS.filter(m => m.id !== 'paper') : MATS;
  for (const m of list) {
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'mcard mcard-' + m.id + (m.id === matId ? ' sel' : '');
    d.title = m.desc || '';
    d.innerHTML = `<div class="mdot" style="background:${m.dot};box-shadow:0 0 5px ${m.dot}66"></div>
                   <div class="mname">${m.name}</div><div class="mer">εᵣ = ${m.er}</div>
                   ${m.desc ? `<div class="mdesc">${m.desc}</div>` : ''}`;
    d.onclick = () => {
      if (won) return;
      const _prevMat = matId;
      matId = m.id;
      measuredCap = null;
      buildMats(); syncUI();
      if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && _prevMat !== m.id)
        Telemetry.log('var_adjust', { var: 'mat', from: _prevMat, to: m.id, after: Telemetry.snapshot() });
    };
    grid.appendChild(d);
  }
}

function revealCapReading() {
  measuredCap = {
    C: calcC(areaCm2, distMm, mat().er),
    bd: broken(),
    E: V_APP / (distMm * 1e-3) / 1e6
  };
  syncUI();
}

function syncCapFormulaLive(m, C, bd) {
  const live = document.getElementById('cap-formula-live');
  if (!live) return;
  if (measuredCap == null) {
    live.innerHTML = '电容 <span class="fv">待测</span>' + (ch === 1 ? '<br>场强 <span class="fe">待测</span>' : '');
    return;
  }
  const showC = measuredCap.C, showBd = measuredCap.bd, showE = measuredCap.E;
  let html = `电容 <span class="fv">${showBd && ch === 1 ? '—' : showC.toFixed(1)} pF</span>`;
  if (ch === 1) {
    const ebd = m.Ebd / 1e6;
    html += `<br>场强 <span class="${showBd ? 'fe-bad' : 'fe'}">${showE.toFixed(2)} MV/m</span> ${showBd ? '超限' : `/ 材料上限 ${ebd.toFixed(0)} MV/m`}`;
  }
  live.innerHTML = html;
}

function syncUI() {
  const m = mat(), er = m.er;
  const C = calcC(areaCm2, distMm, er);
  const tgt = TARGETS[ch], max = MAXBAR[ch];
  const bd  = broken();
  const lo = capWinLo(tgt), hi = capWinHi(tgt);
  const loLbl = Math.round(lo), hiLbl = Math.round(hi);

  if (won && bd) {
    won = false;
    capLockControls(false);
  }

  if (ch === 1) { triedMats.add(matId); if (bd) brokenMats.add(matId); }

  document.getElementById('c-tgt').textContent   = tgt;
  if (measuredCap == null) {
    document.getElementById('c-val').textContent = '待测';
  } else {
    document.getElementById('c-val').textContent = measuredCap.bd ? '击穿！' : measuredCap.C.toFixed(1) + ' pF';
  }
  document.getElementById('v-area').textContent  = areaCm2 + ' cm²';
  document.getElementById('v-dist').textContent  = distMm.toFixed(1) + ' mm';
  const vTh = document.getElementById('v-thickness');
  if (vTh) vTh.textContent = plateThicknessMm.toFixed(1) + ' mm';
  const tw = document.getElementById('thickness-wrap');
  if (tw) tw.style.display = (ch === 0 || ch === 1) ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('prog-max').textContent = max + ' pF';
  document.getElementById('bd-warn').style.display = (measuredCap != null && measuredCap.bd) ? 'block' : 'none';
  const cInBand = !bd && C >= lo && C <= hi;
  const winOk = ch === 0 ? cInBand && ch0ConstraintsOk()
    : ch === 1 ? cInBand && ch1ConstraintsOk()
    : cInBand;
  if (typeof SFX !== 'undefined') {
    if (bd && !_capBdPrev) SFX.play('breakdownZap');
    if (winOk && !_capBandPrev) SFX.play('bandEnter');
    _capBdPrev = bd;
    _capBandPrev = winOk;
  }
  if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined') Telemetry.trackState(bd, winOk, C);
  if (measuredCap == null) {
    syncCapProgBar(0, tgt, max, false, false);
  } else {
    syncCapProgBar(measuredCap.C, tgt, max, measuredCap.bd, winOk);
  }
  syncCapFormulaLive(m, C, bd);

  const hint = document.getElementById('hint');
  if (measuredCap == null) {
    hint.textContent = '读数待测 · 调参后点「读取电容」';
    hint.className = '';
  } else if (measuredCap.bd) {
    hint.textContent = `击穿！当前 E = ${measuredCap.E.toFixed(1)} MV/m，超过 ${m.name}（${(m.Ebd/1e6).toFixed(0)} MV/m）`;
    hint.className = '';
  } else if (measuredCap.C < tgt * 0.55) {
    hint.textContent = ch===0 ? '增大面积（A↑）或减小间距（d↓）可提升电容' : '尝试更高 εᵣ 的介质，同时注意击穿';
    hint.className = '';
  } else if (measuredCap.C < lo) {
    hint.textContent = `还差 ${(lo - measuredCap.C).toFixed(1)} pF（需 ${loLbl}–${hiLbl} pF）`;
    hint.className = '';
  } else if (measuredCap.C <= hi) {
    if (ch === 0 && !ch0DistOk()) {
      hint.textContent = `电容已达标，但间距 d 低于工程师下限（≥ ${CH0_D_MIN} mm）——不能无限缩小间距`;
      hint.className = '';
    } else if (ch === 0 && !ch0AreaOk()) {
      hint.textContent = `电容已达标，但面积 A 超过旧设备上限（≤ ${CH0_A_MAX} cm²）——须收紧间距 d 配合调节`;
      hint.className = '';
    } else if (ch === 1 && !ch1DistOk()) {
      hint.textContent = `电容已达标，但间距 d 低于塔体下限（≥ ${CH1_D_MIN} mm）——不能无限缩小间距`;
      hint.className = '';
    } else if (ch === 1 && !ch1AreaOk()) {
      hint.textContent = `电容已达标，但面积 A 超过塔面安装上限（≤ ${CH1_A_MAX} cm²）——须收紧间距 d 配合调节`;
      hint.className = '';
    } else if (ch === 1 && !ch1MatOk()) {
      hint.textContent = '电容已达标，但空气间隙无法承载信号塔——须更换介质';
      hint.className = '';
    } else {
      hint.textContent = '✓ 目标达成！';
      hint.className = 'ok';
    }
  } else {
    hint.textContent = '超出目标——减小面积或增大间距';
    hint.className = '';
  }

  tgtBright = bd ? tgtBright : Math.min(1, C/tgt);

  // 须先读取电容，再判定过关（避免调参实时剧透）
  if (!won && measuredCap != null && !measuredCap.bd && capPuzzleOk()) {
    won = true;
    capLockControls(true);
    if (ch === 1) finalSol = { matId, areaCm2, distMm, C: measuredCap.C, mat: m };
    if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined') Telemetry.log('solution_locked', { after: Telemetry.snapshot() });
    setTimeout(capTryShowWin, 1100);
  }
}
