<script>
/* ===== js/core/chapter-intro-cinematics.js ===== */
// Chapters 1–6 animated intro cinematics
const CH_INTRO_THEME = {
  1: [110, 205, 255],  // 信号塔 · 青
  2: [255, 165, 65],   // 储能站 · 橙
  3: [95, 235, 150],   // 造物 · 绿
  4: [255, 205, 95],   // 能量门 · 琥珀
  5: [90, 205, 255],   // 雷暴穹顶 · 青蓝
  6: [190, 120, 255],  // 法拉第笼 · 紫
};

let _chIntroTrack = { key: '', t: 0 };
function ciBeat() {
  const beat = (phase === 'intro') ? -1 : (dlgIdx | 0);
  const key = ch + ':' + beat;
  if (key !== _chIntroTrack.key) { _chIntroTrack.key = key; _chIntroTrack.t = 0; }
  _chIntroTrack.t++;
  const _fr = Math.min(1, _chIntroTrack.t / 50);
  const fade = _fr * _fr * (3 - 2 * _fr); // smoothstep — gentler cinematic fade-in
  return { beat, t: _chIntroTrack.t, fade };
}

// ── shared drawing helpers (game-grade) ───────────────────────────────
function ciCol(c, a) { return `rgba(${c[0]},${c[1]},${c[2]},${a})`; }
function ciLite(c, d) { return [Math.min(255, c[0] + d), Math.min(255, c[1] + d), Math.min(255, c[2] + d)]; }
function ciRR(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}
// soft 3-stop radial glow
function ciOrb(cx, cy, r, col, a) {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, r * 0.04, cx, cy, r);
  g.addColorStop(0, ciCol(col, a));
  g.addColorStop(0.55, ciCol(col, a * 0.28));
  g.addColorStop(1, ciCol(col, 0));
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
}
// beveled lit metal panel
function ciPanel(x, y, w, h, r, c1, c2, edge) {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x, y + h);
  g.addColorStop(0, c1); g.addColorStop(0.5, c2); g.addColorStop(1, c1);
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ciRR(x, y, w, h, r); ctx.fill();
  // top highlight + bottom shadow
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + r, y + 1); ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y + 1); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + r, y + h - 1); ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y + h - 1); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = edge || 'rgba(120,130,160,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
  ciRR(x, y, w, h, r); ctx.stroke();
}
// brass / steel stud with recess + specular
function ciStud(x, y, r, warm) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.50)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + 0.5, y + 0.8, r + 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x - r * 0.4, y - r * 0.4, 0.5, x, y, r);
  if (warm) { g.addColorStop(0, '#f3d790'); g.addColorStop(0.55, '#bb8c3e'); g.addColorStop(1, '#5e4018'); }
  else { g.addColorStop(0, '#e6ecf3'); g.addColorStop(0.55, '#a7aeba'); g.addColorStop(1, '#474d58'); }
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
}
// glass instrument dial — brass bezel + ivory face + shine
function ciGlassDial(cx, cy, r, faceA) {
  // brass bezel
  const bz = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - r * 0.3, cy - r * 0.3, r * 0.2, cx, cy, r);
  bz.addColorStop(0, '#d9b463'); bz.addColorStop(0.7, '#8a6326'); bz.addColorStop(1, '#3c2a10');
  ctx.fillStyle = bz; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  // ivory face
  const fg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 1, cx, cy, r * 0.82);
  fg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(236,224,196,${faceA == null ? 1 : faceA})`);
  fg.addColorStop(1, `rgba(196,184,156,${faceA == null ? 1 : faceA})`);
  ctx.fillStyle = fg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r * 0.82, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  // glass shine (upper-left)
  const sh = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - r * 0.3, cy - r * 0.35, 1, cx - r * 0.3, cy - r * 0.35, r * 0.7);
  sh.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)'); sh.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = sh; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r * 0.82, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
}
// lightning bolt: wide halo + bright core
// Fractal lightning path via midpoint displacement: recursively split each segment
// and nudge the midpoint *perpendicular* to it (so a near-vertical bolt jitters
// sideways and never folds back), giving organic detail at many scales. Shared by
// ciBolt and ciBoltLive so all lightning in the game looks consistent.
function ciBoltPoints(x1, y1, x2, y2, jit, seedN, levels) {
  let s = ((seedN || 0) * 2749 + 13) >>> 0;
  const rnd = () => { s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff; return s / 0x7fffffff; };
  let pts = [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]];
  let disp = jit * 0.9;
  for (let lv = 0; lv < (levels || 5); lv++) {
    const np = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
      const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1];
      np.push(a);
      const dx = b[0] - a[0], dy = b[1] - a[1], len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1, off = (rnd() - 0.5) * disp;
      np.push([(a[0] + b[0]) / 2 + (-dy / len) * off, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2 + (dx / len) * off]);
    }
    np.push(pts[pts.length - 1]);
    pts = np; disp *= 0.52;
  }
  return pts;
}
function ciBolt(x1, y1, x2, y2, col, lw, jit, seedN) {
  const pts = ciBoltPoints(x1, y1, x2, y2, jit, seedN, 5);
  ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  const trace = () => { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]); for (const p of pts) ctx.lineTo(p[0], p[1]); ctx.stroke(); };
  ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(col, 0.5); ctx.lineWidth = lw * 3; ctx.shadowBlur = 18; ctx.shadowColor = ciCol(col, 0.9); trace();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)'; ctx.lineWidth = lw; ctx.shadowBlur = 8; trace();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
}
// Lively lightning: a jagged channel that can grow from the head (stepped leader),
// pulse in brightness (return-stroke flicker via `alpha`), and taper from head to
// tail. The channel swells wider in its middle so it never reads as a stiff zigzag.
// Natural lightning via fractal midpoint-displacement. The channel is generated by
// recursively splitting each segment and nudging the midpoint *perpendicular* to it
// (so a vertical bolt jitters sideways and never folds back), giving fine detail at
// many scales. It's stroked as ONE continuous path per pass — no per-segment round
// caps, so there's no "beaded" look. `grow` draws a leading fraction (stepped leader),
// `alpha` is the flicker brightness, `jit` the overall channel roughness.
function ciBoltLive(x1, y1, x2, y2, col, lw, jit, seedN, grow = 1, alpha = 1, taper = true) {
  if (alpha <= 0.01) return;
  const pts = ciBoltPoints(x1, y1, x2, y2, jit, seedN, 6);   // 6 levels → fine detail
  const drawN = Math.max(1, Math.round((pts.length - 1) * Math.min(1, grow)));
  ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  const trace = () => { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]); for (let i = 1; i <= drawN; i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]); ctx.stroke(); };
  // 1) wide soft aura
  ctx.shadowBlur = 18 + 12 * alpha; ctx.shadowColor = ciCol(col, 0.9 * alpha);
  ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(col, 0.22 * alpha); ctx.lineWidth = lw * (taper ? 4.2 : 3.4); trace();
  // 2) coloured channel
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10; ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(ciLite(col, 30), 0.55 * alpha); ctx.lineWidth = lw * 2; trace();
  // 3) white-hot core
  ctx.shadowBlur = 6; ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.95 * alpha})`; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.7, lw * 0.9); trace();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  // bright head while the leader is still descending
  if (grow < 1) ciOrb(pts[drawN][0], pts[drawN][1], 9, [255, 255, 255], 0.5 * alpha);
}
// engraved/glowing label
function ciLabel(txt, x, y, col, px, glow) {
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.font = `italic ${px}px Georgia,'Cambria Math',serif`;
  if (glow) { ctx.shadowBlur = glow; ctx.shadowColor = ciCol(col, 0.8); }
  ctx.fillStyle = ciCol(col, 0.92);
  ctx.fillText(txt, x, y);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
}
// proper capacitor symbol (two curved-edge plates) with optional energised glow
function ciCapSym(x, y, half, col, lit, tk) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  if (lit) { ctx.shadowBlur = 10; ctx.shadowColor = ciCol(col, 0.8); }
  ctx.strokeStyle = lit ? ciCol(ciLite(col, 40), 0.95) : 'rgba(205,215,230,0.85)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - half, y - 6); ctx.lineTo(x + half, y - 6); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - half, y + 6); ctx.lineTo(x + half, y + 6); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  if (lit) {
    const a = 0.35 + 0.45 * Math.abs(Math.sin((tk || 0) * 0.06));
    ctx.fillStyle = ciCol(col, a); ctx.fillRect(x - half + 2, y - 5, (half - 2) * 2, 10);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawChapterIntro(ctx) {
  drawSharedWorld(ctx, { calm: true });
  const col = CH_INTRO_THEME[ch];
  if (!col) return;
  const { beat, t, fade } = ciBeat();
  const tk = tick;
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H * 0.40;

  ctx.save();
  // cinematic vignette + faint colour wash
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, H * 0.10, cx, cy, H * 0.92);
  vg.addColorStop(0, ciCol(col, 0.06 * fade));
  vg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  vg.addColorStop(1, `rgba(2,2,8,${0.6 * fade})`);
  ctx.fillStyle = vg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  if (ch === 1) drawCh1Intro(beat, t, fade, col, cx, cy, tk);
  else if (ch === 2) drawCh2Intro(beat, t, fade, col, cx, cy, tk);
  else if (ch === 3) drawCh3Intro(beat, t, fade, col, cx, cy, tk);
  else if (ch === 4) drawCh4Intro(beat, t, fade, col, cx, cy, tk);
  else if (ch === 5) drawCh5Intro(beat, t, fade, col, cx, cy, tk);
  else if (ch === 6) drawCh6Intro(beat, t, fade, col, cx, cy, tk);
  ctx.restore();
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  CH1 · 信号塔危机
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
function ciSignalTower(tx, ty0, ty1, alive, col, tk) {
  const baseW = 42, topW = 9;
  ctx.save();
  // legs (tapering steel, gradient)
  const lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(tx - baseW, 0, tx + baseW, 0);
  lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(70,82,98,0.95)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(150,168,190,0.95)'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(70,82,98,0.95)');
  ctx.strokeStyle = lg; ctx.lineWidth = 3.2; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx - baseW, ty0); ctx.lineTo(tx - topW, ty1); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx + baseW, ty0); ctx.lineTo(tx + topW, ty1); ctx.stroke();
  // cross-bracing
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,140,165,0.6)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.3;
  const N = 9;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const f0 = i / N, f1 = (i + 1) / N;
    const y0 = ty0 + (ty1 - ty0) * f0, y1 = ty0 + (ty1 - ty0) * f1;
    const wl0 = baseW + (topW - baseW) * f0, wl1 = baseW + (topW - baseW) * f1;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx - wl0, y0); ctx.lineTo(tx + wl1, y1); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx + wl0, y0); ctx.lineTo(tx - wl1, y1); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(90,105,128,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx - wl1, y1); ctx.lineTo(tx + wl1, y1); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,140,165,0.6)';
  }
  // dish/antenna head
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,48,60,0.95)';
  ctx.fillRect(tx - 6, ty1 - 10, 12, 12);
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawCh1Intro(beat, t, fade, col, cx, cy, tk) {
  ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
  const tx = cx, ty0 = cy + H * 0.22, ty1 = cy - H * 0.20;
  if (beat <= 0) {
    ciOrb(tx, cy, H * 0.40, col, 0.10);
    ciSignalTower(tx, ty0, ty1, false, col, tk);
    // dying signal rings (break up, flicker)
    const ringT = (tk * 0.018) % 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const rt = (ringT + i / 3) % 1;
      const flick = 0.35 + 0.65 * Math.abs(Math.sin(tk * 0.06 + i));
      ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(col, (1 - rt) * 0.45 * flick);
      ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.setLineDash([14, 10]); ctx.lineDashOffset = tk * 0.5;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, ty1, rt * H * 0.30, Math.PI * 1.18, Math.PI * 1.82); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    // breakdown arc across an air gap near base
    if (Math.sin(tk * 0.16) > 0.45) {
      ciBolt(tx - 34, ty0 - 36, tx + 34, ty0 - 36, [220, 240, 255], 1.6, 16, Math.floor(tk / 6));
      ciOrb(tx, ty0 - 36, 40, [200, 220, 255], 0.3);
    }
    ciLabel('2000 V · 空气间隙击穿', cx, ty0 + 30, col, Math.round(H * 0.022), 8);
  } else if (beat === 1) {
    // three dielectric samples — glossy slabs on a brass rail
    const names = ['云母', '陶瓷', '玻璃'];
    const cols = [[205, 222, 255], [238, 214, 172], [186, 232, 236]];
    // rail
    const ry = cy + H * 0.12;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,120,60,0.5)'; ctx.fillRect(cx - W * 0.26, ry, W * 0.52, 5);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,230,170,0.25)'; ctx.fillRect(cx - W * 0.26, ry, W * 0.52, 1.5);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const sx = cx + (i - 1) * W * 0.17;
      const sw = W * 0.11, sh = H * 0.18, sy = ry - sh;
      ciOrb(sx, sy + sh / 2, sw * 1.3, cols[i], 0.16);
      // glossy slab
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(sx - sw / 2, sy, sx + sw / 2, sy);
      g.addColorStop(0, ciCol(cols[i], 0.30));
      g.addColorStop(0.45, ciCol(cols[i], 0.85));
      g.addColorStop(0.55, ciCol(ciLite(cols[i], 30), 0.95));
      g.addColorStop(1, ciCol(cols[i], 0.30));
      ctx.fillStyle = g; ciRR(sx - sw / 2, sy, sw, sh, 4); ctx.fill();
      // moving sheen
      const sweep = ((tk * 0.012 + i * 0.33) % 1);
      ctx.save(); ciRR(sx - sw / 2, sy, sw, sh, 4); ctx.clip();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.30)';
      ctx.fillRect(sx - sw / 2 + sweep * sw - 6, sy, 6, sh);
      ctx.restore();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ciRR(sx - sw / 2, sy, sw, sh, 4); ctx.stroke();
      // pedestal
      ciStud(sx - sw * 0.32, ry - 3, 3, true); ciStud(sx + sw * 0.32, ry - 3, 3, true);
      ciLabel(names[i], sx, ry + 24, col, Math.round(H * 0.024), 0);
    }
  } else if (beat === 2) {
    // capacitor cross-section: copper plates + dielectric slab + field
    ciOrb(cx, cy, H * 0.34, col, 0.14);
    const w = W * 0.28, gap = H * 0.14;
    // plates (copper, gradient + rivets)
    for (const sgn of [-1, 1]) {
      const py = cy + sgn * (gap / 2 + 5);
      const pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx, py - 6, cx, py + 6);
      pg.addColorStop(0, '#e8a460'); pg.addColorStop(0.5, '#c87a3c'); pg.addColorStop(1, '#9c5824');
      ctx.fillStyle = pg; ctx.fillRect(cx - w / 2, py - 6, w, 12);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,210,150,0.4)'; ctx.fillRect(cx - w / 2, py - 6, w, 1.5);
      for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) ciStud(cx - w / 2 + (k + 0.5) * w / 5, py, 2.4, true);
    }
    // dielectric slab with hatch texture
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = ciCol([200, 220, 255], 0.16); ctx.fillRect(cx - w / 2, cy - gap / 2, w, gap);
    ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol([200, 220, 255], 0.18); ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let xx = cx - w / 2; xx < cx + w / 2; xx += 12) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(xx, cy - gap / 2); ctx.lineTo(xx + 8, cy + gap / 2); ctx.stroke(); }
    ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol([200, 220, 255], 0.35); ctx.strokeRect(cx - w / 2, cy - gap / 2, w, gap);
    ctx.restore();
    // field lines with arrowheads + flow
    ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(col, 0.55); ctx.lineWidth = 1.4; ctx.shadowBlur = 8; ctx.shadowColor = ciCol(col, 0.8);
    const n = 6;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const ex = cx - w / 2 + (i + 0.5) * w / n;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ex, cy - gap / 2); ctx.lineTo(ex, cy + gap / 2); ctx.stroke();
      const ay = cy - gap / 2 + ((tk * 1.5 + i * 20) % gap);
      ctx.fillStyle = ciCol(ciLite(col, 60), 0.9);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ex, ay + 5); ctx.lineTo(ex - 3, ay - 2); ctx.lineTo(ex + 3, ay - 2); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ciLabel('εᵣ ↑   储能 ↑', cx, cy + gap / 2 + 42, col, Math.round(H * 0.028), 10);
  } else {
    // restored tower, strong beam + beacon
    ciOrb(tx, ty1, H * 0.46, col, 0.20 + 0.08 * Math.sin(tk * 0.08));
    ciSignalTower(tx, ty0, ty1, true, col, tk);
    const ringT = (tk * 0.03) % 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const rt = (ringT + i / 4) % 1;
      ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(col, (1 - rt) * 0.8); ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.shadowBlur = 8; ctx.shadowColor = ciCol(col, 0.7);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, ty1, rt * H * 0.34, Math.PI * 1.1, Math.PI * 1.9); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 22; ctx.shadowColor = ciCol(col, 1);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, ty1 - 6, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  CH2 · 储能电站
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
function ciCapCan(sx, cy, cw, chh, col, charge, dim, tk, i) {
  // cylindrical body
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(sx - cw / 2, 0, sx + cw / 2, 0);
  if (dim) { g.addColorStop(0, '#34291a'); g.addColorStop(0.5, '#6a5532'); g.addColorStop(1, '#2c2316'); }
  else { g.addColorStop(0, '#3a3020'); g.addColorStop(0.5, '#8a7038'); g.addColorStop(1, '#322914'); }
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ciRR(sx - cw / 2, cy - chh / 2, cw, chh, 5); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(20,16,8,0.7)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ciRR(sx - cw / 2, cy - chh / 2, cw, chh, 5); ctx.stroke();
  // top crimp ring + terminal
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,120,70,0.9)'; ctx.fillRect(sx - cw / 2, cy - chh / 2, cw, 4);
  ciStud(sx, cy - chh / 2 - 4, 4, true);
  // charge fill from bottom
  const fh = chh * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, charge));
  if (fh > 1) {
    const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, cy + chh / 2 - fh, 0, cy + chh / 2);
    fg.addColorStop(0, ciCol(col, 0.55)); fg.addColorStop(1, ciCol(col, 0.15));
    ctx.save(); ciRR(sx - cw / 2 + 2, cy - chh / 2 + 2, cw - 4, chh - 4, 4); ctx.clip();
    ctx.fillStyle = fg; ctx.fillRect(sx - cw / 2, cy + chh / 2 - fh, cw, fh);
    ctx.fillStyle = ciCol(ciLite(col, 40), 0.85); ctx.shadowBlur = 8; ctx.shadowColor = ciCol(col, 0.8);
    ctx.fillRect(sx - cw / 2, cy + chh / 2 - fh - 1, cw, 2); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.restore();
  }
  // level ticks
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let k = 1; k < 5; k++) { const yy = cy + chh / 2 - chh * k / 5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx - cw / 2 + 3, yy); ctx.lineTo(sx + cw / 2 - 3, yy); ctx.stroke(); }
}

function getTopChromeInset() {
  const bar = document.getElementById('top-chrome');
  if (bar && bar.offsetHeight > 0) return bar.offsetHeight;
  const raw = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--top-chrome-h');
  const parsed = parseInt(raw, 10);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 52;
}

function getCtrlPanelInset() {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const ids = ['controls','controls2','controls3','controls4','controls5','controls6','controls7'];
  let panel = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    const el = document.getElementById(ids[i]);
    if (el && getComputedStyle(el).display !== 'none') { panel = el; break; }
  }
  if (!panel) {
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-h', '0px');
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-w', '0px');
    return 0;
  }
  const narrow = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 560px)').matches;
  const rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
  if (narrow) {
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-w', '0px');
    const h = rect.height;
    if (h > 0) {
      root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-h', h + 'px');
      return h + 14;
    }
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-h', '0px');
    return 0;
  }
  const w = rect.width;
  root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-h', '0px');
  if (w > 0) {
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-w', w + 'px');
    return 0;
  }
  root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-w', '0px');
  return 0;
}

function getCapPlayfield() {
  const bottomInset = getCtrlPanelInset();
  const cityLine = getCityGroundY();
  const margin = 18;
  return {
    safeTop: cityLine + 12,
    safeBottom: H - bottomInset - margin,
  };
}

function getCityGroundY() {
  const base = H * 0.58;
  if (ch !== 0 && ch !== 1) return base;
  const bottomInset = getCtrlPanelInset();
  const capReserve = 145;
  if (bottomInset > 0) {
    return Math.min(base, H - bottomInset - capReserve);
  }
  return base;
}

function tickCityBrightness() {
  cityBright += (tgtBright - cityBright) * 0.016;
  if (phase === 'puzzle' || phase === 'win') cityBright = Math.max(CITY_BRIGHT_MIN, cityBright);
}

function updateCh1Atmosphere() {
  const bd = won === false && phase === 'puzzle' && broken();
  let targetStorm = 0, targetDanger = 0;
  if      (phase === 'win')    targetStorm = Math.max(0, stormIntensity - 0.004);
  else if (phase === 'puzzle') targetStorm = bd ? 0.95 : 0.50;
  else                         targetStorm = dlgIdx <= 1 ? 0.88 : 0.72;
  targetDanger = bd ? Math.min(1, dangerPulse + 0.04) : Math.max(0, dangerPulse - 0.025);
  stormIntensity += (targetStorm - stormIntensity) * 0.013;
  dangerPulse    += (targetDanger - dangerPulse) * 0.04;
  if (flashTimer > 0) flashTimer--;
  return bd;
}

function drawSharedWorld(ctx, opts) {
  const bd = opts && opts.bd;
  const calm = opts && opts.calm;
  drawSky();

  boltT--;
  const boltInterval = calm
    ? 50 + Math.random() * 120
    : bd ? 6 + Math.random() * 10
    : stormIntensity > 0.7 ? 12 + Math.random() * 20
    : 35 + Math.random() * 65;
  if (boltT <= 0) {
    boltT = boltInterval;
    if (phase !== 'win' || stormIntensity > 0.1) spawnBolt();
  }
  for (let i = bolts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (--bolts[i].life <= 0) bolts.splice(i, 1);
  if (bolts.length > 0) {
    const ml = Math.max(...bolts.map(b => b.life));
    const fr = Math.floor((dangerPulse > 0.3 ? 130 : 100) * ml / 30);
    const fg = Math.floor(175 * (1 - dangerPulse * 0.4) * ml / 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${fr},${fg},255,${(ml / 30) * .11})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  drawCity();
  drawTowers();
  drawLightning();
  drawGround();
  drawDangerOverlay();
  drawFlash();
}

function tickCanvasIntroAndDlg() {
  if ((phase === 'dlg' || phase === 'intro') && typeTarget && typeShown < typeTarget.length) {
    if (++typeTick >= TSPEED) { typeTick = 0; typeShown++; }
    document.getElementById('dlg-text').textContent = typeTarget.slice(0, typeShown);
  }
  if (phase === 'intro') {
    introTick++;
    if (introTick >= INTRO) {
      phase = 'dlg';
      dlgIdx = 0;
      setLine(0);
      document.getElementById('dialogue').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('chapter-badge').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('chapter-badge').textContent = CH_NAMES[ch];
    }
  }
}

function finishCanvasWinFrame() {
  if (phase === 'win') tgtBright = 1;
}

function frameCanvasChapter(ctx, hooks = {}) {
  syncIntroTitleOverlay();
  let worldOpts = hooks.worldOpts;
  if (hooks.beforeWorld) {
    const extra = hooks.beforeWorld();
    if (extra && extra.worldOpts !== undefined) worldOpts = extra.worldOpts;
  }
  tickCityBrightness();
  const inIntroCine = (phase === 'intro' || phase === 'dlg')
    && ch >= 1 && ch <= 6
    && typeof CH_INTRO_THEME !== 'undefined' && CH_INTRO_THEME[ch];
  if (inIntroCine) drawChapterIntro(ctx);
  else if (hooks.customWorld) hooks.customWorld(ctx);
  else drawSharedWorld(ctx, worldOpts);
  if (!inIntroCine && hooks.afterWorld) hooks.afterWorld(ctx);
  if (hooks.midFrame) hooks.midFrame(ctx);
  if (!inIntroCine && hooks.puzzleDraw) hooks.puzzleDraw(ctx);
  tickCanvasIntroAndDlg();
  finishCanvasWinFrame();
}

<script>
/* ===== js/research/telemetry.js ·(研究埋点，非原游戏代码)===== */
// 存储字段：变量 + 调整（含 从→到、微操作数、时长、调后反馈快照）+ 系统事件
// 传输：优先 POST 到后端（?ep= 可覆盖），同时镜像 localStorage，可手动导出 JSONL
const Telemetry = (function () {
  const qs = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const sid = qs.get('sid') || ('anon-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8));
  const endpoint = qs.get('ep') || 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/events'; // 后端未启动时静默降级
  const session = {
    session_id: sid + '-' + Date.now().toString(36),
    student_id: sid,
    game_id: 'cap-ch1-dielectric',
    game_ver: 'sample-v1',
    started_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    ua: navigator.userAgent,
  };
  const buf = [];      // 待发送
  const all = [];      // 全量（供导出/镜像）
  const t0 = performance.now();
  let seq = 0;

  function snapshot() {
    try {
      const m = mat();
      const C = calcC(areaCm2, distMm, m.er);
      return {
        A: areaCm2, d: distMm, t: plateThicknessMm, mat: matId, er: m.er,
        C: +C.toFixed(2), bd: broken(), phase: phase,
      };
    } catch (e) { return {}; }
  }

  function log(type, data) {
    const ev = Object.assign({
      seq: seq++,
      rel_ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0),
      ts: new Date().toISOString(),
      type: type,
    }, data || {});
    buf.push(ev); all.push(ev);
    mirror();
  }

  // ── localStorage 镜像（节流） ──
  let mirrorTimer = null;
  function mirror() {
    if (mirrorTimer) return;
    mirrorTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      mirrorTimer = null;
      try { localStorage.setItem('telemetry:' + session.session_id,
        JSON.stringify({ session, events: all })); } catch (e) {}
    }, 800);
  }

  // ── 后端上报 ──
  function flush(final) {
    if (!buf.length || !endpoint) return;
    const payload = JSON.stringify({ session, events: buf.splice(0) });
    if (final && navigator.sendBeacon) {
      navigator.sendBeacon(endpoint, new Blob([payload], { type: 'application/json' }));
      return;
    }
    fetch(endpoint, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: payload, keepalive: true }).catch(() => {});
  }
  setInterval(() => flush(false), 5000);
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { log('page_hide', {}); flush(true); });

  // ── 滑块手势聚合：input 计微操作，change 提交一次"调整" ──
  const VAR_OF = { 's-area': 'A', 's-dist': 'd', 's-thickness': 't' };
  const gest = {}; // id -> {from, micro, vmin, vmax, t0}
  document.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    const id = e.target && e.target.id;
    if (!(id in VAR_OF)) return;
    const v = +e.target.value;
    if (!gest[id]) gest[id] = { from: null, micro: 0, vmin: v, vmax: v, t0: performance.now() };
    const g = gest[id];
    if (g.from === null) g.from = commit[id] !== undefined ? commit[id] : v;
    g.micro++; g.vmin = Math.min(g.vmin, v); g.vmax = Math.max(g.vmax, v);
  }, true);
  const commit = { 's-area': 57, 's-dist': 5, 's-thickness': 2 };
  document.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    const id = e.target && e.target.id;
    if (!(id in VAR_OF)) return;
    const v = +e.target.value;
    const g = gest[id] || { from: commit[id], micro: 1, vmin: v, vmax: v, t0: performance.now() };
    log('var_adjust', {
      var: VAR_OF[id], from: g.from, to: v,
      micro: g.micro, vmin: g.vmin, vmax: g.vmax,
      dur_ms: Math.round(performance.now() - g.t0),
      after: snapshot(),
    });
    commit[id] = v; delete gest[id];
  }, true);

  // ── 状态转变追踪（击穿 / 进出目标带），由 syncUI 每帧调用 ──
  let _bdPrev = false, _bandPrev = false;
  function trackState(bd, winOk, C) {
    if (bd !== _bdPrev) { log(bd ? 'breakdown_start' : 'breakdown_end', { after: snapshot() }); _bdPrev = bd; }
    if (winOk !== _bandPrev) { log(winOk ? 'enter_win_band' : 'leave_win_band', { C: +C.toFixed(2), after: snapshot() }); _bandPrev = winOk; }
  }

  // ── phase 变化看守（intro/dlg/puzzle/win 时间戳） ──
  let _phasePrev = null;
  setInterval(() => {
    try { if (phase !== _phasePrev) { log('phase_change', { from: _phasePrev, to: phase }); _phasePrev = phase; } } catch (e) {}
  }, 200);

  log('session_start', { href: location.href });
  return { log, flush, trackState, snapshot, session };
})();

    };
    //         ch:  0     1     2     3     4     5     6     7     8
    //              序章  一章  二章  三章  四章  五章  六章  七章  八章
    var CH_THEME=['c0', 'c1', 'c2', 'c3', 'c4', 'c5', 'c6', 'c7', 'c8'];
    function inFinaleMontage(){ try{ return typeof document!=='undefined' && !!document.getElementById('finale-cv'); }catch(e){ return false; } }
    function inPrologue(){ try{ if(typeof gamePrologueActive!=='undefined') return !!gamePrologueActive; }catch(e){} return false; }
    function desiredTheme(){
      // 结尾回忆蒙太奇自带最顶层画布 #finale-cv —— 切到「黎明」主题
      if(inFinaleMontage()) return 'dawn';
      var c=getCh(), ph=getPhase()||'';
      // 开场动画 + 序章开场白（标题动画 + 开场对白）：悬而未发；进入解谜后旋律绽放
      if(inPrologue()) return 'open';
      if(c===0 && (ph==='intro'||ph==='dlg')) return 'open';
      // 关卡数（9 章）必须与 CH_THEME 一一对应，缺失则回退到最后一章主题，避免“串调”
      return CH_THEME[c] || CH_THEME[CH_THEME.length-1];
    }

    function build(){
      ctx=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
      master=ctx.createGain(); master.gain.value=0;
      busComp=ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();
      busComp.threshold.value=-14; busComp.ratio.value=3; busComp.attack.value=0.01; busComp.release.value=0.25;
      busComp.connect(master); master.connect(ctx.destination);
      delay=ctx.createDelay(); delay.delayTime.value=0.42;
      delayGain=ctx.createGain(); delayGain.gain.value=0.30;
      var dWet=ctx.createGain(); dWet.gain.value=0.5;
      delay.connect(delayGain); delayGain.connect(delay); delay.connect(dWet); dWet.connect(busComp);
      delay._in=ctx.createGain(); delay._in.connect(delay);
      reverb=ctx.createConvolver(); reverb.buffer=makeImpulse(2.4,2.2);
      revGain=ctx.createGain(); revGain.gain.value=0.5; reverb.connect(revGain); revGain.connect(busComp);
      reverb._in=ctx.createGain(); reverb._in.connect(reverb);
    }
    function makeImpulse(dur,decay){
      var rate=ctx.sampleRate, len=rate*dur, buf=ctx.createBuffer(2,len,rate);
      for(var c=0;c<2;c++){ var d=buf.getChannelData(c);
        for(var i=0;i<len;i++) d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.pow(1-i/len,decay); }
      return buf;
    }

    // ── 音色（均按当前预设 T 调整） ──────────────────
    //  长音弦垫：铺底的持续和声（comp='pad' 用）
    function padVoice(freq,cents,t,dur,T,amp){
      var o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain(),lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      o.type=T.padWave||'sawtooth'; o.frequency.value=freq; o.detune.value=cents;
      lp.type='lowpass'; lp.frequency.value=T.lp; lp.Q.value=0.6;
      o.connect(lp); lp.connect(g);
      var A=Math.min(1.1,dur*0.35), R=Math.min(1.3,dur*0.42), pk=0.045*amp;
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(pk,t+A);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(pk,Math.max(t+A,t+dur-R));
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
      g.connect(busComp); g.connect(reverb._in);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+dur+0.05);
    }
    function pad(freq,t,dur,T){
      padVoice(freq,-T.det,t,dur,T,1); padVoice(freq,T.det,t,dur,T,1);
      if(T.fuller){ padVoice(freq*0.5,-T.det,t,dur,T,0.5); padVoice(freq*0.5,T.det,t,dur,T,0.5); }
    }
    //  和弦断奏：快起快落的节奏型和声（comp='stab' 用）——章与章节奏差异的核心
    function chordStab(freq,t,dur,T){
      var wv=T.padWave||'sawtooth';
      var o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain(),lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      o.type=wv; o.frequency.value=freq;
      lp.type='lowpass'; lp.frequency.value=Math.max(1000,T.lp*0.9); lp.Q.value=0.8;
      // 断奏保持「干」声（不进混响）—— 节奏章节因此清脆有冲击，与铺底章节的湿润空灵形成鲜明对比
      o.connect(lp); lp.connect(g); g.connect(busComp);
      var bright=(wv==='square'||wv==='sawtooth'), pk=(bright?0.030:0.046);
      var d=Math.max(0.10,dur);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(pk,t+0.012);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+d);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+d+0.03);
    }
    function bass(freq,t,dur){
      var o=ctx.createOscillator(),o2=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain(),lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      o.type='sine'; o.frequency.value=freq;
      o2.type='triangle'; o2.frequency.value=freq*2;
      var g2=ctx.createGain(); g2.gain.value=0.35; o2.connect(g2); g2.connect(g);
      lp.type='lowpass'; lp.frequency.value=420;
      o.connect(g); g.connect(lp); lp.connect(busComp);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.14,t+0.04);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.14,Math.max(t+0.05,t+dur-0.4));
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
      o.start(t);o2.start(t);o.stop(t+dur+0.05);o2.stop(t+dur+0.05);
    }
    function arp(freq,t,T){
      var o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();
      o.type=T.arpWave||'triangle'; o.frequency.value=freq;
      o.connect(g); g.connect(busComp); g.connect(delay._in); g.connect(reverb._in);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.045,t+0.01);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+0.7);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+0.75);
    }
    function lead(freq,t,dur,beat,T){
      var o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain(),lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      var wv=T.leadWave||'triangle'; o.type=wv; o.frequency.value=freq;
      // 锯齿 / 方波泛音更亮，整体压低音量并收紧低通，避免刺耳
      var amp=(wv==='square'||wv==='sawtooth')?0.62:1;
      var vib=ctx.createOscillator(),vg=ctx.createGain();
      vib.frequency.value=5; vg.gain.value=freq*0.006; vib.connect(vg); vg.connect(o.frequency); vib.start(t); vib.stop(t+dur+0.1);
      lp.type='lowpass'; lp.frequency.value=Math.max(1600,T.lp);
      o.connect(lp); lp.connect(g); g.connect(busComp); g.connect(delay._in); g.connect(reverb._in);
      var d=Math.max(0.18,dur*beat);
      // 旋律是「每章听感不同」的主角 —— 显著提高音量让它浮在伴奏之上
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.15*amp,t+0.04);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.10*amp,t+0.12);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.092*amp,Math.max(t+0.13,t+d-0.12));
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+d);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+d+0.05);
    }

    // 琶音音序索引（上行 / 下行 / 往返），让各章琶音走向也不同
    function arpIndex(q,n,dir){
      if(n<=1) return 0;
      if(dir==='down') return (n-1)-(q%n);
      if(dir==='updown'){ var p=2*n-2, k=q%p; return k<n?k:(p-k); }
      return q%n;
    }

    // ── 调度一个小节（读取当前预设，故换章数秒内即生效） ──
    function scheduleBar(i,t,T){
      var tf=Math.pow(2,(T.tr||0)/12), beat=60/T.bpm, bar=beat*4, q;
      var prog=T.prog, bassArr=T.bass, mel=T.mel;
      var chord=prog[i%prog.length], tones=chord;
      var rootHz=f(bassArr[i%bassArr.length])*tf;
      var comp=T.comp||[[0,4]], stab=(T.compVoice==='stab');
      // 和声层：长音弦垫 or 节奏断奏
      comp.forEach(function(h){
        var ht=t+h[0]*beat, hd=h[1]*beat;
        if(stab) chord.forEach(function(n){ chordStab(f(n)*tf,ht,hd,T); });
        else     chord.forEach(function(n){ pad(f(n)*tf,ht,hd,T); });
      });
      // 低音：断奏型走稳定四分根音；铺底型按和声节奏走长音
      if(stab){ for(q=0;q<4;q++) bass(rootHz,t+q*beat,beat*0.92); }
      else comp.forEach(function(h){ bass(rootHz,t+h[0]*beat,h[1]*beat); });
      // 琶音（断奏章节通常关闭，靠和弦脉冲提供律动）
      if(T.arp>0){ var dir=T.arpDir||'up';
        for(q=0;q<T.arp;q++) arp(f(tones[arpIndex(q,tones.length,dir)])*tf*2, t+(q+0.5)*(bar/T.arp), T); }
      // 旋律
      if(T.lead!=='off' && mel){
        var mt=t, loOct=Math.pow(2,T.lo||0), barMel=mel[i%mel.length];
        barMel.forEach(function(nd){ var n=nd[0], dd=nd[1];
          if(n){ if(T.lead!=='sparse'||dd>=1) lead(f(n)*tf*loOct,mt,dd,beat,T); } mt+=dd*beat; });
      }
    }
    function tick(){
      if(!ctx) return;
      var ahead=ctx.currentTime+0.3;
      while(nextBar<ahead){
        var name=desiredTheme(), T=THEMES[name];
        if(on){
          scheduleBar(barIdx,nextBar,T);
          if(name!==curTheme){ curTheme=name;
            var mp3Vol=T.mp3;
            try{ if(window.SFX && typeof window.SFX.volume==='number' && !window.SFX.muted) mp3Vol=T.mp3*window.SFX.volume; else if(window.SFX&&window.SFX.muted) mp3Vol=0; }catch(e){}
            fadeMp3To(mp3Vol,1800); }
        }
        nextBar += (60/T.bpm)*4;
        barIdx=(barIdx+1)%8;
      }
    }

    function start(){
      if(started) return; started=true;
      if(!ctx) build();
      if(ctx.state==='suspended') ctx.resume();
      // 顶部喇叭按钮是统一的音频总开关：若启动时 SFX 已静音，则音乐随之保持静音，
      // 不在静音状态下被「首次交互自动播放」偷偷唤醒。
      var vol=1;
      try{ if(window.SFX){ if(window.SFX.muted) on=false; else if(typeof window.SFX.volume==='number') vol=window.SFX.volume; } }catch(e){}
      var T=THEMES[desiredTheme()]; curTheme=desiredTheme();
      barIdx=0; nextBar=ctx.currentTime+0.2;
      schedTimer=setInterval(tick,30);
      if(on){
        startMp3(T.mp3 * vol);
        master.gain.cancelScheduledValues(ctx.currentTime);
        master.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,ctx.currentTime);
        master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol * BGM_GAIN_PEAK,ctx.currentTime+2.2);
      } else {
        master.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,ctx.currentTime);
      }
    }
    var BGM_GAIN_PEAK = 0.55;
    function applyVolume(v){
      var vol = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
      on = vol > 0.001;
      if(!started){ if(on) start(); return; }
      if(!ctx || !master) return;
      master.gain.cancelScheduledValues(ctx.currentTime);
      master.gain.setValueAtTime(master.gain.value, ctx.currentTime);
      master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol * BGM_GAIN_PEAK, ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
      if(on){
        if(audioEl && audioEl.paused) audioEl.play().catch(function(){});
        fadeMp3To((THEMES[desiredTheme()] || THEMES.c0).mp3 * vol, 500);
      } else {
        fadeMp3To(0, 500, true);
      }
    }
    function setOn(v){
      applyVolume(v ? (function(){
        try{ if(window.SFX && typeof window.SFX.volume === 'number') return window.SFX.volume; }catch(e){}
        return 1;
      })() : 0);
    }
    return { start:start, setOn:setOn, applyVolume:applyVolume,
      get on(){return on;}, get ctx(){return ctx;},
      THEMES:THEMES, CH_THEME:CH_THEME }; // 暴露预设表，便于运行时微调
  })();

  // 全局可访问（游戏内的点击音效等也可复用 MUSIC.ctx）
  if(typeof window!=='undefined') window.MUSIC = MUSIC;

  // ── 自动播放策略 + 右下角开关按钮 ──────────────
  function wireUI(){
    if(AUTOSTART){
      var kick=function(){ MUSIC.start(); ['pointerdown','keydown','touchstart'].forEach(function(e){ window.removeEventListener(e,kick); }); };
      ['pointerdown','keydown','touchstart'].forEach(function(e){ window.addEventListener(e,kick,{once:false}); });
    }
    // 游戏顶栏已有统一的音频总开关（#sfx-btn，由 audio.js 驱动，会一并控制本音乐引擎）。
    // 此时不再生成右下角这个独立的「♪ 音乐」按钮，避免出现两个互相矛盾的音频开关。
    if(typeof document!=='undefined' && document.getElementById('sfx-btn')) return;
    var btn=document.createElement('div');
    btn.title='背景音乐开关';
    var mon=true;
    function lbl(){ btn.textContent = mon ? '♪ 音乐 ON' : '♪ 音乐 OFF'; }
    btn.style.cssText='position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:74px;z-index:99999;padding:8px 14px;'+
      'display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;font-size:14px;'+
      'font-family:"Courier New",monospace;letter-spacing:1px;cursor:pointer;'+
      'color:rgba(0,220,255,0.95);border:1px solid rgba(0,220,255,0.55);border-radius:20px;'+
      'background:rgba(2,16,30,0.85);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,200,255,0.25);'+
      'transition:all .2s;user-select:none;';
    lbl();
    btn.onmouseenter=function(){ btn.style.borderColor='rgba(0,220,255,0.9)'; };
    btn.onmouseleave=function(){ btn.style.borderColor=mon?'rgba(0,220,255,0.55)':'rgba(120,140,160,0.4)'; };
    btn.onclick=function(ev){ ev.stopPropagation(); mon=!mon; MUSIC.setOn(mon); lbl();
      btn.style.opacity=mon?'1':'0.55';
      btn.style.color=mon?'rgba(0,220,255,0.95)':'rgba(150,170,190,0.7)';
      btn.style.borderColor=mon?'rgba(0,220,255,0.55)':'rgba(120,140,160,0.4)'; };
    document.body.appendChild(btn);
  }
  if(typeof document!=='undefined'){
    if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',wireUI);
    else wireUI();
  }
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){

    try {
      if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {

  }
  function snapControls() {

      el.addEventListener('change', function() {

  });
})();

<script>

      if (WIN_TEXT[i].test(text)) {
        emitWin('text_' + i);

  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function() { scanWinText(); });

  });
})();

<script>
/* === dual-mode-manual runtime === */
(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeManual) return;
  window.__dualModeManual = true;
  var MAX=5;
  var EXP=600;
  var state={mode:'explore',attempts:MAX,timeLeft:EXP,timerId:null};
  function $(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
  function setPhase(p){
    try{
      if(typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase==='function') window.__platformTraceSetPhase(p);
      else if(window.PlatformTraceAdapter&&window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase) window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(p);
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function fmt(sec){var m=Math.floor(sec/60),s=sec%60;return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':'+(s<10?'0':'')+s;}
  function stop(){if(state.timerId){clearInterval(state.timerId);state.timerId=null;}}
  function render(){
    var label=$('modeLabel'),stats=$('challengeStats'),att=$('attemptsDisplay'),td=$('timerDisplay'),chip=$('dual-timer-chip');
    if(label) label.textContent=state.mode==='explore'?'探究模式':'竞赛模式';
    if(stats){ if(state.mode==='challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible'); else stats.classList.remove('is-visible'); }
    if(att) att.textContent=String(state.attempts);
    if(chip) chip.style.display=state.mode==='explore'?'inline-flex':'none';
    if(td) td.textContent=fmt(Math.max(0,state.timeLeft));
  }
  function startTimer(){
    stop(); state.timeLeft=EXP; render();
    state.timerId=setInterval(function(){
      if(state.mode!=='explore') return;
      state.timeLeft--; render();
      if(state.timeLeft<=0){
        stop();
        var sel=$('modeSelect');
        if(sel){ sel.value='challenge'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); }
      }
    },1000);
  }
  function apply(mode){
    state.mode=mode==='challenge'?'challenge':'explore';
    if(state.mode==='challenge'){ stop(); state.attempts=MAX; }
    else startTimer();
    render(); setPhase(state.mode);
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dual-mode-change',{detail:{mode:state.mode,attempts:state.attempts}}));
  }
  function consume(){
    if(state.mode!=='challenge') return true;
    if(state.attempts<=0) return false;
    state.attempts--; render();
    return state.attempts>=0;
  }
  window.__dualModeConsumeAttempt=consume;
  window.__dualModeGet=function(){return {mode:state.mode,attempts:state.attempts};};
  function boot(){
    var sel=$('modeSelect');
    if(!sel) return;
    sel.addEventListener('change',function(){ apply(sel.value); });
    apply(sel.value||'explore');
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>

<script>

(function(){

  });

  var hud = document.getElementById('essence-hud') || document.getElementById('dual-mode-hud') || document.getElementById('hud');
  if (hud && !document.getElementById('craft-gauge')) {
    var g = document.createElement('div');
    g.id = 'craft-gauge';
    g.innerHTML = '<span>目标仪表</span><strong id="craftGaugeVal">待测</strong>';
    hud.appendChild(g);
  }
function showWin(extra){
    if (win) {
      window.__craftWinDismissed = false;
      win.hidden = false;
      var t = document.getElementById('craftWinText');
      if (t && extra) t.textContent = extra;
    }
  }
  window.__craftShowWin = showWin;

  // Hook common win paths
  var _emit = window.__emit;
  window.__emit = function(type, payload){
    if (typeof _emit === 'function') _emit(type, payload);
    if (type === 'win') showWin();
  };
  // Observe win banners
  var obs = new MutationObserver(function(){
    if (window.__craftWinDismissed) return;
    var el = document.querySelector('.win-banner,.win-badge,#winBanner,[data-win="1"]');
    if (el && el.offsetParent !== null) showWin();
  });
  obs.observe(document.body, {childList:true, subtree:true, attributes:true, attributeFilter:['class','style','hidden']});

  // Live gauge from first range readout if possible
  function tick(){
    var val = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .value-badge, #essence-bench .value, .observe-box .state, .observe-value, #craftGaugeVal');
    var src = document.querySelector('.observe-box .state, .observe-value, #hud-dist, #g-T, .gauge .gval');
    var gval = document.getElementById('craftGaugeVal');
    if (gval && src && src !== gval) gval.textContent = (src.textContent || '').trim() || '观测中';
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
})();
</script>

  /* ---------- 4. DOM 构建 ---------- */

    timers.push(setTimeout(function(){var aw=card.querySelector('.dv-away');if(aw)aw.classList.add('show');},after+gap*0.7));

        return {id:cur7,label:(cur7==='p2'?all7[1].label:all7[0].label),all:all7};
      }
      if(idx===8){
        var all8=[{id:'p1',label:'实验台 · 推导'},{id:'p2',label:'控制台 · 升频'}];
        var C=null; try{C=(typeof CH8!=='undefined'&&CH8)?CH8:window.CH8;}catch(e){}
        var ph=C&&C.phase;
        if(ph==='console'||ph==='climax')return {id:'p2',label:all8[1].label,all:all8};
        return {id:'p1',label:all8[0].label,all:all8};
      }
    }catch(e){}
    return null;
  }
  var rlShownIdx=-1, rlShownPhase='';   // 当前规则浮层显示的章节与阶段（用于即时刷新）

  function buildRules(idx){
    var d=RULES[idx];if(!d)return false;
    rlCard.style.setProperty('--dv-accent',accent(idx));
    // 选定当前阶段文案（多阶段章节随 phase 即时变化）
    var ph=d.phases?rulePhase(idx):null;
    var view=d;
    if(ph&&d.phases&&d.phases[ph.id]){
      var pv=d.phases[ph.id];
      view={sub:pv.sub||d.sub,steps:pv.steps||d.steps,win:pv.win||d.win,tip:pv.tip||d.tip};
    }
    rlShownIdx=idx; rlShownPhase=ph?ph.id:'';
    var h='<div class="dv-kicker">'+d.kicker+'</div><div class="dv-title">'+d.title+'</div>';
    if(ph&&ph.all&&ph.all.length>1){
      h+='<div class="rl-phases">';
      ph.all.forEach(function(pp){h+='<span class="rl-phase'+(pp.id===ph.id?' on':'')+'">'+pp.label+'</span>';});
      h+='</div>';
    }
    h+='<div class="dv-sub">'+view.sub+'</div><div class="dv-steps">';
    var n=0;
    view.steps.forEach(function(s){n++;h+='<div class="dv-step show"><div class="dv-num-chip">'+n+'</div><div class="dv-body">'
      +'<div class="rl-txt">'+s.t+'</div>'+(s.n?'<div class="rl-note">'+s.n+'</div>':'')+'</div></div>';});
    h+='</div><div class="rl-win"><span class="rl-wlbl">过关</span>'+view.win+'</div>';
    if(view.tip)h+='<div class="dv-away show">▸ '+view.tip+'</div>';
    h+='<div class="dv-actions"><button class="dv-skip" type="button">点击空白处关闭</button><button class="dv-go" type="button">明 白 了</button></div>';
    rlCard.innerHTML=h;
    rlCard.querySelector('.dv-go').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();rlClose();});
    rlCard.querySelector('.dv-skip').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();rlClose();});
    return true;
  }
  function rlShow(idx){if(!buildRules(idx))return;rlOpen=true;rlOverlay.style.display='flex';
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){requestAnimationFrame(function(){rlOverlay.classList.add('show');});});}
  function rlClose(){rlOpen=false;rlShownIdx=-1;rlOverlay.classList.remove('show');setTimeout(function(){rlOverlay.style.display='none';},420);}
  rlOverlay.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===rlOverlay)rlClose();});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(rlOpen&&e.key==='Escape')rlClose();});
  rlBtn.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();var c=curCh();if(RULES[c])rlShow(c);});
  window.showRules=rlShow;

  /* ---------- 剧情电影感字幕 ---------- */
  function applyAccent(){
    var d=document.getElementById('dialogue');if(d)d.style.setProperty('--dlg-accent',accent(curCh()));
    var c8=document.getElementById('ch8-dialogue');if(c8)c8.style.setProperty('--dlg-accent',accent(8));
    rlBtn.style.setProperty('--dlg-accent',accent(curCh()));
  }
  function cine(id){var el=document.getElementById(id);if(el){el.classList.remove('dlg-cineout');el.classList.remove('dlg-cine');void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('dlg-cine');}}
  function cineOut(id){var el=document.getElementById(id);if(el){el.classList.remove('dlg-cine');void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('dlg-cineout');}}
  function vis(id){var e=document.getElementById(id);return !!e&&getComputedStyle(e).display!=='none';}
  function holdMs(len){return Math.min(4200,Math.max(1600,1250+(len||0)*52));}
  var ff=false;
  /* 序～七 自动过场 */
  var aGen=0,aT1=0,aT2=0;
  function clearAuto(){clearTimeout(aT1);clearTimeout(aT2);}
  function autoAdvance(len){
    clearAuto();var g=++aGen;
    aT1=setTimeout(function(){
      if(g!==aGen||!vis('dialogue'))return;
      cineOut('dlg-text');
      aT2=setTimeout(function(){if(g!==aGen||!vis('dialogue'))return;try{window.advanceDlg();}catch(e){}},ff?120:480);
    },ff?180:holdMs(len));
  }
  /* 长按快进：真正"按住"超过阈值才快进；单击 / 轻点（含点「游戏规则」按钮）一律不跳过剧情。 */
  var pressTimer=0, pressing=false;
  function inStoryArea(t){
    // 排除规则按钮 / 各类浮层 / 交互控件，避免点它们时误触发快进
    return !(t && t.closest && t.closest('#rl-reopen,#rl-overlay,#dv-overlay,#rl-card,button,a,input,select,textarea,[role=button]'));
  }
  function kick(){
    ff=true;
    if(vis('dialogue')){clearAuto();var g=++aGen;cineOut('dlg-text');aT2=setTimeout(function(){if(g!==aGen||!vis('dialogue'))return;try{window.advanceDlg();}catch(e){}},120);}
  }
  function unkick(){ff=false;pressing=false;clearTimeout(pressTimer);}
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
    if(!vis('dialogue'))return;
    if(!inStoryArea(e.target))return;          // 点击 UI（如游戏规则）→ 不快进
    pressing=true;clearTimeout(pressTimer);
    pressTimer=setTimeout(function(){ if(pressing&&vis('dialogue'))kick(); },430); // 需按住约 0.43s 才进入快进
  },true);
  document.addEventListener('pointerup',unkick,true);
  document.addEventListener('pointercancel',unkick,true);
  window.addEventListener('blur',unkick);
  var ffHint=document.createElement('div');ffHint.id='dlg-ff-hint';ffHint.textContent='长按快进 ▸▸';
  if(document.body)document.body.appendChild(ffHint);else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){document.body.appendChild(ffHint);});

  /* 序～七：取消逐字打字，整行直接浮现（与开头字幕同款） */
  function hookSetLine(){
    if(typeof window.setLine!=='function')return false;
    if(window.setLine.__cineHooked)return true;
    var orig=window.setLine;
    var w=function(idx){
      var r=orig.apply(this,arguments);
      try{
        var tt=null; try{tt=typeTarget;}catch(e){}
        var el=document.getElementById('dlg-text');
        if(el){ if(tt!=null)el.textContent=tt; cine('dlg-text'); }
        try{ if(tt!=null){ typeShown=tt.length; typeTick=0; } }catch(e){}
        applyAccent();
        autoAdvance(tt!=null?tt.length:((el&&el.textContent)||'').length);
      }catch(e){}
      return r;
    };
    w.__cineHooked=true;window.setLine=w;return true;
  }
  function hookBegin(){
    if(typeof window.beginChapterIntro!=='function')return false;
    if(window.beginChapterIntro.__cineHooked)return true;
    var orig=window.beginChapterIntro;
    var w=function(){var r=orig.apply(this,arguments);try{applyAccent();}catch(e){}return r;};
    w.__cineHooked=true;window.beginChapterIntro=w;return true;
  }
  /* 第八章：整行浮现 + 自动过场（与序～七同款；轮询驱动，避免逐字观察的竞态） */
  function ch8Ref(){ try{ if(typeof CH8!=='undefined'&&CH8) return CH8; }catch(e){} return window.CH8||null; }
  function ch8Advance(){ var C=ch8Ref(); if(C&&C._advanceDlg){ try{C._advanceDlg();}catch(e){} } }
  function ch8AutoCine(){
    var lastLen=0, holdUntil=0, armed=false, advancing=false, gen=0;
    function loop(){
      var box=document.getElementById('ch8-dialogue');
      var el=document.getElementById('ch8-dlg-text');
      var on = box && el && getComputedStyle(box).display!=='none';
      if(on){
        var t=el.textContent||'';
        // 新的一行：setLine 刚写入首字（长度回落到 1）
        if(t.length===1 && lastLen!==1){
          gen++;
          applyAccent();
          ch8Advance();                 // 立即补全整行（取消逐字）
          cine('ch8-dlg-text');
          var full=el.textContent||'';
          holdUntil=performance.now()+holdMs(full.length);
          armed=true; advancing=false;
        } else if(armed && !advancing && performance.now()>=holdUntil){
          armed=false; advancing=true;
          var myGen=gen;
          cineOut('ch8-dlg-text');
          setTimeout(function(){
            advancing=false;
            if(myGen!==gen)return;                 // 期间已切到新行，放弃本次推进
            var b=document.getElementById('ch8-dialogue');
            if(!b||getComputedStyle(b).display==='none')return;
            ch8Advance();                          // 进入下一行
          },480);
        }
        lastLen=(el.textContent||'').length;
      } else { lastLen=0; armed=false; advancing=false; }
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  /* ---------- 规则按钮显隐 ---------- */
  var GAMEPLAY=['controls','controls2','controls3','controls4','controls5','controls6','controls7','ch8-console-hud','phase-experiment'];
  function isVis(el){if(!el)return false;var cs=getComputedStyle(el);if(cs.display==='none'||cs.visibility==='hidden')return false;if(parseFloat(cs.opacity||'1')<0.05)return false;var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return r.width>2&&r.height>2;}
  function anyVis(ids){for(var i=0;i<ids.length;i++)if(isVis(document.getElementById(ids[i])))return true;return false;}
  function summaryVis(){if(isVis(document.getElementById('ch8-summary')))return true;var e=document.querySelectorAll('.ch-summary');for(var i=0;i<e.length;i++)if(isVis(e[i]))return true;return false;}
  function overlayOpen(){var a=document.getElementById('dv-overlay'),b=document.getElementById('rl-overlay');return (a&&getComputedStyle(a).display!=='none')||(b&&getComputedStyle(b).display!=='none');}
  function updateRuleBtn(){
    var c=curCh();
    var show=!!RULES[c]&&anyVis(GAMEPLAY)&&!summaryVis()&&!overlayOpen();
    rlBtn.style.display=show?'flex':'none';
    if(show)rlBtn.style.setProperty('--dlg-accent',accent(c));
    ffHint.style.display=vis('dialogue')?'block':'none';
    // 即时变化：规则浮层打开时，若当前章节进入新阶段（如第五章 phase1→phase2），自动刷新内容
    if(rlOpen&&rlShownIdx===c&&RULES[c]&&RULES[c].phases){
      var ph=rulePhase(c);
      if(ph&&ph.id!==rlShownPhase){
        var sc=rlCard.scrollTop;
        buildRules(c);
        rlCard.scrollTop=sc;
      }
    }
  }
  setInterval(updateRuleBtn,450);

  /* ---------- 初始化 ---------- */
  function init(){ch8AutoCine();applyAccent();}
  if(document.body)init();else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init);
  var tries=0;(function t(){var a=hookSetLine(),b=hookBegin();if((a&&b)||tries>40)return;tries++;setTimeout(t,150);})();
})();
</script>

<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     剧情背景动画（电磁余晖）— 独立模块，可整段删除
     仅在剧情对白阶段显示：分级色罩 + 流动极光带 + 发光电荷粒子 +
     景深光斑 + 偶发放电弧 + 暗角。按章节主题色，requestAnimationFrame 绘制。
     ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';
  var ACC={0:'#37c8ff',1:'#37c8ff',2:'#ff9a3c',3:'#5cf08c',4:'#ffcf4a',5:'#37d8ff',6:'#b06bff',7:'#37c8ff',8:'#e8c270'};
  function curCh(){try{if(typeof window.ch==='number')return window.ch;}catch(e){}return -1;}
  function hex2rgb(h){h=(h||'').replace('#','');return [parseInt(h.substr(0,2),16)||55,parseInt(h.substr(2,2),16)||200,parseInt(h.substr(4,2),16)||255];}
  function rnd(a,b){return a+Math.random()*(b-a);}

  var cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.id='story-bg';
  cv.style.cssText='position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:20;display:none;pointer-events:none;';
  (function attach(){if(document.body)document.body.appendChild(cv);else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',attach);})();
  var cx=cv.getContext('2d');
  var W=1,H=1,DPR=1;
  function resize(){DPR=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);W=window.innerWidth;H=window.innerHeight;cv.width=Math.max(1,W*DPR);cv.height=Math.max(1,H*DPR);cv.style.width=W+'px';cv.style.height=H+'px';cx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);initField();}
  window.addEventListener('resize',resize);

  /* 主题色（平滑过渡） */
  var col=[55,200,255],tgt=[55,200,255];
  function setTheme(c){tgt=hex2rgb(ACC[c]||'#37c8ff');}

  /* 发光精灵（drawImage 比 shadowBlur 快很多） */
  var sprite=document.createElement('canvas'),sctx=sprite.getContext('2d');
  function buildSprite(rgb){var S=64;sprite.width=S;sprite.height=S;var g=sctx.createRadialGradient(S/2,S/2,0,S/2,S/2,S/2);
    g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)');g.addColorStop(0.28,'rgba('+rgb[0]+','+rgb[1]+','+rgb[2]+',0.8)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba('+rgb[0]+','+rgb[1]+','+rgb[2]+',0)');
    sctx.clearRect(0,0,S,S);sctx.fillStyle=g;sctx.fillRect(0,0,S,S);}
  buildSprite(col);
  var whiteSprite=document.createElement('canvas');(function(){var s=64,c=whiteSprite.getContext('2d');whiteSprite.width=s;whiteSprite.height=s;
    var g=c.createRadialGradient(s/2,s/2,0,s/2,s/2,s/2);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)');g.addColorStop(0.32,'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,s,s);})();

  /* 场内元素 */
  var P=[],B=[],R=[],NP=26;
  function newP(init){return {x:rnd(0,W),y:init?rnd(0,H):H+rnd(0,40),vx:rnd(-4,4),vy:rnd(-15,-6),r:rnd(1.4,3.0),a:rnd(0.16,0.46),ph:rnd(0,6.28),sw:rnd(0.3,0.85),hot:Math.random()<0.10};}
  function initField(){
    P=[];for(var i=0;i<NP;i++)P.push(newP(true));
    B=[];for(var j=0;j<3;j++)B.push({x:rnd(0,W),y:rnd(0,H),r:rnd(130,270),vx:rnd(-3,3),vy:rnd(-5,2),a:rnd(0.02,0.045)});
    R=[];for(var k=0;k<2;k++)R.push({y:rnd(0.24,0.8),amp:rnd(26,60),len:rnd(0.8,1.5),sp:rnd(0.05,0.1)*(Math.random()<.5?-1:1),ph:rnd(0,6.28),a:rnd(0.035,0.06),th:rnd(64,140)});
  }
  resize();

  var arc=null,arcT=0,arcLife=0,nextArc=520+Math.random()*600;
  function makeArc(){var x=rnd(0,W),y=rnd(0,H*0.85),pts=[{x:x,y:y}],n=8+(Math.random()*8|0),dir=rnd(0,6.28);
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){dir+=rnd(-0.85,0.85);x+=Math.cos(dir)*rnd(12,42);y+=Math.sin(dir)*rnd(12,42);pts.push({x:x,y:y});}return pts;}

  function visible(){var d=document.getElementById('dialogue'),e=document.getElementById('ch8-dialogue');
    return (d&&getComputedStyle(d).display!=='none')||(e&&getComputedStyle(e).display!=='none');}

  var last=performance.now(),tick=0,env=0;
  function frame(now){
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    var dt=Math.min(50,now-last)/16.67;last=now;
    if(!visible()){if(cv.style.display!=='none')cv.style.display='none';env=0;return;}
    if(cv.style.display==='none')cv.style.display='block';
    tick++;
    env=Math.min(1,env+0.05*dt);   // 整体柔和淡入（剧情开场不再生硬弹出）
    var moved=false;for(var c=0;c<3;c++){var d2=tgt[c]-col[c];if(Math.abs(d2)>0.5){col[c]+=d2*0.06;moved=true;}}
    if(moved&&tick%5===0)buildSprite([col[0]|0,col[1]|0,col[2]|0]);
    var rr=col[0]|0,gg=col[1]|0,bb=col[2]|0;

    cx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

    /* 分级色罩 */
    var bw=cx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    bw.addColorStop(0,'rgba('+(rr*0.18|0)+','+(gg*0.18|0)+','+(bb*0.18|0)+',0.30)');
    bw.addColorStop(0.5,'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)');
    bw.addColorStop(1,'rgba('+(rr*0.12|0)+','+(gg*0.12|0)+','+(bb*0.12|0)+',0.32)');
    cx.fillStyle=bw;cx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    cx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';

    /* 极光带 */
    for(var ri=0;ri<R.length;ri++){var rb=R[ri];rb.ph+=rb.sp*0.02*dt;var yy=rb.y*H;
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(0,yy);
      for(var xx=0;xx<=W;xx+=16){var off=Math.sin(xx*0.006*rb.len+rb.ph)*rb.amp+Math.sin(xx*0.013+rb.ph*1.7)*rb.amp*0.3;cx.lineTo(xx,yy+off);}
      cx.strokeStyle='rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+(rb.a*env)+')';cx.lineWidth=rb.th;cx.lineCap='round';cx.stroke();
    }

    /* 体积光束（god-rays）— 从顶部斜射而下的柔光，缓慢摆动，更有电影质感 */
    for(var gi=0;gi<3;gi++){
      var sway=Math.sin(tick*0.006+gi*2.1)*0.18;
      var ox=W*(0.22+gi*0.30)+Math.sin(tick*0.004+gi)*W*0.04;
      cx.save();
      cx.translate(ox,-H*0.10);
      cx.rotate(0.32+sway+gi*0.05);
      var rayLen=H*1.25, rayW=W*(0.10+gi*0.03);
      var rg=cx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,rayLen);
      var ra=(0.045+gi*0.012)*env;
      rg.addColorStop(0,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+ra+')');
      rg.addColorStop(0.55,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+(ra*0.35)+')');
      rg.addColorStop(1,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+',0)');
      cx.fillStyle=rg;
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(-rayW*0.3,0);cx.lineTo(rayW*0.3,0);cx.lineTo(rayW,rayLen);cx.lineTo(-rayW,rayLen);cx.closePath();cx.fill();
      cx.restore();
    }

    /* 景深光斑 */
    for(var bi=0;bi<B.length;bi++){var bk=B[bi];bk.x+=bk.vx*0.1*dt;bk.y+=bk.vy*0.1*dt;
      if(bk.y<-bk.r){bk.y=H+bk.r;bk.x=rnd(0,W);}if(bk.x<-bk.r)bk.x=W+bk.r;if(bk.x>W+bk.r)bk.x=-bk.r;
      var bg=cx.createRadialGradient(bk.x,bk.y,0,bk.x,bk.y,bk.r);
      bg.addColorStop(0,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+bk.a+')');bg.addColorStop(1,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+',0)');
      cx.fillStyle=bg;cx.fillRect(bk.x-bk.r,bk.y-bk.r,bk.r*2,bk.r*2);
    }

    /* 电荷粒子 */
    for(var pi=0;pi<P.length;pi++){var p=P[pi];p.ph+=0.02*dt;
      p.x+=(p.vx+Math.sin(p.ph)*p.sw)*0.1*dt;p.y+=p.vy*0.1*dt;
      if(p.y<-12||p.x<-24||p.x>W+24){P[pi]=newP(false);continue;}
      var sz=p.r*(p.hot?5:6);
      cx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,p.a*(0.6+0.4*Math.sin(p.ph*2))*env));
      cx.drawImage(p.hot?whiteSprite:sprite,p.x-sz/2,p.y-sz/2,sz,sz);
    }
    cx.globalAlpha=1;

    /* 偶发放电弧（闪电感的「闪光」）——只在雷暴/电塔题材的章节出现，
       其余章节进场保持安静，不再每章都闪。 */
    var _c=curCh(), _storm=(_c===6||_c===7||_c===8);
    if(_storm){
      arcT++;
      if(!arc&&arcT>nextArc){arc=makeArc();arcLife=0;}
      if(arc){arcLife+=dt;var la=Math.max(0,1-arcLife/15);
        if(la<=0){arc=null;arcT=0;nextArc=560+Math.random()*640;}
        else{cx.strokeStyle='rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+(0.30*la)+')';cx.lineWidth=1.4;
          cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(arc[0].x,arc[0].y);for(var ai=1;ai<arc.length;ai++)cx.lineTo(arc[ai].x,arc[ai].y);cx.stroke();}
      }
    } else { arc=null; arcT=0; }

    cx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';

    /* 暗角（聚焦中央、便于阅读） */
    var vg=cx.createRadialGradient(W/2,H*0.55,Math.min(W,H)*0.20,W/2,H*0.55,Math.max(W,H)*0.78);
    vg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');vg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,'+(0.55*env)+')');
    cx.fillStyle=vg;cx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    /* 电影感黑边（letterbox）— 随淡入展开，营造宽银幕过场质感 */
    var lb=Math.round(Math.min(70,H*0.072)*env);

/* ── Victory ── */
#victory { position:fixed; inset:0; display:none; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; text-align:center; pointer-events:none; background:rgba(0,26,44,0); transition:background 2.2s; z-index:95; }

}

/* ── Chapter transition ── */

/* ── Summary ── */
.sum-hd { font-size:15px; letter-spacing:5px; color:#00c8ff; text-align:center; margin-bottom:24px; padding-bottom:14px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,200,255,0.15); }

.sum-kv { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:5px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); font-size:13px; }

.sum-kv .v { color:#c8dce8; }
.sum-mat { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:4px; margin-bottom:5px; font-size:12px; border:1px solid rgba(0,200,255,0.08); }

.formula-block {

/* ── Ch5 Controls — Tesla-era resonance console deck ── */
#controls5 {
  width:100%; max-width:none;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.022) 0 1px, transparent 1px 5px),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#242b3b 0%,#151a28 60%,#0e131e 100%);
  border:2px solid rgba(201,162,75,0.50);
  border-radius:10px; padding:14px 22px 16px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05), inset 0 0 26px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
}
#c5-top { display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:8px; }
#c5-freq-readout {
  font-size:26px; font-weight:bold; color:#00cfff; letter-spacing:1px;
  text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(0,207,255,0.7); font-family:'Courier New',monospace;
}
#c5-target-disp { color:#ffce6a; font-weight:bold; }
#c5-status-msg { font-size:12px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.78); margin-top:3px; letter-spacing:1px; }
#c5-track-wrap { margin-bottom:8px; }
#c5-track-label { font-size:11px; color:rgba(0,207,255,0.55); margin-bottom:4px; letter-spacing:2px; }
#c5-track-bar-bg { background:rgba(0,0,0,0.45); border-radius:3px; height:7px; overflow:hidden; box-shadow:inset 0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); }
#c5-track-bar { height:100%; border-radius:3px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#005a44,#00ffb4); box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,255,180,0.6); transition:width 0.15s; width:0%; }
.c5-srow { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; margin:9px 0 2px; }
.c5-slabel { font-size:12px; width:145px; flex-shrink:0; }
.c5-slabel small { display:block; font-size:10px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.78); margin-top:2px; }
.c5-sval { font-size:13px; width:80px; text-align:right; flex-shrink:0; font-family:'Courier New',monospace; }
#c5-phase-badge {
  display:inline-block; margin-bottom:6px;
  font-size:9px; letter-spacing:4px; padding:4px 12px; border-radius:3px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(64,50,24,0.7),rgba(28,22,12,0.8));
  border:1px solid rgba(201,162,75,0.5);
  color:rgba(232,198,124,0.92); text-transform:uppercase;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}
@keyframes c5LockPulse { 0%,100%{text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(80,255,220,0.5)} 50%{text-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(80,255,220,0.95)} }
#c5-freq-readout.locked { animation:c5LockPulse 0.6s infinite; color:#50ffdc; }
input[type=range].c5-slider {
  -webkit-appearance:none; appearance:none; height:7px; border-radius:4px; outline:none;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(92,66,26,0.95),rgba(44,32,14,0.95));
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 0 1px rgba(201,162,75,0.25);
}
input[type=range].c5-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance:none; width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:50%; cursor:pointer;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 32%, #ffe1a0, #b9801f 75%, #6e4c12);
  box-shadow:0 0 9px rgba(255,170,0,0.85), inset 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}
input[type=range].c5-slider::-moz-range-thumb {
  width:18px; height:18px; border:none; border-radius:50%; cursor:pointer;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 32%, #ffe1a0, #b9801f 75%, #6e4c12);
  box-shadow:0 0 9px rgba(255,170,0,0.85);
}
.c5-lcard {
  flex:1; padding:9px 6px; text-align:center; cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid rgba(201,162,75,0.30); border-radius:5px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(36,42,56,0.96),rgba(18,22,34,0.97));
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05), inset 0 -2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
  transition:all 0.16s; font-size:15px; font-family:inherit; color:rgba(150,180,210,0.7);
  user-select:none; line-height:1.3;
}
.c5-lcard small { display:block; font-size:9px; color:rgba(150,180,210,0.42); margin-top:3px; letter-spacing:1px; }
.c5-lcard:hover:not(.sel) { border-color:rgba(201,162,75,0.55); color:rgba(205,225,245,0.95); }
.c5-lcard.sel {
  border-color:rgba(0,200,255,0.85);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,42,72,0.96),rgba(6,26,50,0.97));
  color:#5cd6ff; box-shadow:inset 0 0 12px rgba(0,180,255,0.32), 0 0 10px rgba(0,180,255,0.30);
  text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(0,200,255,0.7);
}
.c5-lcard.sel small { color:rgba(120,210,255,0.7); }

/* ── Ch6 Controls ── */
#controls6 {
  width:100%; max-width:none; background:rgba(14,8,28,0.94);
  border:1px solid rgba(160,80,255,0.28); padding:12px 20px 14px;
}
#c6-phase-badge { display:inline-block; margin-bottom:5px; font-size:9px; letter-spacing:4px; padding:3px 10px; border-radius:3px; background:rgba(80,20,160,0.40); border:1px solid rgba(160,80,255,0.35); color:rgba(180,100,255,0.80); text-transform:uppercase; }
.c6-srow { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; margin:5px 0; }
.c6-slabel { font-size:12px; width:170px; flex-shrink:0; color:rgba(180,120,255,0.85); }
.c6-slabel small { display:block; font-size:10px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.80); margin-top:2px; }
.c6-sval { font-size:12px; width:52px; text-align:right; flex-shrink:0; color:rgba(180,120,255,0.85); }
input[type=range].c6-slider { background:rgba(160,80,255,0.18); }
input[type=range].c6-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb { background:#a060ff; box-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(160,80,255,0.85); }
#c6-seal-status { font-size:11px; margin-top:3px; }
#c6-heat-bar-wrap { margin-top:8px; }
#c6-heat-bg { background:rgba(255,40,0,0.12); border-radius:3px; height:7px; overflow:hidden; }
#c6-heat-bar { height:100%; width:0%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff6600,#ff0000); border-radius:3px; box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,60,0,0.6); transition:width 0.15s; }
/* Phase-2 console "heating up" glow — escalates with the melt timer */
@keyframes c6HeatPulse { 0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,80,20,0.35);} 50%{box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,90,30,0.55);} }
@keyframes c6CritPulse { 0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,60,10,0.55);} 50%{box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,40,0,0.85);} }
#c6-circuit-panel.c6-hot, #c6-heat-bar-wrap.c6-hot { border-radius:5px; animation:c6HeatPulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
#c6-circuit-panel.c6-critical, #c6-heat-bar-wrap.c6-critical { border-radius:5px; animation:c6CritPulse 0.7s ease-in-out infinite; }
.c6-btn { cursor:pointer; font-size:11px; padding:4px 14px; border:1px solid rgba(160,80,255,0.35); border-radius:3px; color:rgba(180,100,255,0.80); background:rgba(40,10,80,0.50); user-select:none; }
.c6-btn:hover { border-color:rgba(200,120,255,0.65); color:rgba(220,160,255,1); }
/* ── Map debug button ── */
#map-dev { margin-top:14px; padding:10px 14px; border:1px solid rgba(255,190,30,0.18); border-radius:4px; display:none; }
.map-dev-btn { font-size:10px; letter-spacing:2px; color:rgba(255,190,30,0.55); cursor:pointer; border:1px solid rgba(255,190,30,0.22); padding:5px 12px; border-radius:3px; background:rgba(20,14,0,0.60); font-family:inherit; transition:all 0.15s; }
.map-dev-btn:hover { color:rgba(255,210,60,0.95); border-color:rgba(255,190,30,0.55); background:rgba(40,26,0,0.80); }
#map-dev-pw { background:rgba(20,14,0,0.70); border:1px solid rgba(255,190,30,0.30); border-radius:3px; color:rgba(255,210,60,0.85); font-family:inherit; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:2px; padding:4px 10px; width:140px; outline:none; }
#map-dev-pw::placeholder { color:rgba(255,190,30,0.25); letter-spacing:1px; }
#map-dev-pw.err { border-color:rgba(255,60,40,0.70); animation:devShake 0.35s; }
#map-dev-submit { background:rgba(20,14,0,0.70); border:1px solid rgba(255,190,30,0.30); border-radius:3px; color:rgba(255,190,30,0.65); font-family:inherit; font-size:12px; padding:4px 10px; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.15s; }
#map-dev-submit:hover { color:rgba(255,210,60,0.95); border-color:rgba(255,190,30,0.55); }
@keyframes devShake { 0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)} 20%{transform:translateX(-5px)} 60%{transform:translateX(5px)} }

/* ── Ch7 Controls ── */
#controls7 { width:100%; max-width:none; background:rgba(12,10,24,0.94); border:1px solid rgba(255,150,0,0.28); padding:10px 18px 14px; }
#c7-phase-badge,#c7-beam-badge { display:inline-block; margin-bottom:5px; font-size:9px; letter-spacing:4px; padding:3px 10px; border-radius:3px; background:rgba(100,50,0,0.45); border:1px solid rgba(255,150,0,0.35); color:rgba(255,160,60,0.85); text-transform:uppercase; }
.c7-slot { display:inline-block; width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid rgba(255,150,0,0.28); margin-right:5px; vertical-align:middle; transition:all 0.3s; }
.c7-slot.on { background:#ffaa30; border-color:#ffaa30; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,150,0,0.7); }

#c7-beam-badge { font-size:11px; letter-spacing:2px; color:rgba(255,180,50,0.85); }
.c7-beam-hint { font-size:9px; color:rgba(90,215,255,0.72); margin-top:2px; }
#c7-attempts-disp { font-size:13px; letter-spacing:3px; color:rgba(255,200,80,0.80); }
#c7-fire-btn { padding:7px 20px; background:rgba(255,150,0,0.18); border:1.5px solid rgba(255,150,0,0.60); border-radius:4px; color:rgba(255,210,60,0.92); font-family:inherit; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:2px; cursor:pointer; }
#c7-beam-result { font-size:12px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.80); min-width:70px; }
#f-vcp { color:rgba(255,160,40,0.65); }
#f-vc3 { color:rgba(0,200,255,0.65); }
.prog-bg-layered { position:relative; }

.sum-box-scroll--ch3 { background:rgba(2,12,6,0.97); border:1px solid rgba(80,255,140,0.26); scrollbar-color:rgba(80,255,140,0.3) transparent; }
.sum-box-scroll--ch4 { background:rgba(10,7,2,0.97); border:1px solid rgba(255,190,30,0.26); scrollbar-color:rgba(255,190,30,0.3) transparent; }
.sum-box-scroll--ch5 { width:min(620px,92vw); max-height:90vh; background:rgba(2,6,22,0.97); border:1px solid rgba(0,160,255,0.28); scrollbar-color:rgba(0,160,255,0.3) transparent; }
.sum-box-scroll--ch6 { background:rgba(6,2,18,0.97); border:1px solid rgba(160,80,255,0.28); scrollbar-color:rgba(160,80,255,0.3) transparent; }

.sum-close-btn { display:block; margin:20px auto 0; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:3px; padding:9px 28px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; text-align:center; transition:all 0.2s; }
.sum-body-muted { font-size:12px; line-height:1.9; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.64); }

  .ctrl-panel {
    top: auto; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100%; max-width: 100vw;
    transform: none; border-left: none; border-right: none;
    border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0; max-height: min(42vh, 360px);
  }
  #controls, #controls2, #controls3, 

  .ctrl-top { margin-bottom: 9px; }
  .c-readout { font-size: 21px; }
  .c-label, .c-meta { font-size: 10px; }
  .srow { gap: 8px; margin: 7px 0; }
  .slabel { width: auto; flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; font-size: 11px; }
  .slabel small { font-size: 9px; }
  .sval { width: 56px; font-size: 11px; }
  input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

  .c5-srow, .c6-srow { gap: 8px; }
  .c5-slabel, .c6-slabel { width: auto; flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; font-size: 11px; }
  .c5-slabel small, .c6-slabel small { font-size: 9px; }
  .c5-sval { width: 62px; font-size: 11px; }
  .c6-sval { width: 46px; font-size: 11px; }

  #mat-grid { gap: 5px; }
  .mcard { padding: 6px 3px; }
  .mname { font-size: 11px; } .mer { font-size: 9px; } .mdesc { font-size: 8px; line-height: 1.3; }
  .ch2-caps { gap: 6px; }
  .ch2-cap { padding: 7px 8px; }
  .ch2-cap-val { font-size: 16px; }
  #ch2-formula { font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.7; }

  #dialogue { width: 94vw; bottom: 110px; padding: 14px 16px; }
  #dlg-text { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; }
  #dlg-speaker { margin-bottom: 7px; }

  #v-title { font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: 3px; }
  #v-sub { font-size: 13px; }
  #v-btn { margin-top: 22px; }
  #trans-title { font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: 5px; }
  #trans-sub { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 3px; padding: 0 16px; text-align: center; max-width: 94vw; }

    overflow-y: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }
}

/* === craft-gold-shell === */
:root{--font-sans:"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",system-ui,sans-serif;--font-mono:ui-monospace,"Cascadia Code",Consolas,monospace;--font-display:var(--font-sans);--font-formula:"Cambria Math","Times New Roman",serif;--craft-accent:#d4a050;--craft-bg:#141008;--craft-panel:#241c10;--craft-text:#f0e8d4;--craft-muted:#a09070;}
html,body{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;overflow:hidden!important;
  font-family:var(--font-sans)!important;background:var(--craft-bg)!important;color:var(--craft-text)!important;}
#essence-app,#app{background:var(--craft-bg)!important;}
#essence-stage,#stage{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%,rgba(255,255,255,.04),transparent 55%),var(--craft-bg)!important;}
#essence-bench,.control-panel,#controls-area,#bench{background:linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-panel) 92%,#fff),var(--craft-panel))!important;border-left:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 35%,transparent)!important;color:var(--craft-text)!important;}
#essence-bench-hd,.dual-bench-hd,.bench-hd,.ctrl-hd{background:rgba(0,0,0,.25)!important;border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 30%,transparent)!important;}
#essence-bench-hd h1,.bench-hd-title,.ctrl-hd{color:var(--craft-accent)!important;}
#essence-bench .essence-scroll,#essence-bench .essence-ft,.bench-scroll,.ctrl-scroll,.ctrl-ft{background:transparent!important;color:var(--craft-text)!important;}
#essence-bench label,.slider-group label,.slabel{color:var(--craft-muted)!important;}
#essence-bench .btn,button.btn,.pixel-btn,#btnLaunch{background:var(--craft-accent)!important;border:none!important;color:#0b1020!important;font-weight:700!important;border-radius:12px!important;}
#craft-intro,#craft-win{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
}
#craft-intro[hidden],#craft-win[hidden]{display:none!important;}
.craft-card{
  width:min(440px,92vw);background:var(--craft-panel);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 45%,transparent);
  border-radius:18px;padding:22px 22px 18px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
