<script>
/* ===== js/core/registry.js ===== */
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Game shell — chapter registry & navigation
//
//  Chapter API (via Game.register):
//    init()              — enter chapter
//    frame(ctx)          — per-frame render + tick (required)
//    usesCanvas          — true: chapter uses #c canvas (default); Ch8 uses clearCanvas: false
//    clearCanvas         — false: skip clearRect even when usesCanvas is true (Ch8 sky overlay)
//    syncSize()          — optional resize hook
//    skipToPhase2()      — optional dev skip
//    showSummary()       — optional victory epilogue
//    onCanvasClick/Move/Down/Up/RightClick — optional input hooks
//    onCanvasTouchStart/Move/End — optional touch hooks
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
window.Game = window.Game || {
  ch: 0,
  chapters: [],

  register(index, api) {
    this.chapters[index] = api;
  },

  getModule(n) {
    return this.chapters[n] || null;
  }
};

Object.defineProperty(window, 'ch', {
  get() { return Game.ch; },
  set(v) { Game.ch = v; },
  configurable: true
});

(function (Game) {
  Game.frame = function (ctx) {
    const mod = Game.getModule(Game.ch);
    if (!mod || !mod.frame) return false;
    if (mod.usesCanvas !== false && mod.clearCanvas !== false) ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    mod.frame(ctx);
    return true;
  };

  Game.syncActiveChapterSize = function () {
    const mod = Game.getModule(Game.ch);
    if (mod && mod.syncSize) mod.syncSize();
  };

  Game.dispatchCanvas = function (hook, ...args) {
    const mod = Game.getModule(Game.ch);
    if (mod && typeof mod[hook] === 'function') mod[hook](...args);
  };

  Game._jumpToCore = function (n) {
    if (typeof resetChapterUI === 'function') resetChapterUI();
    Game.ch = n;
    if (typeof SFX !== 'undefined' && SFX.scene) SFX.scene(n); // ambient per chapter
    const mod = Game.getModule(n);
    if (mod && mod.init) mod.init();
    if (typeof saveGameProgress === 'function') saveGameProgress();
  };

  Game.jumpTo = function (n) {
    Game.ensureChapter(n).then(() => {
      Game._jumpToCore(n);
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.error(err);
    });
  };
})(window.Game);

function jumpToChapter(n) {
  Game.jumpTo(n);
}

</script>
<script>
/* ===== js/core/chapter-loader.js ===== */
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Lazy chapter script / Ch8 CSS loader
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
(function (Game) {
  const loadedScripts = new Set();
  let ch8CssLoaded = false;
  let ch8BundleLoaded = false;

  const CHAPTER_SCRIPTS = {
    0: ['js/chapters/ch0.js'],
    1: ['js/chapters/ch1.js'],
    2: ['js/chapters/ch2.js'],
    3: ['js/chapters/ch3.js'],
    4: ['js/chapters/ch4.js'],
    5: ['js/chapters/ch5.js'],
    6: [
      'js/chapters/ch6/state.js',
      'js/chapters/ch6/armor.js',
      'js/chapters/ch6/circuit.js',
      'js/chapters/ch6/main.js',
    ],
    7: [
      'js/chapters/ch7/state.js',
      'js/chapters/ch7/phase1.js',
      'js/chapters/ch7/iso.js',
      'js/chapters/ch7/main.js',
    ],
  };

  const CH8_SCRIPTS = [
    'js/chapters/ch8/init.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/experiment.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/phase-3-transition-lab-d.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/phase-4-the-console.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/pulse-resolution-single.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/sky.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/climax.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/main.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/assemble.js',
  ];

  function loadScript(src) {
    if (loadedScripts.has(src)) return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const el = document.createElement('script');
      el.src = src;
      el.onload = () => {
        loadedScripts.add(src);
        resolve();
      };
      el.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load ' + src));
      document.body.appendChild(el);
    });
  }

  function loadScriptsSequential(urls) {
    return urls.reduce(
      (chain, url) => chain.then(() => loadScript(url)),
      Promise.resolve()
    );
  }

  function ensureCh8Css() {
    if (ch8CssLoaded) return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const link = document.createElement('link');
      link.rel = 'stylesheet';
      link.href = 'css/ch8.css';
      link.onload = () => {
        ch8CssLoaded = true;
        resolve();
      };
      link.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load css/ch8.css'));
      document.head.appendChild(link);
    });
  }

  Game.ensureChapter = function (n) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 0 || n > 8) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error('Invalid chapter: ' + n));
    }
    if (Game.getModule(n)) return Promise.resolve();

    if (n === 8) {
      if (ch8BundleLoaded) return Promise.resolve();
      return ensureCh8Css()
        .then(() => loadScriptsSequential(CH8_SCRIPTS))
        .then(() => {
          ch8BundleLoaded = true;
        });
    }

    const urls = CHAPTER_SCRIPTS[n];
    if (!urls) return Promise.reject(new Error('No scripts for chapter ' + n));
    return loadScriptsSequential(urls);
  };
})(window.Game);

</script>
<script>
/* ===== js/core/audio.js ===== */
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Procedural SFX — single AudioContext, zero files
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const STORAGE_KEY = 'nus-capacitor-era-sfx-v1';
  const TICK_MS = 45;

  let ctx = null;
  let master = null;     // global volume/mute gain
  let comp = null;       // safety compressor before destination
  let sfxBus = null;     // all one-shot SFX route here
  let muted = false;
  let volume = 1;
  const tickLast = {};

  function loadSettings() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (!raw) return;
      const s = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (typeof s.muted === 'boolean') muted = s.muted;
      if (typeof s.volume === 'number') volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s.volume));
    } catch (_) {}
    updateUi();
    syncMusic();
  }

  function saveSettings() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ muted, volume }));
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  function applyMaster() {
    if (!master) return;
    master.gain.value = muted ? 0 : volume;
  }

  // The top speaker button is the single master audio control: keep the
  // background-music engine (window.MUSIC, defined in music.js) in lockstep
  // with the SFX mute state so one click silences / restores everything.
  function syncMusic() {
    try {
      if (window.MUSIC && typeof window.MUSIC.applyVolume === 'function') {
        window.MUSIC.applyVolume(muted ? 0 : volume);
      } else if (window.MUSIC && typeof window.MUSIC.setOn === 'function') {
        window.MUSIC.setOn(!muted);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  function ensure() {
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AC) return false;
    if (!ctx) {
      ctx = new AC();
      master = ctx.createGain();
      comp = ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();   // tame overlapping peaks
      comp.threshold.value = -10;
      comp.knee.value = 18;
      comp.ratio.value = 4;
      comp.attack.value = 0.003;
      comp.release.value = 0.25;
      sfxBus = ctx.createGain();
      sfxBus.gain.value = 1;
      sfxBus.connect(master);
      master.connect(comp);
      comp.connect(ctx.destination);
      applyMaster();
    }
    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
    return true;
  }

  function setVolume(v) {
    volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
    if (volume <= 0) muted = true;
    else muted = false;
    applyMaster();
    syncMusic();
    saveSettings();
    updateUi();
  }

  function setMuted(m) {
    muted = m;
    applyMaster();
    syncMusic();
    saveSettings();
    updateUi();
  }

  function toggleMute() {
    setMuted(!muted);
  }

  function cycleVolume() {
    if (muted || volume <= 0.01) {
      muted = false;
      volume = 1;
    } else if (volume > 0.6) {
      volume = 0.5;
    } else {
      muted = true;
    }
    applyMaster();
    syncMusic();
    saveSettings();
    updateUi();
  }

  function syncVolumeSlider() {
    const slider = document.getElementById('audio-volume');
    if (!slider) return;
    slider.value = String(Math.round(volume * 100));
    slider.disabled = false;
  }

  function updateUi() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('sfx-btn');
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.textContent = muted ? '\u{1F507}' : (volume < 0.99 ? '\u{1F509}' : '\u{1F50A}');
    btn.title = muted
      ? '\u97F3\u6548\uFF1A\u9759\u97F3\uFF08\u70B9\u51FB\u6062\u590D \u00b7 \u62D6\u52A8\u6ED1\u5757\u8C03\u8282\uFF09'
      : `\u97F3\u6548\uFF1A${Math.round(volume * 100)}%\uFF08\u70B9\u51FB\u9759\u97F3 \u00b7 \u62D6\u52A8\u6ED1\u5757\u8C03\u8282\uFF09`;
    btn.classList.toggle('muted', muted);
    syncVolumeSlider();
  }

  // Interactive controls that should give a faint hover blip.
  const HOVER_SEL = 'button, .c6-btn, .c5-lcard, .map-node.clickable, .map-dev-btn,' +
    ' #v-btn, #map-btn, #map-close, #c3-start-btn, #c3-activate-btn, #c4-discharge-btn,' +
    ' [id^="sum"][id$="-close"], #ch8-sum-close';

  function initUi() {
    // Delegated hover feedback across all interactive controls.
    document.addEventListener('pointerover', (e) => {
      if (muted) return;
      const t = e.target;
      if (t && t.closest && t.closest(HOVER_SEL)) tick('uiHover', 80);
    }, true);

    const btn = document.getElementById('sfx-btn');
    const slider = document.getElementById('audio-volume');
    if (slider) {
      slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
        ensure();
        const v = parseInt(slider.value, 10) / 100;
        volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
        if (volume > 0) muted = false;
        else muted = true;
        applyMaster();
        syncMusic();
        saveSettings();
        updateUi();
      });
      slider.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
    }
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      ensure();
      if (e.shiftKey) cycleVolume();
      else toggleMute();
    });
    updateUi();
  }

  function t0() { return ctx ? ctx.currentTime : 0; }

  // ── Core synth primitive ────────────────────────────────
  // opts: { type, freq, freqEnd, gain, attack, dur, delay, detune,
  //         filter:{type,freq,q} }
  function voice(opts) {
    if (!ensure() || muted) return;
    const o = opts || {};
    const start = t0() + (o.delay || 0);
    const gain = o.gain != null ? o.gain : 0.05;
    const attack = o.attack != null ? o.attack : 0.008;
    const dur = o.dur != null ? o.dur : 0.2;
    const f0 = o.freq || 440;
    const f1 = o.freqEnd != null ? o.freqEnd : f0;

    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    osc.type = o.type || 'sine';
    if (o.detune) osc.detune.value = o.detune;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0, start);
    if (f1 !== f0) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(1, f1), start + dur);

    const g = ctx.createGain();
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, start);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.0002, gain), start + attack);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, start + dur);

    if (o.filter) {
      const flt = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      flt.type = o.filter.type || 'lowpass';
      flt.frequency.value = o.filter.freq || 1200;
      if (o.filter.q != null) flt.Q.value = o.filter.q;
      osc.connect(flt);
      flt.connect(g);
    } else {
      osc.connect(g);
    }
    g.connect(sfxBus);
    osc.start(start);
    osc.stop(start + dur + 0.03);
  }

  // Soft chord/pad of stacked voices with optional spread + detune.
  function chord(freqs, opts) {
    const o = opts || {};
    const n = freqs.length;
    freqs.forEach((f, i) => voice({
      type: o.type || 'sine',
      freq: f,
      gain: o.gain != null ? o.gain : 0.05,
      attack: o.attack != null ? o.attack : 0.01,
      dur: o.dur != null ? o.dur : 0.4,
      delay: (o.spread || 0) * i,
      detune: (i - (n - 1) / 2) * (o.detune || 0),
      filter: o.filter ? { type: 'lowpass', freq: o.filter } : null,
    }));
  }

  // Short, lightly filtered plucked note (ticks / keys / gears).
  function pluck(freq, opts) {
    const o = opts || {};
    const gain = o.gain != null ? o.gain : 0.05;
    const dur = o.dur != null ? o.dur : 0.08;
    voice({
      type: o.type || 'triangle',
      freq, gain, attack: 0.003, dur,
      filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: o.filter || 2200 },
    });
    if (o.harmonic) {
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: freq * 2, gain: gain * 0.4, attack: 0.003, dur: dur * 0.7 });
    }
  }

  // Cheap reverb-ish tail: a few decaying, low-passed echoes.
  function tail(freq, gain, dur) {
    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
      voice({
        type: 'sine', freq,
        gain: gain * Math.pow(0.5, i),
        attack: 0.01, dur,
        delay: i * 0.11,
        filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1600 },
      });
    }
  }

  // Filtered noise burst. opts: { q, curve, tame, filterType, smooth }
  // The raw signal is a one-pole-smoothed noise (softer "air" rather than
  // harsh static) with a non-linear decay and a soft attack to kill clicks;
  // a fixed lowpass ("tame") shaves the fizz off the top end.
  function noiseBurst(gain, dur, filterFreq, opts) {
    if (!ensure() || muted) return;
    const o = opts || {};
    const start = t0();
    const len = Math.ceil(ctx.sampleRate * dur);
    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, len, ctx.sampleRate);
    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
    const smooth = o.smooth != null ? o.smooth : 0.4; // 1 = white, →0 = darker
    const curve = o.curve != null ? o.curve : 2;      // higher = faster, softer tail
    let prev = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
      prev += smooth * ((Math.random() * 2 - 1) - prev);
      d[i] = prev * Math.pow(1 - i / len, curve);
    }
    const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = buf;
    const g = ctx.createGain();
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, start);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.0002, gain), start + 0.006); // soft attack
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, start + dur);
    let node = src;
    if (filterFreq) {
      const flt = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      flt.type = o.filterType || 'bandpass';
      flt.frequency.value = filterFreq;
      flt.Q.value = o.q != null ? o.q : 0.7;
      node.connect(flt);
      node = flt;
    }
    const tame = ctx.createBiquadFilter();   // gentle high cut → no grit/fizz
    tame.type = 'lowpass';
    tame.frequency.value = o.tame || 3000;
    tame.Q.value = 0.5;
    node.connect(tame);
    tame.connect(g);
    g.connect(sfxBus);
    src.start(start);
  }

  // Legacy single-tone helper (kept for compatibility), now softened
  // with a short attack + lowpass and routed through the SFX bus.
  function tone(type, freq, gain, dur) {
    voice({ type, freq, gain, attack: 0.006, dur, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: Math.min(6000, freq * 5 + 600) } });
  }

  function arpeggio(freqs, gain, step) {
    freqs.forEach((f, i) => voice({
      type: 'triangle', freq: f, gain,
      attack: 0.006, dur: step * 1.7, delay: i * step,
      filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: Math.min(5000, f * 4) },
    }));
  }

  // tiny random detune (cents) so repeated ticks don't feel mechanical
  function jit(c) { return (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (c || 6); }

  const PRESETS = {
    // ── UI ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    uiClick: () => pluck(330, { gain: 0.06, dur: 0.07, filter: 1500, harmonic: true }),
    uiHover: () => voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 900, gain: 0.016, attack: 0.004, dur: 0.05,
                           filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 2600 } }),
    uiOpen: () => {
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 520, gain: 0.05, dur: 0.1, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1900 } });
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 780, gain: 0.04, dur: 0.13, delay: 0.05, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 2300 } });
    },
    uiClose: () => {
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 660, gain: 0.045, dur: 0.1, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 2000 } });
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 420, gain: 0.04, dur: 0.13, delay: 0.05, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1500 } });
    },
    dlgAdvance: () => pluck(560, { gain: 0.038, dur: 0.06, filter: 1900 }),

    // ── Win / transitions ────────────────────────────────
    winFanfare: () => {
      arpeggio([261.63, 329.63, 392, 523.25], 0.07, 0.12);
      tail(523.25, 0.05, 0.5);
    },
    chapterTransition: () => {
      voice({ type: 'sawtooth', freq: 90, freqEnd: 60, gain: 0.05, dur: 0.45, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 600 } });
      chord([110, 164.81, 220], { type: 'triangle', gain: 0.03, dur: 0.6, detune: 5 });
    },

    // ── Sliders / ticks ──────────────────────────────────
    sliderTick: () => voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 760, detune: jit(), gain: 0.024, attack: 0.002, dur: 0.03,
                              filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 3000 } }),
    sliderEdge: () => pluck(440, { gain: 0.05, dur: 0.09, filter: 1400, harmonic: true }),
    errorBuzz: () => {
      // soft low "no" — a muffled minor-second wobble instead of a raw saw rasp
      voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 174.61, freqEnd: 146.83, gain: 0.055, dur: 0.18, detune: -6, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 620 } });
      voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 185, freqEnd: 155.56, gain: 0.04, dur: 0.18, detune: 7, delay: 0.015, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 560 } });
    },
    breakdownZap: () => {
      // capacitor breakdown — a tamed crackle plus a pitched discharge "tzap"
      noiseBurst(0.06, 0.08, 2000, { q: 1.3, tame: 2600 });
      voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 1400, freqEnd: 320, gain: 0.05, dur: 0.09, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 2200 } });
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 660, gain: 0.03, dur: 0.13, delay: 0.02, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1300 } });
    },
    bandEnter: () => { voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 640, gain: 0.06, dur: 0.14 }); tail(640, 0.03, 0.3); },
    puzzleComplete: () => { arpeggio([523.25, 659.25, 783.99], 0.06, 0.09); tail(783.99, 0.04, 0.4); },

  // ambient-pad layer that used to live here was removed so the two
  // music beds never play on top of each other and bleed between

  // per-chapter calls (registry, prologue, victory) keep working.
  function scene() {}
  function stopScene() {}

  function play(preset) {
    if (muted) return;
    const fn = PRESETS[preset];
    if (fn) fn();
  }

  function tick(preset, ms) {
    if (muted) return;
    const interval = ms != null ? ms : TICK_MS;
    const now = performance.now();
    if (tickLast[preset] && now - tickLast[preset] < interval) return;
    tickLast[preset] = now;
    play(preset);
  }

  function edge(key, cond, preset) {
    if (!window._sfxEdge) window._sfxEdge = {};
    const prev = window._sfxEdge[key];
    window._sfxEdge[key] = !!cond;
    if (cond && !prev) play(preset);
    return !!cond;
  }

  function bindGestureUnlock() {
    const unlock = () => {
      ensure();
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', unlock, true);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', unlock, true);
    };
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', unlock, true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', unlock, true);
  }

  window.SFX = {
    ensure,
    play,
    tick,
    edge,
    scene,
    stopScene,
    setVolume,
    setMuted,
    toggleMute,
    cycleVolume,
    loadSettings,
    saveSettings,
    get muted() { return muted; },
    get volume() { return volume; },
  };

  loadSettings();
  bindGestureUnlock();
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initUi);
  } else {
    initUi();
  }
})();

const UNLOCKED_CH = 9;
let completedChapters = new Set();

/* ===== js/core/progress.js ===== */
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Local progress persistence (localStorage)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
const PROGRESS_KEY = 'nus-capacitor-era-v1';

function saveGameProgress() {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(PROGRESS_KEY, JSON.stringify({
      v: 1,
      completed: [...completedChapters].sort((a, b) => a - b),
      chapter: Game.ch,
      devUnlocked: !!devUnlocked,
    }));
  } catch (_) { /* quota / private browsing */ }
}

function loadGameProgress() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(PROGRESS_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const data = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!data || data.v !== 1 || !Array.isArray(data.completed)) return null;
    return data;
  } catch (_) {
    return null;
  }
}

function applyGameProgress(data) {
  if (!data) return;
  completedChapters.clear();
  for (const i of data.completed) {
    if (Number.isInteger(i) && i >= 0 && i < UNLOCKED_CH) completedChapters.add(i);
  }
  devUnlocked = !!data.devUnlocked;
}

function getProgressResumeChapter(data) {
  const n = data.chapter;
  if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 0 || n >= UNLOCKED_CH) return 0;
  return n;
}

function markChapterComplete(idx) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(idx) || idx < 0 || idx >= UNLOCKED_CH) return;
  completedChapters.add(idx);
  saveGameProgress();
}

function resetGameProgress() {
  if (!confirm('确定要重置所有进度吗？\n已完成的章节记录将被清除，将回到序章。')) return;
  try { localStorage.removeItem(PROGRESS_KEY); } catch (_) {}
  completedChapters.clear();
  devUnlocked = false;
  closeMap();
  Game.jumpTo(0);
}

<script>
/* ===== js/core/canvas-world.js ===== */
// ── City ─────────────────────────────────────
let buildings = [];
function genCity() {
  buildings = []; let sx = 0x2A3F91;
  function r() { sx^=sx<<13; sx^=sx>>17; sx^=sx<<5; return (sx>>>0)/4294967296; }
  let x = 0; const gY = typeof getCityGroundY === 'function' ? getCityGroundY() : H * 0.58;
  const towerXs = TOWER_FX.map(fx => fx * W);
  const CLEAR = 62, NEAR = 170; // px: clear zone / near-tower influence zone
  while (x < W + 10) {
    const w=30+r()*54, h=65+r()*(H*0.33);
    const bCx = x + w/2;
    // Skip buildings that would overlap a tower silhouette
    if (!towerXs.some(tx => Math.abs(bCx - tx) < CLEAR)) {
      const fc=Math.max(2,Math.floor(h/22)), cc=Math.max(1,Math.floor(w/14));
      const wins=[];
      for(let f=0;f<fc;f++) for(let c=0;c<cc;c++) wins.push({f,c,lit:r()>0.42});
      const nearTower = towerXs.some(tx => Math.abs(bCx - tx) < NEAR);
      buildings.push({x,w,h,fc,cc,wins,nearTower});
    }
    x+=w+3+r()*8;
  }
}
function drawCity() {
  const gY = typeof getCityGroundY === 'function' ? getCityGroundY() : H * 0.58;
  for (const b of buildings) {
    const top = gY - b.h;
    ctx.fillStyle='#0c0c1e'; ctx.fillRect(b.x,top,b.w,b.h);
    ctx.fillStyle='#181830'; ctx.fillRect(b.x,top,b.w,2);
    // Buildings near towers lose power when breakdown danger rises
    const bMult = (ch===1 && b.nearTower && phase!=='win')
      ? Math.max(0.08, 1 - dangerPulse * 0.94) : 1.0;
    const ww=Math.max(3,(b.w/b.cc)*0.44), wh=4;
    for (const win of b.wins) {
      const wx=b.x+(win.c+0.28)*(b.w/b.cc), wy=top+10+win.f*((b.h-12)/b.fc);
      const br=Math.max(CITY_BRIGHT_MIN*0.55,cityBright)*bMult*(win.lit?1.0:CITY_WIN_UNLIT);
      if(br<0.01) continue;
      if(win.lit&&br>0.25){ctx.shadowColor=`rgba(255,200,80,${br*0.55})`;ctx.shadowBlur=5;}
      ctx.fillStyle=win.lit?`rgba(255,${Math.floor(215*br)},${Math.floor(70*br)},${br})`:`rgba(${Math.floor(90*br)},${Math.floor(70*br)},${Math.floor(50*br)},${br})`;
      ctx.fillRect(wx,wy,ww,wh); ctx.shadowBlur=0;
    }
  }
}

// ── Signal towers (ch1) ──────────────────────
const TOWER_FX = [0.20, 0.62, 0.85];
function drawTowers() {
  if (ch !== 1) return;
  const gY = typeof getCityGroundY === 'function' ? getCityGroundY() : H * 0.58;
  const bd = broken();
  const isWin = phase === 'win';

  for (let ti=0; ti<TOWER_FX.length; ti++) {
    const tx = TOWER_FX[ti] * W;
    const tH = 130 + ti * 40;
    const tW = 9;

    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111128'; ctx.fillRect(tx-tW/2, gY-tH, tW, tH);
    // Cross struts
    for (let k=0.3; k<1; k+=0.28) {
      ctx.fillStyle='#1a1a32'; ctx.fillRect(tx-tW*1.5, gY-tH*k-2, tW*3, 2);
    }
    // Antenna
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx,gY-tH-40); ctx.lineTo(tx-2,gY-tH); ctx.lineTo(tx+2,gY-tH); ctx.fillStyle='#20203a'; ctx.fill();

    if (isWin) {
      // Blue glow on victory
      const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(tick*0.05+ti*2);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, gY-tH-40, 4+pulse*2, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(0,200,255,${0.6+pulse*0.4})`; ctx.shadowColor='rgba(0,200,255,0.9)'; ctx.shadowBlur=16; ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur=0;
      // Ring pulse
      const ring = (tick*0.8+ti*60) % 120;
      const rAlpha = Math.max(0, 1-ring/120)*0.5;
      if (rAlpha>0.02){
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, gY-tH-40, ring*0.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(0,200,255,${rAlpha})`; ctx.lineWidth=1.5; ctx.stroke();
      }
    } else {

// ── Capacitor ────────────────────────────────
function geom() {
  const cx = W / 2;
  const nA = Math.min(1, areaCm2 / 300), nD = distMm / 10;
  const pw = 180 + nA * (Math.min(W * 0.52, 370) - 180), ph = 12;
  let gap = 26 + nD * 85;
  const labelDrop = ch === 0 ? 48 : 50;
  let cy;

  if (ch === 0 || ch === 1) {
    const pf = typeof getCapPlayfield === 'function'
      ? getCapPlayfield()
      : { safeTop: H * 0.58 + 12, safeBottom: H - 16 };
    const safeTop = pf.safeTop;
    const safeBottom = pf.safeBottom;
    const availH = Math.max(60, safeBottom - safeTop);
    const maxGap = availH - 2 * ph - labelDrop - 8;
    if (maxGap < gap) gap = Math.max(26, maxGap);
    const assemblyH = gap + 2 * ph + labelDrop;
    const slack = Math.max(0, availH - assemblyH);
    const slackBias = phase === 'win' ? 0.5 : 0.85;
    cy = safeTop + ph + gap / 2 + slack * slackBias;
    const minCy = safeTop + ph + gap / 2;
    const maxCy = safeBottom - (gap / 2 + ph + labelDrop);
    cy = Math.min(maxCy, Math.max(minCy, cy));
  } else {
    cy = H * 0.705;
  }

  return { cx, cy, pw, ph, gap, topY: cy - gap / 2 - ph, botY: cy + gap / 2, gx: cx - pw / 2, gy: cy - gap / 2, gw: pw, gh: gap };
}

}

// ── shared drawing helpers (game-grade) ───────────────────────────────
function ciCol(c, a) { return `rgba(${c[0]},${c[1]},${c[2]},${a})`; }
function ciLite(c, d) { return [Math.min(255, c[0] + d), Math.min(255, c[1] + d), Math.min(255, c[2] + d)]; }
function ciRR(x, y, w, h, r) {

  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);

// soft 3-stop radial glow

  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, r * 0.04, cx, cy, r);
  g.addColorStop(0, ciCol(col, a));

}
// beveled lit metal panel
function ciPanel(x, y, w, h, r, c1, c2, edge) {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x, y + h);

// lightning bolt: wide halo + bright core
// Fractal lightning path via midpoint displacement: recursively split each segment
// and nudge the midpoint *perpendicular* to it (so a near-vertical bolt jitters
// sideways and never folds back), giving organic detail at many scales. Shared by
// ciBolt and ciBoltLive so all lightning in the game looks consistent.
function ciBoltPoints(x1, y1, x2, y2, jit, seedN, levels) {
  let s = ((seedN || 0) * 2749 + 13) >>> 0;
  const rnd = () => { s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff; return s / 0x7fffffff; };
  let pts = [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]];

function getCtrlPanelInset() {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const ids = ['controls','controls2','controls3','controls4','controls5','controls6','controls7'];
  let panel = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    const el = document.getElementById(ids[i]);
    if (el && getComputedStyle(el).display !== 'none') { panel = el; break; }
  }
  if (!panel) {
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-h', '0px');
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-w', '0px');
    return 0;
  }
  const narrow = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 560px)').matches;
  const rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
  if (narrow) {
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-w', '0px');
    const h = rect.height;
    if (h > 0) {
      root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-h', h + 'px');
      return h + 14;
    }
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-h', '0px');
    return 0;
  }
  const w = rect.width;
  root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-h', '0px');
  if (w > 0) {
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-w', w + 'px');
    return 0;
  }
  root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-w', '0px');
  return 0;
}

  const bottomInset = getCtrlPanelInset();

    safeTop: cityLine + 12,
    safeBottom: H - bottomInset - margin,
  };
}

  const base = H * 0.58;
  if (ch !== 0 && ch !== 1) return base;
  const bottomInset = getCtrlPanelInset();
  const capReserve = 145;
  if (bottomInset > 0) {
    return Math.min(base, H - bottomInset - capReserve);

  return base;
}

function updateCh1Atmosphere() {
  const bd = won === false && phase === 'puzzle' && broken();
  let targetStorm = 0, targetDanger = 0;
  if      (phase === 'win')    targetStorm = Math.max(0, stormIntensity - 0.004);
  else if (phase === 'puzzle') targetStorm = bd ? 0.95 : 0.50;
  else                         targetStorm = dlgIdx <= 1 ? 0.88 : 0.72;
  targetDanger = bd ? Math.min(1, dangerPulse + 0.04) : Math.max(0, dangerPulse - 0.025);
  stormIntensity += (targetStorm - stormIntensity) * 0.013;
  dangerPulse    += (targetDanger - dangerPulse) * 0.04;
  if (flashTimer > 0) flashTimer--;
  return bd;
}

function drawSharedWorld(ctx, opts) {
  const bd = opts && opts.bd;
  const calm = opts && opts.calm;
  drawSky();

  boltT--;
  const boltInterval = calm
    ? 50 + Math.random() * 120
    : bd ? 6 + Math.random() * 10
    : stormIntensity > 0.7 ? 12 + Math.random() * 20
    : 35 + Math.random() * 65;
  if (boltT <= 0) {
    boltT = boltInterval;
    if (phase !== 'win' || stormIntensity > 0.1) spawnBolt();
  }
  for (let i = bolts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (--bolts[i].life <= 0) bolts.splice(i, 1);
  if (bolts.length > 0) {
    const ml = Math.max(...bolts.map(b => b.life));
    const fr = Math.floor((dangerPulse > 0.3 ? 130 : 100) * ml / 30);
    const fg = Math.floor(175 * (1 - dangerPulse * 0.4) * ml / 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${fr},${fg},255,${(ml / 30) * .11})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  drawCity();
  drawTowers();
  drawLightning();
  drawGround();
  drawDangerOverlay();
  drawFlash();
}

function tickCanvasIntroAndDlg() {
  if ((phase === 'dlg' || phase === 'intro') && typeTarget && typeShown < typeTarget.length) {
    if (++typeTick >= TSPEED) { typeTick = 0; typeShown++; }
    document.getElementById('dlg-text').textContent = typeTarget.slice(0, typeShown);
  }
  if (phase === 'intro') {
    introTick++;
    if (introTick >= INTRO) {
      phase = 'dlg';
      dlgIdx = 0;
      setLine(0);
      document.getElementById('dialogue').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('chapter-badge').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('chapter-badge').textContent = CH_NAMES[ch];
    }
  }
}

function finishCanvasWinFrame() {
  if (phase === 'win') tgtBright = 1;
}

function frameCanvasChapter(ctx, hooks = {}) {
  syncIntroTitleOverlay();
  let worldOpts = hooks.worldOpts;
  if (hooks.beforeWorld) {
    const extra = hooks.beforeWorld();
    if (extra && extra.worldOpts !== undefined) worldOpts = extra.worldOpts;
  }
  tickCityBrightness();
  const inIntroCine = (phase === 'intro' || phase === 'dlg')
    && ch >= 1 && ch <= 6
    && typeof CH_INTRO_THEME !== 'undefined' && CH_INTRO_THEME[ch];
  if (inIntroCine) drawChapterIntro(ctx);
  else if (hooks.customWorld) hooks.customWorld(ctx);
  else drawSharedWorld(ctx, worldOpts);
  if (!inIntroCine && hooks.afterWorld) hooks.afterWorld(ctx);
  if (hooks.midFrame) hooks.midFrame(ctx);
  if (!inIntroCine && hooks.puzzleDraw) hooks.puzzleDraw(ctx);
  tickCanvasIntroAndDlg();
  finishCanvasWinFrame();
}

  const loPct = (CH2_TARGET * CH2_WIN_LO / CH2_MAXBAR) * 100;
  const hiPct = (CH2_TARGET * CH2_WIN_HI / CH2_MAXBAR) * 100;
  const midPct = (CH2_TARGET / CH2_MAXBAR) * 100;
  const band = document.getElementById('prog2-win-band');
  if (band) {
    band.style.left = loPct + '%';
    band.style.width = (hiPct - loPct) + '%';
    band.classList.toggle('ok', ch2InTargetBand(ct) && ch2IsSafe());
  }
  const loMk = document.getElementById('prog2-win-lo');
  const hiMk = document.getElementById('prog2-win-hi');
  const tgtMk = document.getElementById('prog2-tgt');
  const dngMk = document.getElementById('prog2-danger');
  if (loMk) loMk.style.left = loPct + '%';
  if (hiMk) hiMk.style.left = hiPct + '%';
  if (tgtMk) tgtMk.style.left = midPct + '%';
  if (dngMk) dngMk.style.left = (CH2_OVERLOAD / CH2_MAXBAR * 100) + '%';
  const lbl = document.getElementById('prog2-lbl-mid');
  if (lbl) {
    lbl.textContent = `过关 ${Math.round(CH2_TARGET * CH2_WIN_LO)}–${Math.round(CH2_TARGET * CH2_WIN_HI)} µF`;
  }
  const fill = document.getElementById('prog2');
  if (fill) {
    fill.style.width = Math.min(100, ct / CH2_MAXBAR * 100) + '%';
    if (anyFault) {
      fill.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg,#7a2000,#ff6020)';
    } else if (ch2InTargetBand(ct)) {
      fill.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg,#3a5800,#50ff8c)';
      fill.style.boxShadow = '0 0 11px rgba(80,255,140,0.55)';
    } else {
      fill.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg,#7a3800,#ffb040)';
      fill.style.boxShadow = '0 0 9px rgba(255,160,40,0.45)';
    }
  }
}

function syncCh2UI() {
  const cp  = c2_c1 + c2_c2;
  const ct  = calcCh2Total();
  const E   = ch2Energy(ct);
  const { V_Cp, V_C3 } = calcCh2Voltages();
  const ovl = ct > CH2_OVERLOAD;
  const bCp = V_Cp > CH2_VRATED;
  const bC3 = V_C3 > CH2_VRATED;
  const anyFault = ovl || bCp || bC3;
  const tgt = CH2_TARGET;

  document.getElementById('c2v-1').textContent = c2_c1 + ' µF';
  document.getElementById('c2v-2').textContent = c2_c2 + ' µF';
  document.getElementById('c2v-3').textContent = c2_c3 + ' µF';
  document.getElementById('f-cp').textContent  = measuredCh2 == null ? '—' : String(cp);
  document.getElementById('f-ct').textContent  = measuredCh2 == null ? '—' : measuredCh2.ct.toFixed(1);
  document.getElementById('f-e').textContent   = measuredCh2 == null ? '—' : measuredCh2.E.toFixed(2);

  // Voltage spans — turn red when exceeding rated
  const fvcp = document.getElementById('f-vcp');
  const fvc3 = document.getElementById('f-vc3');
  if (measuredCh2 == null) {
    fvcp.textContent = 'V并联=待测';
    fvcp.style.color = 'rgba(255,160,40,0.65)';
    fvc3.textContent = 'V串联=待测';
    fvc3.style.color = 'rgba(0,200,255,0.65)';
    document.getElementById('c2-val').textContent = '待测';
    document.getElementById('c2-val').style.color = '#94a3b8';
  } else {
    fvcp.textContent = `V并联=${measuredCh2.V_Cp.toFixed(0)} V`;
    fvcp.style.color = measuredCh2.bCp ? '#ff6030' : 'rgba(255,160,40,0.65)';
    fvc3.textContent = `V串联=${measuredCh2.V_C3.toFixed(0)} V`;
    fvc3.style.color = measuredCh2.bC3 ? '#ff6030' : 'rgba(0,200,255,0.65)';
    document.getElementById('c2-val').textContent = measuredCh2.ovl ? '过载！' : measuredCh2.bCp||measuredCh2.bC3 ? '击穿！' : measuredCh2.ct.toFixed(1) + ' µF';
    document.getElementById('c2-val').style.color  = (measuredCh2.ovl||measuredCh2.bCp||measuredCh2.bC3) ? '#ff6030' : '#00c8ff';
  }
  syncCh2ProgBar(measuredCh2 == null ? 0 : measuredCh2.ct, measuredCh2 != null && anyFault);

  // Warning banner（确认配置前不剧透过载/击穿数值）
  const warnEl = document.getElementById('ch2-overload');
  if (measuredCh2 == null) {
    warnEl.style.display = 'none';
  } else if (measuredCh2.ovl) {
    warnEl.innerHTML = `⚠ 过载！总电容 ${measuredCh2.ct.toFixed(0)} µF 超过安全阈值 ${CH2_OVERLOAD} µF——减小电容值`;
    warnEl.style.display = 'block';
  } else if (measuredCh2.bCp) {
    warnEl.innerHTML = `击穿！并联组承压 <b>${measuredCh2.V_Cp.toFixed(0)} V</b> 超过额定耐压 ${CH2_VRATED} V`;
    warnEl.style.display = 'block';
  } else if (measuredCh2.bC3) {
    warnEl.innerHTML = `击穿！C₃ 承压 <b>${measuredCh2.V_C3.toFixed(0)} V</b> 超过额定耐压 ${CH2_VRATED} V`;
    warnEl.style.display = 'block';
  } else {
    warnEl.style.display = 'none';
  }

  const hint2 = document.getElementById('hint2');
  if (measuredCh2 == null) {
    hint2.textContent = '读数待测 · 调参后点「确认配置」';
    hint2.style.color = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.50)';
  } else if (measuredCh2.bCp) {
    hint2.textContent = '并联组承压超限——并联时容量与承压有何关系？';
    hint2.style.color = 'rgba(255,130,60,0.75)';
  } else if (measuredCh2.bC3) {
    hint2.textContent = 'C₃ 承压超限——串联时电容越小，承压如何变化？';
    hint2.style.color = 'rgba(255,130,60,0.75)';
  } else if (measuredCh2.ovl) {
    hint2.textContent = '总容过载——减小某组电容';
    hint2.style.color = 'rgba(255,140,80,0.70)';
  } else if (measuredCh2.ct < tgt * 0.50) {
    hint2.textContent = '容量远低于目标——并联与串联各如何影响总电容？';
    hint2.style.color = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.50)';
  } else if (ch2InTargetBand(measuredCh2.ct) && !ch2IsSafe()) {
    hint2.textContent = '总容达标，但存在故障——排查承压超限问题';
    hint2.style.color = 'rgba(255,140,80,0.85)';
  } else if (measuredCh2.ct < tgt * CH2_WIN_LO) {
    hint2.textContent = '容量偏低（未入目标带）——对照读数继续调高';
    hint2.style.color = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.50)';
  } else if (measuredCh2.ct > tgt * CH2_WIN_HI && measuredCh2.ct <= CH2_OVERLOAD) {
    hint2.textContent = '容量偏高（略超目标带）——对照读数微调减小';
    hint2.style.color = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.50)';
  } else if (ch2InTargetBand(measuredCh2.ct) && ch2IsSafe()) {
    hint2.textContent = '✓ 配置合格：总容与安全均达标';
    hint2.style.color = 'rgba(80,255,180,0.65)';
  } else {
    hint2.textContent = '待配 · 调三组电容，使总容入区间且不过载';
    hint2.style.color = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.50)';
  }

  tgtBright = anyFault ? tgtBright : Math.min(1, ct / tgt) * 0.9 + 0.1;

  if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined') Telemetry.trackCh2(ovl, bCp, bC3, ch2InTargetBand(ct) && ch2IsSafe(), ct);
  ch2TryWin();
}

// ── Ch2 Scene ────────────────────────────────
let ch2Sparks = [];
let ch2Particles = Array.from({length:50}, () => ({
  lane: Math.floor(Math.random()*3),   // 0=top(C1) 1=bot(C2) 2=mid(C3)
  t: Math.random(), spd: 0.004+Math.random()*0.004, alpha: 0.4+Math.random()*0.5
}));

function ch2CircGeom() {
  const gY = H*0.60;
  const lx = W*0.12, rx = W*0.88;
  const jx = W*0.54;             // junction between parallel group and C3
  const topY = H*0.32, botY = H*0.50, midY = (topY+botY)/2;
  const cap1x = (lx + jx)*0.5;
  const cap3x = (jx + rx)*0.5;
  return { lx, rx, jx, topY, botY, midY, cap1x, cap3x, gY };
}

function drawCapSymH(cx, cy, plateH, glowR, glowG, glowB, glowA) {
  const GAP=5, LEAD=30;
  ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.shadowBlur=8;
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${glowR},${glowG},${glowB},${glowA})`;
  ctx.shadowColor =`rgba(${glowR},${glowG},${glowB},${glowA*0.7})`;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx-LEAD,cy); ctx.lineTo(cx-GAP,cy); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx+GAP,cy);  ctx.lineTo(cx+LEAD,cy); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx-GAP,cy-plateH); ctx.lineTo(cx-GAP,cy+plateH); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx+GAP,cy-plateH); ctx.lineTo(cx+GAP,cy+plateH); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
}

function drawCh2Circuit() {
  const g   = ch2CircGeom();
  const ct  = calcCh2Total(), cp = c2_c1+c2_c2;
  const I   = Math.min(1, ct/CH2_TARGET);
  const ovl = ch2Overloaded();
  const bCp = ch2BrokenCp(), bC3 = ch2BrokenC3();
  const isWin = phase==='win';
  const { V_Cp, V_C3 } = calcCh2Voltages();

  const oR=ovl?255:255, oG=ovl?100:160, oB=ovl?40:40;
  const wA = 0.35+I*0.50;

  // ── Bus bars (thick physical conductors) ──
  ctx.lineWidth=3.5; ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.lineJoin='round'; ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  // Parallel group wires: orange normally, red when bCp
  const cpWire = bCp ? `rgba(255,60,20,${wA+0.2})` : `rgba(${oR},${oG},${oB},${wA})`;
  const c3Wire = bC3 ? `rgba(255,60,20,${wA+0.2})` : `rgba(224,160,80,${wA})`;
  ctx.strokeStyle=cpWire;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(g.lx,g.topY); ctx.lineTo(g.lx,g.botY); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(g.lx,g.topY); ctx.lineTo(g.cap1x-34,g.topY); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(g.cap1x+34,g.topY); ctx.lineTo(g.jx,g.topY); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(g.lx,g.botY); ctx.lineTo(g.cap1x-34,g.botY); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(g.cap1x+34,g.botY); ctx.lineTo(g.jx,g.botY); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(g.jx,g.topY); ctx.lineTo(g.jx,g.botY); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle=c3Wire;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(g.jx,g.midY); ctx.lineTo(g.cap3x-34,g.midY); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(g.cap3x+34,g.midY); ctx.lineTo(g.rx,g.midY); ctx.stroke();
  // Return wire (dashed)
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${oR},${oG},${oB},${wA*0.45})`;
  ctx.setLineDash([6,8]);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(g.lx,g.botY+22); ctx.lineTo(g.rx,g.botY+22); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(g.lx,g.botY); ctx.lineTo(g.lx,g.botY+22); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(g.rx,g.midY); ctx.lineTo(g.rx,g.botY+22); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // ── Capacitor symbols ──
  const pp = 0.5+0.5*Math.sin(tick*0.14);
  if (bCp) {
    // Red flash overlay on parallel group area
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,40,0,${0.06+pp*0.10})`;
    ctx.fillRect(g.lx-10, g.topY-18, g.jx-g.lx+20, g.botY-g.topY+36);
    drawCapSymH(g.cap1x, g.topY, 13, 255,60,20, 0.85+pp*0.15);
    drawCapSymH(g.cap1x, g.botY, 13, 255,60,20, 0.85+pp*0.15);
  } else {
    drawCapSymH(g.cap1x, g.topY, 13, oR,oG,oB, wA+0.15);
    drawCapSymH(g.cap1x, g.botY, 13, oR,oG,oB, wA+0.15);
  }
  if (bC3) {
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,40,0,${0.06+pp*0.10})`;
    ctx.fillRect(g.cap3x-44, g.midY-22, 88, 44);
    drawCapSymH(g.cap3x, g.midY, 16, 255,60,20, 0.85+pp*0.15);
  } else {
    drawCapSymH(g.cap3x, g.midY, 16, 224,160,80, wA+0.15);
  }

  // ── Labels ──
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  // C1 label + voltage
  ctx.font='bold 12px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle = bCp ? `rgba(255,80,30,0.92)` : `rgba(${oR},${oG},${oB},0.85)`;
  ctx.fillText(`C₁ = ${c2_c1} µF`, g.cap1x, g.topY-24);
  ctx.font='10px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle = bCp ? 'rgba(255,60,20,0.90)' : 'rgba(255,160,40,0.48)';
  ctx.fillText(`${V_Cp.toFixed(0)} V${bCp?' ⚡':''}`, g.cap1x, g.topY-11);
  // C2 label
  ctx.font='bold 12px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle = bCp ? `rgba(255,80,30,0.92)` : `rgba(${oR},${oG},${oB},0.85)`;
  ctx.fillText(`C₂ = ${c2_c2} µF`, g.cap1x, g.botY+30);
  // C3 label + voltage
  ctx.fillStyle = bC3 ? 'rgba(255,80,30,0.92)' : 'rgba(240,200,120,0.85)';
  ctx.fillText(`C₃ = ${c2_c3} µF`, g.cap3x, g.midY-26);
  ctx.font='10px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle = bC3 ? 'rgba(255,60,20,0.90)' : 'rgba(224,160,80,0.48)';
  ctx.fillText(`${V_C3.toFixed(0)} V${bC3?' ⚡':''}`, g.cap3x, g.midY-12);

  // Cp junction label
  ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(${oR},${oG},${oB},0.38)`; ctx.font='11px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(`Cp=${cp} µF`, g.jx, g.midY+6);

  // Total readout (right side)
  ctx.font='bold 14px Courier New'; ctx.shadowBlur=12;
  if (ovl || bCp || bC3) {
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,75,20,0.92)'; ctx.shadowColor='rgba(255,40,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillText(ovl?'过载！':'击穿！', g.rx+44, g.midY+5);
    if (ovl) {
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,80,0,${0.5+pp*0.45})`; ctx.lineWidth=2;
      ctx.shadowColor='rgba(255,50,0,0.6)'; ctx.strokeRect(g.lx, g.topY-22, g.jx-g.lx, g.botY-g.topY+44);
    }
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,180,40,${0.7+I*0.3})`; ctx.shadowColor='rgba(255,160,40,0.6)';
    if (measuredCh2 == null) ctx.fillText('C 待测', g.rx+44, g.midY+5);
    else ctx.fillText(`C = ${measuredCh2.ct.toFixed(1)} µF`, g.rx+44, g.midY+5);
    if (isWin) {
      const wp=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(tick*0.06);
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(80,255,180,${0.4+wp*0.5})`; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
      ctx.shadowColor='rgba(80,255,180,0.5)'; ctx.strokeRect(g.cap3x-42,g.midY-28,84,56);
    }
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur=0; ctx.textAlign='left';

  // ── Breakdown sparks ──
  if (bCp && Math.random()<0.22) {
    for (let k=0;k<2;k++) ch2Sparks.push({
      x:g.cap1x+(Math.random()-.5)*50, y:[g.topY,g.botY][k]+(Math.random()-.5)*18,
      life:7+Math.random()*8, type:'cp'
    });
  }
  if (bC3 && Math.random()<0.22) ch2Sparks.push({
    x:g.cap3x+(Math.random()-.5)*44, y:g.midY+(Math.random()-.5)*18,
    life:7+Math.random()*8, type:'c3'
  });
  for (let i=ch2Sparks.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
    const s=ch2Sparks[i]; if(--s.life<=0){ch2Sparks.splice(i,1);continue;}
    const a=s.life/14;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(s.x,s.y);
    ctx.lineTo(s.x+(Math.random()-.5)*20, s.y+(Math.random()-.5)*20);
    ctx.strokeStyle=s.type==='c3'?`rgba(100,180,255,${a})`:`rgba(255,130,30,${a})`;
    ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.shadowColor=ctx.strokeStyle; ctx.shadowBlur=6;
    ctx.stroke(); ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  }

  // ── Charge flow particles ──
  const alive = I > 0.05 && !bCp && !bC3 && !ovl;
  for (const p of ch2Particles) {
    if (!alive) continue;
    p.t += p.spd*I; if(p.t>1) p.t-=1;
    let px,py;
    if (p.lane===0)      { px=g.lx+p.t*(g.jx-g.lx); py=g.topY; }
    else if (p.lane===1) { px=g.lx+p.t*(g.jx-g.lx); py=g.botY; }
    else                 { px=g.jx+p.t*(g.rx-g.jx);  py=g.midY; }
    const r=p.lane<2?oR:224, g2=p.lane<2?oG:160, b2=p.lane<2?oB:80;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px,py,2.2,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(${r},${g2},${b2},${p.alpha*I})`; ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawCh2Sky() {
  // Dark charcoal industrial sky
  const gr=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H*0.60);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'#0a0a14'); gr.addColorStop(1,'#111222');
  ctx.fillStyle=gr; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H*0.60);
  // Distant haze glow (amber industrial)
  const hg=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*0.5,H*0.60,0,W*0.5,H*0.60,W*0.55);
  hg.addColorStop(0,`rgba(80,50,10,0.22)`); hg.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
  ctx.fillStyle=hg; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H*0.62);
}

function drawCh2Ground() {
  const gY=H*0.58;
  const gr=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,gY,0,H);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'#0a0a12'); gr.addColorStop(1,'#050507');
  ctx.fillStyle=gr; ctx.fillRect(0,gY,W,H-gY);
  const ct=calcCh2Total(), ef=Math.min(1,ct/CH2_TARGET);
  const fault=ch2Overloaded()||ch2AnyBroken();
  const inBand=ch2InTargetBand(ct)&&ch2IsSafe();
  const col=fault?'255,90,30':inBand?'80,255,150':'255,150,30';
  const vpx=W*0.5;
  ctx.save();
  // Perspective verticals converging toward a vanishing point on the horizon
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${col},${0.05+ef*0.06})`; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let i=-12;i<=12;i++){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(vpx+i*10,gY); ctx.lineTo(vpx+i*120,H); ctx.stroke();
  }
  // Receding horizontals
  for(let k=1;k<=8;k++){
    const tt=k/8, y=gY+Math.pow(tt,1.7)*(H-gY);
    ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${col},${Math.max(0.02,0.11-0.009*k)+ef*0.05})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,y); ctx.lineTo(W,y); ctx.stroke();
  }
  // Glowing horizon line
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${col},${0.22+ef*0.4})`; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
  ctx.shadowColor=`rgba(${col},0.6)`; ctx.shadowBlur=10;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,gY); ctx.lineTo(W,gY); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCh2IndustrialBG() {
  const gY = H*0.58;
  const ct=calcCh2Total(), ef=Math.min(1,ct/CH2_TARGET);
  const fault=ch2Overloaded()||ch2AnyBroken();
  const inBand=ch2InTargetBand(ct)&&ch2IsSafe();
  const col=fault?[255,80,30]:inBand?[80,255,150]:[255,160,40];

  // ── Signal tower in the far background ──
  drawCh2SignalTower();

  // ── Twin energy storage silos ──
  const silos=[{x:W*0.085,w:54,h:220},{x:W*0.915,w:54,h:220}];
  for (const s of silos) {
    const x=s.x-s.w/2, y=gY-s.h;
    // Housing
    const hg=ctx.createLinearGradient(x,y,x+s.w,y);
    hg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(16,16,26,0.96)');
    hg.addColorStop(0.5,'rgba(22,20,34,0.96)');
    hg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(16,16,26,0.96)');
    ctx.fillStyle=hg; ctx.fillRect(x,y,s.w,s.h);
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(55,55,80,0.65)'; ctx.lineWidth=1.8; ctx.strokeRect(x,y,s.w,s.h);
    // Inner accent rail
    ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},0.12)`; ctx.lineWidth=0.8;
    ctx.strokeRect(x+3,y+3,s.w-6,s.h-6);
    // Glowing fill (charge level)
    const fh=s.h*Math.min(1,ef);
    if (fh>1) {
      const fg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,gY-fh,0,gY);
      fg.addColorStop(0,`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},0.52)`);
      fg.addColorStop(1,`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},0.14)`);
      ctx.fillStyle=fg; ctx.fillRect(x+4,gY-fh,s.w-8,fh);
      ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},0.88)`;
      ctx.shadowColor=`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},0.7)`; ctx.shadowBlur=10;
      ctx.fillRect(x+4,gY-fh-1,s.w-8,2); ctx.shadowBlur=0;
    }
    // Level tick marks
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(200,200,255,0.06)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
    for(let k=1;k<6;k++){
      const yy=gY-s.h*k/6;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x+4,yy); ctx.lineTo(x+s.w-4,yy); ctx.stroke();
    }
    // Segment divider bands
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(50,50,75,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth=2.5;
    for(let b=1;b<=3;b++){
      const by=gY-s.h*b/4;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,by); ctx.lineTo(x+s.w,by); ctx.stroke();
    }
    // Top cap + beacon
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(20,18,32,0.98)'; ctx.fillRect(x-5,y-10,s.w+10,10);
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(55,55,80,0.65)'; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
    ctx.strokeRect(x-5,y-10,s.w+10,10);
    const blink=Math.sin(tick*0.04+s.x*0.01)>0;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x,y-16,3.5,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle=fault?`rgba(255,55,15,0.92)`:`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},${blink?0.92:0.38})`;
    ctx.shadowColor=ctx.fillStyle; ctx.shadowBlur=blink?10:3;
    ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  }

  // ── Overhead pipe runs connecting silos to the circuit housing ──
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(38,36,55,0.80)'; ctx.lineWidth=8; ctx.lineCap='round';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, gY-165); ctx.lineTo(W*0.10, gY-165); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W*0.90, gY-165); ctx.lineTo(W, gY-165); ctx.stroke();
  // Pipe highlight
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(80,80,120,0.22)'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,gY-169); ctx.lineTo(W*0.10,gY-169); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W*0.90,gY-169); ctx.lineTo(W,gY-169); ctx.stroke();
}

function drawCh2SignalTower() {
  // The comms tower that ch2's power station is meant to revive.
  // Rendered in deep background behind the circuit + reactor glow.
  const ct=calcCh2Total(), ef=Math.min(1,ct/CH2_TARGET);
  const fault=ch2Overloaded()||ch2AnyBroken();
  const inBand=ch2InTargetBand(ct)&&ch2IsSafe();
  const col=fault?[255,80,30]:inBand?[80,255,150]:[255,160,40];
  const t=tick;
  const tx=W*0.5, gY=H*0.58;
  const tBase=gY-10, tTop=H*0.04;
  const bW=38, tW=8; // base width, tip width

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.38 + ef * 0.32;

  // Main trapezoidal tower body
  const towerG = ctx.createLinearGradient(tx-bW,tBase,tx+bW,tTop);
  towerG.addColorStop(0,'rgba(18,18,28,0.95)');
  towerG.addColorStop(1,'rgba(30,28,40,0.88)');
  ctx.fillStyle=towerG;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(tx-bW, tBase);
  ctx.lineTo(tx-tW,  tTop);
  ctx.lineTo(tx+tW,  tTop);
  ctx.lineTo(tx+bW,  tBase);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  // Left/right edge highlights
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},${0.08+ef*0.18})`; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx-bW,tBase); ctx.lineTo(tx-tW,tTop); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx+bW,tBase); ctx.lineTo(tx+tW,tTop); ctx.stroke();

  // Cross struts (5, tapering with tower width)
  const nStruts=5;
  for(let s=0;s<nStruts;s++){
    const frac=(s+0.5)/nStruts;
    const y=tBase + (tTop-tBase)*frac;
    const hw=bW*(1-frac)+tW*frac;
    ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},${0.06+ef*0.12})`; ctx.lineWidth=0.8;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx-hw,y); ctx.lineTo(tx+hw,y); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Antenna mast extending above tower
  const mastTop = tTop - 45;
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},${0.12+ef*0.22})`; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx,tTop); ctx.lineTo(tx,mastTop); ctx.stroke();
  // Dish/array at mast tip
  ctx.lineWidth=1.2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx-12,mastTop+6); ctx.lineTo(tx,mastTop); ctx.lineTo(tx+12,mastTop+6); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx-8,mastTop+3); ctx.lineTo(tx+8,mastTop+3); ctx.stroke();

  // Blinking beacon at very tip
  const blink = Math.sin(t*0.06) > 0.4;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, mastTop-3, 2.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle=blink?`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},0.95)`:`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},0.22)`;
  ctx.shadowColor=`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},0.8)`; ctx.shadowBlur=blink?12:3;
  ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur=0;

  // Transmission ring arcs — signal being broadcast (only near target)
  if(ef>0.6 && !fault){
    const ringAlpha=(ef-0.6)/0.4 * (0.4+0.3*Math.sin(t*0.04));
    for(let r=1;r<=3;r++){
      const rr = 28 + r*22 + (t*0.8%22);
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},${ringAlpha*(0.8-r*0.18)})`;
      ctx.lineWidth=0.8; ctx.shadowColor=`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},0.5)`; ctx.shadowBlur=6;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx,mastTop,rr,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  }

  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCh2Reactor() {
  const ct=calcCh2Total(), ef=Math.min(1,ct/CH2_TARGET);
  const fault=ch2Overloaded()||ch2AnyBroken();
  const inBand=ch2InTargetBand(ct)&&ch2IsSafe();
  const col=fault?[255,70,25]:inBand?[80,255,160]:[255,165,45];
  const cx=W*0.5, cy=H*0.41, t=tick;
  const pulse=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(t*(fault?0.3:0.08));
  ctx.save();
  const R=72+ef*64;
  const gl=ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,4,cx,cy,R);
  gl.addColorStop(0,`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},${(0.09+ef*0.22)*(0.7+0.3*pulse)})`);
  gl.addColorStop(0.6,`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},${(0.03+ef*0.06)})`);
  gl.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=gl; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},${0.10+ef*0.12})`; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(const rr of [R*0.55,R*0.78]){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,rr,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke(); }
  ctx.setLineDash([10,12]); ctx.lineDashOffset=-t*(fault?2.2:1.0);
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},${0.14+ef*0.20})`; ctx.lineWidth=1.4;
  ctx.shadowColor=`rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},0.4)`; ctx.shadowBlur=6;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,R*0.92,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]); ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.restore();
}

function frameCh2(ctx) {
  frameCanvasChapter(ctx, {
    customWorld(ctx) {
      drawCh2Sky();
      drawCh2Ground();
      drawCh2IndustrialBG();
      drawCh2Reactor();
      drawCh2Circuit();
    },
    afterWorld(ctx) {
      if (phase === 'win') {
        const wp = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(tick * 0.05);
        // Warm amber bloom from the tower coming online
        const cx=W*0.5, topY=H*0.04;
        const winG = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,topY,10,cx,topY,W*0.75);
        winG.addColorStop(0, `rgba(80,255,150,${0.22+wp*0.18})`);
        winG.addColorStop(0.3, `rgba(80,240,120,${0.10+wp*0.08})`);
        winG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle=winG; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
        // Scanning arc around tower tip
        const scanA = (tick*0.03) % (Math.PI*2);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(80,255,160,${0.35+wp*0.30})`;
        ctx.lineWidth=1.5; ctx.shadowColor='rgba(80,255,150,0.6)'; ctx.shadowBlur=12;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,topY,38+wp*8,scanA,scanA+Math.PI*0.7); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.shadowBlur=0; ctx.restore();
      }
    },
  });
}

Game.register(2, { init: initCh2, frame: frameCh2, usesCanvas: true, showSummary: showSummary2 });

</script>
<script>
/* ===== js/research/telemetry.js ·(研究埋点，非原游戏代码)===== */
const Telemetry = (function () {
  const qs = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const sid = qs.get('sid') || ('anon-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8));
  const endpoint = qs.get('ep') || 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/events';
  const session = {
    session_id: sid + '-' + Date.now().toString(36),
    student_id: sid,
    game_id: 'cap-ch2-series-parallel',
    game_ver: 'sample-v1',
    started_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    ua: navigator.userAgent,
  };
  const buf = [];
  const all = [];
  const t0 = performance.now();
  let seq = 0;

  function snapshot() {
    try {
      const ct = calcCh2Total();
      return {
        C1: c2_c1, C2: c2_c2, C3: c2_c3, L: _cableLen,
        ct: +ct.toFixed(1), overload: ch2Overloaded(),
        brokenCp: ch2BrokenCp(), brokenC3: ch2BrokenC3(), phase: phase,
      };
    } catch (e) { return {}; }
  }

  function log(type, data) {
    const ev = Object.assign({
      seq: seq++,
      rel_ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0),
      ts: new Date().toISOString(),
      type: type,
    }, data || {});
    buf.push(ev); all.push(ev);
    mirror();
  }

  let mirrorTimer = null;
  function mirror() {
    if (mirrorTimer) return;
    mirrorTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      mirrorTimer = null;
      try { localStorage.setItem('telemetry:' + session.session_id,
        JSON.stringify({ session, events: all })); } catch (e) {}
    }, 800);
  }

  function flush(final) {
    if (!buf.length || !endpoint) return;
    const payload = JSON.stringify({ session, events: buf.splice(0) });
    if (final && navigator.sendBeacon) {
      navigator.sendBeacon(endpoint, new Blob([payload], { type: 'application/json' }));
      return;
    }
    fetch(endpoint, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: payload, keepalive: true }).catch(() => {});
  }
  setInterval(() => flush(false), 5000);
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { log('page_hide', {}); flush(true); });

  // ── 滑块手势聚合 ──
  const VAR_OF = { 's-c1': 'C1', 's-c2': 'C2', 's-c3': 'C3', 's-cable': 'L' };
  const commit = { 's-c1': 200, 's-c2': 200, 's-c3': 300, 's-cable': 40 };
  const gest = {};
  document.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    const id = e.target && e.target.id;
    if (!(id in VAR_OF)) return;
    const v = +e.target.value;
    if (!gest[id]) gest[id] = { from: null, micro: 0, vmin: v, vmax: v, t0: performance.now() };
    const g = gest[id];
    if (g.from === null) g.from = commit[id] !== undefined ? commit[id] : v;
    g.micro++; g.vmin = Math.min(g.vmin, v); g.vmax = Math.max(g.vmax, v);
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    const id = e.target && e.target.id;
    if (!(id in VAR_OF)) return;
    const v = +e.target.value;
    const g = gest[id] || { from: commit[id], micro: 1, vmin: v, vmax: v, t0: performance.now() };
    log('var_adjust', {
      var: VAR_OF[id], from: g.from, to: v,
      micro: g.micro, vmin: g.vmin, vmax: g.vmax,
      dur_ms: Math.round(performance.now() - g.t0),
      after: snapshot(),
    });
    commit[id] = v; delete gest[id];
  }, true);

  // ── ch2 状态转变追踪（过载 / 两处击穿 / 目标带） ──
  let _cableLen = 40;
  let _ovlPrev = false, _bCpPrev = false, _bC3Prev = false, _bandPrev = false;
  function trackCh2(ovl, bCp, bC3, band, ct) {
    if (ovl !== _ovlPrev) { log(ovl ? 'overload_start' : 'overload_end', { after: snapshot() }); _ovlPrev = ovl; }
    if (bCp !== _bCpPrev) { log(bCp ? 'breakdown_cp_start' : 'breakdown_cp_end', { after: snapshot() }); _bCpPrev = bCp; }
    if (bC3 !== _bC3Prev) { log(bC3 ? 'breakdown_c3_start' : 'breakdown_c3_end', { after: snapshot() }); _bC3Prev = bC3; }
    if (band !== _bandPrev) { log(band ? 'enter_win_band' : 'leave_win_band', { ct: +ct.toFixed(1), after: snapshot() }); _bandPrev = band; }
  }

  // ── phase 看守 ──
  let _phasePrev = null;
  setInterval(() => {
    try { if (phase !== _phasePrev) { log('phase_change', { from: _phasePrev, to: phase }); _phasePrev = phase; } } catch (e) {}
  }, 200);

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const sc = document.getElementById('s-cable');
    if (sc) sc.addEventListener('input', function () {
      _cableLen = +this.value;
      const v = document.getElementById('c2v-L');
      if (v) v.textContent = _cableLen + ' m';
      if (typeof SFX !== 'undefined') SFX.tick('sliderTick');
    });
  });

  log('session_start', { href: location.href });
  return { log, flush, snapshot, session, trackCh2 };
})();

<script>
/* ===== music.js ===== */
/* music.js — 自适应背景音乐引擎（独立模块）。用法注释已省略，避免 HTML script 截断。 */
(function(){
  'use strict';

  // ── 配置 ─────────────────────────────────────
  var MP3_SRC = (typeof window!=='undefined' && window.MUSIC_MP3_SRC) || 'bgm.mp3';
  var MP3_SKIP_INTRO = 6;          // 跳过 mp3 开头 ~6s 的渐弱静音引子
  var AUTOSTART = (typeof window==='undefined' || window.MUSIC_AUTOSTART!==false); // 默认首次交互即开始

  // ── 安全读取游戏状态（兼容 let 顶层变量 / window 属性 / 不存在三种情况） ──
  function getCh(){ try { if(typeof ch==='number') return ch; } catch(e){} return (typeof window!=='undefined'&&typeof window.ch==='number')?window.ch:0; }
  function getPhase(){ try { if(typeof phase!=='undefined') return phase; } catch(e){} return (typeof window!=='undefined')?window.phase:undefined; }

  var MUSIC = (function(){
    var ctx=null, master=null, busComp=null, delay=null, delayGain=null, reverb=null, revGain=null;
    var on=true, started=false, schedTimer=null, barIdx=0, nextBar=0, curTheme=null;

    // ── mp3 氛围铺底（普通 <audio>，与 Web Audio 在扬声器处混合，file:// 也可用） ──
    var audioEl=null, mp3Fade=null;
    function fadeMp3To(target,ms,pauseAtZero){
      if(!audioEl) return; if(mp3Fade) clearTimeout(mp3Fade);
      var from=audioEl.volume, t0=performance.now();
      var step=function(){ var k=Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/ms);
        audioEl.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,from+(target-from)*k));
        if(k<1) mp3Fade=setTimeout(step,30); // setTimeout：后台标签页也会触发（rAF 会冻结）
        else { mp3Fade=null; if(target===0&&pauseAtZero) audioEl.pause(); } };
      step();
    }
    function startMp3(vol){
      if(!audioEl){
        audioEl=new Audio(MP3_SRC); audioEl.loop=true; audioEl.volume=0;
        audioEl.addEventListener('timeupdate',function(){ if(audioEl.currentTime<MP3_SKIP_INTRO-0.3 && audioEl.played.length) audioEl.currentTime=MP3_SKIP_INTRO; });
      }
      audioEl.play().then(function(){ try{ if(audioEl.currentTime<MP3_SKIP_INTRO) audioEl.currentTime=MP3_SKIP_INTRO; }catch(e){} }).catch(function(){});
      fadeMp3To(vol,1200);
    }

    // 音名 → 频率
    var SEMI={C:0,'C#':1,D:2,'D#':3,E:4,F:5,'F#':6,G:7,'G#':8,A:9,'A#':10,B:11};
    function f(n){ var m=n.match(/^([A-G]#?)(\d)$/); var semi=SEMI[m[1]], oct=+m[2];
      var midi=(oct+1)*12+semi; return 440*Math.pow(2,(midi-69)/12); }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    //  作曲思路（leitmotif / 主导动机）
    //  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    //  全曲共用一个「灯火动机」：上行三度叠三度 1–3–5（C 调即 C–E–G），
    //  象征「点亮一盏灯」。它在各章里以不同面貌出现，使整部作品统一而不重复：
    //    序章 open   动机被拆碎、下行、悬而不决  —— 光熄灭了

    function build(){

      delay._in=ctx.createGain(); delay._in.connect(delay);

      revGain=ctx.createGain(); revGain.gain.value=0.5; reverb.connect(revGain); revGain.connect(busComp);
      reverb._in=ctx.createGain(); reverb._in.connect(reverb);

      var rate=ctx.sampleRate, len=rate*dur, buf=ctx.createBuffer(2,len,rate);

      return buf;

      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(pk,t+A);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(pk,Math.max(t+A,t+dur-R));
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
      g.connect(busComp); g.connect(reverb._in);

    }

    function chordStab(freq,t,dur,T){
      var wv=T.padWave||'sawtooth';

      o.type=wv; o.frequency.value=freq;
      lp.type='lowpass'; lp.frequency.value=Math.max(1000,T.lp*0.9); lp.Q.value=0.8;
      // 断奏保持「干」声（不进混响）—— 节奏章节因此清脆有冲击，与铺底章节的湿润空灵形成鲜明对比
      o.connect(lp); lp.connect(g); g.connect(busComp);

      var d=Math.max(0.10,dur);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(pk,t+0.012);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+d);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+d+0.03);
    }

      var o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain(),lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      var wv=T.leadWave||'triangle'; o.type=wv; o.frequency.value=freq;
      // 锯齿 / 方波泛音更亮，整体压低音量并收紧低通，避免刺耳
      var amp=(wv==='square'||wv==='sawtooth')?0.62:1;
      var vib=ctx.createOscillator(),vg=ctx.createGain();
      vib.frequency.value=5; vg.gain.value=freq*0.006; vib.connect(vg); vg.connect(o.frequency); vib.start(t); vib.stop(t+dur+0.1);
      lp.type='lowpass'; lp.frequency.value=Math.max(1600,T.lp);
      o.connect(lp); lp.connect(g); g.connect(busComp); g.connect(delay._in); g.connect(reverb._in);
      var d=Math.max(0.18,dur*beat);
      // 旋律是「每章听感不同」的主角 —— 显著提高音量让它浮在伴奏之上
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.15*amp,t+0.04);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.10*amp,t+0.12);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.092*amp,Math.max(t+0.13,t+d-0.12));
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+d);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+d+0.05);
    }

    // 琶音音序索引（上行 / 下行 / 往返），让各章琶音走向也不同
    function arpIndex(q,n,dir){
      if(n<=1) return 0;
      if(dir==='down') return (n-1)-(q%n);
      if(dir==='updown'){ var p=2*n-2, k=q%p; return k<n?k:(p-k); }
      return q%n;
    }

    // ── 调度一个小节（读取当前预设，故换章数秒内即生效） ──
    function scheduleBar(i,t,T){
      var tf=Math.pow(2,(T.tr||0)/12), beat=60/T.bpm, bar=beat*4, q;
      var prog=T.prog, bassArr=T.bass, mel=T.mel;
      var chord=prog[i%prog.length], tones=chord;
      var rootHz=f(bassArr[i%bassArr.length])*tf;
      var comp=T.comp||[[0,4]], stab=(T.compVoice==='stab');
      // 和声层：长音弦垫 or 节奏断奏
      comp.forEach(function(h){
        var ht=t+h[0]*beat, hd=h[1]*beat;
        if(stab) chord.forEach(function(n){ chordStab(f(n)*tf,ht,hd,T); });
        else     chord.forEach(function(n){ pad(f(n)*tf,ht,hd,T); });
      });
      // 低音：断奏型走稳定四分根音；铺底型按和声节奏走长音
      if(stab){ for(q=0;q<4;q++) bass(rootHz,t+q*beat,beat*0.92); }
      else comp.forEach(function(h){ bass(rootHz,t+h[0]*beat,h[1]*beat); });
      // 琶音（断奏章节通常关闭，靠和弦脉冲提供律动）
      if(T.arp>0){ var dir=T.arpDir||'up';
        for(q=0;q<T.arp;q++) arp(f(tones[arpIndex(q,tones.length,dir)])*tf*2, t+(q+0.5)*(bar/T.arp), T); }
      // 旋律
      if(T.lead!=='off' && mel){
        var mt=t, loOct=Math.pow(2,T.lo||0), barMel=mel[i%mel.length];
        barMel.forEach(function(nd){ var n=nd[0], dd=nd[1];
          if(n){ if(T.lead!=='sparse'||dd>=1) lead(f(n)*tf*loOct,mt,dd,beat,T); } mt+=dd*beat; });
      }
    }
    function tick(){
      if(!ctx) return;
      var ahead=ctx.currentTime+0.3;
      while(nextBar<ahead){
        var name=desiredTheme(), T=THEMES[name];
        if(on){
          scheduleBar(barIdx,nextBar,T);
          if(name!==curTheme){ curTheme=name;
            var mp3Vol=T.mp3;
            try{ if(window.SFX && typeof window.SFX.volume==='number' && !window.SFX.muted) mp3Vol=T.mp3*window.SFX.volume; else if(window.SFX&&window.SFX.muted) mp3Vol=0; }catch(e){}
            fadeMp3To(mp3Vol,1800); }
        }
        nextBar += (60/T.bpm)*4;
        barIdx=(barIdx+1)%8;
      }
    }

    function start(){
      if(started) return; started=true;
      if(!ctx) build();
      if(ctx.state==='suspended') ctx.resume();
      // 顶部喇叭按钮是统一的音频总开关：若启动时 SFX 已静音，则音乐随之保持静音，
      // 不在静音状态下被「首次交互自动播放」偷偷唤醒。
      var vol=1;
      try{ if(window.SFX){ if(window.SFX.muted) on=false; else if(typeof window.SFX.volume==='number') vol=window.SFX.volume; } }catch(e){}
      var T=THEMES[desiredTheme()]; curTheme=desiredTheme();
      barIdx=0; nextBar=ctx.currentTime+0.2;
      schedTimer=setInterval(tick,30);
      if(on){
        startMp3(T.mp3 * vol);
        master.gain.cancelScheduledValues(ctx.currentTime);
        master.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,ctx.currentTime);
        master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol * BGM_GAIN_PEAK,ctx.currentTime+2.2);
      } else {
        master.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,ctx.currentTime);
      }
    }
    var BGM_GAIN_PEAK = 0.55;
    function applyVolume(v){
      var vol = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
      on = vol > 0.001;
      if(!started){ if(on) start(); return; }
      if(!ctx || !master) return;
      master.gain.cancelScheduledValues(ctx.currentTime);
      master.gain.setValueAtTime(master.gain.value, ctx.currentTime);
      master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol * BGM_GAIN_PEAK, ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
      if(on){
        if(audioEl && audioEl.paused) audioEl.play().catch(function(){});
        fadeMp3To((THEMES[desiredTheme()] || THEMES.c0).mp3 * vol, 500);
      } else {
        fadeMp3To(0, 500, true);
      }
    }
    function setOn(v){
      applyVolume(v ? (function(){
        try{ if(window.SFX && typeof window.SFX.volume === 'number') return window.SFX.volume; }catch(e){}
        return 1;
      })() : 0);
    }
    return { start:start, setOn:setOn, applyVolume:applyVolume,
      get on(){return on;}, get ctx(){return ctx;},
      THEMES:THEMES, CH_THEME:CH_THEME }; // 暴露预设表，便于运行时微调
  })();

  // 全局可访问（游戏内的点击音效等也可复用 MUSIC.ctx）
  if(typeof window!=='undefined') window.MUSIC = MUSIC;

  // ── 自动播放策略 + 右下角开关按钮 ──────────────
  function wireUI(){
    if(AUTOSTART){
      var kick=function(){ MUSIC.start(); ['pointerdown','keydown','touchstart'].forEach(function(e){ window.removeEventListener(e,kick); }); };
      ['pointerdown','keydown','touchstart'].forEach(function(e){ window.addEventListener(e,kick,{once:false}); });
    }
    // 游戏顶栏已有统一的音频总开关（#sfx-btn，由 audio.js 驱动，会一并控制本音乐引擎）。
    // 此时不再生成右下角这个独立的「♪ 音乐」按钮，避免出现两个互相矛盾的音频开关。
    if(typeof document!=='undefined' && document.getElementById('sfx-btn')) return;
    var btn=document.createElement('div');
    btn.title='背景音乐开关';
    var mon=true;
    function lbl(){ btn.textContent = mon ? '♪ 音乐 ON' : '♪ 音乐 OFF'; }
    btn.style.cssText='position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:74px;z-index:99999;padding:8px 14px;'+
      'display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;font-size:14px;'+
      'font-family:"Courier New",monospace;letter-spacing:1px;cursor:pointer;'+
      'color:rgba(0,220,255,0.95);border:1px solid rgba(0,220,255,0.55);border-radius:20px;'+
      'background:rgba(2,16,30,0.85);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,200,255,0.25);'+
      'transition:all .2s;user-select:none;';
    lbl();
    btn.onmouseenter=function(){ btn.style.borderColor='rgba(0,220,255,0.9)'; };
    btn.onmouseleave=function(){ btn.style.borderColor=mon?'rgba(0,220,255,0.55)':'rgba(120,140,160,0.4)'; };
    btn.onclick=function(ev){ ev.stopPropagation(); mon=!mon; MUSIC.setOn(mon); lbl();
      btn.style.opacity=mon?'1':'0.55';
      btn.style.color=mon?'rgba(0,220,255,0.95)':'rgba(150,170,190,0.7)';
      btn.style.borderColor=mon?'rgba(0,220,255,0.55)':'rgba(120,140,160,0.4)'; };
    document.body.appendChild(btn);
  }
  if(typeof document!=='undefined'){
    if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',wireUI);
    else wireUI();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
/* === dual-mode-manual runtime === */
(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeManual) return;
  window.__dualModeManual = true;
  var MAX=5;
  var EXP=600;
  var state={mode:'explore',attempts:MAX,timeLeft:EXP,timerId:null};
  function $(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
  function setPhase(p){
    try{
      if(typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase==='function') window.__platformTraceSetPhase(p);
      else if(window.PlatformTraceAdapter&&window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase) window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(p);
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function fmt(sec){var m=Math.floor(sec/60),s=sec%60;return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':'+(s<10?'0':'')+s;}
  function stop(){if(state.timerId){clearInterval(state.timerId);state.timerId=null;}}
  function render(){
    var label=$('modeLabel'),stats=$('challengeStats'),att=$('attemptsDisplay'),td=$('timerDisplay'),chip=$('dual-timer-chip');
    if(label) label.textContent=state.mode==='explore'?'探究模式':'竞赛模式';
    if(stats){ if(state.mode==='challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible'); else stats.classList.remove('is-visible'); }
    if(att) att.textContent=String(state.attempts);
    if(chip) chip.style.display=state.mode==='explore'?'inline-flex':'none';
    if(td) td.textContent=fmt(Math.max(0,state.timeLeft));
  }
  function startTimer(){
    stop(); state.timeLeft=EXP; render();
    state.timerId=setInterval(function(){
      if(state.mode!=='explore') return;
      state.timeLeft--; render();
      if(state.timeLeft<=0){
        stop();
        var sel=$('modeSelect');
        if(sel){ sel.value='challenge'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); }
      }
    },1000);
  }
  function apply(mode){
    state.mode=mode==='challenge'?'challenge':'explore';
    if(state.mode==='challenge'){ stop(); state.attempts=MAX; }
    else startTimer();
    render(); setPhase(state.mode);
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dual-mode-change',{detail:{mode:state.mode,attempts:state.attempts}}));
  }
  function consume(){
    if(state.mode!=='challenge') return true;
    if(state.attempts<=0) return false;
    state.attempts--; render();
    return state.attempts>=0;
  }
  window.__dualModeConsumeAttempt=consume;
  window.__dualModeGet=function(){return {mode:state.mode,attempts:state.attempts};};
  function boot(){
    var sel=$('modeSelect');
    if(!sel) return;
    sel.addEventListener('change',function(){ apply(sel.value); });
    apply(sel.value||'explore');
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>

  /* ---------- 2. 数学排版小工具 ---------- */

  /* ---------- 3. 各章推导内容 ---------- */
  var DERIV = {

      ],

    1:{accent:'#6ec0ff',kicker:'公式推导 · 第一章',title:'介质与击穿',sub:'介质如何把电容放大 εᵣ 倍',
      steps:[
        {m:'真空时　C₀ = ε₀ '+f('A','d'),n:'上一章的结论'},
        {m:'插入介质 → 被极化 → 产生反向电场',n:'内部电场被削弱到原来的 1 ∕ εᵣ'},

      ],

      final:'C = ε₀ · εᵣ · '+f('A','d'),away:'高 εᵣ 增容，过高场强击穿 —— 两者相互牵制'},

        {m:'各电容电压都 = U',n:'并排接在同样两点之间'},
        {m:'电荷相加　Q = C₁U + C₂U',n:''},
        {m:'C并 = '+f('Q','U')+' = C₁ + C₂',n:'像把极板加宽'},
        {grp:'串联 · 电荷相同'},
        {m:'各电容电荷都 = Q',n:'中间感应出等量异号电荷'},
        {m:'总电压相加　U = '+f('Q','C₁')+' + '+f('Q','C₂'),n:''},

      steps:[
        {m:'回路电压　U = i·R + '+f('q','C'),n:'电阻压降 + 电容压降'},
        {m:'代入 i = '+f('dq','dt')+'　→　R '+f('dq','dt')+' = U − '+f('q','C'),n:''},
        {m:'解得　q(t) = CU(1 − e<sup>−t ∕ RC</sup>)',n:'电压按指数曲线上升'},
        {m:'指数里 t 与 RC 同量纲 → 令 τ = RC',n:'τ 就是这条曲线的"节拍"'}
      ],
      final:'τ = R · C',away:'每过一个 τ 充到约 63%，约 5τ 基本充满'},

      steps:[

      ],

        {m:'电感电压 L '+f('di','dt')+' 与电容电压 '+f('q','C')+' 此消彼长',n:'能量在 L 与 C 之间往返'},
        {m:'列方程　L '+f('d²q','dt²')+' + '+f('q','C')+' = 0',n:'与弹簧振子完全同形'},
