  /* ---------- 4. DOM 构建 ---------- */
  var overlay=document.createElement('div');overlay.id='dv-overlay';
  overlay.innerHTML='<div id="dv-card"></div>';
  var reopen=document.createElement('div');reopen.id='dv-reopen';
  reopen.innerHTML='<span class="dv-fx">ƒ</span><span>公式推导</span>';
  function attach(){
    if(!document.body)return;
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);
    document.body.appendChild(reopen);
  }
  if(document.body)attach();else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',attach);

  var card=overlay.querySelector('#dv-card');
  var timers=[],fastForwarded=false,seen={},open=false;

  function clearTimers(){timers.forEach(clearTimeout);timers=[];}

  function revealAll(){
    fastForwarded=true;clearTimers();
    card.querySelectorAll('.dv-step,.dv-grp').forEach(function(e){e.classList.add('show');});
    var ex=card.querySelector('.dv-extra');if(ex)ex.classList.add('show');
    var fn=card.querySelector('.dv-final');if(fn)fn.classList.add('show');
    var aw=card.querySelector('.dv-away');if(aw)aw.classList.add('show');
  }

  function build(idx){
    var d=DERIV[idx];if(!d)return false;
    card.style.setProperty('--dv-accent',d.accent);
    var h='<div class="dv-kicker">'+d.kicker+'</div>'
         +'<div class="dv-title">'+d.title+'</div>'
         +'<div class="dv-sub">'+d.sub+'</div>'
         +'<div class="dv-steps">';
    var n=0;
    d.steps.forEach(function(s){
      if(s.grp){h+='<div class="dv-grp">'+s.grp+'</div>';return;}
      n++;
      h+='<div class="dv-step"><div class="dv-num-chip">'+n+'</div><div class="dv-body">'
        +'<div class="dv-math">'+s.m+'</div>'
        +(s.n?'<div class="dv-note">'+s.n+'</div>':'')+'</div></div>';
    });
    h+='</div>';
    if(d.extra)h+='<div class="dv-extra">'+d.extra+'</div>';
    h+='<div class="dv-final">'+d.final+'</div>';
    if(d.away)h+='<div class="dv-away">▸ '+d.away+'</div>';
    h+='<div class="dv-actions"><button class="dv-skip" type="button">点击任意处展开全部</button>'
      +'<button class="dv-go" type="button">进 入 关 卡 ▶</button></div>';
    card.innerHTML=h;
    card.querySelector('.dv-go').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();close();});
    card.querySelector('.dv-skip').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();revealAll();});
    return true;
  }

  function animate(){
    var rows=Array.prototype.slice.call(card.querySelectorAll('.dv-step,.dv-grp'));
    var delay=180,gap=480;
    rows.forEach(function(el,i){
      timers.push(setTimeout(function(){el.classList.add('show');if(typeof SFX!=='undefined'&&SFX.play){try{SFX.play('uiClick');}catch(e){}}},delay+i*gap));
    });
    var after=delay+rows.length*gap;
    var ex=card.querySelector('.dv-extra');
    if(ex){timers.push(setTimeout(function(){ex.classList.add('show');},after));after+=gap;}
    timers.push(setTimeout(function(){var fn=card.querySelector('.dv-final');if(fn){fn.classList.add('show');if(typeof SFX!=='undefined'&&SFX.play){try{SFX.play('dlgAdvance');}catch(e){}}}},after));
    timers.push(setTimeout(function(){var aw=card.querySelector('.dv-away');if(aw)aw.classList.add('show');},after+gap*0.7));
  }

  function show(idx){
    if(!DERIV[idx])return;
    open=true;fastForwarded=false;clearTimers();
    if(!build(idx))return;
    reopen.style.display='none';
    overlay.style.display='flex';
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){requestAnimationFrame(function(){overlay.classList.add('show');});});
    animate();
  }

  function close(){
    open=false;clearTimers();
    overlay.classList.remove('show');
    setTimeout(function(){overlay.style.display='none';},460);
    showReopenForCurrent();
  }

  // 点击卡片空白处 = 展开全部（不关闭，避免误触跳过）
  card.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(e.target.closest('.dv-go')||e.target.closest('.dv-skip'))return;
    if(!fastForwarded)revealAll();
  });
  overlay.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===overlay)revealAll();});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(!open)return;
    if(e.key==='Escape'){close();}
    else if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){if(!fastForwarded){revealAll();}else{close();}e.preventDefault();}
  });
  reopen.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();var c=curCh();if(DERIV[c])show(c);});

  /* ---------- 5. 与游戏挂钩 ---------- */
  function curCh(){
    try{if(typeof window.ch==='number')return window.ch;}catch(e){}
    try{if(typeof ch==='number')return ch;}catch(e){}
    return -1;
  }
  function showReopenForCurrent(){
    var c=curCh();
    if(DERIV[c]&&!open){
      reopen.style.setProperty('--dv-accent',DERIV[c].accent);
      reopen.style.display='flex';
    }else{
      reopen.style.display='none';
    }
  }

  function hookOpenPuzzle(){
    if(typeof window.openPuzzle!=='function')return false;
    if(window.openPuzzle.__dvHooked)return true;
    var orig=window.openPuzzle;
    var wrapped=function(){
      var r=orig.apply(this,arguments);
      // 探究中不剧透：开场不自动弹出公式推导；过关后再开放重看
      reopen.style.display='none';
      return r;
    };
    wrapped.__dvHooked=true;
    window.openPuzzle=wrapped;
    return true;
  }
  // 进入新章节的对白时，隐藏重开按钮，避免在地图/序幕里残留
  function hookBeginIntro(){
    if(typeof window.beginChapterIntro!=='function')return false;
    if(window.beginChapterIntro.__dvHooked)return true;
    var orig=window.beginChapterIntro;
    var wrapped=function(){reopen.style.display='none';return orig.apply(this,arguments);};
    wrapped.__dvHooked=true;
    window.beginChapterIntro=wrapped;
    return true;
  }

  // 主脚本可能在本脚本之后才定义函数，做几次重试挂钩
  var tries=0;
  (function tryHook(){
    var a=hookOpenPuzzle(),b=hookBeginIntro();
    if((a&&b)||tries>40)return;
    tries++;setTimeout(tryHook,150);
  })();

  // 暴露给调试/手动调用
  window.showDerivation=show;
  // 过关后才开放公式推导（符合探究不剧透）
  (function hookWinForDerive(){
    if (window.__dvWinHooked) return;
    function wrap(name){
      if (typeof window[name] !== 'function' || window[name].__dvWinHooked) return false;
      var orig = window[name];
      var wrapped = function(){
        var r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
        try {
          var c = curCh();
          if (DERIV[c] && !seen[c]) {
            seen[c] = true;
            setTimeout(function(){ show(c); }, 600);
          } else {
            showReopenForCurrent();
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        return r;
      };
      wrapped.__dvWinHooked = true;
      window[name] = wrapped;
      return true;
    }
    var tries = 0;
    (function tryW(){
      var ok = wrap('showWin') || wrap('__craftShowWin');
      // also patch craft win reveal if present
      var cw = document.getElementById('craft-win');
      if (cw && !cw.__dvObs) {
        cw.__dvObs = true;
        var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
          if (!cw.hidden && cw.style.display !== 'none') {
            try {
              var c = curCh();
              if (DERIV[c]) showReopenForCurrent();
            } catch (e) {}
          }
        });
        mo.observe(cw, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['hidden', 'style', 'class'] });
      }
      if (ok || tries > 50) { window.__dvWinHooked = true; return; }
      tries++; setTimeout(tryW, 200);
    })();
  })();

})();
</script>

  function rulePhase(idx){

      }
      if(idx===6){
        var all6=[{id:'p1',label:'阶段一 · 三环闭合'},{id:'p2',label:'阶段二 · 接地回路'}];

      }
      if(idx===7){
        var all7=[{id:'p1',label:'阶段一 · 分流定压'},{id:'p2',label:'阶段二 · 中继输电'}];
        var q; try{q=ch7Phase;}catch(e){q=null;}
        var cur7=(q==='beam'||q==='transition'||q==='finale')?'p2':'p1';
        return {id:cur7,label:(cur7==='p2'?all7[1].label:all7[0].label),all:all7};
      }
      if(idx===8){
        var all8=[{id:'p1',label:'实验台 · 推导'},{id:'p2',label:'控制台 · 升频'}];
        var C=null; try{C=(typeof CH8!=='undefined'&&CH8)?CH8:window.CH8;}catch(e){}

        return {id:'p1',label:all8[0].label,all:all8};
      }
    }catch(e){}

  /* 序～七：取消逐字打字，整行直接浮现（与开头字幕同款） */
  function hookSetLine(){
    if(typeof window.setLine!=='function')return false;
    if(window.setLine.__cineHooked)return true;
    var orig=window.setLine;
    var w=function(idx){
      var r=orig.apply(this,arguments);

  function hookBegin(){

    var w=function(){var r=orig.apply(this,arguments);try{applyAccent();}catch(e){}return r;};
    w.__cineHooked=true;window.beginChapterIntro=w;return true;
  }
  /* 第八章：整行浮现 + 自动过场（与序～七同款；轮询驱动，避免逐字观察的竞态） */
  function ch8Ref(){ try{ if(typeof CH8!=='undefined'&&CH8) return CH8; }catch(e){} return window.CH8||null; }
  function ch8Advance(){ var C=ch8Ref(); if(C&&C._advanceDlg){ try{C._advanceDlg();}catch(e){} } }
  function ch8AutoCine(){
    var lastLen=0, holdUntil=0, armed=false, advancing=false, gen=0;
    function loop(){
      var box=document.getElementById('ch8-dialogue');
      var el=document.getElementById('ch8-dlg-text');
      var on = box && el && getComputedStyle(box).display!=='none';
      if(on){
        var t=el.textContent||'';
        // 新的一行：setLine 刚写入首字（长度回落到 1）
        if(t.length===1 && lastLen!==1){
          gen++;
          applyAccent();
          ch8Advance();                 // 立即补全整行（取消逐字）
          cine('ch8-dlg-text');
          var full=el.textContent||'';
          holdUntil=performance.now()+holdMs(full.length);
          armed=true; advancing=false;
        } else if(armed && !advancing && performance.now()>=holdUntil){
          armed=false; advancing=true;
          var myGen=gen;
          cineOut('ch8-dlg-text');
          setTimeout(function(){
            advancing=false;
            if(myGen!==gen)return;                 // 期间已切到新行，放弃本次推进
            var b=document.getElementById('ch8-dialogue');
            if(!b||getComputedStyle(b).display==='none')return;
            ch8Advance();                          // 进入下一行
          },480);
        }
        lastLen=(el.textContent||'').length;
      } else { lastLen=0; armed=false; advancing=false; }
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  /* ---------- 规则按钮显隐 ---------- */
  var GAMEPLAY=['controls','controls2','controls3','controls4','controls5','controls6','controls7','ch8-console-hud','phase-experiment'];
  function isVis(el){if(!el)return false;var cs=getComputedStyle(el);if(cs.display==='none'||cs.visibility==='hidden')return false;if(parseFloat(cs.opacity||'1')<0.05)return false;var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return r.width>2&&r.height>2;}
  function anyVis(ids){for(var i=0;i<ids.length;i++)if(isVis(document.getElementById(ids[i])))return true;return false;}
  function summaryVis(){if(isVis(document.getElementById('ch8-summary')))return true;var e=document.querySelectorAll('.ch-summary');for(var i=0;i<e.length;i++)if(isVis(e[i]))return true;return false;}
  function overlayOpen(){var a=document.getElementById('dv-overlay'),b=document.getElementById('rl-overlay');return (a&&getComputedStyle(a).display!=='none')||(b&&getComputedStyle(b).display!=='none');}
  function updateRuleBtn(){

    rlBtn.style.display=show?'flex':'none';
    if(show)rlBtn.style.setProperty('--dlg-accent',accent(c));

    // 即时变化：规则浮层打开时，若当前章节进入新阶段（如第五章 phase1→phase2），自动刷新内容

        buildRules(c);
        rlCard.scrollTop=sc;
      }
    }
  }
  setInterval(updateRuleBtn,450);

  /* ---------- 初始化 ---------- */
  function init(){ch8AutoCine();applyAccent();}
  if(document.body)init();else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init);
  var tries=0;(function t(){var a=hookSetLine(),b=hookBegin();if((a&&b)||tries>40)return;tries++;setTimeout(t,150);})();
})();

<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     剧情背景动画（电磁余晖）— 独立模块，可整段删除
     仅在剧情对白阶段显示：分级色罩 + 流动极光带 + 发光电荷粒子 +
     景深光斑 + 偶发放电弧 + 暗角。按章节主题色，requestAnimationFrame 绘制。
     ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';
  var ACC={0:'#37c8ff',1:'#37c8ff',2:'#ff9a3c',3:'#5cf08c',4:'#ffcf4a',5:'#37d8ff',6:'#b06bff',7:'#37c8ff',8:'#e8c270'};
  function curCh(){try{if(typeof window.ch==='number')return window.ch;}catch(e){}return -1;}
  function hex2rgb(h){h=(h||'').replace('#','');return [parseInt(h.substr(0,2),16)||55,parseInt(h.substr(2,2),16)||200,parseInt(h.substr(4,2),16)||255];}
  function rnd(a,b){return a+Math.random()*(b-a);}

  var cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.id='story-bg';
  cv.style.cssText='position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:20;display:none;pointer-events:none;';
  (function attach(){if(document.body)document.body.appendChild(cv);else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',attach);})();
  var cx=cv.getContext('2d');
  var W=1,H=1,DPR=1;
  function resize(){DPR=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);W=window.innerWidth;H=window.innerHeight;cv.width=Math.max(1,W*DPR);cv.height=Math.max(1,H*DPR);cv.style.width=W+'px';cv.style.height=H+'px';cx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);initField();}
  window.addEventListener('resize',resize);

  /* 主题色（平滑过渡） */
  var col=[55,200,255],tgt=[55,200,255];
  function setTheme(c){tgt=hex2rgb(ACC[c]||'#37c8ff');}

  /* 发光精灵（drawImage 比 shadowBlur 快很多） */
  var sprite=document.createElement('canvas'),sctx=sprite.getContext('2d');
  function buildSprite(rgb){var S=64;sprite.width=S;sprite.height=S;var g=sctx.createRadialGradient(S/2,S/2,0,S/2,S/2,S/2);
    g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)');g.addColorStop(0.28,'rgba('+rgb[0]+','+rgb[1]+','+rgb[2]+',0.8)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba('+rgb[0]+','+rgb[1]+','+rgb[2]+',0)');
    sctx.clearRect(0,0,S,S);sctx.fillStyle=g;sctx.fillRect(0,0,S,S);}
  buildSprite(col);
  var whiteSprite=document.createElement('canvas');(function(){var s=64,c=whiteSprite.getContext('2d');whiteSprite.width=s;whiteSprite.height=s;
    var g=c.createRadialGradient(s/2,s/2,0,s/2,s/2,s/2);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)');g.addColorStop(0.32,'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,s,s);})();

  /* 场内元素 */
  var P=[],B=[],R=[],NP=26;
  function newP(init){return {x:rnd(0,W),y:init?rnd(0,H):H+rnd(0,40),vx:rnd(-4,4),vy:rnd(-15,-6),r:rnd(1.4,3.0),a:rnd(0.16,0.46),ph:rnd(0,6.28),sw:rnd(0.3,0.85),hot:Math.random()<0.10};}
  function initField(){
    P=[];for(var i=0;i<NP;i++)P.push(newP(true));
    B=[];for(var j=0;j<3;j++)B.push({x:rnd(0,W),y:rnd(0,H),r:rnd(130,270),vx:rnd(-3,3),vy:rnd(-5,2),a:rnd(0.02,0.045)});
    R=[];for(var k=0;k<2;k++)R.push({y:rnd(0.24,0.8),amp:rnd(26,60),len:rnd(0.8,1.5),sp:rnd(0.05,0.1)*(Math.random()<.5?-1:1),ph:rnd(0,6.28),a:rnd(0.035,0.06),th:rnd(64,140)});
  }
  resize();

  var arc=null,arcT=0,arcLife=0,nextArc=520+Math.random()*600;
  function makeArc(){var x=rnd(0,W),y=rnd(0,H*0.85),pts=[{x:x,y:y}],n=8+(Math.random()*8|0),dir=rnd(0,6.28);
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){dir+=rnd(-0.85,0.85);x+=Math.cos(dir)*rnd(12,42);y+=Math.sin(dir)*rnd(12,42);pts.push({x:x,y:y});}return pts;}

  function visible(){var d=document.getElementById('dialogue'),e=document.getElementById('ch8-dialogue');
    return (d&&getComputedStyle(d).display!=='none')||(e&&getComputedStyle(e).display!=='none');}

  var last=performance.now(),tick=0,env=0;
  function frame(now){
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    var dt=Math.min(50,now-last)/16.67;last=now;
    if(!visible()){if(cv.style.display!=='none')cv.style.display='none';env=0;return;}
    if(cv.style.display==='none')cv.style.display='block';
    tick++;
    env=Math.min(1,env+0.05*dt);   // 整体柔和淡入（剧情开场不再生硬弹出）
    var moved=false;for(var c=0;c<3;c++){var d2=tgt[c]-col[c];if(Math.abs(d2)>0.5){col[c]+=d2*0.06;moved=true;}}
    if(moved&&tick%5===0)buildSprite([col[0]|0,col[1]|0,col[2]|0]);
    var rr=col[0]|0,gg=col[1]|0,bb=col[2]|0;

    cx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

    /* 分级色罩 */
    var bw=cx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    bw.addColorStop(0,'rgba('+(rr*0.18|0)+','+(gg*0.18|0)+','+(bb*0.18|0)+',0.30)');
    bw.addColorStop(0.5,'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)');
    bw.addColorStop(1,'rgba('+(rr*0.12|0)+','+(gg*0.12|0)+','+(bb*0.12|0)+',0.32)');
    cx.fillStyle=bw;cx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    cx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';

    /* 极光带 */
    for(var ri=0;ri<R.length;ri++){var rb=R[ri];rb.ph+=rb.sp*0.02*dt;var yy=rb.y*H;
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(0,yy);
      for(var xx=0;xx<=W;xx+=16){var off=Math.sin(xx*0.006*rb.len+rb.ph)*rb.amp+Math.sin(xx*0.013+rb.ph*1.7)*rb.amp*0.3;cx.lineTo(xx,yy+off);}
      cx.strokeStyle='rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+(rb.a*env)+')';cx.lineWidth=rb.th;cx.lineCap='round';cx.stroke();
    }

    /* 体积光束（god-rays）— 从顶部斜射而下的柔光，缓慢摆动，更有电影质感 */
    for(var gi=0;gi<3;gi++){
      var sway=Math.sin(tick*0.006+gi*2.1)*0.18;
      var ox=W*(0.22+gi*0.30)+Math.sin(tick*0.004+gi)*W*0.04;
      cx.save();
      cx.translate(ox,-H*0.10);
      cx.rotate(0.32+sway+gi*0.05);
      var rayLen=H*1.25, rayW=W*(0.10+gi*0.03);
      var rg=cx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,rayLen);
      var ra=(0.045+gi*0.012)*env;
      rg.addColorStop(0,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+ra+')');
      rg.addColorStop(0.55,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+(ra*0.35)+')');
      rg.addColorStop(1,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+',0)');
      cx.fillStyle=rg;
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(-rayW*0.3,0);cx.lineTo(rayW*0.3,0);cx.lineTo(rayW,rayLen);cx.lineTo(-rayW,rayLen);cx.closePath();cx.fill();
      cx.restore();
    }

    /* 景深光斑 */
    for(var bi=0;bi<B.length;bi++){var bk=B[bi];bk.x+=bk.vx*0.1*dt;bk.y+=bk.vy*0.1*dt;
      if(bk.y<-bk.r){bk.y=H+bk.r;bk.x=rnd(0,W);}if(bk.x<-bk.r)bk.x=W+bk.r;if(bk.x>W+bk.r)bk.x=-bk.r;
      var bg=cx.createRadialGradient(bk.x,bk.y,0,bk.x,bk.y,bk.r);
      bg.addColorStop(0,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+bk.a+')');bg.addColorStop(1,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+',0)');
      cx.fillStyle=bg;cx.fillRect(bk.x-bk.r,bk.y-bk.r,bk.r*2,bk.r*2);
    }

    /* 电荷粒子 */
    for(var pi=0;pi<P.length;pi++){var p=P[pi];p.ph+=0.02*dt;
      p.x+=(p.vx+Math.sin(p.ph)*p.sw)*0.1*dt;p.y+=p.vy*0.1*dt;
      if(p.y<-12||p.x<-24||p.x>W+24){P[pi]=newP(false);continue;}
      var sz=p.r*(p.hot?5:6);
      cx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,p.a*(0.6+0.4*Math.sin(p.ph*2))*env));
      cx.drawImage(p.hot?whiteSprite:sprite,p.x-sz/2,p.y-sz/2,sz,sz);
    }
    cx.globalAlpha=1;

    /* 偶发放电弧（闪电感的「闪光」）——只在雷暴/电塔题材的章节出现，
       其余章节进场保持安静，不再每章都闪。 */
    var _c=curCh(), _storm=(_c===6||_c===7||_c===8);
    if(_storm){
      arcT++;
      if(!arc&&arcT>nextArc){arc=makeArc();arcLife=0;}
      if(arc){arcLife+=dt;var la=Math.max(0,1-arcLife/15);
        if(la<=0){arc=null;arcT=0;nextArc=560+Math.random()*640;}
        else{cx.strokeStyle='rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+(0.30*la)+')';cx.lineWidth=1.4;
          cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(arc[0].x,arc[0].y);for(var ai=1;ai<arc.length;ai++)cx.lineTo(arc[ai].x,arc[ai].y);cx.stroke();}
      }
    } else { arc=null; arcT=0; }

    cx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';

    /* 暗角（聚焦中央、便于阅读） */
    var vg=cx.createRadialGradient(W/2,H*0.55,Math.min(W,H)*0.20,W/2,H*0.55,Math.max(W,H)*0.78);
    vg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');vg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,'+(0.55*env)+')');
    cx.fillStyle=vg;cx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    /* 电影感黑边（letterbox）— 随淡入展开，营造宽银幕过场质感 */
    var lb=Math.round(Math.min(70,H*0.072)*env);
    if(lb>0.5){
      var tb=cx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,lb);
      tb.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0.92)');tb.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
      cx.fillStyle=tb;cx.fillRect(0,0,W,lb);
      var bb2=cx.createLinearGradient(0,H-lb,0,H);
      bb2.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');bb2.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0.92)');
      cx.fillStyle=bb2;cx.fillRect(0,H-lb,W,lb);
      // 细发光描边，让黑边边缘更精致
      cx.fillStyle='rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+(0.10*env)+')';
      cx.fillRect(0,lb-1,W,1);cx.fillRect(0,H-lb,W,1);
    }
  }

  setInterval(function(){var c=curCh();if(ACC[c])setTheme(c);},400);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>

## 事理图谱摘要
- 标题：电容实验三：储能与充电
- Play 链：P1(premise) → M1(premise) → O1(operation) → O2(operation) → O3(operation) → O4(operation) → C1(constraint) → C2(constraint) → R1(result) → I1(irrelevant) → C_OUT(constraint)
- 策略途径：单变量·馈线长度；多参盲调；试探·音量
## 埋点规格（telemetrySpec）

按事理图谱 traceMap 上报：每次滑条/按钮操作记录 controlId、值、时间戳。
snapshot 事件在「发射/测试/提交」时记录各 control 当前值。
评判时将轨迹节点映射到 KG play 链（P1→O1→C*→R1）与 strategy routes。
混淆变量触碰可选记录，但不计入主探究路径得分。

### 事件列表

- **irrelevant_touch** `audio-volume` → I1
- **tuning** `modeSelect` → M1（必采）
- **tuning** `s-cable` → O3（必采）

### DT 检查点

- decision: 选择模式?
- decision: 选择 C 和 V?
- retry: 提示选择
- decision: 储能达标?
- retry: 能量不足或过载
- result: 过关
- decision: 电源耗尽?
- retry: 电源耗尽重试

<script>
/* ===== js/core/registry.js ===== */
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Game shell — chapter registry & navigation
//
//  Chapter API (via Game.register):
//    init()              — enter chapter
//    frame(ctx)          — per-frame render + tick (required)
//    usesCanvas          — true: chapter uses #c canvas (default); Ch8 uses clearCanvas: false
//    clearCanvas         — false: skip clearRect even when usesCanvas is true (Ch8 sky overlay)
//    syncSize()          — optional resize hook
//    skipToPhase2()      — optional dev skip
//    showSummary()       — optional victory epilogue
//    onCanvasClick/Move/Down/Up/RightClick — optional input hooks
//    onCanvasTouchStart/Move/End — optional touch hooks
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
window.Game = window.Game || {
  ch: 0,
  chapters: [],

  register(index, api) {
    this.chapters[index] = api;
  },

  getModule(n) {
    return this.chapters[n] || null;
  }
};

Object.defineProperty(window, 'ch', {
  get() { return Game.ch; },
  set(v) { Game.ch = v; },
  configurable: true
});

(function (Game) {
  Game.frame = function (ctx) {
    const mod = Game.getModule(Game.ch);
    if (!mod || !mod.frame) return false;
    if (mod.usesCanvas !== false && mod.clearCanvas !== false) ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    mod.frame(ctx);
    return true;
  };

  Game.syncActiveChapterSize = function () {
    const mod = Game.getModule(Game.ch);
    if (mod && mod.syncSize) mod.syncSize();
  };

  Game.dispatchCanvas = function (hook, ...args) {
    const mod = Game.getModule(Game.ch);
    if (mod && typeof mod[hook] === 'function') mod[hook](...args);
  };

  Game._jumpToCore = function (n) {
    if (typeof resetChapterUI === 'function') resetChapterUI();
    Game.ch = n;
    if (typeof SFX !== 'undefined' && SFX.scene) SFX.scene(n); // ambient per chapter
    const mod = Game.getModule(n);
    if (mod && mod.init) mod.init();
    if (typeof saveGameProgress === 'function') saveGameProgress();
  };

  Game.jumpTo = function (n) {
    Game.ensureChapter(n).then(() => {
      Game._jumpToCore(n);
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.error(err);
    });
  };
})(window.Game);

function jumpToChapter(n) {
  Game.jumpTo(n);
}

</script>
<script>
/* ===== js/core/chapter-loader.js ===== */
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Lazy chapter script / Ch8 CSS loader
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
(function (Game) {
  const loadedScripts = new Set();
  let ch8CssLoaded = false;
  let ch8BundleLoaded = false;

  const CHAPTER_SCRIPTS = {
    0: ['js/chapters/ch0.js'],
    1: ['js/chapters/ch1.js'],
    2: ['js/chapters/ch2.js'],
    3: ['js/chapters/ch3.js'],
    4: ['js/chapters/ch4.js'],
    5: ['js/chapters/ch5.js'],
    6: [
      'js/chapters/ch6/state.js',
      'js/chapters/ch6/armor.js',
      'js/chapters/ch6/circuit.js',
      'js/chapters/ch6/main.js',
    ],
    7: [
      'js/chapters/ch7/state.js',
      'js/chapters/ch7/phase1.js',
      'js/chapters/ch7/iso.js',
      'js/chapters/ch7/main.js',
    ],
  };

  const CH8_SCRIPTS = [
    'js/chapters/ch8/init.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/experiment.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/phase-3-transition-lab-d.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/phase-4-the-console.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/pulse-resolution-single.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/sky.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/climax.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/main.js',
    'js/chapters/ch8/assemble.js',
  ];

  function loadScript(src) {
    if (loadedScripts.has(src)) return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const el = document.createElement('script');
      el.src = src;
      el.onload = () => {
        loadedScripts.add(src);
        resolve();
      };
      el.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load ' + src));
      document.body.appendChild(el);
    });
  }

  function loadScriptsSequential(urls) {
    return urls.reduce(
      (chain, url) => chain.then(() => loadScript(url)),
      Promise.resolve()
    );
  }

  function ensureCh8Css() {
    if (ch8CssLoaded) return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const link = document.createElement('link');
      link.rel = 'stylesheet';
      link.href = 'css/ch8.css';
      link.onload = () => {
        ch8CssLoaded = true;
        resolve();
      };
      link.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load css/ch8.css'));
      document.head.appendChild(link);
    });
  }

  Game.ensureChapter = function (n) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 0 || n > 8) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error('Invalid chapter: ' + n));
    }
    if (Game.getModule(n)) return Promise.resolve();

    if (n === 8) {
      if (ch8BundleLoaded) return Promise.resolve();
      return ensureCh8Css()
        .then(() => loadScriptsSequential(CH8_SCRIPTS))
        .then(() => {
          ch8BundleLoaded = true;
        });
    }

    const urls = CHAPTER_SCRIPTS[n];
    if (!urls) return Promise.reject(new Error('No scripts for chapter ' + n));
    return loadScriptsSequential(urls);
  };
})(window.Game);

</script>
<script>
/* ===== js/core/audio.js ===== */
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Procedural SFX — single AudioContext, zero files
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const STORAGE_KEY = 'nus-capacitor-era-sfx-v1';
  const TICK_MS = 45;

  let ctx = null;
  let master = null;     // global volume/mute gain
  let comp = null;       // safety compressor before destination
  let sfxBus = null;     // all one-shot SFX route here
  let muted = false;
  let volume = 1;
  const tickLast = {};

  function loadSettings() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (!raw) return;
      const s = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (typeof s.muted === 'boolean') muted = s.muted;
      if (typeof s.volume === 'number') volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s.volume));
    } catch (_) {}
    updateUi();
    syncMusic();
  }

  function saveSettings() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ muted, volume }));
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  function applyMaster() {
    if (!master) return;
    master.gain.value = muted ? 0 : volume;
  }

  // The top speaker button is the single master audio control: keep the
  // background-music engine (window.MUSIC, defined in music.js) in lockstep
  // with the SFX mute state so one click silences / restores everything.
  function syncMusic() {
    try {
      if (window.MUSIC && typeof window.MUSIC.applyVolume === 'function') {
        window.MUSIC.applyVolume(muted ? 0 : volume);
      } else if (window.MUSIC && typeof window.MUSIC.setOn === 'function') {
        window.MUSIC.setOn(!muted);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  function ensure() {
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AC) return false;
    if (!ctx) {
      ctx = new AC();
      master = ctx.createGain();
      comp = ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();   // tame overlapping peaks
      comp.threshold.value = -10;
      comp.knee.value = 18;
      comp.ratio.value = 4;
      comp.attack.value = 0.003;
      comp.release.value = 0.25;
      sfxBus = ctx.createGain();
      sfxBus.gain.value = 1;
      sfxBus.connect(master);
      master.connect(comp);
      comp.connect(ctx.destination);
      applyMaster();
    }
    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
    return true;
  }

  function setVolume(v) {
    volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
    if (volume <= 0) muted = true;
    else muted = false;
    applyMaster();
    syncMusic();
    saveSettings();
    updateUi();
  }

  function setMuted(m) {
    muted = m;
    applyMaster();
    syncMusic();
    saveSettings();
    updateUi();
  }

  function toggleMute() {
    setMuted(!muted);
  }

  function cycleVolume() {
    if (muted || volume <= 0.01) {
      muted = false;
      volume = 1;
    } else if (volume > 0.6) {
      volume = 0.5;
    } else {
      muted = true;
    }
    applyMaster();
    syncMusic();
    saveSettings();
    updateUi();
  }

  function syncVolumeSlider() {
    const slider = document.getElementById('audio-volume');
    if (!slider) return;
    slider.value = String(Math.round(volume * 100));
    slider.disabled = false;
  }

  function updateUi() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('sfx-btn');
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.textContent = muted ? '\u{1F507}' : (volume < 0.99 ? '\u{1F509}' : '\u{1F50A}');
    btn.title = muted
      ? '\u97F3\u6548\uFF1A\u9759\u97F3\uFF08\u70B9\u51FB\u6062\u590D \u00b7 \u62D6\u52A8\u6ED1\u5757\u8C03\u8282\uFF09'
      : `\u97F3\u6548\uFF1A${Math.round(volume * 100)}%\uFF08\u70B9\u51FB\u9759\u97F3 \u00b7 \u62D6\u52A8\u6ED1\u5757\u8C03\u8282\uFF09`;
    btn.classList.toggle('muted', muted);
    syncVolumeSlider();
  }

  // Interactive controls that should give a faint hover blip.
  const HOVER_SEL = 'button, .c6-btn, .c5-lcard, .map-node.clickable, .map-dev-btn,' +
    ' #v-btn, #map-btn, #map-close, #c3-start-btn, #c3-activate-btn, #c4-discharge-btn,' +
    ' [id^="sum"][id$="-close"], #ch8-sum-close';

  function initUi() {
    // Delegated hover feedback across all interactive controls.
    document.addEventListener('pointerover', (e) => {
      if (muted) return;
      const t = e.target;
      if (t && t.closest && t.closest(HOVER_SEL)) tick('uiHover', 80);
    }, true);

    const btn = document.getElementById('sfx-btn');
    const slider = document.getElementById('audio-volume');
    if (slider) {
      slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
        ensure();
        const v = parseInt(slider.value, 10) / 100;
        volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
        if (volume > 0) muted = false;
        else muted = true;
        applyMaster();
        syncMusic();
        saveSettings();
        updateUi();
      });
      slider.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
    }
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      ensure();
      if (e.shiftKey) cycleVolume();
      else toggleMute();
    });
    updateUi();
  }

  function t0() { return ctx ? ctx.currentTime : 0; }

  // ── Core synth primitive ────────────────────────────────
  // opts: { type, freq, freqEnd, gain, attack, dur, delay, detune,
  //         filter:{type,freq,q} }
  function voice(opts) {
    if (!ensure() || muted) return;
    const o = opts || {};
    const start = t0() + (o.delay || 0);
    const gain = o.gain != null ? o.gain : 0.05;
    const attack = o.attack != null ? o.attack : 0.008;
    const dur = o.dur != null ? o.dur : 0.2;
    const f0 = o.freq || 440;
    const f1 = o.freqEnd != null ? o.freqEnd : f0;

    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    osc.type = o.type || 'sine';
    if (o.detune) osc.detune.value = o.detune;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0, start);
    if (f1 !== f0) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(1, f1), start + dur);

    const g = ctx.createGain();
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, start);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.0002, gain), start + attack);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, start + dur);

    if (o.filter) {
      const flt = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      flt.type = o.filter.type || 'lowpass';
      flt.frequency.value = o.filter.freq || 1200;
      if (o.filter.q != null) flt.Q.value = o.filter.q;
      osc.connect(flt);
      flt.connect(g);
    } else {
      osc.connect(g);
    }
    g.connect(sfxBus);
    osc.start(start);
    osc.stop(start + dur + 0.03);
  }

  // Soft chord/pad of stacked voices with optional spread + detune.
  function chord(freqs, opts) {
    const o = opts || {};
    const n = freqs.length;
    freqs.forEach((f, i) => voice({
      type: o.type || 'sine',
      freq: f,
      gain: o.gain != null ? o.gain : 0.05,
      attack: o.attack != null ? o.attack : 0.01,
      dur: o.dur != null ? o.dur : 0.4,
      delay: (o.spread || 0) * i,
      detune: (i - (n - 1) / 2) * (o.detune || 0),
      filter: o.filter ? { type: 'lowpass', freq: o.filter } : null,
    }));
  }

  // Short, lightly filtered plucked note (ticks / keys / gears).
  function pluck(freq, opts) {
    const o = opts || {};
    const gain = o.gain != null ? o.gain : 0.05;
    const dur = o.dur != null ? o.dur : 0.08;
    voice({
      type: o.type || 'triangle',
      freq, gain, attack: 0.003, dur,
      filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: o.filter || 2200 },
    });
    if (o.harmonic) {
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: freq * 2, gain: gain * 0.4, attack: 0.003, dur: dur * 0.7 });
    }
  }

  // Cheap reverb-ish tail: a few decaying, low-passed echoes.
  function tail(freq, gain, dur) {
    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
      voice({
        type: 'sine', freq,
        gain: gain * Math.pow(0.5, i),
        attack: 0.01, dur,
        delay: i * 0.11,
        filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1600 },
      });
    }
  }

  // Filtered noise burst. opts: { q, curve, tame, filterType, smooth }
  // The raw signal is a one-pole-smoothed noise (softer "air" rather than
  // harsh static) with a non-linear decay and a soft attack to kill clicks;
  // a fixed lowpass ("tame") shaves the fizz off the top end.
  function noiseBurst(gain, dur, filterFreq, opts) {
    if (!ensure() || muted) return;
    const o = opts || {};
    const start = t0();
    const len = Math.ceil(ctx.sampleRate * dur);
    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, len, ctx.sampleRate);
    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
    const smooth = o.smooth != null ? o.smooth : 0.4; // 1 = white, →0 = darker
    const curve = o.curve != null ? o.curve : 2;      // higher = faster, softer tail
    let prev = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
      prev += smooth * ((Math.random() * 2 - 1) - prev);
      d[i] = prev * Math.pow(1 - i / len, curve);
    }
    const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = buf;
    const g = ctx.createGain();
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, start);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.0002, gain), start + 0.006); // soft attack
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, start + dur);
    let node = src;
    if (filterFreq) {
      const flt = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      flt.type = o.filterType || 'bandpass';
      flt.frequency.value = filterFreq;
      flt.Q.value = o.q != null ? o.q : 0.7;
      node.connect(flt);
      node = flt;
    }
    const tame = ctx.createBiquadFilter();   // gentle high cut → no grit/fizz
    tame.type = 'lowpass';
    tame.frequency.value = o.tame || 3000;
    tame.Q.value = 0.5;
    node.connect(tame);
    tame.connect(g);
    g.connect(sfxBus);
    src.start(start);
  }

  // Legacy single-tone helper (kept for compatibility), now softened
  // with a short attack + lowpass and routed through the SFX bus.
  function tone(type, freq, gain, dur) {
    voice({ type, freq, gain, attack: 0.006, dur, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: Math.min(6000, freq * 5 + 600) } });
  }

  function arpeggio(freqs, gain, step) {
    freqs.forEach((f, i) => voice({
      type: 'triangle', freq: f, gain,
      attack: 0.006, dur: step * 1.7, delay: i * step,
      filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: Math.min(5000, f * 4) },
    }));
  }

  // tiny random detune (cents) so repeated ticks don't feel mechanical
  function jit(c) { return (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (c || 6); }

  const PRESETS = {
    // ── UI ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    uiClick: () => pluck(330, { gain: 0.06, dur: 0.07, filter: 1500, harmonic: true }),
    uiHover: () => voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 900, gain: 0.016, attack: 0.004, dur: 0.05,
                           filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 2600 } }),
    uiOpen: () => {
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 520, gain: 0.05, dur: 0.1, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1900 } });
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 780, gain: 0.04, dur: 0.13, delay: 0.05, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 2300 } });
    },
    uiClose: () => {
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 660, gain: 0.045, dur: 0.1, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 2000 } });
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 420, gain: 0.04, dur: 0.13, delay: 0.05, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1500 } });
    },
    dlgAdvance: () => pluck(560, { gain: 0.038, dur: 0.06, filter: 1900 }),

    // ── Win / transitions ────────────────────────────────
    winFanfare: () => {
      arpeggio([261.63, 329.63, 392, 523.25], 0.07, 0.12);
      tail(523.25, 0.05, 0.5);
    },
    chapterTransition: () => {
      voice({ type: 'sawtooth', freq: 90, freqEnd: 60, gain: 0.05, dur: 0.45, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 600 } });
      chord([110, 164.81, 220], { type: 'triangle', gain: 0.03, dur: 0.6, detune: 5 });
    },

    // ── Sliders / ticks ──────────────────────────────────
    sliderTick: () => voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 760, detune: jit(), gain: 0.024, attack: 0.002, dur: 0.03,
                              filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 3000 } }),
    sliderEdge: () => pluck(440, { gain: 0.05, dur: 0.09, filter: 1400, harmonic: true }),
    errorBuzz: () => {
      // soft low "no" — a muffled minor-second wobble instead of a raw saw rasp
      voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 174.61, freqEnd: 146.83, gain: 0.055, dur: 0.18, detune: -6, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 620 } });
      voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 185, freqEnd: 155.56, gain: 0.04, dur: 0.18, detune: 7, delay: 0.015, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 560 } });
    },
    breakdownZap: () => {
      // capacitor breakdown — a tamed crackle plus a pitched discharge "tzap"
      noiseBurst(0.06, 0.08, 2000, { q: 1.3, tame: 2600 });
      voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 1400, freqEnd: 320, gain: 0.05, dur: 0.09, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 2200 } });
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 660, gain: 0.03, dur: 0.13, delay: 0.02, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1300 } });
    },
    bandEnter: () => { voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 640, gain: 0.06, dur: 0.14 }); tail(640, 0.03, 0.3); },
    puzzleComplete: () => { arpeggio([523.25, 659.25, 783.99], 0.06, 0.09); tail(783.99, 0.04, 0.4); },

    // ── Chapter 3 ────────────────────────────────────────
    ch3ChargeStart: () => voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 220, freqEnd: 340, gain: 0.06, dur: 0.25, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1200 } }),
    ch3ActivateOk: () => { arpeggio([440, 554, 660], 0.06, 0.08); tail(660, 0.035, 0.35); },
    ch3ActivateFail: () => {
      voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 200, freqEnd: 120, gain: 0.06, dur: 0.22, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 760 } });
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 100, freqEnd: 70, gain: 0.035, dur: 0.24, delay: 0.02, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 480 } });
    },
    ch3Awaken: () => { chord([110, 138.59, 164.81, 220], { type: 'sine', gain: 0.04, dur: 0.55, spread: 0.05, detune: 4 }); },

    // ── Chapter 4 ────────────────────────────────────────
    ch4RunePulse: () => voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 380, gain: 0.05, dur: 0.12, filter: { type: 'bandpass', freq: 760, q: 2 } }),
    ch4DoorOpen: () => { arpeggio([220, 277, 330, 440], 0.06, 0.1); tail(440, 0.04, 0.45); },

    // ── Chapter 5 ────────────────────────────────────────
    ch5CalLocked: () => { voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 500, gain: 0.06, dur: 0.22 }); tail(500, 0.03, 0.3); },
    ch5Handshake: () => arpeggio([392, 494, 587], 0.05, 0.07),
    ch5TrackLocked: () => pluck(720, { gain: 0.045, dur: 0.09, filter: 2600, harmonic: true }),
    ch5TrackLost: () => voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 320, freqEnd: 220, gain: 0.05, dur: 0.16, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 900 } }),
    ch5SignalLock: () => { arpeggio([523, 659, 784, 988], 0.07, 0.1); tail(988, 0.05, 0.5); },

    // ── Chapter 6 ────────────────────────────────────────
    ch6Seal: () => { arpeggio([330, 415, 494], 0.07, 0.09); tail(494, 0.04, 0.35); },
    ch6Transform: () => chord([110, 146.83, 174.61], { type: 'sine', gain: 0.045, dur: 0.5, spread: 0.04, detune: 5 }),
    ch6Overheat: () => {
      // warm low rumble with a soft hiss riding on top — no harsh static
      noiseBurst(0.05, 0.2, 1300, { q: 0.6, tame: 1700, curve: 1.4, smooth: 0.28 });
      voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 70, freqEnd: 50, gain: 0.05, dur: 0.3, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 460 } });
    },
    ch6WireStep: () => voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 620, detune: jit(), gain: 0.034, attack: 0.002, dur: 0.045, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 2600 } }),
    ch6CompOn: () => pluck(520, { type: 'square', gain: 0.04, dur: 0.07, filter: 1700, harmonic: true }),
    ch6ReverseBlock: () => voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 150, freqEnd: 110, gain: 0.06, dur: 0.1, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 760 } }),
    ch6MeltReset: () => {
      voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 90, freqEnd: 54, gain: 0.07, dur: 0.3, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 540 } });
      noiseBurst(0.05, 0.16, 1100, { q: 0.6, tame: 1500, curve: 1.4, smooth: 0.28 });
    },

    // ── Chapter 7 ────────────────────────────────────────
    ch7DialTick: () => pluck(180, { type: 'square', gain: 0.06, dur: 0.05, filter: 1400 }),
    ch7BeamFire: () => {
      // tesla discharge — keep the energy, drop the fizz; add a pitched core
      noiseBurst(0.04, 0.09, 2600, { q: 1.1, tame: 3000 });
      voice({ type: 'sawtooth', freq: 1000, freqEnd: 520, gain: 0.045, dur: 0.2, filter: { type: 'bandpass', freq: 1500, q: 1.0 } });
      voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 520, gain: 0.03, dur: 0.18, delay: 0.03, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 1200 } });
    },
    ch7BeamHit: () => { arpeggio([440, 550, 660, 880], 0.07, 0.09); tail(880, 0.04, 0.4); },
    ch7BeamMiss: () => voice({ type: 'triangle', freq: 240, freqEnd: 150, gain: 0.07, dur: 0.22, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 700 } }),
    ch7Finale: () => { arpeggio([262, 330, 392, 523, 659], 0.06, 0.11); tail(659, 0.05, 0.6); },

    // ── Chapter 8 ────────────────────────────────────────
    ch8KnobTick: () => voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 900, detune: jit(), gain: 0.02, attack: 0.002, dur: 0.022, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 3200 } }),
    ch8NeedleSnap: () => pluck(300, { type: 'square', gain: 0.038, dur: 0.04, filter: 1600 }),
    ch8LeverPull: () => voice({ type: 'sawtooth', freq: 150, freqEnd: 90, gain: 0.06, dur: 0.18, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 700 } }),
    ch8PulseResolve: () => { voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 480, gain: 0.06, dur: 0.14 }); tail(480, 0.03, 0.3); },
    ch8Climax: () => {
      chord([110, 138.59, 164.81, 220], { type: 'sine', gain: 0.04, dur: 0.7, spread: 0.05, detune: 5 });
      tail(220, 0.04, 0.6);
    },

    // ── Prologue ─────────────────────────────────────────
    prologueSkip: () => pluck(380, { gain: 0.04, dur: 0.08, filter: 1800 }),
    prologueBeat: () => voice({ type: 'sine', freq: 260, gain: 0.02, attack: 0.02, dur: 0.18, filter: { type: 'lowpass', freq: 900 } }),
  };

  // ══ Background music ════════════════════════════════════
  // The adaptive BGM (per-chapter melody, harmony, pad bed) is now
  // owned by the standalone engine in music.js (window.MUSIC). The old
  // ambient-pad layer that used to live here was removed so the two
  // music beds never play on top of each other and bleed between
  // chapters. scene()/stopScene() stay as no-ops so the existing
  // per-chapter calls (registry, prologue, victory) keep working.
  function scene() {}
  function stopScene() {}

  function play(preset) {
    if (muted) return;
    const fn = PRESETS[preset];
    if (fn) fn();
  }

  function tick(preset, ms) {
    if (muted) return;
    const interval = ms != null ? ms : TICK_MS;
    const now = performance.now();
    if (tickLast[preset] && now - tickLast[preset] < interval) return;
    tickLast[preset] = now;
    play(preset);
  }

  function edge(key, cond, preset) {
    if (!window._sfxEdge) window._sfxEdge = {};
    const prev = window._sfxEdge[key];
    window._sfxEdge[key] = !!cond;
    if (cond && !prev) play(preset);
    return !!cond;
  }

  function bindGestureUnlock() {
    const unlock = () => {
      ensure();
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', unlock, true);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', unlock, true);
    };
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', unlock, true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', unlock, true);
  }

  window.SFX = {
    ensure,
    play,
    tick,
    edge,
    scene,
    stopScene,
    setVolume,
    setMuted,
    toggleMute,
    cycleVolume,
    loadSettings,
    saveSettings,
    get muted() { return muted; },
    get volume() { return volume; },
  };

  loadSettings();
  bindGestureUnlock();
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initUi);
  } else {
    initUi();
  }
})();

</script>

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Local progress persistence (localStorage)

const PROGRESS_KEY = 'nus-capacitor-era-v1';

function saveGameProgress() {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(PROGRESS_KEY, JSON.stringify({
      v: 1,
      completed: [...completedChapters].sort((a, b) => a - b),
      chapter: Game.ch,
      devUnlocked: !!devUnlocked,
    }));
  } catch (_) { /* quota / private browsing */ }
}

function loadGameProgress() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(PROGRESS_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const data = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!data || data.v !== 1 || !Array.isArray(data.completed)) return null;
    return data;
  } catch (_) {
    return null;
  }
}

function applyGameProgress(data) {
  if (!data) return;
  completedChapters.clear();
  for (const i of data.completed) {
    if (Number.isInteger(i) && i >= 0 && i < UNLOCKED_CH) completedChapters.add(i);
  }
  devUnlocked = !!data.devUnlocked;
}

function getProgressResumeChapter(data) {
  const n = data.chapter;
  if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 0 || n >= UNLOCKED_CH) return 0;
  return n;
}

function markChapterComplete(idx) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(idx) || idx < 0 || idx >= UNLOCKED_CH) return;
  completedChapters.add(idx);
  saveGameProgress();
}

function resetGameProgress() {
  if (!confirm('确定要重置所有进度吗？\n已完成的章节记录将被清除，将回到序章。')) return;
  try { localStorage.removeItem(PROGRESS_KEY); } catch (_) {}
  completedChapters.clear();
  devUnlocked = false;
  closeMap();
  Game.jumpTo(0);
}

let buildings = [];
function genCity() {
  buildings = []; let sx = 0x2A3F91;
  function r() { sx^=sx<<13; sx^=sx>>17; sx^=sx<<5; return (sx>>>0)/4294967296; }
  let x = 0; const gY = typeof getCityGroundY === 'function' ? getCityGroundY() : H * 0.58;
  const towerXs = TOWER_FX.map(fx => fx * W);
  const CLEAR = 62, NEAR = 170; // px: clear zone / near-tower influence zone
  while (x < W + 10) {
    const w=30+r()*54, h=65+r()*(H*0.33);
    const bCx = x + w/2;
    // Skip buildings that would overlap a tower silhouette
    if (!towerXs.some(tx => Math.abs(bCx - tx) < CLEAR)) {
      const fc=Math.max(2,Math.floor(h/22)), cc=Math.max(1,Math.floor(w/14));
      const wins=[];
      for(let f=0;f<fc;f++) for(let c=0;c<cc;c++) wins.push({f,c,lit:r()>0.42});
      const nearTower = towerXs.some(tx => Math.abs(bCx - tx) < NEAR);
      buildings.push({x,w,h,fc,cc,wins,nearTower});
    }
    x+=w+3+r()*8;
  }
}
function drawCity() {
  const gY = typeof getCityGroundY === 'function' ? getCityGroundY() : H * 0.58;
  for (const b of buildings) {
    const top = gY - b.h;
    ctx.fillStyle='#0c0c1e'; ctx.fillRect(b.x,top,b.w,b.h);
    ctx.fillStyle='#181830'; ctx.fillRect(b.x,top,b.w,2);
    // Buildings near towers lose power when breakdown danger rises
    const bMult = (ch===1 && b.nearTower && phase!=='win')
      ? Math.max(0.08, 1 - dangerPulse * 0.94) : 1.0;
    const ww=Math.max(3,(b.w/b.cc)*0.44), wh=4;
    for (const win of b.wins) {
      const wx=b.x+(win.c+0.28)*(b.w/b.cc), wy=top+10+win.f*((b.h-12)/b.fc);
      const br=Math.max(CITY_BRIGHT_MIN*0.55,cityBright)*bMult*(win.lit?1.0:CITY_WIN_UNLIT);
      if(br<0.01) continue;
      if(win.lit&&br>0.25){ctx.shadowColor=`rgba(255,200,80,${br*0.55})`;ctx.shadowBlur=5;}
      ctx.fillStyle=win.lit?`rgba(255,${Math.floor(215*br)},${Math.floor(70*br)},${br})`:`rgba(${Math.floor(90*br)},${Math.floor(70*br)},${Math.floor(50*br)},${br})`;
      ctx.fillRect(wx,wy,ww,wh); ctx.shadowBlur=0;
    }
  }
}

// ── Signal towers (ch1) ──────────────────────
const TOWER_FX = [0.20, 0.62, 0.85];

  if (ch !== 1) return;

  const bd = broken();

  for (let ti=0; ti<TOWER_FX.length; ti++) {
    const tx = TOWER_FX[ti] * W;
    const tH = 130 + ti * 40;
    const tW = 9;

    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111128'; ctx.fillRect(tx-tW/2, gY-tH, tW, tH);
    // Cross struts
    for (let k=0.3; k<1; k+=0.28) {
      ctx.fillStyle='#1a1a32'; ctx.fillRect(tx-tW*1.5, gY-tH*k-2, tW*3, 2);

    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx,gY-tH-40); ctx.lineTo(tx-2,gY-tH); ctx.lineTo(tx+2,gY-tH); ctx.fillStyle='#20203a'; ctx.fill();

    if (isWin) {
      // Blue glow on victory
      const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(tick*0.05+ti*2);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, gY-tH-40, 4+pulse*2, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(0,200,255,${0.6+pulse*0.4})`; ctx.shadowColor='rgba(0,200,255,0.9)'; ctx.shadowBlur=16; ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur=0;
      // Ring pulse
      const ring = (tick*0.8+ti*60) % 120;
      const rAlpha = Math.max(0, 1-ring/120)*0.5;

    } else {

function spawnStream() {

function drawStreams() {

// ── Atmosphere ───────────────────────────────
function drawSky() {

// ── Capacitor ────────────────────────────────
function geom() {
  const cx = W / 2;
  const nA = Math.min(1, areaCm2 / 300), nD = distMm / 10;
  const pw = 180 + nA * (Math.min(W * 0.52, 370) - 180), ph = 12;
  let gap = 26 + nD * 85;
  const labelDrop = ch === 0 ? 48 : 50;
  let cy;

  if (ch === 0 || ch === 1) {
    const pf = typeof getCapPlayfield === 'function'
      ? getCapPlayfield()
      : { safeTop: H * 0.58 + 12, safeBottom: H - 16 };
    const safeTop = pf.safeTop;
    const safeBottom = pf.safeBottom;
    const availH = Math.max(60, safeBottom - safeTop);
    const maxGap = availH - 2 * ph - labelDrop - 8;
    if (maxGap < gap) gap = Math.max(26, maxGap);
    const assemblyH = gap + 2 * ph + labelDrop;
    const slack = Math.max(0, availH - assemblyH);
    const slackBias = phase === 'win' ? 0.5 : 0.85;
    cy = safeTop + ph + gap / 2 + slack * slackBias;
    const minCy = safeTop + ph + gap / 2;
    const maxCy = safeBottom - (gap / 2 + ph + labelDrop);
    cy = Math.min(maxCy, Math.max(minCy, cy));
  } else {
    cy = H * 0.705;

  return { cx, cy, pw, ph, gap, topY: cy - gap / 2 - ph, botY: cy + gap / 2, gx: cx - pw / 2, gy: cy - gap / 2, gw: pw, gh: gap };
}

    ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore();
  }
}

function setLine(idx) {
  typeTarget = DLG[ch][idx];

  if (ch === 1 && idx === 1) flashTimer = 18;

function advanceDlg() {
  if (typeof SFX !== 'undefined') SFX.ensure();
  if (typeShown < typeTarget.length) {
    typeShown = typeTarget.length;
    typeTick = 0;
    document.getElementById('dlg-text').textContent = typeTarget;
    return;
  }
  if (typeof SFX !== 'undefined') SFX.play('dlgAdvance');
  dlgIdx++;
  if (dlgIdx >= DLG[ch].length) {
    document.getElementById('dialogue').style.display = 'none';
    openPuzzle();
  } else {
    setLine(dlgIdx);
  }
}

function openPuzzle() {
  const introWrap = document.getElementById('intro-title-wrap');

  if (ch===2) {
    document.getElementById('controls2').style.display = 'block';

    syncCh2UI();

    document.getElementById('controls3').style.display = 'block';

    syncCh5UI();

    document.getElementById('controls6').style.display = 'block';
    syncCh6UI();
  } else if (ch===7) {
    document.getElementById('controls7').style.display = 'block';
    ch7OpenPuzzle();
  } else {
    document.getElementById('controls').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('cap-formula').style.display = 'block';
    if (ch===1) document.getElementById('mat-wrap').style.display = 'block';

}

// lightning bolt: wide halo + bright core
// Fractal lightning path via midpoint displacement: recursively split each segment
// and nudge the midpoint *perpendicular* to it (so a near-vertical bolt jitters
// sideways and never folds back), giving organic detail at many scales. Shared by
// ciBolt and ciBoltLive so all lightning in the game looks consistent.
function ciBoltPoints(x1, y1, x2, y2, jit, seedN, levels) {
  let s = ((seedN || 0) * 2749 + 13) >>> 0;
  const rnd = () => { s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff; return s / 0x7fffffff; };
  let pts = [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]];
  let disp = jit * 0.9;
  for (let lv = 0; lv < (levels || 5); lv++) {
    const np = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
      const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1];
      np.push(a);
      const dx = b[0] - a[0], dy = b[1] - a[1], len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1, off = (rnd() - 0.5) * disp;
      np.push([(a[0] + b[0]) / 2 + (-dy / len) * off, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2 + (dx / len) * off]);
    }
    np.push(pts[pts.length - 1]);
    pts = np; disp *= 0.52;
  }
  return pts;
}
function ciBolt(x1, y1, x2, y2, col, lw, jit, seedN) {
  const pts = ciBoltPoints(x1, y1, x2, y2, jit, seedN, 5);
  ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  const trace = () => { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]); for (const p of pts) ctx.lineTo(p[0], p[1]); ctx.stroke(); };
  ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(col, 0.5); ctx.lineWidth = lw * 3; ctx.shadowBlur = 18; ctx.shadowColor = ciCol(col, 0.9); trace();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)'; ctx.lineWidth = lw; ctx.shadowBlur = 8; trace();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
}
// Lively lightning: a jagged channel that can grow from the head (stepped leader),
// pulse in brightness (return-stroke flicker via `alpha`), and taper from head to
// tail. The channel swells wider in its middle so it never reads as a stiff zigzag.
// Natural lightning via fractal midpoint-displacement. The channel is generated by
// recursively splitting each segment and nudging the midpoint *perpendicular* to it
// (so a vertical bolt jitters sideways and never folds back), giving fine detail at
// many scales. It's stroked as ONE continuous path per pass — no per-segment round
// caps, so there's no "beaded" look. `grow` draws a leading fraction (stepped leader),
// `alpha` is the flicker brightness, `jit` the overall channel roughness.
function ciBoltLive(x1, y1, x2, y2, col, lw, jit, seedN, grow = 1, alpha = 1, taper = true) {
  if (alpha <= 0.01) return;
  const pts = ciBoltPoints(x1, y1, x2, y2, jit, seedN, 6);   // 6 levels → fine detail
  const drawN = Math.max(1, Math.round((pts.length - 1) * Math.min(1, grow)));
  ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  const trace = () => { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]); for (let i = 1; i <= drawN; i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]); ctx.stroke(); };

  ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(col, 0.22 * alpha); ctx.lineWidth = lw * (taper ? 4.2 : 3.4); trace();
  // 2) coloured channel
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10; ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(ciLite(col, 30), 0.55 * alpha); ctx.lineWidth = lw * 2; trace();
  // 3) white-hot core
  ctx.shadowBlur = 6; ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.95 * alpha})`; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.7, lw * 0.9); trace();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

}

function ciSignalTower(tx, ty0, ty1, alive, col, tk) {
  const baseW = 42, topW = 9;
  ctx.save();
  // legs (tapering steel, gradient)
  const lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(tx - baseW, 0, tx + baseW, 0);
  lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(70,82,98,0.95)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(150,168,190,0.95)'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(70,82,98,0.95)');
  ctx.strokeStyle = lg; ctx.lineWidth = 3.2; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx - baseW, ty0); ctx.lineTo(tx - topW, ty1); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx + baseW, ty0); ctx.lineTo(tx + topW, ty1); ctx.stroke();
  // cross-bracing
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,140,165,0.6)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.3;
  const N = 9;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const f0 = i / N, f1 = (i + 1) / N;
    const y0 = ty0 + (ty1 - ty0) * f0, y1 = ty0 + (ty1 - ty0) * f1;
    const wl0 = baseW + (topW - baseW) * f0, wl1 = baseW + (topW - baseW) * f1;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx - wl0, y0); ctx.lineTo(tx + wl1, y1); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx + wl0, y0); ctx.lineTo(tx - wl1, y1); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(90,105,128,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx - wl1, y1); ctx.lineTo(tx + wl1, y1); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,140,165,0.6)';
  }
  // dish/antenna head
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,48,60,0.95)';
  ctx.fillRect(tx - 6, ty1 - 10, 12, 12);
  ctx.restore();
}

// ancient circular resonant seal — concentric rune rings + igniting core.
function ciVault(cx, cy, R, col, act, tk) {
  const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, R * 0.75, cx, cy, R * 1.20);
  sg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(28,21,12,0)'); sg.addColorStop(0.78, 'rgba(26,19,11,0.92)'); sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(12,9,5,0.96)');
  ctx.fillStyle = sg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R * 1.20, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(col, 0.30); ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R * 1.12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  const rings = [
    { r: R * 0.86, n: 24, dir: 1, spin: 0.004 },
    { r: R * 0.60, n: 16, dir: -1, spin: 0.006 },
    { r: R * 0.38, n: 10, dir: 1, spin: 0.009 },
  ];
  for (const rg of rings) {
    const drift = rg.dir * tk * rg.spin * (1 - act * 0.92);
    ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(col, 0.16 + act * 0.30); ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    if (act > 0.5) { ctx.shadowBlur = 10 + act * 12; ctx.shadowColor = ciCol(col, 0.7); }
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, rg.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < rg.n; i++) {
      const a = drift + i / rg.n * Math.PI * 2, keyM = (i % 3 === 0);
      ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(keyM ? ciLite(col, 45) : col, act * (keyM ? 1 : 0.5) + 0.10);
      ctx.lineWidth = keyM ? 2 : 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * (rg.r - 6), cy + Math.sin(a) * (rg.r - 6));
      ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * (rg.r + 6), cy + Math.sin(a) * (rg.r + 6));
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  if (act > 0.6) {
    const sa = (act - 0.6) / 0.4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(ciLite(col, 55), sa * 0.7); ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.shadowBlur = 8; ctx.shadowColor = ciCol(col, 0.85);
    for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) { const a = k / 6 * Math.PI * 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * R * 0.20, cy + Math.sin(a) * R * 0.20); ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * R * 0.86, cy + Math.sin(a) * R * 0.86); ctx.stroke(); }
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }
  ciOrb(cx, cy, R * 0.42 * (0.6 + act * 0.8), col, 0.14 + act * 0.5);
  ctx.fillStyle = ciCol(ciLite(col, Math.round(act * 60)), 0.3 + act * 0.6);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 6 + act * 22; ctx.shadowColor = ciCol(col, 1);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R * 0.16 * (0.7 + act * 0.6), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
}
function ciChargeArc(cx, cy, R, col, frac, t0, t1) {
  const A0 = -Math.PI * 0.5;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.07)'; ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, A0, A0 + Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(90,255,170,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = 4;

  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, A0, A0 + Math.max(0.001, frac) * Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0; ctx.lineCap = 'butt';

function drawCh4Intro(beat, t, fade, col, cx, cy, tk) {
  ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
  const R = H * 0.19;
  if (beat <= 0) {
    // dormant ancient seal — barely glowing, slow drift, dust
    ciVault(cx, cy, R, col, 0.06 + 0.03 * Math.sin(tk * 0.03), tk);
    for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) { const dx = cx + Math.cos(i * 1.7 + tk * 0.005) * R * 1.6, dy = cy + Math.sin(i * 2.3 + tk * 0.007) * R * 1.6; ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,225,160,${0.05 + 0.11 * Math.sin(tk * 0.03 + i)})`; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 0.9, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
    ciLabel('封印了三百年', cx, cy + R * 1.55, col, Math.round(H * 0.022), 0);
  } else if (beat === 1) {
    // injecting stored energy — rim charge-gauge builds toward the target window
    const frac = (Math.sin(tk * 0.03) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.55;
    ciVault(cx, cy, R, col, 0.12 + frac * 0.22, tk);
    ciChargeArc(cx, cy, R * 1.34, col, frac, 0.60, 0.78);
    ciLabel('储能校准', cx, cy - R * 1.55, col, Math.round(H * 0.034), 14);
  } else if (beat === 2) {
    // choosing C × V — selector chips + target gauge
    ciVault(cx, cy - H * 0.02, R * 0.92, col, 0.18, tk);
    const frac = 0.42 + 0.32 * (Math.sin(tk * 0.05) * 0.5 + 0.5);
    ciChargeArc(cx, cy - H * 0.02, R * 1.26, col, frac, 0.62, 0.76);
    const n = 4, cw = W * 0.052, gap = W * 0.013, totalW = n * cw + (n - 1) * gap, sx = cx - totalW / 2, sy = cy + R * 1.05;
    const hi = Math.floor(tk * 0.04) % n;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const x = sx + i * (cw + gap);
      ciPanel(x, sy, cw, H * 0.05, 5, i === hi ? 'rgba(60,42,16,0.96)' : 'rgba(30,22,10,0.94)', 'rgba(18,13,6,0.95)', ciCol(col, i === hi ? 0.8 : 0.3));
      ctx.fillStyle = ciCol(col, i === hi ? 0.95 : 0.5); ctx.font = `${Math.round(H * 0.018)}px 'Cambria Math',serif`; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(['C₁', 'C₂', 'C₃', 'C₄'][i], x + cw / 2, sy + H * 0.033);
    }
    ciLabel('选定 C × V 的组合', cx, cy - R * 1.45, col, Math.round(H * 0.022), 0);
  } else {
    // RELEASE — a single controlled discharge ignites the seal: rings align, resonant pulse
    const act = Math.min(1, t / 55);
    if (t < 42 && Math.sin(tk * 0.4) > 0) ciBolt(cx, cy - R * 2.1, cx, cy, [255, 232, 155], 2, 16, Math.floor(tk / 4));
    ciVault(cx, cy, R, col, act, tk);
    // expanding resonant pulse rings
    for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
      const rr = ((tk * 1.6 + r * 42) % 126), a = act * (1 - rr / 126) * 0.5;
      if (a <= 0.01) continue;
      ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(ciLite(col, 30), a); ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R * 0.5 + rr, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    }
    // energy threads spiralling inward
    ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(col, 0.4 * act); ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
      const a0 = k / 8 * Math.PI * 2 + tk * 0.02;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let s = 0; s <= 1.0001; s += 0.1) { const rr = R * 1.5 * (1 - s), aa = a0 + s * 1.4, x = cx + Math.cos(aa) * rr, y = cy + Math.sin(aa) * rr; if (s === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y); }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ciLabel('共振解封', cx, cy + R * 1.55, col, Math.round(H * 0.026), 12);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
//  CH5 · 雷暴穹顶

function ciDome(cx, dcy, R, col, drift, glowA, tk) {
  // shell arcs
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
    const j = drift ? Math.sin(tk * 0.05 + k) * 4 : 0;
    ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(col, (0.5 - k * 0.13) * (drift ? (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(tk * 0.08 + k)) : 1));
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.shadowBlur = glowA ? 10 : 0; ctx.shadowColor = ciCol(col, 0.6);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, dcy, R + k * 14 + j, Math.PI * 1.08, Math.PI * 1.92); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  // mesh ribs + nodes
  ctx.strokeStyle = ciCol(col, 0.22); ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = -6; i <= 6; i++) {
    const a = Math.PI * 1.5 + i * 0.11;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * R * 0.42, dcy + Math.sin(a) * R * 0.42); ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * (R + 28), dcy + Math.sin(a) * (R + 28)); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = ciCol(col, 0.5); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + Math.cos(a) * R, dcy + Math.sin(a) * R, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
}

}

function getCtrlPanelInset() {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const ids = ['controls','controls2','controls3','controls4','controls5','controls6','controls7'];
  let panel = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {

    if (el && getComputedStyle(el).display !== 'none') { panel = el; break; }
  }
  if (!panel) {
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-h', '0px');
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-w', '0px');
    return 0;
  }
  const narrow = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 560px)').matches;
  const rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
  if (narrow) {
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-w', '0px');
    const h = rect.height;

      root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-h', h + 'px');
      return h + 14;
    }
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-h', '0px');
    return 0;
  }
  const w = rect.width;
  root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-h', '0px');
  if (w > 0) {
    root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-w', w + 'px');
    return 0;
  }
  root.style.setProperty('--ctrl-panel-w', '0px');
  return 0;
}

function getCapPlayfield() {
  const bottomInset = getCtrlPanelInset();
  const cityLine = getCityGroundY();
  const margin = 18;
  return {
    safeTop: cityLine + 12,
    safeBottom: H - bottomInset - margin,
  };
}

function getCityGroundY() {
  const base = H * 0.58;
  if (ch !== 0 && ch !== 1) return base;
  const bottomInset = getCtrlPanelInset();
  const capReserve = 145;
  if (bottomInset > 0) {
    return Math.min(base, H - bottomInset - capReserve);
  }
  return base;
}

function tickCityBrightness() {
  cityBright += (tgtBright - cityBright) * 0.016;
  if (phase === 'puzzle' || phase === 'win') cityBright = Math.max(CITY_BRIGHT_MIN, cityBright);
}

function updateCh1Atmosphere() {
  const bd = won === false && phase === 'puzzle' && broken();
  let targetStorm = 0, targetDanger = 0;
  if      (phase === 'win')    targetStorm = Math.max(0, stormIntensity - 0.004);
  else if (phase === 'puzzle') targetStorm = bd ? 0.95 : 0.50;
  else                         targetStorm = dlgIdx <= 1 ? 0.88 : 0.72;
  targetDanger = bd ? Math.min(1, dangerPulse + 0.04) : Math.max(0, dangerPulse - 0.025);
  stormIntensity += (targetStorm - stormIntensity) * 0.013;
  dangerPulse    += (targetDanger - dangerPulse) * 0.04;
  if (flashTimer > 0) flashTimer--;
  return bd;
}

function drawSharedWorld(ctx, opts) {
  const bd = opts && opts.bd;
  const calm = opts && opts.calm;
  drawSky();

  boltT--;
  const boltInterval = calm
    ? 50 + Math.random() * 120
    : bd ? 6 + Math.random() * 10
    : stormIntensity > 0.7 ? 12 + Math.random() * 20
    : 35 + Math.random() * 65;
  if (boltT <= 0) {
    boltT = boltInterval;
    if (phase !== 'win' || stormIntensity > 0.1) spawnBolt();
  }
  for (let i = bolts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (--bolts[i].life <= 0) bolts.splice(i, 1);
  if (bolts.length > 0) {
    const ml = Math.max(...bolts.map(b => b.life));
    const fr = Math.floor((dangerPulse > 0.3 ? 130 : 100) * ml / 30);
    const fg = Math.floor(175 * (1 - dangerPulse * 0.4) * ml / 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${fr},${fg},255,${(ml / 30) * .11})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  drawCity();
  drawTowers();
  drawLightning();
  drawGround();
  drawDangerOverlay();
  drawFlash();
}

function tickCanvasIntroAndDlg() {
  if ((phase === 'dlg' || phase === 'intro') && typeTarget && typeShown < typeTarget.length) {
    if (++typeTick >= TSPEED) { typeTick = 0; typeShown++; }
    document.getElementById('dlg-text').textContent = typeTarget.slice(0, typeShown);
  }
  if (phase === 'intro') {
    introTick++;
    if (introTick >= INTRO) {
      phase = 'dlg';
      dlgIdx = 0;
      setLine(0);
      document.getElementById('dialogue').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('chapter-badge').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('chapter-badge').textContent = CH_NAMES[ch];
    }
  }
}

function finishCanvasWinFrame() {
  if (phase === 'win') tgtBright = 1;
}

function frameCanvasChapter(ctx, hooks = {}) {
  syncIntroTitleOverlay();
  let worldOpts = hooks.worldOpts;
  if (hooks.beforeWorld) {
    const extra = hooks.beforeWorld();
    if (extra && extra.worldOpts !== undefined) worldOpts = extra.worldOpts;
  }
  tickCityBrightness();
  const inIntroCine = (phase === 'intro' || phase === 'dlg')
    && ch >= 1 && ch <= 6
    && typeof CH_INTRO_THEME !== 'undefined' && CH_INTRO_THEME[ch];
  if (inIntroCine) drawChapterIntro(ctx);
  else if (hooks.customWorld) hooks.customWorld(ctx);
  else drawSharedWorld(ctx, worldOpts);
  if (!inIntroCine && hooks.afterWorld) hooks.afterWorld(ctx);
  if (hooks.midFrame) hooks.midFrame(ctx);
  if (!inIntroCine && hooks.puzzleDraw) hooks.puzzleDraw(ctx);
  tickCanvasIntroAndDlg();
  finishCanvasWinFrame();
}

/* ===== js/chapters/ch4.js ===== */
// ── Chapter 4: 能量之门 ───────────────────────
let CH4_ELOW  = 950;

let _cap4PlayMode = 'explore';
let _cap4Locked = null;
function refreshCap4Goals() {

}
/** FixedChallenge：带宽明显窄于探究 200 J */
function lockCap4Challenge() {

  const half = 40 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 25); // 带宽约 80–130，窄于探究 200

window.__capEra4ApplyMode = function(mode) {

/* BATCH5-CAP-FIXED-20260724 FixedChallenge */

let ch4Choices_C = [], ch4Choices_V = [];
let ch4CorrectCI = 0, ch4CorrectVI = 0;
let ch4SelCI = -1, ch4SelVI = -1;
let ch4ChargesLeft = 5;
let ch4GateTick = 0;
// Animation
let ch4AnimState = 'idle'; // 'idle'|'charge_up'|'bolt'|'gate_ramp'|'gate_hold'|'door_open'|'gate_fade'|'overload'|'done'
let ch4AnimTick = 0;
let ch4CapGlow = 0;
let ch4BoltProgress = 0;
let ch4BoltPath = null;
let ch4GateLevel = 0;
let ch4GateTarget = 0;
let ch4FlashLevel = 0;
let ch4DischargeResult = null; // 'low'|'high'|'correct'
let ch4DoorOpen = 0;

function ch4CalcE(ci, vi) {
  return 0.5 * ch4Choices_C[ci] * 1e-6 * ch4Choices_V[vi] * ch4Choices_V[vi];
}

function generateCh4Puzzle() {
  const ELOW = CH4_ELOW, EHIGH = CH4_EHIGH;
  for (let att = 0; att < 150; att++) {
    const cPool = [400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, 1500, 2000, 2500];
    const correctC = cPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * cPool.length)];
    const targetE = ELOW + Math.random() * (EHIGH - ELOW);
    let correctV = Math.round(Math.sqrt(2 * targetE / (correctC * 1e-6)) / 100) * 100;
    if (correctV < 400) correctV = 400;
    const actualE = 0.5 * correctC * 1e-6 * correctV * correctV;
    if (actualE < ELOW || actualE > EHIGH) continue;

    // Wrong C: E(wrong_C, correctV) clearly outside [ELOW-160, EHIGH+160]
    const wCPool = cPool.filter(c => {
      if (c === correctC) return false;
      const e = 0.5 * c * 1e-6 * correctV * correctV;
      return e < ELOW - 160 || e > EHIGH + 160;
    });
    if (wCPool.length < 3) continue;
    wCPool.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
    const wrongCs = wCPool.slice(0, 3);

    // Wrong V: E(correctC, wrong_V) clearly outside range
    const vPool = [];
    for (let v = 400; v <= 3000; v += 200) vPool.push(v);
    const wVPool = vPool.filter(v => {
      if (v === correctV) return false;
      const e = 0.5 * correctC * 1e-6 * v * v;
      return e < ELOW - 160 || e > EHIGH + 160;
    });
    if (wVPool.length < 3) continue;
    wVPool.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
    const wrongVs = wVPool.slice(0, 3);

    const ci = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
    const vi = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
    const cChoices = [...wrongCs]; cChoices.splice(ci, 0, correctC);
    const vChoices = [...wrongVs]; vChoices.splice(vi, 0, correctV);

    // Verify: exactly one valid combination across all 16
    let validCount = 0, unique = true;
    for (let a = 0; a < 4; a++) for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) {
      const e = 0.5 * cChoices[a] * 1e-6 * vChoices[b] * vChoices[b];
      if (e >= ELOW && e <= EHIGH) {
        validCount++;
        if (a !== ci || b !== vi) unique = false;
      }
    }
    if (unique && validCount === 1) {
      ch4Choices_C = cChoices; ch4Choices_V = vChoices;
      ch4CorrectCI = ci; ch4CorrectVI = vi;
      return;
    }
  }
  // Hardcoded fallback: 400µF × 2200V → 968 J ✓, all 15 others outside [950,1150]
  ch4Choices_C = [400, 800, 1600, 3000];
  ch4Choices_V = [600, 1000, 1800, 2200];
  ch4CorrectCI = 0; ch4CorrectVI = 3;
}

function buildCh4ChoiceGrid() {
  const cgrid = document.getElementById('c4-c-grid');
  const vgrid = document.getElementById('c4-v-grid');
  cgrid.innerHTML = ''; vgrid.innerHTML = '';
  const busy = ch4AnimState !== 'idle';
  ch4Choices_C.forEach((c, i) => {
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'c4-choice' + (i === ch4SelCI ? ' sel' : '') + (busy ? ' disabled' : '');
    d.innerHTML = `${c}<small>µF</small>`;
    d.onclick = () => { if (busy) return;
      const _p = ch4SelCI >= 0 ? ch4Choices_C[ch4SelCI] : null;
      measuredE4 = null; ch4SelCI = i; buildCh4ChoiceGrid(); updateCh4Readout();
      if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && _p !== c) Telemetry.log('var_adjust', { var: 'C', from: _p, to: c, after: Telemetry.snapshot() });
    };
    cgrid.appendChild(d);
  });
  ch4Choices_V.forEach((v, i) => {
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'c4-choice' + (i === ch4SelVI ? ' sel' : '') + (busy ? ' disabled' : '');
    d.innerHTML = `${v}<small>V</small>`;
    d.onclick = () => { if (busy) return;
      const _p = ch4SelVI >= 0 ? ch4Choices_V[ch4SelVI] : null;
      measuredE4 = null; ch4SelVI = i; buildCh4ChoiceGrid(); updateCh4Readout();
      if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && _p !== v) Telemetry.log('var_adjust', { var: 'V', from: _p, to: v, after: Telemetry.snapshot() });
    };
    vgrid.appendChild(d);
  });
}

/** 仅放电后揭示储能 E */
let measuredE4 = null;

function updateCh4Readout() {
  const ro = document.getElementById('c4-readout');
  if (ch4SelCI < 0 || ch4SelVI < 0) { ro.textContent = '-- J'; ro.style.color = '#ffbe1e'; return; }
  if (measuredE4 == null) {
    ro.textContent = '待测';
    ro.style.color = '#94a3b8';
    return;
  }
  const e = measuredE4;
  ro.textContent = e.toFixed(0) + ' J';
  ro.style.color = (e >= CH4_ELOW && e <= CH4_EHIGH) ? '#ffbe1e'
                 : (e > CH4_EHIGH ? '#ff6030' : '#60b8ff');
}

function updateCh4Pips() {
  const pips = document.getElementById('c4-pips');
  pips.innerHTML = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const s = document.createElement('span');
    s.className = 'c4-pip' + (i >= ch4ChargesLeft ? ' used' : '');

function syncCh4UI() {
  buildCh4ChoiceGrid();

}

function triggerCh4Discharge() {
  if (ch4AnimState !== 'idle') return;
  const m = document.getElementById('c4-result-msg');
  if (ch4SelCI < 0 || ch4SelVI < 0) {
    m.textContent = '请先选择电容量 C 和充电电压 V'; m.className = '';

  }
  if (ch4ChargesLeft <= 0) return;
  ch4ChargesLeft--;
  updateCh4Pips();

  const e = ch4CalcE(ch4SelCI, ch4SelVI);
  measuredE4 = e;
  updateCh4Readout();
  if (e >= CH4_ELOW && e <= CH4_EHIGH) {
    ch4DischargeResult = 'correct';
    ch4GateTarget = 1.0;
  } else if (e > CH4_EHIGH) {
    ch4DischargeResult = 'high';
    ch4GateTarget = Math.min(1.8, 1.0 + (e - CH4_EHIGH) / CH4_EHIGH);
  } else {
    ch4DischargeResult = 'low';
    ch4GateTarget = (e / CH4_ELOW) * 0.82;
  }

  if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined') Telemetry.log('discharge_attempt', {
    C: ch4Choices_C[ch4SelCI], V: ch4Choices_V[ch4SelVI], E: +e.toFixed(1),
    result: ch4DischargeResult, attempt_in_round: 5 - ch4ChargesLeft, charges_left: ch4ChargesLeft,

  ch4AnimState = 'charge_up';
  ch4AnimTick = 0;
  ch4CapGlow = 0;
  ch4BoltProgress = 0;
  ch4BoltPath = null;
  ch4GateLevel = 0;
  ch4FlashLevel = 0;

  document.getElementById('c4-discharge-btn').classList.add('animating');
  buildCh4ChoiceGrid();
}

function ch4AnimSfxFrom(was) {

function tickCh4Anim() {
  if (ch4AnimState === 'idle') return;
  const sfxWas = ch4AnimState;
  ch4AnimTick++;

  if (ch4AnimState === 'charge_up') {
    ch4CapGlow = Math.min(1, ch4AnimTick / 50);
    if (ch4AnimTick >= 50) { ch4AnimState = 'bolt'; ch4AnimTick = 0; }

  } else if (ch4AnimState === 'bolt') {
    ch4BoltProgress = Math.min(1, ch4AnimTick / 22);
    if (ch4AnimTick >= 22) { ch4AnimState = 'gate_ramp'; ch4AnimTick = 0; }

  } else if (ch4AnimState === 'gate_ramp') {
    const dur = 70;
    ch4GateLevel = ch4GateTarget * Math.min(1, ch4AnimTick / dur);
    if (ch4AnimTick >= dur) { ch4AnimState = 'gate_hold'; ch4AnimTick = 0; }

  } else if (ch4AnimState === 'gate_hold') {
    if (ch4AnimTick >= 38) {
      if (ch4DischargeResult === 'correct') {
        won = true; markChapterComplete(4);
        if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined') Telemetry.log('win_combo', { after: Telemetry.snapshot() });
        ch4AnimState = 'door_open';
        ch4AnimTick = 0;
        ch4DoorOpen = 0;
        ch4AnimSfxFrom(sfxWas);
        return;
      }
      ch4AnimState = (ch4DischargeResult === 'high') ? 'overload' : 'gate_fade';
      ch4AnimTick = 0;
    }

  } else if (ch4AnimState === 'door_open') {
    const dur = 88;
    ch4DoorOpen = Math.min(1, ch4AnimTick / dur);
    ch4GateLevel = Math.max(ch4GateLevel, ch4DoorOpen);
    if (ch4AnimTick >= dur) {
      ch4AnimState = 'idle';
      ch4DoorOpen = 1;
      document.getElementById('c4-discharge-btn').classList.remove('animating');
      showWin();
      return;
    }

  } else if (ch4AnimState === 'gate_fade') {
    ch4GateLevel = ch4GateTarget * Math.max(0, 1 - ch4AnimTick / 55);
    if (ch4AnimTick >= 55) { ch4GateLevel = 0; ch4AnimState = 'done'; }

  } else if (ch4AnimState === 'overload') {
    const t = ch4AnimTick;
    // 三段式白光爆闪：瞬间拉满 → 持续纯白 → 衰减 → 二次脉冲 → 衰减 → 三次弱脉冲 → 慢灭
    if      (t < 4)  ch4FlashLevel = t / 4;
    else if (t < 16) ch4FlashLevel = 1.0;
    else if (t < 28) ch4FlashLevel = 1 - (t - 16) / 12;
    else if (t < 34) ch4FlashLevel = (t - 28) / 6 * 0.72;
    else if (t < 46) ch4FlashLevel = 0.72 - (t - 34) / 12 * 0.72;
    else if (t < 52) ch4FlashLevel = (t - 46) / 6 * 0.38;
    else             ch4FlashLevel = Math.max(0, 0.38 - (t - 52) / 28);

  } else if (ch4AnimState === 'done') {
    document.getElementById('c4-discharge-btn').classList.remove('animating');
    const m = document.getElementById('c4-result-msg');
    const e = ch4CalcE(ch4SelCI, ch4SelVI);

}

    <div class="sum-kv"><span class="k">电容量 C</span><span class="v" style="color:#ffbe1e">${C} µF</span></div>

    <div class="sum-kv"><span class="k">储能 E = ½CV²</span><span class="v" style="color:#ffbe1e">${E.toFixed(0)} J ∈ [950, 1150] ✓</span></div>`;
  document.getElementById('sum4-rules').innerHTML=`
    <div class="sum-rule">核心公式：<span>E = ½CV²</span> — 储能与电压的<em>平方</em>成正比，与 C 成线性正比</div>

    <div class="sum-rule">过载危险：<span>E > 1150 J</span> 将导致绝缘击穿，系统失效，无法开门</div>
    <div class="sum-rule">四选一策略：<span>先用 E = ½CV² 逐项估算，排除偏差明显的选项</span></div>
    <div class="sum-rule">封印：<span>门缓缓开启</span>，光从门缝溢出——三百年的沉默，在此刻被打破</div>`;
  openSummaryPanel(document.getElementById('summary4'));

// ── Title card ───────────────────────────────
function drawCh4Environment(cx, gy0, gyBot, gH, hW, pw) {
  const pp = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(ch4GateTick * 0.07);
