  sgrd.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(70,35,140,${0.04 + stormPulse * 0.03})`);
  sgrd.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = sgrd;
  ctx.fillRect(cx - hW * 1.2, gy0, hW * 2.4, gH);

  for (const side of ['left', 'right']) {
    const x0 = side === 'left' ? 0 : cx + hW + pw + 16;
    const x1 = side === 'left' ? cx - hW - pw - 16 : W;
    const wgrd = ctx.createLinearGradient(x0, 0, x1, 0);
    wgrd.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(11,15,20,0.94)');
    wgrd.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(22,28,36,0.45)');
    ctx.fillStyle = wgrd;
    ctx.fillRect(x0, gy0 - 36, x1 - x0, gH + 72);
    // Horizontal panel lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(54,68,84,0.30)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let y = gy0 - 8; y < gyBot + 20; y += 24) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y); ctx.lineTo(x1, y); ctx.stroke();
    }
    // Vertical panel seams
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(50,64,80,0.20)';
    for (let xv = x0 + 44; xv < x1 - 10; xv += 64) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(xv, gy0 - 36); ctx.lineTo(xv, gyBot + 36); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  const tileW = 52;
  for (let tx = -1; tx < W / tileW + 2; tx++) {
    const x0 = tx * tileW + (ch4GateTick * 0.2 % tileW);
    ctx.fillStyle = tx % 2 === 0 ? 'rgba(20,26,33,0.88)' : 'rgba(15,20,26,0.85)';
    ctx.fillRect(x0, gyBot, tileW - 3, H - gyBot + 4);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(46,60,76,0.30)';
    ctx.strokeRect(x0, gyBot, tileW - 3, H - gyBot + 4);
  }
  if (gl > 0.02 || ch4DoorOpen > 0.02) {
    const lit = Math.max(gl, ch4DoorOpen);
    const fgrd = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx, gyBot, cx, H);
    fgrd.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,205,70,${lit * 0.22})`);
    fgrd.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,130,30,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = fgrd;
    ctx.fillRect(cx - hW * 1.6, gyBot, hW * 3.2, H - gyBot);
  }

  // Ceiling-mounted conduit/light units (replaces the old stalactites)
  const ceilY = gy0 - 36;
  [W * 0.07, W * 0.19, W * 0.81, W * 0.93].forEach((sx, i) => {
    const bw = 14, bh = 10 + (i % 3) * 4;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(24,30,38,0.92)';
    ctx.fillRect(sx - bw / 2, ceilY, bw, bh);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,76,94,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(sx - bw / 2, ceilY, bw, bh);
    const on = Math.sin(ch4GateTick * 0.05 + i * 1.7) > 0;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, ceilY + bh + 3, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = on ? 'rgba(120,210,255,0.85)' : 'rgba(40,55,72,0.6)';
    if (on) { ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(120,210,255,0.7)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 6; }
    ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  });

  for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
    const px = (i * 137 + ch4GateTick * 0.35) % W;
    const py = gy0 + ((i * 89 + ch4GateTick * 0.22) % (gH + 30));
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(150,195,235,${0.035 + (i % 5) * 0.01 + pp * 0.008})`;
    ctx.fillRect(px, py, 1.5, 1.5);
  }
}

function drawCh4Scene() {
  // Advance animation state machine each frame
  tickCh4Anim();

  ch4GateTick++;
  const pp = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(ch4GateTick * 0.07);

  const cx = W * 0.50, gy0 = H * 0.13, gyBot = H * 0.67;
  const gH = gyBot - gy0;
  const hW = Math.min(W * 0.145, 128);
  const pw = 26;

  // Capacitor device geometry (left side)
  const devW = Math.min(W * 0.20, 160);
  const devH = gH * 0.88;
  const devX = Math.max(8, cx - hW - pw - devW - W * 0.07);
  const devY = gy0 + gH * 0.06;

  drawCh4Environment(cx, gy0, gyBot, gH, hW, pw);

  // ── Capacitor device ──
  drawCh4CapDevice(devX, devY, devW, devH);
  drawCh4DeviceHud(devX, devY, devW, devH);

  // Bolt start/end points
  const boltSX = devX + devW, boltSY = devY + devH * 0.50;
  const boltEX = cx - hW - pw * 0.4, boltEY = gy0 + gH * 0.50;

  // ── Energy bolt ──
  if (ch4AnimState === 'bolt' || (ch4AnimState === 'gate_ramp' && ch4AnimTick < 4)) {
    drawCh4Bolt(boltSX, boltSY, boltEX, boltEY, ch4BoltProgress);
  }

  // ── Overload screen flash (pure white radial blast) ──
  if (ch4FlashLevel > 0.01) {
    const fl = ch4FlashLevel;
    const fgrd = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, gy0+gH*0.47, 0, cx, gy0+gH*0.47, Math.hypot(W,H)*0.65);
    fgrd.addColorStop(0,   `rgba(255,255,255,${fl * 0.98})`);
    fgrd.addColorStop(0.35,`rgba(245,250,255,${fl * 0.90})`);
    fgrd.addColorStop(0.75,`rgba(200,225,255,${fl * 0.60})`);
    fgrd.addColorStop(1,   `rgba(120,160,220,${fl * 0.28})`);
    ctx.fillStyle = fgrd; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    // 灼烧暗边（闪光衰减后才出现）
    if (fl < 0.55) {
      const vgrd = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,H*0.4,W*0.25, cx,H*0.4,W*0.82);
      vgrd.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
      vgrd.addColorStop(1,`rgba(60,10,0,${(0.55-fl)*0.95})`);
      ctx.fillStyle = vgrd; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    }
  }

  const gl = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ch4GateLevel)); // clamped for drawing
  const isOver = ch4DischargeResult === 'high';

  // ── Portal: a shaped vertical energy gateway behind the gate ──
  if (gl > 0.004) {
    const pcx = cx, pcy = gy0 + gH * 0.47;
    const over = isOver && ch4AnimState !== 'idle';
    // Flat ambient fill — light from the facility behind the door, not a floating orb.
    // Only tints the aperture, no radial ball shape.
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(cx - hW, gy0, hW * 2, gH); ctx.clip();
    const ambCol = over ? '80,30,8' : '8,28,48';
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${ambCol},0.92)`;
    ctx.fillRect(cx - hW, gy0, hW * 2, gH);
    // Subtle top-lit gradient — ceiling light from inside the facility
    const ceilG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, gy0, 0, gy0 + gH * 0.45);
    ceilG.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${over ? '120,70,20' : '40,100,160'},${gl * 0.22})`);
    ceilG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = ceilG; ctx.fillRect(cx - hW, gy0, hW * 2, gH * 0.45);
    ctx.restore();

    // Glimpse of the world beyond — the resonance tower network / energy dome
    const vistaReveal = Math.max(ch4DoorOpen, phase === 'win' ? gl : 0);
    drawCh4Vista(cx, gy0, gH, hW, vistaReveal, isOver && ch4AnimState !== 'idle');

    // Holographic energy membrane filling the aperture (revealed as the doors part)
    {
      const mcx=cx, mcy=gy0+gH*0.47;
      const mcol = (isOver && ch4AnimState!=='idle') ? '255,120,60' : '175,232,255';  // cyan energy field
      ctx.save();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(cx-hW, gy0, hW*2, gH); ctx.clip();
      // Expanding ripple rings
      for (let r=0;r<3;r++){
        const rr=((ch4GateTick*1.3 + r*42) % 126);
        const a=gl*(1-rr/126)*0.42;
        if (a<=0.01) continue;
        ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${mcol},${a})`; ctx.lineWidth=1.3;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(mcx,mcy,rr*0.85,rr*1.25,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
      }
      // Vertical energy threads, gently waving
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${mcol},${gl*0.18})`; ctx.lineWidth=0.7;
      for (let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
        const xx=mcx+i*hW*0.26;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let yy=gy0; yy<gy0+gH; yy+=6){
          const off=Math.sin(yy*0.05+ch4GateTick*0.08+i)*4*gl;
          yy===gy0?ctx.moveTo(xx+off,yy):ctx.lineTo(xx+off,yy);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // (win glow handled by door-crack and vista reveal — no full-screen gold flash)
  }

  // ── Reinforced bulkhead header (replaces the old stone arch) ──
  const gateLit = Math.max(gl, ch4DoorOpen);
  const accCol = isOver ? '255,95,35' : '120,210,255';   // tech accent: cyan, red on overload
  const frameX0 = cx - hW - pw, frameX1 = cx + hW + pw, frameW = frameX1 - frameX0;
  const hdrH = 32;
  // Steel beam
  const hgr = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, gy0 - hdrH, 0, gy0);
  hgr.addColorStop(0, '#3a4654'); hgr.addColorStop(0.45, '#222b35'); hgr.addColorStop(1, '#141a22');
  ctx.fillStyle = hgr;
  ctx.fillRect(frameX0 - 6, gy0 - hdrH, frameW + 12, hdrH);
  // Top bevel highlight + bottom shadow
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,180,210,0.30)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(frameX0 - 6, gy0 - hdrH + 1); ctx.lineTo(frameX1 + 6, gy0 - hdrH + 1); ctx.stroke();
  // Hazard chevron stripe inset
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(frameX0, gy0 - hdrH + 7, frameW, 9); ctx.clip();
  for (let xx = frameX0 - 18; xx < frameX1 + 18; xx += 18) {
    ctx.fillStyle = (((xx / 18) | 0) % 2 === 0) ? 'rgba(205,170,45,0.32)' : 'rgba(18,22,28,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xx, gy0 - hdrH + 7); ctx.lineTo(xx + 9, gy0 - hdrH + 7);
    ctx.lineTo(xx + 18, gy0 - hdrH + 16); ctx.lineTo(xx + 9, gy0 - hdrH + 16);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
  // Status LED row (fills up with charge)
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    const lx = frameX0 + 14 + i * (frameW - 28) / 8;
    const on = gateLit > 0 ? (i / 9 <= gateLit) : (Math.sin(ch4GateTick * 0.05 + i) > 0.4);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(lx, gy0 - 7, 2.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    const c = on ? accCol : '45,60,78';
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${c},${on ? 0.95 : 0.55})`;
    if (on) { ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${c},0.8)`; ctx.shadowBlur = 6; }
    ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }
  // Glowing accent rail along the header underside
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${accCol},${0.30 + gateLit * 0.6})`; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
  ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${accCol},0.55)`; ctx.shadowBlur = 7;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(frameX0, gy0 - 1); ctx.lineTo(frameX1, gy0 - 1); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // ── Side struts (steel) ──
  for (const [px, inner] of [[cx - hW - pw, +1], [cx + hW, -1]]) {
    const pgr = ctx.createLinearGradient(px, 0, px + pw, 0);
    pgr.addColorStop(0, '#19212b'); pgr.addColorStop(0.5, '#2c3744'); pgr.addColorStop(1, '#141a22');
    ctx.fillStyle = pgr; ctx.fillRect(px, gy0, pw, gH);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(95,118,145,0.40)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(px, gy0, pw, gH);
    // Segment bands + bolt squares
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,78,98,0.5)';
    for (let y = gy0 + 26; y < gyBot; y += 30) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px + 2, y); ctx.lineTo(px + pw - 2, y); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,145,170,0.35)';
      ctx.fillRect(px + 3, y + 4, 2, 2); ctx.fillRect(px + pw - 5, y + 4, 2, 2);
    }
    // Inner-edge accent light rail (faces the doors)
    const ex = inner > 0 ? px + pw - 2 : px + 2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${accCol},${0.22 + gl * 0.5})`; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${accCol},0.5)`; ctx.shadowBlur = 5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ex, gy0 + 4); ctx.lineTo(ex, gyBot - 4); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  // ── Door panels ──
  const doorOpenAmt = ch4AnimState === 'door_open' ? ch4DoorOpen : (phase === 'win' ? gl : 0);
  const openOff = doorOpenAmt * hW * 0.92;
  const ldX = cx - hW - openOff, rdX = cx + openOff;

  for (const [dx, side] of [[ldX, +1], [rdX, -1]]) {
    // side=+1 left door (meeting edge on right), -1 right door (meeting edge on left)
    // Steel body
    const dgr = ctx.createLinearGradient(dx, gy0, dx + hW, gy0);
    dgr.addColorStop(0, '#222c38'); dgr.addColorStop(0.5, '#19222c'); dgr.addColorStop(1, '#222c38');
    ctx.fillStyle = dgr; ctx.fillRect(dx, gy0, hW, gH);
    // Recessed stacked panels
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80,100,124,0.45)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
    const pad = 10;
    for (const [t0, t1] of [[0.06, 0.46], [0.54, 0.94]]) {
      const ry = gy0 + gH * t0, rh = gH * (t1 - t0);
      if (ctx.roundRect) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(dx + pad, ry, hW - pad * 2, rh, 4); ctx.stroke(); }
      else ctx.strokeRect(dx + pad, ry, hW - pad * 2, rh);
    }
    // Diagonal hazard chevrons banding the upper panel
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(dx + pad + 2, gy0 + gH * 0.10, hW - pad * 2 - 4, gH * 0.09); ctx.clip();
    for (let xx = dx - 12; xx < dx + hW + 12; xx += 14) {
      ctx.fillStyle = (((xx / 14) | 0) % 2 === 0) ? 'rgba(200,165,45,0.20)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xx, gy0 + gH * 0.10); ctx.lineTo(xx + 7, gy0 + gH * 0.10);
      ctx.lineTo(xx + 7 + gH * 0.09, gy0 + gH * 0.19); ctx.lineTo(xx + gH * 0.09, gy0 + gH * 0.19);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
    // Corner bolts
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,148,175,0.45)';
    for (const bx of [dx + pad + 3, dx + hW - pad - 3])
      for (const by of [gy0 + gH * 0.085, gy0 + gH * 0.915]) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx, by, 1.8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      }
    // Outer frame line (picks up accent when energized)
    ctx.strokeStyle = gl > 0.05 ? `rgba(${accCol},${0.3 + gl * 0.5})` : 'rgba(92,114,140,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; ctx.strokeRect(dx + 3, gy0 + 3, hW - 6, gH - 6);
    // Meeting-edge seam light
    const ex = side > 0 ? dx + hW - 2 : dx + 2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${accCol},${0.25 + gateLit * 0.55})`; ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${accCol},0.55)`; ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ex, gy0 + 6); ctx.lineTo(ex, gyBot - 6); ctx.stroke(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    // Gold energy bleeding through the metal as the gate charges
    if (gateLit > 0.04) {
      ctx.fillStyle = isOver ? `rgba(255,100,20,${gateLit * 0.20})` : `rgba(255,210,80,${gateLit * 0.16})`;
      ctx.fillRect(dx, gy0, hW, gH);
    }
  }

  // Door-crack light during slow open
  if (ch4AnimState === 'door_open' && ch4DoorOpen > 0.08) {
    const crackW = Math.max(4, openOff * 0.35);
    const cgrd = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - crackW, gy0, cx + crackW, gy0);
    cgrd.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,220,80,0)');
    cgrd.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(255,240,160,${ch4DoorOpen * 0.85})`);
    cgrd.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,220,80,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = cgrd;
    ctx.fillRect(cx - crackW, gy0, crackW * 2, gH);
  }

  // ── Energy-lock seals (tech HUD dials, light up with gate level) ──
  function techLock(rx, ry, r, litFrac, rgb) {
    const lit = litFrac > 0.04;
    const a = lit ? litFrac : 0;
    // Outer ring
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${rgb},${0.25 + a * 0.5})`; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    if (lit) { ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${rgb},0.8)`; ctx.shadowBlur = 6 + a * 12; }
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(rx, ry, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    // Notch ticks
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${rgb},${0.3 + a * 0.5})`; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const ang = i / 8 * Math.PI * 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(rx + Math.cos(ang) * (r - 3), ry + Math.sin(ang) * (r - 3));
      ctx.lineTo(rx + Math.cos(ang) * r, ry + Math.sin(ang) * r); ctx.stroke();
    }
    // Rotating inner dashed ring
    ctx.save(); ctx.setLineDash([5, 6]); ctx.lineDashOffset = -ch4GateTick * (lit ? 1.6 : 0.4);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${rgb},${0.2 + a * 0.55})`; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(rx, ry, r * 0.62, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore();
    // Glowing core
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,210,80,${lit ? 0.40 + a * 0.55 * pp : 0.12})`;
    if (lit) { ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,200,60,0.9)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 8 + a * 10; }
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(rx, ry, r * 0.22 + a * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  const runeLit = (ch4AnimState !== 'idle' || phase === 'win') ? Math.max(gl, ch4DoorOpen) : 0;
  const lockCol = isOver ? '255,95,35' : '120,210,255';
  techLock(ldX + hW * 0.5, gy0 + gH * 0.28, 16, runeLit, lockCol);
  techLock(rdX + hW * 0.5, gy0 + gH * 0.65, 16, runeLit, lockCol);
  // Central master lock straddling the seam (clipped per-door so it splits open)
  const rcx = cx, rcy = gy0 + gH * 0.46;
  for (const [dx2, dw2] of [[ldX, hW], [rdX, hW]]) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(dx2, gy0, dw2, gH + 2); ctx.clip();
    techLock(rcx, rcy, 22, runeLit, isOver ? '255,95,35' : '255,210,80');
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Energy motes drifting up out of the opening
  const openLit = ch4AnimState === 'door_open' ? ch4DoorOpen : (phase === 'win' ? gl : 0);
  if (openLit > 0.05) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    const spread = Math.max(6, openOff);
    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
      const t2 = ((ch4GateTick * 0.7 + i * 53) % 110) / 110;
      const mx = cx + Math.sin(i * 2.3 + ch4GateTick * 0.01) * spread * 0.9;
      const my = gy0 + gH - t2 * gH * 1.05;
      const a = (1 - t2) * 0.55 * openLit;
      if (a <= 0.02) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,242,200,${a})`;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx, my, 1.1 + (i % 3 === 0 ? 0.9 : 0), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ── Win: refined light burst from the gate centre ──
  if (phase === 'win') {
    ch4GateLevel = Math.min(1, ch4GateLevel + 0.0028); // 缓缓打开
    if (gl > 0.2) {
      const wp = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(tick * 0.07);
      const ox = cx, oy = gy0 + gH * 0.47;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
      // Thin god-rays of varying length, slowly rotating
      const N = 30;
      for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        const a = i * Math.PI * 2 / N + ch4GateTick * 0.004;
        const len = W * 0.5 * (0.45 + 0.55 * Math.abs(Math.sin(i * 1.7 + ch4GateTick * 0.012)));
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,242,205,${(0.012 + wp * 0.018) * gl})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = (i % 5 === 0) ? 2.2 : 0.9;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(ox, oy);
        ctx.lineTo(ox + Math.cos(a) * len, oy + Math.sin(a) * len);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      // Bright pulsing core
      const cr = 34 + wp * 14;
      const cg = ctx.createRadialGradient(ox, oy, 0, ox, oy, cr);
      cg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,255,248,${0.55 * gl})`);
      cg.addColorStop(0.4, `rgba(255,228,150,${0.32 * gl})`);
      cg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,180,60,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = cg;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ox, oy, cr, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }
}

function drawCh4CapDevice(x, y, w, h) {
  const g = ch4CapGlow;
  const pp2 = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(ch4GateTick * 0.09);

  // Housing outer box
  const borderA = 0.50 + g * 0.40;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(26,22,14,0.95)';
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${80+g*110|0},${72+g*90|0},${40+g*28|0},${borderA})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(x, y, w, h);

  // Header label bar
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${40+g*30|0},${35+g*25|0},${18+g*10|0},0.90)`;
  ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 2, w - 4, 18);
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(180,148,55,${0.40 + g * 0.30})`;
  ctx.font = '7px Courier New'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('CAPACITOR UNIT', x + w * 0.5, y + 13);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';

  // Two electrode cylinder columns
  const colW = w * 0.26, colH = h * 0.60;
  const col1X = x + w * 0.10, col2X = x + w * 0.64;
  const colY  = y + h * 0.22;

  for (const cx2 of [col1X + colW * 0.5, col2X + colW * 0.5]) {
    const cg2 = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx2 - colW * 0.5, 0, cx2 + colW * 0.5, 0);
    cg2.addColorStop(0,   'rgba(44,38,24,0.92)');
    cg2.addColorStop(0.45,'rgba(88,76,42,0.92)');
    cg2.addColorStop(1,   'rgba(36,30,18,0.92)');
    ctx.fillStyle = cg2;
    ctx.fillRect(cx2 - colW * 0.5, colY, colW, colH);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${90+g*40|0},${78+g*30|0},${44+g*12|0},0.62)`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(cx2 - colW * 0.5, colY, colW, colH);
    for (let yb = colY + 10; yb < colY + colH - 4; yb += 13) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx2 - colW * 0.5 + 2, yb);
      ctx.lineTo(cx2 + colW * 0.5 - 2, yb);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // Top terminal cap
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${70+g*60|0},${62+g*50|0},${35+g*20|0},0.88)`;
    ctx.fillRect(cx2 - colW * 0.5, colY - 5, colW, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(cx2 - colW * 0.5, colY + colH - 1, colW, 6);
  }

  // Gap between plates — blue plasma glow when charging
  const gapX  = col1X + colW;
  const gapW2 = col2X - gapX;
  const midX  = gapX + gapW2 * 0.5;
  if (g > 0.02) {
    const gg = ctx.createRadialGradient(midX, colY + colH * 0.5, 0, midX, colY + colH * 0.5, gapW2 * 1.4 + colW * 0.6);
    gg.addColorStop(0,   `rgba(240,200,120,${g * (0.80 + pp2 * 0.18)})`);
    gg.addColorStop(0.35,`rgba(212,160,80,${g * 0.48})`);
    gg.addColorStop(1,    'rgba(60,40,10,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = gg;
    ctx.fillRect(gapX, colY + 3, gapW2, colH - 6);

    // Intermittent spark arcs between plates
    if (g > 0.45 && Math.random() < 0.22 * g) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(240,200,120,${g * 0.75})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 6; ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(224,160,80,0.8)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      let sx = col1X + colW, sy = colY + colH * (0.25 + Math.random() * 0.50);
      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
      for (let s = 0; s < 4; s++) {
        sx += gapW2 * 0.25 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8;
        sy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 14;
        ctx.lineTo(sx, sy);
      }
      ctx.lineTo(col2X, colY + colH * (0.25 + Math.random() * 0.50));
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  // Charge level indicator bar on right side of housing
  const indX = x + w - 9, indY = colY, indH = colH;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(16,14,8,0.85)';
  ctx.fillRect(indX, indY, 7, indH);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(90,78,44,0.50)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(indX, indY, 7, indH);
  if (g > 0.01) {
    const fh = indH * g;
    const ig = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, indY + indH - fh, 0, indY + indH);
    ig.addColorStop(0, `rgba(212,160,80,${g * 0.80})`);
    ig.addColorStop(1, `rgba(240,200,120,${g * 0.95})`);
    ctx.fillStyle = ig;
    ctx.fillRect(indX + 1, indY + indH - fh + 1, 5, fh - 1);
  }

  // Connecting cable from device to gate (static background line)
  const boltSX = x + w, boltSY = y + h * 0.50;
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${58+g*70|0},${52+g*55|0},${30+g*18|0},${0.42+g*0.25})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(boltSX, boltSY);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(boltSX + w * 0.55, boltSY - h * 0.06, boltSX + w * 1.1, boltSY);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
}

function drawCh4Bolt(x1, y1, x2, y2, progress) {
  // Generate stable path on first call of this discharge
  if (!ch4BoltPath) {
    const segs = 8;
    ch4BoltPath = [[x1, y1]];
    for (let i = 1; i < segs; i++) {
      const t = i / segs;
      ch4BoltPath.push([
        x1 + (x2 - x1) * t + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24,
        y1 + (y2 - y1) * t + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 18,
      ]);
    }
    ch4BoltPath.push([x2, y2]);
  }

  const totalPts = ch4BoltPath.length;
  const drawUpTo = Math.max(1, Math.floor(progress * totalPts));

  ctx.save();
  // Outer glow pass
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,160,255,0.35)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 5; ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 14; ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(80,190,255,0.85)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(ch4BoltPath[0][0], ch4BoltPath[0][1]);
  for (let i = 1; i < drawUpTo; i++) ctx.lineTo(ch4BoltPath[i][0], ch4BoltPath[i][1]);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Core bright line
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,235,255,0.92)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(ch4BoltPath[0][0], ch4BoltPath[0][1]);
  for (let i = 1; i < drawUpTo; i++) ctx.lineTo(ch4BoltPath[i][0], ch4BoltPath[i][1]);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Tip spark
  const tip = ch4BoltPath[Math.min(drawUpTo - 1, totalPts - 1)];
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,228,255,0.95)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10; ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(100,210,255,1)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tip[0], tip[1], 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCh4DeviceHud(x, y, w, h) {
  const sel = ch4SelCI >= 0 && ch4SelVI >= 0;
  const e = sel ? ch4CalcE(ch4SelCI, ch4SelVI) : 0;
  const inB = e >= CH4_ELOW && e <= CH4_EHIGH;
  const over = e > CH4_EHIGH;
  const col = !sel ? [120,140,170] : inB ? [120,255,160] : over ? [255,90,40] : [90,170,255];
  const cs = `${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]}`;
  ctx.save();
  // Corner brackets
  const pad=10, L=15;
  const x0=x-pad,y0=y-pad,x1=x+w+pad,y1=y+h+pad;
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${cs},0.55)`; ctx.lineWidth=1.4;
  ctx.shadowColor=`rgba(${cs},0.4)`; ctx.shadowBlur=5;
  for(const [px,py,sx,sy] of [[x0,y0,1,1],[x1,y0,-1,1],[x0,y1,1,-1],[x1,y1,-1,-1]]){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px+sx*L,py); ctx.lineTo(px,py); ctx.lineTo(px,py+sy*L); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  // Energy gauge (270° arc) above the device
  const gcx=x+w*0.5, gcy=y-30, gr=16, sMax=2000;
  const A0=Math.PI*0.75, SPAN=Math.PI*1.5;
  const ang=(v)=>A0+Math.min(1,v/sMax)*SPAN;
  ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.10)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(gcx,gcy,gr,A0,A0+SPAN,false); ctx.stroke();
  // Target band segment
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,255,160,0.55)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(gcx,gcy,gr,ang(CH4_ELOW),ang(CH4_EHIGH),false); ctx.stroke();
  // Needle
  if (sel) {
    const a=ang(Math.min(sMax,e));
    ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${cs},0.95)`; ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.shadowColor=`rgba(${cs},0.8)`; ctx.shadowBlur=6;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(gcx,gcy); ctx.lineTo(gcx+Math.cos(a)*gr,gcy+Math.sin(a)*gr); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(gcx,gcy,2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(${cs},0.95)`; ctx.fill();
  }
  // Readout
  ctx.font='8px Courier New'; ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(${cs},0.85)`;
  if (!sel) ctx.fillText('-- J', gcx, gcy+gr+10);
  else if (measuredE4 == null) ctx.fillText('待测', gcx, gcy+gr+10);
  else ctx.fillText(`${measuredE4.toFixed(0)} J`, gcx, gcy+gr+10);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCh4Vista(cx, gy0, gH, hW, reveal, over) {
  if (reveal <= 0.03) return;
  const t = ch4GateTick;
  const skyCol  = over ? '60,18,8'   : '10,24,46';   // distant sky
  const colRGB  = over ? '255,140,80' : '120,210,255'; // accent colour
  const midRGB  = over ? '255,80,20'  : '0,160,220';  // mid-tone
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(cx - hW, gy0, hW * 2, gH); ctx.clip();

  // Sky gradient — gives towers something to silhouette against
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, gy0, 0, gy0 + gH);
  sky.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${skyCol},${reveal * 0.85})`);
  sky.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(${skyCol},${reveal * 0.72})`);
  sky.addColorStop(1,   `rgba(0,0,0,${reveal * 0.55})`);
  ctx.fillStyle = sky; ctx.fillRect(cx - hW, gy0, hW * 2, gH);

  const ground = gy0 + gH * 0.80;

  // Ground-level glow (facility floor)
  const gndG = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, ground - 8, 0, ground + 20);
  gndG.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${colRGB},${reveal * 0.30})`);
  gndG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = gndG; ctx.fillRect(cx - hW, ground - 8, hW * 2, 28);

  // Energy dome arcs
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${colRGB},0.60)`; ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
  for (const [rf, al] of [[1.60, 0.32], [1.22, 0.22], [0.88, 0.14]]) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${colRGB},${reveal * al})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, ground, hW * rf, Math.PI * 1.10, Math.PI * 1.90); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // ── Signal towers ──────────────────────────────────────────
  // 5 towers at varying depths (size = depth cue).
  const towers = [
    { dx: -0.72, s: 0.55 }, { dx: -0.32, s: 0.82 },
    { dx:  0.00, s: 1.00 }, { dx:  0.34, s: 0.78 }, { dx: 0.68, s: 0.50 },
  ];
  const tops = [];
  for (const tw of towers) {
    const tx  = cx + tw.dx * hW * 1.30;
    const th  = gH * 0.68 * tw.s;        // taller: 68 % of aperture height
    const ty  = ground - th;
    const bw  = 7 * tw.s;                // base width at ground
    const mw  = 2.5 * tw.s;             // mast width at apex
    tops.push([tx, ty]);
    const alpha = reveal * (0.60 + 0.30 * tw.s);

    // Tower body — tapered trapezoid silhouette
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${skyCol},${alpha + 0.15})`;  // slightly darker than sky
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(tx - bw, ground);
    ctx.lineTo(tx + bw, ground);
    ctx.lineTo(tx + mw, ty + 8);
    ctx.lineTo(tx - mw, ty + 8);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

    // Edge highlights (structural steel look)
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${colRGB},${alpha * 0.70})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.9 * tw.s + 0.3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(tx - bw, ground); ctx.lineTo(tx - mw, ty + 8);
    ctx.moveTo(tx + bw, ground); ctx.lineTo(tx + mw, ty + 8);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Cross struts (3 per tower, evenly spaced)
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${midRGB},${alpha * 0.55})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
    for (let k = 0.28; k < 0.98; k += 0.28) {
      const sy  = ground - th * k;
      const swt = bw + (mw - bw) * k;   // taper
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx - swt, sy); ctx.lineTo(tx + swt, sy); ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Antenna mast above taper
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${colRGB},${alpha * 0.85})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx, ty + 8); ctx.lineTo(tx, ty - 10 * tw.s); ctx.stroke();

    // Beacon light (blinking)
    const blink = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 0.07 + tw.dx * 9.3);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, ty - 10 * tw.s, 2.2 * tw.s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${colRGB},${reveal * blink * 0.95})`;
    ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${colRGB},0.90)`; ctx.shadowBlur = 8 * reveal * blink;
    ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  // Resonance links between tower tops + travelling signal pulses
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${colRGB},${reveal * 0.28})`; ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
  for (let i = 0; i < tops.length - 1; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tops[i][0], tops[i][1]); ctx.lineTo(tops[i+1][0], tops[i+1][1]); ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < tops.length - 1; i++) {
    const f = (t * 0.012 + i * 0.22) % 1;
    const px = tops[i][0] + (tops[i+1][0] - tops[i][0]) * f;
    const py = tops[i][1] + (tops[i+1][1] - tops[i][1]) * f;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${reveal * 0.70})`; ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function frameCh4(ctx) {
  frameCanvasChapter(ctx, {
    worldOpts: { calm: true },
    puzzleDraw(ctx) {
      if (phase === 'puzzle' || phase === 'win') drawCh4Scene();
    },
  });
}

Game.register(4, { init: initCh4, frame: frameCh4, usesCanvas: true, showSummary: showSummary4 });

</script>

/* ===== js/research/telemetry.js ·(研究埋点，非原游戏代码)===== */
const Telemetry = (function () {
  const qs = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const sid = qs.get('sid') || ('anon-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8));
  const endpoint = qs.get('ep') || 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/events';
  const session = {
    session_id: sid + '-' + Date.now().toString(36),
    student_id: sid,
    game_id: 'cap-ch4-energy',
    game_ver: 'sample-v1',
    started_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    ua: navigator.userAgent,
  };
  const buf = [];
  const all = [];
  const t0 = performance.now();
  let seq = 0;

  function snapshot() {
    try {
      const selC = ch4SelCI >= 0 ? ch4Choices_C[ch4SelCI] : null;
      const selV = ch4SelVI >= 0 ? ch4Choices_V[ch4SelVI] : null;
      const E = (ch4SelCI >= 0 && ch4SelVI >= 0) ? +ch4CalcE(ch4SelCI, ch4SelVI).toFixed(1) : null;
      return { selC: selC, selV: selV, E: E, charges_left: ch4ChargesLeft, phase: phase };
    } catch (e) { return {}; }
  }

  function log(type, data) {
    const ev = Object.assign({
      seq: seq++,
      rel_ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0),
      ts: new Date().toISOString(),
      type: type,
    }, data || {});
    buf.push(ev); all.push(ev);
    mirror();
  }

  let mirrorTimer = null;
  function mirror() {
    if (mirrorTimer) return;
    mirrorTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      mirrorTimer = null;
      try { localStorage.setItem('telemetry:' + session.session_id,
        JSON.stringify({ session, events: all })); } catch (e) {}
    }, 800);
  }

  function flush(final) {
    if (!buf.length || !endpoint) return;
    const payload = JSON.stringify({ session, events: buf.splice(0) });
    if (final && navigator.sendBeacon) {
      navigator.sendBeacon(endpoint, new Blob([payload], { type: 'application/json' }));
      return;
    }
    fetch(endpoint, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: payload, keepalive: true }).catch(() => {});
  }
  setInterval(() => flush(false), 5000);
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { log('page_hide', {}); flush(true); });

  // ── 滑块手势聚合 ──
  const VAR_OF = {};
  const commit = {};
  const gest = {};
  document.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    const id = e.target && e.target.id;
    if (!(id in VAR_OF)) return;
    const v = +e.target.value;
    if (!gest[id]) gest[id] = { from: null, micro: 0, vmin: v, vmax: v, t0: performance.now() };
    const g = gest[id];
    if (g.from === null) g.from = commit[id] !== undefined ? commit[id] : v;
    g.micro++; g.vmin = Math.min(g.vmin, v); g.vmax = Math.max(g.vmax, v);
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    const id = e.target && e.target.id;
    if (!(id in VAR_OF)) return;
    const v = +e.target.value;
    const g = gest[id] || { from: commit[id], micro: 1, vmin: v, vmax: v, t0: performance.now() };
    log('var_adjust', {
      var: VAR_OF[id], from: g.from, to: v,
      micro: g.micro, vmin: g.vmin, vmax: g.vmax,
      dur_ms: Math.round(performance.now() - g.t0),
      after: snapshot(),
    });
    commit[id] = v; delete gest[id];
  }, true);

  // ── ch4 谜题快照（每局随机生成，须记录为本局金标准） ──
  function puzzleSpec() {
    try {
      return {
        choices_C: ch4Choices_C.slice(), choices_V: ch4Choices_V.slice(),
        correct_C: ch4Choices_C[ch4CorrectCI], correct_V: ch4Choices_V[ch4CorrectVI],
        E_band: [CH4_ELOW, CH4_EHIGH],
      };
    } catch (e) { return {}; }
  }

  // ── phase 看守 ──
  let _phasePrev = null;
  setInterval(() => {
    try { if (phase !== _phasePrev) { log('phase_change', { from: _phasePrev, to: phase }); _phasePrev = phase; } } catch (e) {}
  }, 200);

  log('session_start', { href: location.href });
  return { log, flush, snapshot, session, puzzleSpec };
})();

/* music.js — 自适应背景音乐引擎（独立模块）。用法注释已省略，避免 HTML script 截断。 */
(function(){
  'use strict';

  // ── 配置 ─────────────────────────────────────
  var MP3_SRC = (typeof window!=='undefined' && window.MUSIC_MP3_SRC) || 'bgm.mp3';
  var MP3_SKIP_INTRO = 6;          // 跳过 mp3 开头 ~6s 的渐弱静音引子
  var AUTOSTART = (typeof window==='undefined' || window.MUSIC_AUTOSTART!==false); // 默认首次交互即开始

  // ── 安全读取游戏状态（兼容 let 顶层变量 / window 属性 / 不存在三种情况） ──
  function getCh(){ try { if(typeof ch==='number') return ch; } catch(e){} return (typeof window!=='undefined'&&typeof window.ch==='number')?window.ch:0; }
  function getPhase(){ try { if(typeof phase!=='undefined') return phase; } catch(e){} return (typeof window!=='undefined')?window.phase:undefined; }

  var MUSIC = (function(){
    var ctx=null, master=null, busComp=null, delay=null, delayGain=null, reverb=null, revGain=null;
    var on=true, started=false, schedTimer=null, barIdx=0, nextBar=0, curTheme=null;

    // ── mp3 氛围铺底（普通 <audio>，与 Web Audio 在扬声器处混合，file:// 也可用） ──
    var audioEl=null, mp3Fade=null;
    function fadeMp3To(target,ms,pauseAtZero){
      if(!audioEl) return; if(mp3Fade) clearTimeout(mp3Fade);
      var from=audioEl.volume, t0=performance.now();
      var step=function(){ var k=Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/ms);
        audioEl.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,from+(target-from)*k));
        if(k<1) mp3Fade=setTimeout(step,30); // setTimeout：后台标签页也会触发（rAF 会冻结）
        else { mp3Fade=null; if(target===0&&pauseAtZero) audioEl.pause(); } };
      step();
    }
    function startMp3(vol){
      if(!audioEl){
        audioEl=new Audio(MP3_SRC); audioEl.loop=true; audioEl.volume=0;
        audioEl.addEventListener('timeupdate',function(){ if(audioEl.currentTime<MP3_SKIP_INTRO-0.3 && audioEl.played.length) audioEl.currentTime=MP3_SKIP_INTRO; });
      }
      audioEl.play().then(function(){ try{ if(audioEl.currentTime<MP3_SKIP_INTRO) audioEl.currentTime=MP3_SKIP_INTRO; }catch(e){} }).catch(function(){});
      fadeMp3To(vol,1200);
    }

    // 音名 → 频率
    var SEMI={C:0,'C#':1,D:2,'D#':3,E:4,F:5,'F#':6,G:7,'G#':8,A:9,'A#':10,B:11};
    function f(n){ var m=n.match(/^([A-G]#?)(\d)$/); var semi=SEMI[m[1]], oct=+m[2];
      var midi=(oct+1)*12+semi; return 440*Math.pow(2,(midi-69)/12); }

    //  作曲思路（leitmotif / 主导动机）

    var CH_THEME=['c0', 'c1', 'c2', 'c3', 'c4', 'c5', 'c6', 'c7', 'c8'];

      if(inFinaleMontage()) return 'dawn';
      var c=getCh(), ph=getPhase()||'';
      // 开场动画 + 序章开场白（标题动画 + 开场对白）：悬而未发；进入解谜后旋律绽放
      if(inPrologue()) return 'open';

    function build(){
      ctx=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
      master=ctx.createGain(); master.gain.value=0;
      busComp=ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();
      busComp.threshold.value=-14; busComp.ratio.value=3; busComp.attack.value=0.01; busComp.release.value=0.25;
      busComp.connect(master); master.connect(ctx.destination);
      delay=ctx.createDelay(); delay.delayTime.value=0.42;
      delayGain=ctx.createGain(); delayGain.gain.value=0.30;
      var dWet=ctx.createGain(); dWet.gain.value=0.5;
      delay.connect(delayGain); delayGain.connect(delay); delay.connect(dWet); dWet.connect(busComp);
      delay._in=ctx.createGain(); delay._in.connect(delay);
      reverb=ctx.createConvolver(); reverb.buffer=makeImpulse(2.4,2.2);
      revGain=ctx.createGain(); revGain.gain.value=0.5; reverb.connect(revGain); revGain.connect(busComp);
      reverb._in=ctx.createGain(); reverb._in.connect(reverb);
    }
    function makeImpulse(dur,decay){
      var rate=ctx.sampleRate, len=rate*dur, buf=ctx.createBuffer(2,len,rate);
      for(var c=0;c<2;c++){ var d=buf.getChannelData(c);
        for(var i=0;i<len;i++) d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.pow(1-i/len,decay); }
      return buf;
    }

    // ── 音色（均按当前预设 T 调整） ──────────────────
    //  长音弦垫：铺底的持续和声（comp='pad' 用）
    function padVoice(freq,cents,t,dur,T,amp){
      var o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain(),lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      o.type=T.padWave||'sawtooth'; o.frequency.value=freq; o.detune.value=cents;
      lp.type='lowpass'; lp.frequency.value=T.lp; lp.Q.value=0.6;
      o.connect(lp); lp.connect(g);
      var A=Math.min(1.1,dur*0.35), R=Math.min(1.3,dur*0.42), pk=0.045*amp;
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(pk,t+A);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(pk,Math.max(t+A,t+dur-R));
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
      g.connect(busComp); g.connect(reverb._in);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+dur+0.05);
    }
    function pad(freq,t,dur,T){
      padVoice(freq,-T.det,t,dur,T,1); padVoice(freq,T.det,t,dur,T,1);
      if(T.fuller){ padVoice(freq*0.5,-T.det,t,dur,T,0.5); padVoice(freq*0.5,T.det,t,dur,T,0.5); }
    }
    //  和弦断奏：快起快落的节奏型和声（comp='stab' 用）——章与章节奏差异的核心
    function chordStab(freq,t,dur,T){
      var wv=T.padWave||'sawtooth';
      var o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain(),lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      o.type=wv; o.frequency.value=freq;
      lp.type='lowpass'; lp.frequency.value=Math.max(1000,T.lp*0.9); lp.Q.value=0.8;
      // 断奏保持「干」声（不进混响）—— 节奏章节因此清脆有冲击，与铺底章节的湿润空灵形成鲜明对比
      o.connect(lp); lp.connect(g); g.connect(busComp);
      var bright=(wv==='square'||wv==='sawtooth'), pk=(bright?0.030:0.046);
      var d=Math.max(0.10,dur);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(pk,t+0.012);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+d);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+d+0.03);
    }
    function bass(freq,t,dur){
      var o=ctx.createOscillator(),o2=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain(),lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      o.type='sine'; o.frequency.value=freq;
      o2.type='triangle'; o2.frequency.value=freq*2;
      var g2=ctx.createGain(); g2.gain.value=0.35; o2.connect(g2); g2.connect(g);
      lp.type='lowpass'; lp.frequency.value=420;
      o.connect(g); g.connect(lp); lp.connect(busComp);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.14,t+0.04);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.14,Math.max(t+0.05,t+dur-0.4));
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
      o.start(t);o2.start(t);o.stop(t+dur+0.05);o2.stop(t+dur+0.05);
    }
    function arp(freq,t,T){
      var o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();
      o.type=T.arpWave||'triangle'; o.frequency.value=freq;
      o.connect(g); g.connect(busComp); g.connect(delay._in); g.connect(reverb._in);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.045,t+0.01);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+0.7);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+0.75);
    }
    function lead(freq,t,dur,beat,T){
      var o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain(),lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      var wv=T.leadWave||'triangle'; o.type=wv; o.frequency.value=freq;
      // 锯齿 / 方波泛音更亮，整体压低音量并收紧低通，避免刺耳
      var amp=(wv==='square'||wv==='sawtooth')?0.62:1;
      var vib=ctx.createOscillator(),vg=ctx.createGain();
      vib.frequency.value=5; vg.gain.value=freq*0.006; vib.connect(vg); vg.connect(o.frequency); vib.start(t); vib.stop(t+dur+0.1);
      lp.type='lowpass'; lp.frequency.value=Math.max(1600,T.lp);
      o.connect(lp); lp.connect(g); g.connect(busComp); g.connect(delay._in); g.connect(reverb._in);
      var d=Math.max(0.18,dur*beat);
      // 旋律是「每章听感不同」的主角 —— 显著提高音量让它浮在伴奏之上
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.15*amp,t+0.04);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.10*amp,t+0.12);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.092*amp,Math.max(t+0.13,t+d-0.12));
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+d);
      o.start(t); o.stop(t+d+0.05);
    }

    // 琶音音序索引（上行 / 下行 / 往返），让各章琶音走向也不同
    function arpIndex(q,n,dir){
      if(n<=1) return 0;
      if(dir==='down') return (n-1)-(q%n);
      if(dir==='updown'){ var p=2*n-2, k=q%p; return k<n?k:(p-k); }
      return q%n;
    }

    // ── 调度一个小节（读取当前预设，故换章数秒内即生效） ──
    function scheduleBar(i,t,T){
      var tf=Math.pow(2,(T.tr||0)/12), beat=60/T.bpm, bar=beat*4, q;
      var prog=T.prog, bassArr=T.bass, mel=T.mel;
      var chord=prog[i%prog.length], tones=chord;
      var rootHz=f(bassArr[i%bassArr.length])*tf;
      var comp=T.comp||[[0,4]], stab=(T.compVoice==='stab');
      // 和声层：长音弦垫 or 节奏断奏
      comp.forEach(function(h){
        var ht=t+h[0]*beat, hd=h[1]*beat;
        if(stab) chord.forEach(function(n){ chordStab(f(n)*tf,ht,hd,T); });
        else     chord.forEach(function(n){ pad(f(n)*tf,ht,hd,T); });
      });
      // 低音：断奏型走稳定四分根音；铺底型按和声节奏走长音
      if(stab){ for(q=0;q<4;q++) bass(rootHz,t+q*beat,beat*0.92); }
      else comp.forEach(function(h){ bass(rootHz,t+h[0]*beat,h[1]*beat); });
      // 琶音（断奏章节通常关闭，靠和弦脉冲提供律动）
      if(T.arp>0){ var dir=T.arpDir||'up';
        for(q=0;q<T.arp;q++) arp(f(tones[arpIndex(q,tones.length,dir)])*tf*2, t+(q+0.5)*(bar/T.arp), T); }
      // 旋律
      if(T.lead!=='off' && mel){
        var mt=t, loOct=Math.pow(2,T.lo||0), barMel=mel[i%mel.length];
        barMel.forEach(function(nd){ var n=nd[0], dd=nd[1];
          if(n){ if(T.lead!=='sparse'||dd>=1) lead(f(n)*tf*loOct,mt,dd,beat,T); } mt+=dd*beat; });
      }
    }
    function tick(){
      if(!ctx) return;
      var ahead=ctx.currentTime+0.3;
      while(nextBar<ahead){
        var name=desiredTheme(), T=THEMES[name];
        if(on){
          scheduleBar(barIdx,nextBar,T);
          if(name!==curTheme){ curTheme=name;
            var mp3Vol=T.mp3;
            try{ if(window.SFX && typeof window.SFX.volume==='number' && !window.SFX.muted) mp3Vol=T.mp3*window.SFX.volume; else if(window.SFX&&window.SFX.muted) mp3Vol=0; }catch(e){}
            fadeMp3To(mp3Vol,1800); }
        }
        nextBar += (60/T.bpm)*4;
        barIdx=(barIdx+1)%8;
      }
    }

    function start(){
      if(started) return; started=true;
      if(!ctx) build();
      if(ctx.state==='suspended') ctx.resume();
      // 顶部喇叭按钮是统一的音频总开关：若启动时 SFX 已静音，则音乐随之保持静音，
      // 不在静音状态下被「首次交互自动播放」偷偷唤醒。
      var vol=1;
      try{ if(window.SFX){ if(window.SFX.muted) on=false; else if(typeof window.SFX.volume==='number') vol=window.SFX.volume; } }catch(e){}
      var T=THEMES[desiredTheme()]; curTheme=desiredTheme();
      barIdx=0; nextBar=ctx.currentTime+0.2;
      schedTimer=setInterval(tick,30);
      if(on){
        startMp3(T.mp3 * vol);
        master.gain.cancelScheduledValues(ctx.currentTime);
        master.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,ctx.currentTime);
        master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol * BGM_GAIN_PEAK,ctx.currentTime+2.2);
      } else {
        master.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,ctx.currentTime);
      }
    }
    var BGM_GAIN_PEAK = 0.55;
    function applyVolume(v){
      var vol = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
      on = vol > 0.001;
      if(!started){ if(on) start(); return; }
      if(!ctx || !master) return;
      master.gain.cancelScheduledValues(ctx.currentTime);
      master.gain.setValueAtTime(master.gain.value, ctx.currentTime);
      master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol * BGM_GAIN_PEAK, ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
      if(on){
        if(audioEl && audioEl.paused) audioEl.play().catch(function(){});
        fadeMp3To((THEMES[desiredTheme()] || THEMES.c0).mp3 * vol, 500);
      } else {
        fadeMp3To(0, 500, true);
      }
    }
    function setOn(v){
      applyVolume(v ? (function(){
        try{ if(window.SFX && typeof window.SFX.volume === 'number') return window.SFX.volume; }catch(e){}
        return 1;
      })() : 0);
    }
    return { start:start, setOn:setOn, applyVolume:applyVolume,
      get on(){return on;}, get ctx(){return ctx;},
      THEMES:THEMES, CH_THEME:CH_THEME }; // 暴露预设表，便于运行时微调
  })();

  // 全局可访问（游戏内的点击音效等也可复用 MUSIC.ctx）
  if(typeof window!=='undefined') window.MUSIC = MUSIC;

  // ── 自动播放策略 + 右下角开关按钮 ──────────────
  function wireUI(){
    if(AUTOSTART){
      var kick=function(){ MUSIC.start(); ['pointerdown','keydown','touchstart'].forEach(function(e){ window.removeEventListener(e,kick); }); };
      ['pointerdown','keydown','touchstart'].forEach(function(e){ window.addEventListener(e,kick,{once:false}); });
    }
    // 游戏顶栏已有统一的音频总开关（#sfx-btn，由 audio.js 驱动，会一并控制本音乐引擎）。
    // 此时不再生成右下角这个独立的「♪ 音乐」按钮，避免出现两个互相矛盾的音频开关。
    if(typeof document!=='undefined' && document.getElementById('sfx-btn')) return;
    var btn=document.createElement('div');
    btn.title='背景音乐开关';
    var mon=true;
    function lbl(){ btn.textContent = mon ? '♪ 音乐 ON' : '♪ 音乐 OFF'; }
    btn.style.cssText='position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:74px;z-index:99999;padding:8px 14px;'+
      'display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;font-size:14px;'+
      'font-family:"Courier New",monospace;letter-spacing:1px;cursor:pointer;'+
      'color:rgba(0,220,255,0.95);border:1px solid rgba(0,220,255,0.55);border-radius:20px;'+
      'background:rgba(2,16,30,0.85);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,200,255,0.25);'+
      'transition:all .2s;user-select:none;';
    lbl();
    btn.onmouseenter=function(){ btn.style.borderColor='rgba(0,220,255,0.9)'; };
    btn.onmouseleave=function(){ btn.style.borderColor=mon?'rgba(0,220,255,0.55)':'rgba(120,140,160,0.4)'; };
    btn.onclick=function(ev){ ev.stopPropagation(); mon=!mon; MUSIC.setOn(mon); lbl();
      btn.style.opacity=mon?'1':'0.55';
      btn.style.color=mon?'rgba(0,220,255,0.95)':'rgba(150,170,190,0.7)';
      btn.style.borderColor=mon?'rgba(0,220,255,0.55)':'rgba(120,140,160,0.4)'; };
    document.body.appendChild(btn);
  }
  if(typeof document!=='undefined'){
    if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',wireUI);
    else wireUI();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
/* === dual-mode-manual runtime === */
(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeManual) return;
  window.__dualModeManual = true;
  var MAX=5;
  var EXP=600;
  var state={mode:'explore',attempts:MAX,timeLeft:EXP,timerId:null};
  function $(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
  function setPhase(p){
    try{
      if(typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase==='function') window.__platformTraceSetPhase(p);
      else if(window.PlatformTraceAdapter&&window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase) window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(p);
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function fmt(sec){var m=Math.floor(sec/60),s=sec%60;return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':'+(s<10?'0':'')+s;}
  function stop(){if(state.timerId){clearInterval(state.timerId);state.timerId=null;}}
  function render(){
    var label=$('modeLabel'),stats=$('challengeStats'),att=$('attemptsDisplay'),td=$('timerDisplay'),chip=$('dual-timer-chip');
    if(label) label.textContent=state.mode==='explore'?'探究模式':'竞赛模式';
    if(stats){ if(state.mode==='challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible'); else stats.classList.remove('is-visible'); }
    if(att) att.textContent=String(state.attempts);
    if(chip) chip.style.display=state.mode==='explore'?'inline-flex':'none';
    if(td) td.textContent=fmt(Math.max(0,state.timeLeft));
  }
  function startTimer(){
    stop(); state.timeLeft=EXP; render();
    state.timerId=setInterval(function(){
      if(state.mode!=='explore') return;
      state.timeLeft--; render();
      if(state.timeLeft<=0){
        stop();
        var sel=$('modeSelect');
        if(sel){ sel.value='challenge'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); }
      }
    },1000);
  }
  function apply(mode){
    state.mode=mode==='challenge'?'challenge':'explore';
    if(state.mode==='challenge'){ stop(); state.attempts=MAX; }
    else startTimer();
    render(); setPhase(state.mode);
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dual-mode-change',{detail:{mode:state.mode,attempts:state.attempts}}));
  }
  function consume(){
    if(state.mode!=='challenge') return true;
    if(state.attempts<=0) return false;
    state.attempts--; render();
    return state.attempts>=0;
  }
  window.__dualModeConsumeAttempt=consume;
  window.__dualModeGet=function(){return {mode:state.mode,attempts:state.attempts};};
  function boot(){
    var sel=$('modeSelect');
    if(!sel) return;
    sel.addEventListener('change',function(){ apply(sel.value); });
    apply(sel.value||'explore');
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>

  /* ---------- 2. 数学排版小工具 ---------- */

  /* ---------- 3. 各章推导内容 ---------- */
  var DERIV = {

    1:{accent:'#6ec0ff',kicker:'公式推导 · 第一章',title:'介质与击穿',sub:'介质如何把电容放大 εᵣ 倍',
      steps:[

      ],

        {m:'C并 = '+f('Q','U')+' = C₁ + C₂',n:'像把极板加宽'},
        {grp:'串联 · 电荷相同'},
        {m:'各电容电荷都 = Q',n:'中间感应出等量异号电荷'},
        {m:'总电压相加　U = '+f('Q','C₁')+' + '+f('Q','C₂'),n:''},

        {m:'解得　q(t) = CU(1 − e<sup>−t ∕ RC</sup>)',n:'电压按指数曲线上升'},
        {m:'指数里 t 与 RC 同量纲 → 令 τ = RC',n:'τ 就是这条曲线的"节拍"'}
      ],
      final:'τ = R · C',away:'每过一个 τ 充到约 63%，约 5τ 基本充满'},

        {m:'电感电压 L '+f('di','dt')+' 与电容电压 '+f('q','C')+' 此消彼长',n:'能量在 L 与 C 之间往返'},

  /* ---------- 4. DOM 构建 ---------- */
  var overlay=document.createElement('div');overlay.id='dv-overlay';
  overlay.innerHTML='<div id="dv-card"></div>';
  var reopen=document.createElement('div');reopen.id='dv-reopen';
  reopen.innerHTML='<span class="dv-fx">ƒ</span><span>公式推导</span>';
  function attach(){
    if(!document.body)return;
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);
    document.body.appendChild(reopen);
  }
  if(document.body)attach();else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',attach);

  var card=overlay.querySelector('#dv-card');
  var timers=[],fastForwarded=false,seen={},open=false;

  function clearTimers(){timers.forEach(clearTimeout);timers=[];}

  function revealAll(){
    fastForwarded=true;clearTimers();
    card.querySelectorAll('.dv-step,.dv-grp').forEach(function(e){e.classList.add('show');});
    var ex=card.querySelector('.dv-extra');if(ex)ex.classList.add('show');
    var fn=card.querySelector('.dv-final');if(fn)fn.classList.add('show');
    var aw=card.querySelector('.dv-away');if(aw)aw.classList.add('show');
  }

  function build(idx){
    var d=DERIV[idx];if(!d)return false;
    card.style.setProperty('--dv-accent',d.accent);
    var h='<div class="dv-kicker">'+d.kicker+'</div>'
         +'<div class="dv-title">'+d.title+'</div>'
         +'<div class="dv-sub">'+d.sub+'</div>'
         +'<div class="dv-steps">';
    var n=0;
    d.steps.forEach(function(s){
      if(s.grp){h+='<div class="dv-grp">'+s.grp+'</div>';return;}
      n++;
      h+='<div class="dv-step"><div class="dv-num-chip">'+n+'</div><div class="dv-body">'
        +'<div class="dv-math">'+s.m+'</div>'
        +(s.n?'<div class="dv-note">'+s.n+'</div>':'')+'</div></div>';
    });
    h+='</div>';
    if(d.extra)h+='<div class="dv-extra">'+d.extra+'</div>';
    h+='<div class="dv-final">'+d.final+'</div>';
    if(d.away)h+='<div class="dv-away">▸ '+d.away+'</div>';
    h+='<div class="dv-actions"><button class="dv-skip" type="button">点击任意处展开全部</button>'
      +'<button class="dv-go" type="button">进 入 关 卡 ▶</button></div>';
    card.innerHTML=h;
    card.querySelector('.dv-go').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();close();});
    card.querySelector('.dv-skip').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();revealAll();});
    return true;
  }

  function animate(){
    var rows=Array.prototype.slice.call(card.querySelectorAll('.dv-step,.dv-grp'));
    var delay=180,gap=480;
    rows.forEach(function(el,i){
      timers.push(setTimeout(function(){el.classList.add('show');if(typeof SFX!=='undefined'&&SFX.play){try{SFX.play('uiClick');}catch(e){}}},delay+i*gap));
    });
    var after=delay+rows.length*gap;
    var ex=card.querySelector('.dv-extra');
    if(ex){timers.push(setTimeout(function(){ex.classList.add('show');},after));after+=gap;}
    timers.push(setTimeout(function(){var fn=card.querySelector('.dv-final');if(fn){fn.classList.add('show');if(typeof SFX!=='undefined'&&SFX.play){try{SFX.play('dlgAdvance');}catch(e){}}}},after));
    timers.push(setTimeout(function(){var aw=card.querySelector('.dv-away');if(aw)aw.classList.add('show');},after+gap*0.7));
  }

  function show(idx){
    if(!DERIV[idx])return;
    open=true;fastForwarded=false;clearTimers();
    if(!build(idx))return;
    reopen.style.display='none';
    overlay.style.display='flex';
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){requestAnimationFrame(function(){overlay.classList.add('show');});});
    animate();
  }

  function close(){
    open=false;clearTimers();
    overlay.classList.remove('show');
    setTimeout(function(){overlay.style.display='none';},460);
    showReopenForCurrent();
  }

  // 点击卡片空白处 = 展开全部（不关闭，避免误触跳过）
  card.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(e.target.closest('.dv-go')||e.target.closest('.dv-skip'))return;
    if(!fastForwarded)revealAll();
  });
  overlay.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===overlay)revealAll();});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(!open)return;
    if(e.key==='Escape'){close();}
    else if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){if(!fastForwarded){revealAll();}else{close();}e.preventDefault();}
  });
  reopen.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();var c=curCh();if(DERIV[c])show(c);});

  /* ---------- 5. 与游戏挂钩 ---------- */
  function curCh(){
    try{if(typeof window.ch==='number')return window.ch;}catch(e){}
    try{if(typeof ch==='number')return ch;}catch(e){}
    return -1;
  }
  function showReopenForCurrent(){
    var c=curCh();
    if(DERIV[c]&&!open){
      reopen.style.setProperty('--dv-accent',DERIV[c].accent);
      reopen.style.display='flex';
    }else{
      reopen.style.display='none';
    }
  }

  function hookOpenPuzzle(){
    if(typeof window.openPuzzle!=='function')return false;
    if(window.openPuzzle.__dvHooked)return true;
    var orig=window.openPuzzle;
    var wrapped=function(){
      var r=orig.apply(this,arguments);
      // 探究中不剧透：开场不自动弹出公式推导；过关后再开放重看
      reopen.style.display='none';
      return r;
    };
    wrapped.__dvHooked=true;
    window.openPuzzle=wrapped;
    return true;
  }
  // 进入新章节的对白时，隐藏重开按钮，避免在地图/序幕里残留
  function hookBeginIntro(){
    if(typeof window.beginChapterIntro!=='function')return false;
    if(window.beginChapterIntro.__dvHooked)return true;
    var orig=window.beginChapterIntro;
    var wrapped=function(){reopen.style.display='none';return orig.apply(this,arguments);};
    wrapped.__dvHooked=true;
    window.beginChapterIntro=wrapped;
    return true;
  }

  // 主脚本可能在本脚本之后才定义函数，做几次重试挂钩
  var tries=0;
  (function tryHook(){
    var a=hookOpenPuzzle(),b=hookBeginIntro();
    if((a&&b)||tries>40)return;
    tries++;setTimeout(tryHook,150);
  })();

  // 暴露给调试/手动调用
  window.showDerivation=show;
  // 过关后才开放公式推导（符合探究不剧透）
  (function hookWinForDerive(){
    if (window.__dvWinHooked) return;
    function wrap(name){
      if (typeof window[name] !== 'function' || window[name].__dvWinHooked) return false;
      var orig = window[name];
      var wrapped = function(){
        var r = orig.apply(this, arguments);
        try {
          var c = curCh();
          if (DERIV[c] && !seen[c]) {
            seen[c] = true;
            setTimeout(function(){ show(c); }, 600);
          } else {
            showReopenForCurrent();
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        return r;
      };
      wrapped.__dvWinHooked = true;
      window[name] = wrapped;
      return true;
    }
    var tries = 0;
    (function tryW(){
      var ok = wrap('showWin') || wrap('__craftShowWin');
      // also patch craft win reveal if present
      var cw = document.getElementById('craft-win');
      if (cw && !cw.__dvObs) {
        cw.__dvObs = true;
        var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){
          if (!cw.hidden && cw.style.display !== 'none') {
            try {
              var c = curCh();
              if (DERIV[c]) showReopenForCurrent();
            } catch (e) {}
          }
        });
        mo.observe(cw, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['hidden', 'style', 'class'] });
      }
      if (ok || tries > 50) { window.__dvWinHooked = true; return; }
      tries++; setTimeout(tryW, 200);
    })();
  })();

})();
</script>

  /* 序～七：取消逐字打字，整行直接浮现（与开头字幕同款） */
  function hookSetLine(){

  /* 第八章：整行浮现 + 自动过场（与序～七同款；轮询驱动，避免逐字观察的竞态） */
  function ch8Ref(){ try{ if(typeof CH8!=='undefined'&&CH8) return CH8; }catch(e){} return window.CH8||null; }
  function ch8Advance(){ var C=ch8Ref(); if(C&&C._advanceDlg){ try{C._advanceDlg();}catch(e){} } }
  function ch8AutoCine(){
    var lastLen=0, holdUntil=0, armed=false, advancing=false, gen=0;
    function loop(){
      var box=document.getElementById('ch8-dialogue');
      var el=document.getElementById('ch8-dlg-text');
      var on = box && el && getComputedStyle(box).display!=='none';
      if(on){
        var t=el.textContent||'';
        // 新的一行：setLine 刚写入首字（长度回落到 1）
        if(t.length===1 && lastLen!==1){
          gen++;
          applyAccent();
          ch8Advance();                 // 立即补全整行（取消逐字）
          cine('ch8-dlg-text');
          var full=el.textContent||'';
          holdUntil=performance.now()+holdMs(full.length);
          armed=true; advancing=false;
        } else if(armed && !advancing && performance.now()>=holdUntil){
          armed=false; advancing=true;
          var myGen=gen;
          cineOut('ch8-dlg-text');
          setTimeout(function(){
            advancing=false;

            var b=document.getElementById('ch8-dialogue');

          },480);

      } else { lastLen=0; armed=false; advancing=false; }
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);

  /* ---------- 规则按钮显隐 ---------- */
  var GAMEPLAY=['controls','controls2','controls3','controls4','controls5','controls6','controls7','ch8-console-hud','phase-experiment'];
  function isVis(el){if(!el)return false;var cs=getComputedStyle(el);if(cs.display==='none'||cs.visibility==='hidden')return false;if(parseFloat(cs.opacity||'1')<0.05)return false;var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return r.width>2&&r.height>2;}
  function anyVis(ids){for(var i=0;i<ids.length;i++)if(isVis(document.getElementById(ids[i])))return true;return false;}
  function summaryVis(){if(isVis(document.getElementById('ch8-summary')))return true;var e=document.querySelectorAll('.ch-summary');for(var i=0;i<e.length;i++)if(isVis(e[i]))return true;return false;}
  function overlayOpen(){var a=document.getElementById('dv-overlay'),b=document.getElementById('rl-overlay');return (a&&getComputedStyle(a).display!=='none')||(b&&getComputedStyle(b).display!=='none');}
  function updateRuleBtn(){

  var tries=0;(function t(){var a=hookSetLine(),b=hookBegin();if((a&&b)||tries>40)return;tries++;setTimeout(t,150);})();
})();

<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     剧情背景动画（电磁余晖）— 独立模块，可整段删除
     仅在剧情对白阶段显示：分级色罩 + 流动极光带 + 发光电荷粒子 +
     景深光斑 + 偶发放电弧 + 暗角。按章节主题色，requestAnimationFrame 绘制。
     ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';
  var ACC={0:'#37c8ff',1:'#37c8ff',2:'#ff9a3c',3:'#5cf08c',4:'#ffcf4a',5:'#37d8ff',6:'#b06bff',7:'#37c8ff',8:'#e8c270'};
  function curCh(){try{if(typeof window.ch==='number')return window.ch;}catch(e){}return -1;}
  function hex2rgb(h){h=(h||'').replace('#','');return [parseInt(h.substr(0,2),16)||55,parseInt(h.substr(2,2),16)||200,parseInt(h.substr(4,2),16)||255];}
  function rnd(a,b){return a+Math.random()*(b-a);}

  var cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.id='story-bg';
  cv.style.cssText='position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:20;display:none;pointer-events:none;';
  (function attach(){if(document.body)document.body.appendChild(cv);else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',attach);})();
  var cx=cv.getContext('2d');
  var W=1,H=1,DPR=1;
  function resize(){DPR=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);W=window.innerWidth;H=window.innerHeight;cv.width=Math.max(1,W*DPR);cv.height=Math.max(1,H*DPR);cv.style.width=W+'px';cv.style.height=H+'px';cx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);initField();}
  window.addEventListener('resize',resize);

  /* 主题色（平滑过渡） */
  var col=[55,200,255],tgt=[55,200,255];
  function setTheme(c){tgt=hex2rgb(ACC[c]||'#37c8ff');}

  /* 发光精灵（drawImage 比 shadowBlur 快很多） */
  var sprite=document.createElement('canvas'),sctx=sprite.getContext('2d');
  function buildSprite(rgb){var S=64;sprite.width=S;sprite.height=S;var g=sctx.createRadialGradient(S/2,S/2,0,S/2,S/2,S/2);
    g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)');g.addColorStop(0.28,'rgba('+rgb[0]+','+rgb[1]+','+rgb[2]+',0.8)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba('+rgb[0]+','+rgb[1]+','+rgb[2]+',0)');
    sctx.clearRect(0,0,S,S);sctx.fillStyle=g;sctx.fillRect(0,0,S,S);}
  buildSprite(col);
  var whiteSprite=document.createElement('canvas');(function(){var s=64,c=whiteSprite.getContext('2d');whiteSprite.width=s;whiteSprite.height=s;
    var g=c.createRadialGradient(s/2,s/2,0,s/2,s/2,s/2);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)');g.addColorStop(0.32,'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,s,s);})();

  /* 场内元素 */
  var P=[],B=[],R=[],NP=26;
  function newP(init){return {x:rnd(0,W),y:init?rnd(0,H):H+rnd(0,40),vx:rnd(-4,4),vy:rnd(-15,-6),r:rnd(1.4,3.0),a:rnd(0.16,0.46),ph:rnd(0,6.28),sw:rnd(0.3,0.85),hot:Math.random()<0.10};}
  function initField(){
    P=[];for(var i=0;i<NP;i++)P.push(newP(true));
    B=[];for(var j=0;j<3;j++)B.push({x:rnd(0,W),y:rnd(0,H),r:rnd(130,270),vx:rnd(-3,3),vy:rnd(-5,2),a:rnd(0.02,0.045)});
    R=[];for(var k=0;k<2;k++)R.push({y:rnd(0.24,0.8),amp:rnd(26,60),len:rnd(0.8,1.5),sp:rnd(0.05,0.1)*(Math.random()<.5?-1:1),ph:rnd(0,6.28),a:rnd(0.035,0.06),th:rnd(64,140)});
  }
  resize();

  var arc=null,arcT=0,arcLife=0,nextArc=520+Math.random()*600;
  function makeArc(){var x=rnd(0,W),y=rnd(0,H*0.85),pts=[{x:x,y:y}],n=8+(Math.random()*8|0),dir=rnd(0,6.28);
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){dir+=rnd(-0.85,0.85);x+=Math.cos(dir)*rnd(12,42);y+=Math.sin(dir)*rnd(12,42);pts.push({x:x,y:y});}return pts;}

  function visible(){var d=document.getElementById('dialogue'),e=document.getElementById('ch8-dialogue');
    return (d&&getComputedStyle(d).display!=='none')||(e&&getComputedStyle(e).display!=='none');}

  var last=performance.now(),tick=0,env=0;
  function frame(now){
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    var dt=Math.min(50,now-last)/16.67;last=now;
    if(!visible()){if(cv.style.display!=='none')cv.style.display='none';env=0;return;}
    if(cv.style.display==='none')cv.style.display='block';
    tick++;
    env=Math.min(1,env+0.05*dt);   // 整体柔和淡入（剧情开场不再生硬弹出）
    var moved=false;for(var c=0;c<3;c++){var d2=tgt[c]-col[c];if(Math.abs(d2)>0.5){col[c]+=d2*0.06;moved=true;}}
    if(moved&&tick%5===0)buildSprite([col[0]|0,col[1]|0,col[2]|0]);
    var rr=col[0]|0,gg=col[1]|0,bb=col[2]|0;

    cx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

    /* 分级色罩 */
    var bw=cx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    bw.addColorStop(0,'rgba('+(rr*0.18|0)+','+(gg*0.18|0)+','+(bb*0.18|0)+',0.30)');
    bw.addColorStop(0.5,'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)');
    bw.addColorStop(1,'rgba('+(rr*0.12|0)+','+(gg*0.12|0)+','+(bb*0.12|0)+',0.32)');
    cx.fillStyle=bw;cx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    cx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';

    /* 极光带 */
    for(var ri=0;ri<R.length;ri++){var rb=R[ri];rb.ph+=rb.sp*0.02*dt;var yy=rb.y*H;
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(0,yy);
      for(var xx=0;xx<=W;xx+=16){var off=Math.sin(xx*0.006*rb.len+rb.ph)*rb.amp+Math.sin(xx*0.013+rb.ph*1.7)*rb.amp*0.3;cx.lineTo(xx,yy+off);}
      cx.strokeStyle='rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+(rb.a*env)+')';cx.lineWidth=rb.th;cx.lineCap='round';cx.stroke();
    }

    /* 体积光束（god-rays）— 从顶部斜射而下的柔光，缓慢摆动，更有电影质感 */
    for(var gi=0;gi<3;gi++){
      var sway=Math.sin(tick*0.006+gi*2.1)*0.18;
      var ox=W*(0.22+gi*0.30)+Math.sin(tick*0.004+gi)*W*0.04;
      cx.save();
      cx.translate(ox,-H*0.10);
      cx.rotate(0.32+sway+gi*0.05);
      var rayLen=H*1.25, rayW=W*(0.10+gi*0.03);
      var rg=cx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,rayLen);
      var ra=(0.045+gi*0.012)*env;
      rg.addColorStop(0,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+ra+')');
      rg.addColorStop(0.55,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+(ra*0.35)+')');
      rg.addColorStop(1,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+',0)');
      cx.fillStyle=rg;
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(-rayW*0.3,0);cx.lineTo(rayW*0.3,0);cx.lineTo(rayW,rayLen);cx.lineTo(-rayW,rayLen);cx.closePath();cx.fill();
      cx.restore();
    }

    /* 景深光斑 */
    for(var bi=0;bi<B.length;bi++){var bk=B[bi];bk.x+=bk.vx*0.1*dt;bk.y+=bk.vy*0.1*dt;
      if(bk.y<-bk.r){bk.y=H+bk.r;bk.x=rnd(0,W);}if(bk.x<-bk.r)bk.x=W+bk.r;if(bk.x>W+bk.r)bk.x=-bk.r;
      var bg=cx.createRadialGradient(bk.x,bk.y,0,bk.x,bk.y,bk.r);
      bg.addColorStop(0,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+bk.a+')');bg.addColorStop(1,'rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+',0)');
      cx.fillStyle=bg;cx.fillRect(bk.x-bk.r,bk.y-bk.r,bk.r*2,bk.r*2);
    }

    /* 电荷粒子 */
    for(var pi=0;pi<P.length;pi++){var p=P[pi];p.ph+=0.02*dt;
      p.x+=(p.vx+Math.sin(p.ph)*p.sw)*0.1*dt;p.y+=p.vy*0.1*dt;
      if(p.y<-12||p.x<-24||p.x>W+24){P[pi]=newP(false);continue;}
      var sz=p.r*(p.hot?5:6);
      cx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,p.a*(0.6+0.4*Math.sin(p.ph*2))*env));
      cx.drawImage(p.hot?whiteSprite:sprite,p.x-sz/2,p.y-sz/2,sz,sz);
    }
    cx.globalAlpha=1;

    /* 偶发放电弧（闪电感的「闪光」）——只在雷暴/电塔题材的章节出现，
       其余章节进场保持安静，不再每章都闪。 */
    var _c=curCh(), _storm=(_c===6||_c===7||_c===8);
    if(_storm){
      arcT++;
      if(!arc&&arcT>nextArc){arc=makeArc();arcLife=0;}
      if(arc){arcLife+=dt;var la=Math.max(0,1-arcLife/15);
        if(la<=0){arc=null;arcT=0;nextArc=560+Math.random()*640;}
        else{cx.strokeStyle='rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+(0.30*la)+')';cx.lineWidth=1.4;
          cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(arc[0].x,arc[0].y);for(var ai=1;ai<arc.length;ai++)cx.lineTo(arc[ai].x,arc[ai].y);cx.stroke();}
      }
    } else { arc=null; arcT=0; }

    cx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';

    /* 暗角（聚焦中央、便于阅读） */
    var vg=cx.createRadialGradient(W/2,H*0.55,Math.min(W,H)*0.20,W/2,H*0.55,Math.max(W,H)*0.78);
    vg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');vg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,'+(0.55*env)+')');
    cx.fillStyle=vg;cx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    /* 电影感黑边（letterbox）— 随淡入展开，营造宽银幕过场质感 */
    var lb=Math.round(Math.min(70,H*0.072)*env);
    if(lb>0.5){
      var tb=cx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,lb);
      tb.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0.92)');tb.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
      cx.fillStyle=tb;cx.fillRect(0,0,W,lb);
      var bb2=cx.createLinearGradient(0,H-lb,0,H);
      bb2.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');bb2.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0.92)');
      cx.fillStyle=bb2;cx.fillRect(0,H-lb,W,lb);
      // 细发光描边，让黑边边缘更精致
      cx.fillStyle='rgba('+rr+','+gg+','+bb+','+(0.10*env)+')';
      cx.fillRect(0,lb-1,W,1);cx.fillRect(0,H-lb,W,1);
    }
  }

  setInterval(function(){var c=curCh();if(ACC[c])setTheme(c);},400);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
